richDetail: [TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Not shaking or moving (used in the book when Griffith tells everyone to keep the dragon calm while putting on the saddle)[/EN][CN]平稳的；稳定的（书中指格里菲斯让大家给龙装马鞍时，让龙保持不摇晃）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈstedɪ/[/PH][DU]"Steady now," warned Griffith, the king's wizard.|(原文例句)“现在稳住，”国王的巫师格里菲斯警告道。[/DU][DU]Keep steady when you stand on the dragon's back.|站在龙背上时要保持平稳。[/DU][DU]The little bird stayed steady on the thin branch.|小鸟稳稳地停在细树枝上。[/DU][/DEF] [IMG]infopic01/steady.webp[/IMG] [DEF][EN]To make something stop shaking or moving[/EN][CN]使平稳；稳住[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo steadied the saddle before putting it on Shu.|波在给舒装马鞍前先稳住了它。[/DU][DU]She steadied the bowl with both hands.|她用双手稳住了碗。[/DU][DU]The hiker steadied himself against the rock.|徒步旅行者靠着石头稳住了身体。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]steady hand|平稳的手[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]You need a steady hand to feed the small dragon.|喂小龙需要手稳。[/EX][EX]The artist has a steady hand to draw fine lines.|艺术家有一双平稳的手来画细线。[/EX][C]a steady hand for painting|画画用的平稳的手[/C][C]a steady hand for cooking|做饭用的平稳的手[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]steady oneself|稳住自己[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He steadied himself on the dragon's saddle.|他在龙的马鞍上稳住了自己。[/EX][EX]She steadied herself when the wind blew hard.|大风刮起时，她稳住了自己。[/EX][C]steady oneself against the wind|逆风稳住自己[/C][C]steady oneself on the ladder|在梯子上稳住自己[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon flew at a steady pace through the sky.[POS]adj.[/POS]|龙以平稳的速度在空中飞行。[/EX][EX]The water in the lake is steady on calm days.[POS]adj.[/POS]|无风的日子里，湖面很平稳。[/EX][EX]He steadied the box so it wouldn't fall off the table.[POS]v.[/POS]|他稳住了盒子，不让它从桌子上掉下来。[/EX][EX]The teacher steadied the student's hand to write neatly.[POS]v.[/POS]|老师稳住学生的手，让他写得工整。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 steady 和 stable！steady 侧重“动作、状态不摇晃”，stable 侧重“结构、局势稳定”，比如“稳定的工作”是 a stable job，不是 a steady job。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，直接接宾语，不能说“steady on sth”，正确表达：steady the saddle（稳住马鞍）。[/ERR][ERR]作形容词时，修饰名词要放在前面，不能说“a hand steady”，正确表达：a steady hand（平稳的手）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A seat for riding a dragon or horse (used in the book when the Dragon Masters put seats on their dragons for travel)[/EN][CN]马鞍；鞍具（书中指龙法师们给龙装的供骑行的座位）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈsædl/[/PH][DU]We have never tried putting a saddle on a dragon before.|(原文例句)我们以前从未试过给龙装马鞍。[/DU][DU]The cowboy put a saddle on his horse before riding.|牛仔骑马前给马装上了马鞍。[/DU][DU]The dragon's saddle is made of soft cloth.|龙的鞍具是用柔软的布料做的。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/saddle.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To put a saddle on an animal[/EN][CN]给……装马鞍；套上鞍具[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo saddled Shu carefully to avoid hurting her.|(原文相关例句)波小心地给舒装鞍具，以免弄伤她。[/DU][DU]They saddled the horses early in the morning for the trip.|他们一大早给马装鞍，准备出发。[/DU][DU]Can you help me saddle the pony?|你能帮我给小马装鞍具吗？[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]put a saddle on|给……装马鞍[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The Dragon Masters put a saddle on each dragon.|龙法师们给每条龙都装了马鞍。[/EX][EX]She put a saddle on her pet goat for fun.|她给宠物山羊装了鞍具，玩得很开心。[/EX][C]put a saddle on a dragon|给龙装马鞍[/C][C]put a saddle on a horse|给马装马鞍[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]ride with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的……[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Riding with a saddle is safer than riding without.|骑着带鞍具的动物比没装鞍具更安全。[/EX][EX]The knight rode with a shiny saddle on his horse.|骑士骑着带有闪亮鞍具的马。[/EX][C]ride a dragon with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的龙[/C][C]ride a horse with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的马[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The saddle on Vulcan was red like his scales.[POS]n.[/POS]|伏尔坎背上的鞍具和他的鳞片一样红。[/EX][EX]We need to clean the saddle after riding in the mud.[POS]n.[/POS]|在泥地里骑完后，我们需要清理鞍具。[/EX][EX]He saddled the dragon quickly and climbed on its back.[POS]v.[/POS]|他快速给龙装完鞍具，爬上了龙背。[/EX][EX]She saddled her toy dragon and pretended to fly.[POS]v.[/POS]|她给玩具龙装了鞍具，假装飞行。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]作名词时，复数形式是 saddles，不能说“a saddle of dragon”，正确表达是 a dragon's saddle（龙的马鞍）。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，直接接宾语，不能说“saddle on the dragon”，正确表达：saddle the dragon（给龙装鞍具）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 saddle 和 seat！saddle 是“专门用于骑马/龙的鞍具”，seat 是泛指“座位”，比如“椅子上的座位”是 a seat on the chair。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A fastener for a strap or belt (used in the book when Bo uses the fastener to fix the saddle on Shu)[/EN][CN]带扣；搭扣（书中指波用来固定龙鞍具的扣件）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbʌkl/[/PH][DU]Bo, bring the buckle under Shu's belly.|(原文例句)波，把带扣绕到舒的肚子底下。[/DU][DU]The buckle on my backpack keeps the strap tight.|我背包上的带扣让带子保持紧绷。[/DU][DU]The cowboy's belt has a silver buckle.|牛仔的腰带上有一个银色的带扣。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/buckle.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To fasten with a buckle[/EN][CN]扣上；扣紧[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo buckled the saddle strap tightly under Shu's belly.|(原文相关例句)波把鞍具的带子在舒的肚子底下扣紧。[/DU][DU]She buckled her shoes before running outside.|她跑出去前扣好了鞋子的搭扣。[/DU][DU]Can you help me buckle this belt?|你能帮我扣上这条腰带吗？[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]fasten the buckle|扣上带扣[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Fasten the buckle before riding the dragon.|骑龙前把带扣扣紧。[/EX][EX]He fastened the buckle on his suitcase tightly.|他把行李箱上的带扣紧紧扣上。[/EX][C]fasten a belt buckle|扣上腰带扣[/C][C]fasten a saddle buckle|扣上鞍具带扣[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]buckle up|系好安全带（口语常用）[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Buckle up before the car starts.|车启动前系好安全带。[/EX][EX]The teacher told the kids to buckle up on the school bus.|老师让孩子们在校车上系好安全带。[/EX][C]buckle up for safety|为安全系好安全带[/C][C]buckle up quickly|快速系好安全带[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The buckle on the saddle is made of strong metal.[POS]n.[/POS]|鞍具上的带扣是用坚固的金属做的。[/EX][EX]I lost the buckle of my favorite bag.|我弄丢了我最喜欢的包的带扣。[/EX][EX]She buckled the strap so the bag wouldn't fall off.|她扣紧了带子，这样包就不会掉下来了。[/EX][EX]He buckled his helmet before riding the bike.|他骑自行车前扣紧了头盔。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 buckle 和 button！buckle 是“带扣”，用于固定带子；button 是“纽扣”，用于固定衣服，比如“衬衫纽扣”是 shirt button。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，“扣上带扣”是 buckle the buckle（正确），不要重复表达为“buckle the fastener”（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]作名词时，复数形式是 buckles，不能说“bucklees”（错误拼写）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make something more tight (used in the book when Bo makes the saddle buckle more firm on Shu)[/EN][CN]拉紧；拧紧；使变紧（书中指波把舒身上的鞍具带扣拉得更紧）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈtaɪtn/[/PH][DU]Now tighten the buckle. Good!|(原文例句)现在把带扣拉紧。很好！[/DU][DU]Tighten the rope so the box won't move.|拉紧绳子，让箱子不会动。[/DU][DU]Can you tighten this screw with a screwdriver?|你能用螺丝刀把这个螺丝拧紧吗？[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tighten.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To become more tight[/EN][CN]变紧；收紧[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The belt tightens up when you pull it hard.|你用力一拉，腰带就会收紧。[/DU][DU]The cold air makes the rubber band tighten up.|冷空气让橡皮筋变紧了。[/DU][DU]The rope tightens as the boat moves away.|船开走时，绳子会变紧。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]tighten a buckle|拉紧带扣[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Bo tightened the buckle to keep the saddle in place.|波拉紧了带扣，让鞍具固定住。[/EX][EX]She tightened the buckle on her shoes before walking.|她走路前拉紧了鞋子的搭扣。[/EX][C]tighten a saddle buckle|拉紧鞍具带扣[/C][C]tighten a belt buckle|拉紧腰带扣[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]tighten up|变紧；收紧[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The muscles in his legs tightened up after running.|跑步后他腿上的肌肉收紧了。[/EX][EX]The rope tightens up when the wind blows.|刮风时，绳子会变紧。[/EX][C]tighten up the rules|收紧规则[/C][C]tighten up the budget|收紧预算[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]He tightened the lid of the jar so the food wouldn't go bad.[POS]v.[/POS]|他拧紧了瓶盖，让食物不会变质。[/EX][EX]The coach told the players to tighten their shoelaces.[POS]v.[/POS]|教练让球员们系紧鞋带。[/EX][EX]The dress tightens up when you sit down.[POS]v.[/POS]|你坐下时，裙子会变紧。[/EX][EX]The rope tightens up as the weight pulls it down.[POS]v.[/POS]|重物往下拉时，绳子会变紧。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 tighten 和 fasten！tighten 侧重“使已有的变得更紧”，fasten 侧重“将分开的固定在一起”，比如“扣上纽扣”是 fasten the button，“拉紧腰带”是 tighten the belt。[/ERR][ERR]作及物动词时直接接宾语，不要说“tighten up the rope”（虽可，但 tighten the rope 更简洁）。[/ERR][ERR]不要写成“tightenning”（错误拼写），正确现在分词形式是 tightening。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A person who makes things by hand (used in the book when the castle workers make saddles for dragons)[/EN][CN]工匠；手艺人（书中指城堡里为龙制作鞍具的手工制作者）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkrɑːftə(r)/（英式）/ˈkræftər/（美式）[/PH][DU]King Roland's crafters are making a saddle for each dragon.|(原文例句)罗兰德国王的工匠们正在给每条龙做马鞍。[/DU][DU]The crafter made a beautiful toy dragon with wood.|工匠用木头做了一个漂亮的玩具龙。[/DU][DU]My grandma is a crafter who knits warm sweaters.|我奶奶是个手艺人，会织温暖的毛衣。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/crafter.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A skilled worker who creates things with their hands[/EN][CN]技艺精湛的手工创作者[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The glass crafter made a shiny vase with colorful patterns.|玻璃工匠做了一个带有彩色花纹的闪亮花瓶。[/DU][DU]The leather crafter made a strong belt for the knight.|皮革工匠给骑士做了一条坚固的腰带。[/DU][DU]The crafter spent three days making the paper dragon.|工匠花了三天时间做这只纸龙。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]dragon saddle crafter|龙鞍具工匠[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The dragon saddle crafter works hard to make safe saddles.|龙鞍具工匠努力制作安全的鞍具。[/EX][EX]We visited the dragon saddle crafter's workshop.|我们参观了龙鞍具工匠的工坊。[/EX][C]a skilled dragon saddle crafter|熟练的龙鞍具工匠[/C][C]a hardworking dragon saddle crafter|勤劳的龙鞍具工匠[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]skilled crafter|熟练的手艺人[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]She is a skilled crafter who makes cloth dolls.|她是个熟练的手艺人，会做布娃娃。[/EX][EX]The skilled crafter can make many kinds of toys.|这个熟练的手艺人能做很多种玩具。[/EX][C]a skilled wood crafter|熟练的木雕工匠[/C][C]a skilled metal crafter|熟练的金属工匠[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The crafter in the castle is good at making metal tools.[POS]n.[/POS]|城堡里的工匠擅长做金属工具。[/EX][EX]The crafter used colorful threads to make the tapestry.[POS]n.[/POS]|工匠用彩色的线做了挂毯。[/EX][EX]We bought a handmade necklace from the crafter.|我们从手艺人那里买了一条手工项链。[/EX][EX]The crafter taught the kids how to make paper flowers.[POS]n.[/POS]|手艺人教孩子们如何做纸花。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]crafter 是可数名词，复数形式是 crafters，不要写成“craftman”（错误拼写），正确复数是 craftsmen（工匠们）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 crafter 和 artist！crafter 侧重“手工制作”，artist 侧重“艺术创作”，比如“画家”是 artist，“陶艺工匠”是 crafter。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“a crafter of wood”，正确表达是 a wood crafter（木雕工匠）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Having a thin and graceful body (used in the book when describing Kepri the Sun Dragon's body shape)[/EN][CN]纤细的；苗条的；修长的（书中用于描述太阳龙凯普丽的身材）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/slɪm/[/PH][DU]Kepri was a Sun Dragon with a slim body and white scales.|(原文例句)凯普丽是一条身材纤细、长着白色鳞片的太阳龙。[/DU][DU]The ballerina has a slim figure to dance easily.|芭蕾舞演员身材纤细，方便跳舞。[/DU][DU]The deer has slim legs that help it run fast.|小鹿有纤细的腿，能跑得很快。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/slim.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Thin in a pleasant and healthy way[/EN][CN]苗条的；修长的（褒义，指健康好看的瘦）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The swan has a slim neck and white feathers.|天鹅有修长的脖子和白色的羽毛。[/DU][DU]My sister has a slim face with big eyes.|我姐姐有一张修长的脸，眼睛很大。[/DU][DU]The tree has slim branches that sway in the wind.|这棵树有纤细的树枝，在风中摇晃。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]slim body|纤细的身体[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The Sun Dragon has a slim body to fly quickly.|太阳龙有纤细的身体，能飞得很快。[/EX][EX]The fairy has a slim body that can fit through small gaps.|仙女有纤细的身体，能穿过小缝隙。[/EX][C]a slim body of a bird|小鸟纤细的身体[/C][C]a slim body of a dragon|龙纤细的身体[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]slim figure|苗条的身材[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The model has a slim figure that looks good in clothes.|模特身材苗条，穿衣服很好看。[/EX][EX]She keeps a slim figure by exercising every day.|她每天锻炼，保持苗条的身材。[/EX][C]a slim figure of a dancer|舞者苗条的身材[/C][C]a slim figure of a gymnast|体操运动员苗条的身材[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The slim snake moved quickly through the grass.[POS]adj.[/POS]|纤细的蛇快速地穿过草丛。[/EX][EX]The slim tree grows tall and straight in the garden.[POS]adj.[/POS]|这棵纤细的树在花园里长得又高又直。[/EX][EX]Her slim fingers can play the piano skillfully.[POS]adj.[/POS]|她纤细的手指能熟练地弹钢琴。[/EX][EX]The slim river flows gently through the village.[POS]adj.[/POS]|纤细的小河温柔地流过村庄。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 slim 和 thin！slim 侧重“纤细且优美”，是褒义；thin 可指“瘦的”，可能带“单薄”意味，比如“他太瘦了，看起来不健康”是 He is too thin and looks unhealthy，“她身材苗条，很优雅”是 She has a slim figure and is very elegant。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“slimly body”（错误），正确表达：slim body（纤细的身体），副词形式是 slimly，修饰动词，比如“slimly built”（身材纤细的）。[/ERR][ERR]slim 的比较级是 slimmer，最高级是 slimmest，不要写成“more slim”（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make someone feel worried or upset (used in the book when Drake finds Bo is upset by something unknown)[/EN][CN]使烦恼；使不安（书中指德雷克发现有事情让波感到心烦意乱）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈbɒðə(r)/（英式）/ˈbɑːðər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Drake could tell that something was bothering Bo.|(原文例句)德雷克能看出有什么事情在困扰着波。[/DU][DU]The loud noise bothers the little cat when it sleeps.|吵闹的声音会让睡觉的小猫感到烦躁。[/DU][DU]Don't bother him when he is doing his homework.|他做作业的时候不要打扰他。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/bother.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To take the time or effort to do something[/EN][CN]费心；麻烦（做某事）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She didn't bother to close the window before leaving.|她离开前懒得费心去关窗户。[/DU][DU]I won't bother to buy that toy, it's too expensive.|我懒得费心买那个玩具，它太贵了。[/DU][DU]He never bothers to say hello to his classmates.|他从不费心和同学们打招呼。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]A feeling of worry or slight trouble[/EN][CN]烦恼；小麻烦[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]It's just a little bother, don't worry about it.|这只是个小麻烦，别担心。[/DU][DU]She had a lot of bother with her broken bike.|她的自行车坏了，给她添了很多麻烦。[/DU][DU]The little boy is such a bother when he cries all day.|小男孩整天哭，真是个小麻烦。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]bother sb|使某人烦恼[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]What's bothering you today?|你今天怎么闷闷不乐的？[/EX][EX]The strange noise bothers the little girl at night.|夜里奇怪的声音让小女孩感到害怕。[/EX][C]something bothers sb|某事让某人烦恼[/C][C]a person bothers sb|某人打扰某人[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]bother to do sth|费心做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He didn't bother to finish his drawing.|他懒得费心完成他的画。[/EX][EX]Do you bother to clean your room every day?|你会每天费心打扫房间吗？[/EX][C]bother to read|费心阅读[/C][C]bother to cook|费心做饭[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a little bother|一点小麻烦[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We met a little bother on our way to the park.|我们去公园的路上遇到了一点小麻烦。[/EX][EX]It's just a little bother, we can solve it easily.|这只是一点小麻烦，我们能轻松解决。[/EX][C]a big bother|一个大麻烦[/C][C]no bother at all|一点也不麻烦[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The fly keeps bothering me when I eat dinner.[POS]v.[/POS]|我吃晚饭时，苍蝇一直缠着我烦。[/EX][EX]She doesn't bother about small things in life.[POS]v.[/POS]|她对生活中的小事从不计较。[/EX][EX]I have no bother in learning to ride a bike.[POS]n.[/POS]|我学骑自行车一点也不费劲。[/EX][EX]The heavy rain caused a lot of bother for the farmers.[POS]n.[/POS]|大雨给农民们带来了很多麻烦。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 bother 和 trouble！bother 偏口语化，指轻微的“烦恼、打扰”；trouble 更正式，指较严重的“麻烦、困扰”，比如“他遇到了大麻烦”是 He is in great trouble，不是 He has a great bother。[/ERR][ERR]bother 作“费心做某事”时，否定句常用 not bother to do sth，不要说 not bother doing sth（错误），正确表达：I didn't bother to go out。[/ERR][ERR]hardly 和 bother 不要混用，hardly 是“几乎不”，bother 是“烦恼”，比如“我几乎不觉得烦恼”是 I hardly feel bothered，不是 I hard bother。[/ERR][ERR]作名词时是可数名词，单数前可加 a，复数为 bothers，不要说“many bother”（错误），正确：many bothers。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A person who likes to sleep or is slow to wake up (used in the book when Rori calls Drake and Bo lazy for getting up late)[/EN][CN]瞌睡虫；懒虫（书中指罗里戏称起床晚的德雷克和波为瞌睡虫）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈsliːpihed/[/PH][DU]"It's about time you two sleepyheads got here," said Rori.|(原文例句)罗里说：“你们这两个瞌睡虫，终于到了。”[/DU][DU]Wake up, sleepyhead! It's time for school.|醒醒，瞌睡虫！该上学了。[/DU][DU]My little sister is a sleepyhead who always gets up late on weekends.|我的小妹妹是个瞌睡虫，周末总是起得很晚。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/sleepyhead.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A magical object or spell that protects something (used in the book when Griffith uses invisible magical spells to protect the Dragon Stone)[/EN][CN]魔法符咒；护身符（书中指格里菲斯用来保护龙石的隐形魔法咒语或物件）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/tʃɑːm/（英式）/tʃɑːrm/（美式）[/PH][DU]I always protect the stone with magic charms.|(原文例句)我总是用魔法符咒来保护这块石头。[/DU][DU]The wizard made a magic charm to keep evil away.|巫师制作了一个魔法符咒来驱邪。[/DU][DU]The magic charm glowed brightly around the treasure chest.|魔法符咒在宝箱周围明亮地发光。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/charm.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A quality that makes someone or something attractive[/EN][CN]魅力；吸引力[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The little girl has a lot of charm that makes everyone like her.|这个小女孩很有魅力，大家都喜欢她。[/DU][DU]The old town is full of charm with its small streets and cute houses.|这座老城有着小街道和可爱的房子，充满了魅力。[/DU][DU]The singer's smile and voice won her many fans with their charm.|这位歌手的笑容和歌声以其魅力赢得了许多粉丝。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To attract or delight someone[/EN][CN]吸引；使着迷[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The magician charmed the audience with his amazing tricks.|魔术师用他惊人的魔术迷住了观众。[/DU][DU]The colorful butterflies charmed the children in the garden.|彩色的蝴蝶吸引了花园里的孩子们。[/DU][DU]Her kind words charmed everyone at the party.|她亲切的话语让派对上的每个人都感到愉悦。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]magic charm|魔法符咒[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic charm formed an invisible net around the Dragon Stone.|魔法符咒在龙石周围形成了一张隐形网。[/EX][EX]We need to find a powerful magic charm to protect the castle.|我们需要找到一个强大的魔法符咒来保护城堡。[/EX][C]protective magic charm|防护魔法符咒[/C][C]invisible magic charm|隐形魔法符咒[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]charm sb with sth|用某物吸引/迷住某人[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The storyteller charmed the kids with funny tales about dragons.|讲故事的人用有趣的龙的故事迷住了孩子们。[/EX][EX]He charmed everyone with his kind personality and sense of humor.|他用善良的性格和幽默感吸引了所有人。[/EX][C]charm sb with smiles|用微笑迷住某人[/C][C]charm sb with magic|用魔法吸引某人[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 charm 和 spell！charm 侧重“有保护或吸引作用的魔法符咒/魅力”，spell 侧重“需要念诵的咒语”，比如“施法”是 cast a spell，“魔法符咒”是 magic charm。[/ERR][ERR]作名词“魅力”时是不可数名词，不能说“a charm of her smile”，正确表达：the charm of her smile（她微笑的魅力）。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，“迷住某人”是 charm sb（及物动词），不要说“charm to sb”（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To disturb or break the effect of something (used in the book when something made the magic charms stop working properly)[/EN][CN]扰乱；使失效（书中指某物导致魔法符咒的效果被破坏）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ʌpˈset/[/PH][DU]This morning, I found that something had upset the magic of the charms.|(原文例句)今天早上，我发现有东西扰乱了符咒的魔法效果。[/DU][DU]The loud noise upset the sleeping dragon.|吵闹的声音惊动了沉睡的龙。[/DU][DU]The dark magic upset the balance of the magical forest.|黑魔法扰乱了魔法森林的平衡。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/upset.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make someone feel sad, worried, or angry[/EN][CN]使难过；使心烦；使生气[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo was upset when he received the note about his family.|波收到关于家人的纸条时很心烦。[/DU][DU]The broken toy upset the little boy.|坏掉的玩具让小男孩很伤心。[/DU][DU]It upsets me when people are mean to dragons.|看到人们对龙不好，我会很生气。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]Feeling sad, worried, or angry[/EN][CN]难过的；心烦的；生气的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]Ana looked upset when she thought Kepri might be in danger.|安娜想到凯普丽可能有危险时，看起来很心烦。[/DU][DU]I felt upset when I missed the dragon show.|我没赶上龙的表演，感到很遗憾。[/DU][DU]The emperor was upset when Bo didn't bring the Dragon Stone.|波没有带来龙石，皇帝很生气。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]upset the magic|扰乱魔法[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The evil wizard tried to upset the magic that protected the castle.|邪恶巫师试图扰乱保护城堡的魔法。[/EX][EX]The red orb upset the magic of the dragon's cave.|红色球体扰乱了龙穴的魔法。[/EX][C]upset the magical balance|扰乱魔法平衡[/C][C]upset the charm's power|破坏符咒的力量[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]be upset about sth|为某事心烦/难过[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Bo was upset about his family being in prison.|波为家人入狱而心烦。[/EX][EX]She was upset about missing the chance to ride the dragon.|她为错过骑龙的机会而难过。[/EX][C]be upset about a mistake|为一个错误而心烦[/C][C]be upset about bad news|为坏消息而难过[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The sudden storm upset our plan to play with the dragons.[POS]v.[/POS]|突如其来的暴风雨打乱了我们和龙玩耍的计划。[/EX][EX]His rude words upset the other Dragon Masters.[POS]v.[/POS]|他粗鲁的话惹恼了其他龙法师。[/EX][EX]The little girl was upset when her dragon toy went missing.[POS]adj.[/POS]|小女孩的龙玩具不见了，她很伤心。[/EX][EX]Drake was upset that he couldn't help Bo right away.[POS]adj.[/POS]|德雷克因为不能立刻帮助波而心烦。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]upset 的过去式和过去分词还是 upset，不要写成“upsetted”（错误拼写）。[/ERR][ERR]作形容词时，主语是人，不能说“the magic is upset”（错误），正确表达：the magic is disturbed（魔法被扰乱）；人作主语时用 be upset，如“he is upset”（他很心烦）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 upset 和 disturb！upset 侧重“情绪上的心烦或计划/效果的打乱”，disturb 侧重“打扰他人休息、工作”，比如“打扰别人睡觉”是 disturb someone's sleep，“让人心烦”是 upset someone。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To look after or protect someone or something (used in the book when Griffith takes responsibility for the Dragon Stone)[/EN][CN]照顾；照料；保护（书中指格里菲斯负责保护龙石）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/keə(r)/（英式）/ker/（美式）[/PH][DU]As long as the stone is in my care, I can keep it safe.|(原文例句)只要这块石头在我保管下，我就能保证它的安全。[/DU][DU]Bo promised to care for Shu and keep her safe.|波承诺会照顾舒，保护她的安全。[/DU][DU]The wizard cares for all the dragons in the castle.|巫师照顾着城堡里所有的龙。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/care.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Concern or attention for someone or something[/EN][CN]关心；在意[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]Drake showed care for his friend Bo by helping him save his family.|德雷克通过帮助波拯救家人，表达了对朋友的关心。[/DU][DU]The king has no care for the dragons' feelings.|国王根本不在意龙的感受。[/DU][DU]We should have care for all living creatures.|我们应该关心所有生物。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To feel worried or concerned about someone or something[/EN][CN]担心；关心[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Ana cares about Kepri more than anything else.|安娜比任何事情都关心凯普丽。[/DU][DU]Do you care if we ride the dragons tomorrow?|你介意我们明天骑龙吗？[/DU][DU]My mom cares about me when I'm away from home.|我离家时，妈妈很担心我。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]take care of|照顾；照料[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Griffith takes care of the Dragon Stone day and night.|格里菲斯日夜照料着龙石。[/EX][EX]Can you take care of my dragon while I'm gone?|我离开时，你能照顾我的龙吗？[/EX][C]take care of a sick dragon|照顾生病的龙[/C][C]take care of a magical object|保管魔法物件[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]care about|关心；在意[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The Dragon Masters care about each other and their dragons.|龙法师们关心彼此和他们的龙。[/EX][EX]He doesn't care about what other people think.|他不在乎别人怎么想。[/EX][C]care about someone's safety|关心某人的安全[/C][C]care about the environment|关心环境[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in one's care|在某人的照顾/保管下[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The dragon was safe in Bo's care.|这条龙在波的照顾下很安全。[/EX][EX]The important spell book is in the wizard's care.|这本重要的咒语书由巫师保管。[/EX][C]leave sth in one's care|把某物交给某人保管[/C][C]trust sth in one's care|放心把某物交给某人照顾[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She cares for the baby dragon as if it were her own.[POS]v.[/POS]|她照顾这只小龙，就像照顾自己的孩子一样。[/EX][EX]Drake cares deeply about his friend Bo's happiness.[POS]v.[/POS]|德雷克非常关心朋友波的幸福。[/EX][EX]The teacher's care helped the student feel welcome.[POS]n.[/POS]|老师的关心让学生感到受欢迎。[/EX][EX]We should show care for animals in need.|我们应该关心有需要的动物。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]care 作“照顾”时是及物动词，可直接接宾语，如 care for sb/sth（正确），不要说“care sb”（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]care about 后面接名词或代词，不要接不定式，比如“关心他的安全”是 care about his safety（正确），不是 care about to keep him safe（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]in care of 表示“由……转交”，不要和 in one's care 混淆，比如“信件由他转交”是 in care of him，“由他照顾”是 in his care。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Not being careful; doing things without thinking about possible problems (used in the book when Griffith says Maldred wouldn't act without planning)[/EN][CN]粗心的；疏忽的（书中指格里菲斯说马尔德雷德不会做事没计划，不会如此粗心）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈkeələs/（英式）/ˈkerləs/（美式）[/PH][DU]Maldred would not have been so careless.|(原文例句)马尔德雷德不会这么粗心大意。[/DU][DU]The careless guard forgot to lock the dragon cave.|粗心的卫兵忘了锁龙穴的门。[/DU][DU]Don't be careless when feeding the fire dragon.|给火龙喂食时别粗心大意。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/careless.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Not giving enough attention or thought to something[/EN][CN]漫不经心的；不认真的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The careless student made many mistakes in his spell practice.|这个漫不经心的学生在咒语练习中犯了很多错误。[/DU][DU]She was careless with the magic wand and dropped it.|她拿魔杖时很不认真，把它掉在了地上。[/DU][DU]A careless mistake can be dangerous when dealing with magic.|处理魔法时，一个粗心的错误可能会很危险。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 careless 和 careful！careless 是“粗心的”（否定），careful 是“细心的”（肯定），比如“细心照顾”是 take careful care of，“粗心对待”是 be careless with。[/ERR][ERR]careless 是形容词，不要写成副词形式“carelessily”（错误），正确副词是 carelessly，比如“他粗心地打翻了杯子”是 He knocked over the cup carelessly。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“careless of sb to do sth”，正确表达是“it's careless of sb to do sth”，比如“他粗心地忘了锁门”是 It's careless of him to forget to lock the door。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To keep doing something without stopping (used in the book when Griffith goes on speaking about protecting the Dragon Stone)[/EN][CN]继续；持续（书中指格里菲斯继续谈论保护龙石的事情）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/kənˈtɪnjuː/[/PH][DU]"To protect the Dragon Stone, I must find a better hiding place for it," Griffith continued.|(原文例句)“为了保护龙石，我必须找一个更好的藏身之处，”格里菲斯继续说道。[/DU][DU]The Dragon Masters continued their journey to save Bo's family.|龙法师们继续他们拯救波家人的旅程。[/DU][DU]The rain continued all night, making the dragon cave wet.|雨下了一整晚，把龙穴弄湿了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/continue.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To start doing something again after stopping[/EN][CN]继续；重拾（停止后再开始）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]After resting for a while, they continued to fly toward the emperor's palace.|休息了一会儿后，他们继续朝着皇宫飞去。[/DU][DU]The wizard continued his spell after being interrupted.|巫师被打断后，继续念他的咒语。[/DU][DU]We can continue our dragon training tomorrow morning.|我们明天早上可以继续我们的龙训练。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]continue 后面可接 to do 或 doing，意思基本相同，不要误以为只能接其中一种，比如“继续读书”可以说 continue to read 或 continue reading。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“continue on doing sth”（多余的 on），正确表达：continue doing sth。[/ERR][ERR]continue 是及物动词，后面可直接接宾语，也可接不定式，不要遗漏宾语，比如“继续这个故事”是 continue the story（正确），不是 continue（错误，缺少宾语）。[/ERR][ERR]continue 的名词形式是 continuation，不要写成“continueation”（错误拼写）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To spend time relaxing or doing nothing special with someone (used in the book when Drake suggests spending time with the dragons in the caves)[/EN][CN]闲逛；待在一起（书中指德雷克建议和龙们在洞穴里待着、放松）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/hæŋ aʊt/[/PH][DU]We can hang out with them in the caves.|(原文例句)我们可以和它们在洞穴里待着。[/DU][DU]Drake and Bo like to hang out with their dragons after training.|德雷克和波喜欢在训练后和他们的龙待在一起。[/DU][DU]The Dragon Masters hang out in the Training Room when they have free time.|龙法师们有空时会在训练室里闲逛。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/hang out.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To stay in a place for a while, usually relaxing[/EN][CN]在某处逗留；闲逛[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]The kids hang out at the park every weekend to watch dragons fly.|孩子们每个周末都在公园逗留，看龙飞行。[/DU][DU]We can hang out by the lake and feed the water dragons.|我们可以在湖边闲逛，喂水龙。[/DU][DU]My friends and I hang out at the library after school.|我和朋友们放学后在图书馆待着。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To move suddenly and quickly (used in the book when Worm's neck moved sharply upward)[/EN][CN]猛地一动；急拉（书中指沃姆的脖子突然向上一抬）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/dʒɜːk/（英式）/dʒɜːrk/（美式）[/PH][DU]Suddenly, Worm's neck jerked up.|(原文例句)突然，沃姆的脖子猛地向上一抬。[/DU][DU]The cat jerked its tail when it saw the mouse.|小猫看到老鼠时，尾巴猛地一甩。[/DU][DU]He jerked the rope to pull the box closer.|他猛地一拉绳子，把箱子拉近。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/jerk.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A sudden sharp movement[/EN][CN]猛动；急拉[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The sudden jerk of the dragon made Drake hold on tight.|龙突然一颠，让德雷克紧紧抓住。[/DU][DU]She felt a jerk when the car started quickly.|汽车猛地启动时，她感到一阵颠簸。[/DU][DU]The fish gave a jerk before jumping out of the water.|鱼猛地一动，然后跳出了水面。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]jerk 作动词时是及物或不及物动词，接宾语时直接接，不要说“jerk at sth”（错误），正确表达：jerk the rope（猛拉绳子）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 jerk 和 pull！jerk 强调“突然、快速的拉”，pull 是泛指“拉”，比如“慢慢拉”是 pull slowly，“猛地拉”是 jerk。[/ERR][ERR]作名词时是可数名词，复数形式是 jerks，不要说“a jerk of”（错误），正确：a jerk of the arm（胳膊猛地一动）。[/ERR]

Drake obeyed.|(原文例句)“进来，德雷克，”格里菲斯说。德雷克照做了。[/DU][DU]The dragon obeyed its master's command to fly.|龙听从主人的命令飞了起来。[/DU][DU]Children should obey their parents' safe rules.|孩子们应该遵守父母定的安全规则。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/obey1.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To follow a rule or law[/EN][CN]遵守（规则、法律）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guards must obey the emperor's orders.|乌鸦卫队必须遵守皇帝的命令。[/DU][DU]We must obey the castle's rules to stay safe.|我们必须遵守城堡的规则才能保证安全。[/DU][DU]Dogs often obey the commands of their owners.|狗通常会听从主人的指令。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To say something suddenly without thinking (used in the book when Drake said something quickly without planning)[/EN][CN]脱口而出；突然说出（书中指德雷克没多想就快速说出了话）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/blɜːt/（英式）/blɜːrt/（美式）[/PH][DU]"Please, Bo!" Drake blurted out.|(原文例句)“求你了，波！”德雷克脱口而出。[/DU][DU]She blurted out the secret when she was excited.|她兴奋时不小心把秘密脱口说了出来。[/DU][DU]The boy blurted out the answer before the teacher finished asking.|老师还没问完，男孩就脱口说出了答案。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/blurt.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To speak suddenly and without control[/EN][CN]贸然说出；不由自主地说[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]He blurted that he had seen the dragon when he was nervous.|他紧张时贸然说出自己见过龙。[/DU][DU]I blurted out my favorite food when Mom asked what I wanted.|妈妈问我想吃什么时，我脱口说出了自己最喜欢的食物。[/DU][DU]She blurted that she liked the dragon show very much.|她不由自主地说自己非常喜欢龙的表演。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]blurt 通常和 out 连用，构成短语 blurt out，单独使用时较少，比如“脱口说出真相”是 blurt out the truth（正确），不是 blurt the truth（不自然）。[/ERR][ERR]blurt 是及物动词，后面必须接宾语，不能说“he blurted”（错误，缺少宾语），正确表达：he blurted a word（他脱口说了一个词）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 blurt 和 say！blurt 强调“突然、无准备地说”，say 是泛指“说”，比如“慢慢说”是 say slowly，“脱口说”是 blurt out。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A great respect or pride (used in the book when Bo's parents thought serving the king was a proud thing)[/EN][CN]荣誉；荣幸（书中指波的父母认为为国王效力是一件光荣的事）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɒnə(r)/（英式）/ˈɑːnər/（美式）[/PH][DU]But my parents said it would be an honor to our kingdom.|(原文例句)但我父母说这对我们的王国来说是一种荣誉。[/DU][DU]It's an honor to meet the great wizard.|能见到伟大的巫师是一种荣幸。[/DU][DU]Winning the dragon race is a big honor for the young master.|赢得龙赛对年轻的法师来说是极大的荣誉。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/honor.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To show respect to someone or something[/EN][CN]尊敬；给……荣誉[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The kingdom honors the brave Dragon Masters for saving the dragons.|王国为勇敢的龙法师们拯救龙的行为授予荣誉。[/DU][DU]We honor the wizard for his kind help.|我们尊敬这位巫师的好心帮助。[/DU][DU]The villagers honor the dragon that protected their home.|村民们尊敬那条保护了他们家园的龙。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]it's an honor to do sth|做某事是一种荣幸[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]It's an honor to train with the famous dragons.|能和著名的龙一起训练是一种荣幸。[/EX][EX]It's an honor to help the kingdom stay safe.|能帮助王国保持安全是一种荣幸。[/EX][C]it's an honor to meet sb|见到某人是一种荣幸[/C][C]it's an honor to serve|服务是一种荣幸[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]honor sb for sth|因某事尊敬/表彰某人[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The king honored Bo for his bravery in saving the dragon stone.|国王因波拯救龙石的勇敢行为表彰了他。[/EX][EX]We honor the soldier for protecting the village.|我们尊敬那位保护村庄的士兵。[/EX][C]honor a hero for courage|因勇气表彰英雄[/C][C]honor a wizard for magic|因魔法尊敬巫师[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She felt great honor when the dragon chose her as its master.[POS]n.[/POS]|当龙选择她作为主人时，她感到无比光荣。[/EX][EX]The honor of saving the kingdom belongs to all Dragon Masters.[POS]n.[/POS]|拯救王国的荣誉属于所有龙法师。[/EX][EX]The school honors students who help others selflessly.[POS]v.[/POS]|学校表彰那些无私帮助他人的学生。[/EX][EX]We honor the tradition of protecting dragons in our family.[POS]v.[/POS]|我们家尊重保护龙的传统。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]honor 作“荣誉”时是不可数名词，不要说“an honor of”（错误），正确表达：the honor of being a master（成为法师的荣誉）。[/ERR][ERR]美式拼写是 honor，英式拼写是 honour，不要混淆两种拼写的用法，保持一致即可。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 honor 和 proud！honor 是名词“荣誉”或动词“尊敬”，proud 是形容词“骄傲的”，比如“感到骄傲”是 feel proud，“获得荣誉”是 get honor。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To have trouble speaking because of strong feelings (used in the book when Bo's voice was blocked by sadness)[/EN][CN]哽咽；说不出话（书中指波因悲伤而声音哽咽）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/tʃəʊk/（英式）/tʃoʊk/（美式）[/PH][DU]"It says -" His voice choked.|(原文例句)“上面写着——”他的声音哽咽了。[/DU][DU]She choked when she talked about her lost dragon.|谈起她失踪的龙时，她哽咽了。[/DU][DU]The little boy choked with joy when he saw the magic stone.|小男孩看到魔法石时，高兴得说不出话。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/choke.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To have difficulty breathing because something is blocking the throat[/EN][CN]窒息；呛到[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The dragon choked on a big piece of meat and coughed.|龙被一大块肉呛到，咳嗽起来。[/DU][DU]Be careful not to choke on small candies.|小心不要被小糖果呛到。[/DU][DU]The bird choked when it ate the seed too quickly.|小鸟吃得太快，被种子呛到了。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]choke up|哽咽；说不出话[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Bo choked up when he talked about his family in prison.|波谈起在监狱里的家人时，哽咽得说不出话。[/EX][EX]She choked up with pride when her dragon won the race.|当她的龙赢得比赛时，她骄傲得哽咽了。[/EX][C]choke up with sadness|因悲伤哽咽[/C][C]choke up with joy|因喜悦哽咽[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]choke on sth|被某物呛到[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The child choked on a peanut and needed help.|孩子被花生呛到，需要帮助。[/EX][EX]The dragon almost choked on the big bone.|龙差点被大骨头呛到。[/EX][C]choke on food|被食物呛到[/C][C]choke on water|被水呛到[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]His voice choked when he thanked the wizard for saving his family.[POS]v.[/POS]|当他感谢巫师拯救了他的家人时，声音哽咽了。[/EX][EX]She choked up and couldn't finish her story about the dragon.[POS]v.[/POS]|她哽咽着，没能讲完关于龙的故事。[/EX][EX]The dog choked on a stick while playing.|小狗玩耍时被一根棍子呛到了。[/EX][EX]Be slow when eating to avoid choking.[POS]v.[/POS]|吃饭要慢，避免呛到。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]choke 作“哽咽”时常用短语 choke up，单独使用时也可，但不如 choke up 自然，比如“因感动哽咽”是 choke up with emotion（正确）。[/ERR][ERR]作“呛到”时，必须接介词 on，不能说“choke sth”（错误），正确表达：choke on sth（被某物呛到）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 choke 和 cry！choke 侧重“因情绪或异物导致说不出话/呼吸困难”，cry 是“哭泣”，比如“哭着说”是 cry and say，“哽咽着说”是 choke out。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Very bad and harmful (used in the book when Bo thought something bad had affected Emperor Song)[/EN][CN]邪恶的；有害的（书中指波认为有邪恶的东西影响了宋皇帝）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈiːvl/[/PH][DU]I fear that some evil has come over him.|(原文例句)我担心有某种邪恶的东西影响了他。[/DU][DU]The evil wizard used dark magic to hurt dragons.|邪恶的巫师用黑魔法伤害龙。[/DU][DU]The evil plan to steal the Dragon Stone failed.|偷窃龙石的邪恶计划失败了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/evil.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Something that is bad or harmful[/EN][CN]邪恶；恶行[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The Dragon Masters fight against evil to protect the kingdom.|龙法师们与邪恶作斗争，保护王国。[/DU][DU]Dark magic is a kind of evil that hurts others.|黑魔法是一种伤害他人的邪恶力量。[/DU][DU]The hero defeated the evil and saved the village.|英雄战胜了邪恶，拯救了村庄。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]evil wizard|邪恶的巫师[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Maldred is an evil wizard who uses dark magic.|马尔德雷德是一个使用黑魔法的邪恶巫师。[/EX][EX]The evil wizard tried to control the dragons.|邪恶的巫师试图控制龙。[/EX][C]evil magic|邪恶的魔法[/C][C]evil plan|邪恶的计划[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]fight against evil|与邪恶作斗争[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Dragon Masters are brave enough to fight against evil.|龙法师们足够勇敢，敢于与邪恶作斗争。[/EX][EX]We must unite to fight against evil in the kingdom.|我们必须团结起来，与王国里的邪恶作斗争。[/EX][C]defeat evil|战胜邪恶[/C][C]resist evil|抵制邪恶[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The evil dragon was controlled by the dark wizard.[POS]adj.[/POS]|那条恶龙被黑巫师控制了。[/EX][EX]His evil words made the other children sad.[POS]adj.[/POS]|他邪恶的话语让其他孩子感到难过。[/EX][EX]Kindness can always beat evil in the end.[POS]n.[/POS]|善良最终总能战胜邪恶。[/EX][EX]The wizard used good magic to drive away evil.[POS]n.[/POS]|巫师用善良的魔法赶走了邪恶。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]evil 作形容词时修饰名词，不要说“an evil”（错误，缺少名词），正确表达：an evil wizard（一个邪恶的巫师）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 evil 和 bad！evil 程度更深，指“邪恶的、道德败坏的”，bad 是泛指“坏的”，比如“坏天气”是 bad weather，“邪恶的魔法”是 evil magic。[/ERR][ERR]evil 的副词形式是 evilly，不要写成“evilily”（错误拼写），比如“邪恶地笑”是 smile evilly。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To affect someone suddenly (used in the book when Bo thought evil had suddenly influenced Emperor Song)[/EN][CN]突然降临；影响（书中指波认为邪恶的东西突然影响了宋皇帝）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/kʌm ˈəʊvə(r)/（英式）/kʌm ˈoʊvər/（美式）[/PH][DU]I fear that some evil has come over him.|(原文例句)我担心有某种邪恶的东西影响了他。[/DU][DU]A feeling of sleepiness came over her when she sat down.|她坐下后，一阵睡意突然袭来。[/DU][DU]A sense of joy came over the children when they saw the dragons.|孩子们看到龙时，一阵喜悦涌上心头。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/come over.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To visit someone at their home or a place they are in[/EN][CN]顺便拜访；过来（访问）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]Can you come over to the dragon cave to play with us?|你能来龙穴和我们一起玩吗？[/DU][DU]The wizard came over to check on the sick dragon.|巫师过来查看生病的龙。[/DU][DU]My friend came over to my house after school.|我的朋友放学后顺便来我家拜访。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a feeling comes over sb|某人突然产生某种感觉[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]A feeling of fear came over Drake when he saw the evil wizard.|德雷克看到邪恶巫师时，突然感到一阵恐惧。[/EX][EX]A sense of calm came over Bo when Shu spoke to him.|当舒和波交流时，他突然感到一阵平静。[/EX][C]a sense of excitement comes over sb|某人突然感到兴奋[/C][C]a feeling of sadness comes over sb|某人突然感到悲伤[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]come over to sp|过来某地[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]Come over to the Training Room; we need your help.|过来训练室，我们需要你的帮助。[/EX][EX]The Dragon Masters came over to the castle to meet the king.|龙法师们过来城堡见国王。[/EX][C]come over to the park|过来公园[/C][C]come over to the workshop|过来工坊[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]A sudden cold came over her when the dark magic appeared.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|黑魔法出现时，她突然感到一阵寒冷。[/EX][EX]A feeling of hope came over them when they found the magic feather.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|当他们找到魔法羽毛时，一阵希望涌上心头。[/EX][EX]Can you come over to help me feed the dragons?[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|你能过来帮我喂龙吗？[/EX][EX]The king came over to praise the Dragon Masters for their bravery.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|国王过来表扬了龙法师们的勇敢。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]come over 作“突然影响”时，主语通常是 feeling、sense 等抽象名词，不要说“sb comes over”（错误），正确表达：a feeling comes over sb（某人突然产生某种感觉）。[/EX][ERR]作“拜访”时，后面接介词 to 加地点，不要说“come over sp”（错误），正确表达：come over to sp（过来某地）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 come over 和 come to！come to 是“苏醒；到达”，come over 是“突然影响；拜访”，比如“醒来”是 come to，“突然感到害怕”是 a fear comes over sb。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A large black bird (used in the book as the name of the emperor's guard group: Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]渡鸦；大乌鸦（书中用作皇帝卫队的名称：乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈreɪvn/[/PH][DU]The black feather is a symbol of the Raven Guard.|(原文例句)黑色羽毛是乌鸦卫队的象征。[/DU][DU]A raven flew over the castle and landed on the tower.|一只渡鸦飞过城堡，落在了塔上。[/DU][DU]The Raven Guard is a group of skilled fighters who serve the emperor.|乌鸦卫队是一群为皇帝效力的熟练战士。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/raven.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Black in color (like a raven's feathers)[/EN][CN]乌黑的；漆黑的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The knight wore a raven cloak that matched the night sky.|骑士穿着一件乌黑的斗篷，和夜空融为一体。[/DU][DU]Her raven hair shone in the sunlight.|她乌黑的头发在阳光下闪闪发光。[/DU][DU]The raven wings of the dragon looked very powerful.|龙乌黑的翅膀看起来非常有力。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]Raven Guard|乌鸦卫队[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Raven Guard dressed all in black and moved silently.|乌鸦卫队全身黑衣，行动无声。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard followed the emperor's orders without question.|乌鸦卫队毫无异议地听从皇帝的命令。[/EX][C]members of the Raven Guard|乌鸦卫队成员[/C][C]the symbol of the Raven Guard|乌鸦卫队的象征[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]raven black|乌黑的[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The dragon's scales were raven black and shiny.|龙的鳞片乌黑发亮。[/EX][EX]He had raven black eyes that looked serious.|他有着乌黑的眼睛，看起来很严肃。[/EX][C]raven black hair|乌黑的头发[/C][C]raven black feathers|乌黑的羽毛[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]A raven perched on the branch and watched the Dragon Masters.[POS]n.[/POS]|一只渡鸦停在树枝上，看着龙法师们。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard is known for their skillful fighting and silent movement.[POS]n.[/POS]|乌鸦卫队以其熟练的战斗技巧和无声的行动而闻名。[/EX][EX]The raven night made it hard to see the path.[POS]adj.[/POS]|漆黑的夜晚让道路难以看清。[/EX][EX]She wore a dress with raven black patterns.|她穿着一件带有乌黑花纹的裙子。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]raven 作名词“渡鸦”时是可数名词，复数形式是 ravens，不要写成“ravenes”（错误拼写）。[/ERR][ERR]作形容词时，通常修饰颜色相关的名词，不要说“a raven coat”（不自然），正确表达：a raven black coat（一件乌黑的外套）。[/ERR][ERR]专有名词 Raven Guard 首字母必须大写，不要写成“raven guard”（错误），表示特定的卫队名称。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Making no sound; quiet (used in the book when describing the Raven Guard's movement without noise)[/EN][CN]寂静的；无声的（书中指乌鸦卫队行动时没有声音）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈsaɪlənt/[/PH][DU]They can move silently without being seen.|(原文例句)他们能无声地移动，不被人发现。[/DU][DU]The silent forest was only broken by the sound of birds.|寂静的森林里，只有鸟儿的叫声打破宁静。[/DU][DU]The children stayed silent when the wizard told them the secret.|当巫师告诉孩子们秘密时，他们保持沉默。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/silent.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Not speaking or making noise[/EN][CN]沉默的；不说话的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]Bo was silent when he thought about his family.|波想起家人时，变得沉默不语。[/DU][DU]The silent dragon watched the visitors carefully.|那条沉默的龙仔细地观察着来访者。[/DU][DU]She remained silent during the meeting to listen to others.|她在会议中保持沉默，倾听别人的意见。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]move silently|无声地移动[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The spy moved silently through the castle to avoid being caught.|间谍无声地穿过城堡，以免被发现。[/EX][EX]The cat moved silently toward the mouse.|小猫无声地朝着老鼠移动。[/EX][C]walk silently|无声地走路[/C][C]sneak silently|无声地潜行[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]stay silent|保持沉默[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]He stayed silent to keep the dragon's secret.|他保持沉默，以保守龙的秘密。[/EX][EX]The students stayed silent when the teacher asked a difficult question.|当老师提出一个难题时，学生们保持沉默。[/EX][C]remain silent|保持沉默[/C][C]keep silent|保持沉默[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]silent 是形容词，不要混淆副词形式 silently，比如“无声地走路”是 walk silently（正确），不是 walk silent（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 silent 和 quiet！silent 强调“完全没有声音”，quiet 强调“安静、不吵闹”，比如“安静的房间”是 quiet room，“寂静的森林”是 silent forest。[/ERR][ERR]silent 的名词形式是 silence，不要写成“silentness”（错误拼写），比如“保持沉默”是 keep silence 或 stay silent。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Having the ability to do something well (used in the book when describing the Raven Guard's good fighting ability)[/EN][CN]熟练的；有技能的（书中指乌鸦卫队的战斗技能高超）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/skɪld/[/PH][DU]The Raven Guard is a group of skilled fighters who serve the emperor.|(原文例句)乌鸦卫队是一群为皇帝效力的熟练战士。[/DU][DU]The skilled wizard can cast powerful magic spells.|这位熟练的巫师能施加强大的魔法咒语。[/DU][DU]The skilled dragon trainer knows how to communicate with dragons.|这位熟练的龙训练师知道如何与龙交流。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/skilled.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Good at doing a particular job or activity because of training or experience[/EN][CN]精通的；技艺高超的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]She is a skilled artist who draws beautiful pictures of dragons.|她是一位技艺高超的艺术家，画的龙非常漂亮。[/DU][DU]The skilled carpenter made a strong saddle for the dragon.|这位熟练的木匠为龙做了一个坚固的马鞍。[/DU][DU]He is skilled at playing the magic flute that calms dragons.|他精通吹奏能安抚龙的魔法长笛。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]skilled fighter|熟练的战士[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The skilled fighter defeated the evil monster easily.|这位熟练的战士轻松打败了邪恶的怪物。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard are all skilled fighters with years of training.|乌鸦卫队的成员都是经过多年训练的熟练战士。[/EX][C]skilled magic user|熟练的魔法使用者[/C][C]skilled dragon rider|熟练的龙骑士[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]skilled at sth/doing sth|擅长某事/做某事[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]She is skilled at training water dragons.|她擅长训练水龙。[/EX][EX]He is skilled at making magic potions.|他擅长制作魔法药剂。[/EX][C]skilled at drawing|擅长画画[/C][C]skilled at fighting|擅长战斗[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The skilled blacksmith made a sharp sword for the knight.[POS]adj.[/POS]|这位熟练的铁匠为骑士打造了一把锋利的剑。[/EX][EX]The Dragon Masters became more skilled at dragon training with practice.[POS]adj.[/POS]|经过练习，龙法师们在龙训练方面变得更加熟练。[/EX][EX]She is skilled at solving difficult magic problems.[POS]adj.[/POS]|她擅长解决复杂的魔法问题。[/EX][EX]The skilled pilot flew the dragon safely through the storm.[POS]adj.[/POS]|这位熟练的驾驶者驾驶着龙安全穿过了暴风雨。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]skilled 后面接介词 at 或 in，不要说“skilled to do sth”（错误），正确表达：skilled at doing sth（擅长做某事）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 skilled 和 skillful！两者意思基本相同，但 skilled 更侧重“经过训练获得的技能”，skillful 更侧重“天生或自然具备的技巧”，比如“熟练的工人”是 skilled worker，“灵巧的手指”是 skillful fingers。[/ERR][ERR]skilled 的副词形式是 skillfully，不要写成“skilledly”（错误拼写），比如“熟练地操作”是 operate skillfully。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make a low, short sound instead of speaking (used in the book when Simon the guard replied with a low sound)[/EN][CN]咕哝；哼了一声（书中指西蒙卫兵用低沉的声音回应）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ɡrʌnt/[/PH][DU]Simon grunted in reply, and the three of them rushed out of the workshop.|(原文例句)西蒙咕哝着回应了一声，然后他们三个人冲出了工坊。[/DU][DU]The dragon grunted when it was given food.|龙得到食物时哼了一声。[/DU][DU]He grunted to show he agreed with the plan.|他咕哝了一声，表示同意这个计划。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/grunt.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A low, short sound made by a person or animal[/EN][CN]咕哝声；哼声[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The guard gave a grunt and opened the castle gate.|卫兵哼了一声，打开了城堡大门。[/DU][DU]We heard a grunt from the dragon's cave and went to check.|我们听到龙穴里传来一声哼声，就过去查看。[/DU][DU]The little boy let out a grunt when he lifted the heavy box.|小男孩抬起重箱子时，发出了一声哼声。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]grunt in reply|咕哝着回应[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The old wizard grunted in reply and continued his work.|老巫师咕哝着回应了一声，继续做他的工作。[/EX][EX]The dragon grunted in reply when its master called it.|主人呼唤龙时，它咕哝着回应。[/EX][C]grunt in agreement|咕哝着表示同意[/C][C]grunt in disagreement|咕哝着表示不同意[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]give a grunt|发出哼声[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]He gave a grunt and stood up from the chair.|他哼了一声，从椅子上站了起来。[/EX][EX]The pig gave a grunt and went back to eating.|小猪哼了一声，继续吃东西。[/EX][C]let out a grunt|发出哼声[/C][C]hear a grunt|听到哼声[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The strong man grunted as he carried the heavy stone.[POS]v.[/POS]|那个强壮的男人搬着重石头时，发出了咕哝声。[/EX][EX]The dog grunted when someone stepped on its tail.[POS]v.[/POS]|有人踩到狗尾巴时，它哼了一声。[/EX][EX]A loud grunt came from the forest, scaring the children.[POS]n.[/POS]|森林里传来一声响亮的哼声，吓了孩子们一跳。[/EX][EX]She gave a grunt of satisfaction after finishing the task.[POS]n.[/POS]|完成任务后，她发出了一声满意的哼声。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]grunt 作动词时是不及物动词，后面不能直接接宾语，要接介词，比如“咕哝着说再见”是 grunt goodbye（正确，再见是宾语），但“咕哝着回应”是 grunt in reply（正确）。[/ERR][ERR]作名词时是可数名词，复数形式是 grunts，不要说“a grunt of”（错误），正确表达：a grunt of pain（痛苦的哼声）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 grunt 和 groan！grunt 是“短促的哼声”，groan 是“拉长的呻吟声”，比如“累得哼了一声”是 grunt with tiredness，“疼得呻吟”是 groan with pain。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]The real facts about something (used in the book when the spy made Rori and Ana tell the real situation)[/EN][CN]真相；实情（书中指间谍让罗里和安娜说出了真实情况）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/truːθ/[/PH][DU]Somehow he made us tell the truth, even though we did not want to.|(原文例句)不知怎么的，他让我们说出了真相，尽管我们并不想这样做。[/DU][DU]The wizard knew the truth about the Dragon Stone's power.|巫师知道龙石力量的真相。[/DU][DU]Tell me the truth: did you see the dragon fly?|告诉我真相：你看到龙飞了吗？[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/truth.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]The quality of being honest[/EN][CN]诚实；真实性[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]Honesty and truth are important for a Dragon Master.|诚实和真诚对龙法师来说很重要。[/DU][DU]The truth of his words was proven by the magic stone.|他话语的真实性被魔法石证实了。[/DU][DU]We should always tell the truth to our friends.|我们应该总是对朋友说真话。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]tell the truth|说真话；说出真相[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The spy used dark magic to make them tell the truth.|间谍用黑魔法让他们说出了真相。[/EX][EX]It's better to tell the truth than to lie.|说真话比撒谎好。[/EX][C]tell the whole truth|说出全部真相[/C][C]refuse to tell the truth|拒绝说出真相[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]the truth about sth|关于某事的真相[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]They finally found out the truth about the evil wizard.|他们终于查明了关于邪恶巫师的真相。[/EX][EX]The truth about the dragon's illness surprised everyone.|关于龙生病的真相让所有人都感到惊讶。[/EX][C]the truth about the magic|关于魔法的真相[/C][C]the truth about the past|关于过去的真相[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The truth is that the dragon was trying to protect the village.[POS]n.[/POS]|真相是那条龙在努力保护村庄。[/EX][EX]She couldn't hide the truth from her friends any longer.[POS]n.[/POS]|她再也不能对朋友们隐瞒真相了。[/EX][EX]The truth of his story was confirmed by the wizard.[POS]n.[/POS]|他故事的真实性得到了巫师的证实。[/EX][EX]We should always seek the truth and not believe lies.[POS]n.[/POS]|我们应该总是追求真相，不相信谎言。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]truth 是不可数名词，不要说“a truth”（错误），但表示“一个真相”时可以说“a piece of truth”。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 truth 和 true！truth 是名词“真相”，true 是形容词“真实的”，比如“真实的故事”是 a true story，“故事的真相”是 the truth of the story。[/ERR][ERR]truth 的反义词是 lie（谎言）或 untruth（不实之事），不要写成“untruth”（较少用），常用 lie，比如“说谎”是 tell a lie，“说真话”是 tell the truth。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To fall asleep suddenly or faint (used in the book when Simon the guard fell unconscious on the floor due to the Raven Guard's trick)[/EN][CN]突然睡着；晕倒，不省人事（书中指西蒙卫兵被乌鸦卫队暗算后晕倒在地上）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/kɒŋk/（英式）/kɑːŋk/（美式）[/PH][DU]When they got to Griffith's office, Simon the guard was conked out on the floor!|(原文例句)当他们到达格里菲斯的办公室时，西蒙卫兵已经晕倒在地上了！[/DU][DU]The tired knight conked out on the chair as soon as he got back to the castle.|疲惫的骑士一回到城堡，就倒在椅子上睡着了。[/DU][DU]He conked out from the magic mist and woke up an hour later.|他被魔法雾气熏晕，一小时后才醒过来。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/conk.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To hit someone hard on the head, making them unconscious[/EN][CN]猛击（头部）使晕倒[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guard conked the castle guard on the head to sneak in.|乌鸦卫队猛击城堡卫兵的头部，趁机溜了进去。[/DU][DU]He accidentally conked his head on the dragon's hard scale and felt dizzy.|他不小心把头撞到了龙坚硬的鳞片上，一阵头晕。[/DU][DU]The thief tried to conk the wizard but was stopped by magic.|小偷想把巫师打晕，却被魔法阻拦了。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]conk out|突然睡着；晕倒[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The guard conked out after breathing in the Raven Guard's sleeping powder.|卫兵吸入了乌鸦卫队的迷药后晕倒了。[/EX][EX]After flying for the whole day, the dragon conked out on the grassland.|飞了一整天后，这条龙在草地上沉沉睡去。[/EX][C]conk out on the floor|晕倒在地上[/C][C]conk out from tiredness|累得昏睡过去[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]conk sb on the head|猛击某人的头部[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The spy tried to conk Drake on the head but missed him quickly.|间谍想猛击德雷克的头部，却被他躲开了。[/EX][C]conk sb on the forehead|猛击某人的额头[/C][C]conk the guard on the skull|猛击卫兵的后脑勺[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The little boy conked out during the boring magic lesson and snored loudly.|小男孩在枯燥的魔法课上睡着了，还打起了呼噜。[/EX][EX]The wizard conked out after casting too many powerful spells in a row.|巫师连续施了太多强力咒语，累得晕了过去。[/EX][EX]A stone fell from the tower and conked him on the head, making him conk out at once.|一块石头从塔上掉下来砸中了他的头，他当场就晕了。[/EX][EX]My pet dragon conks out every time after eating a big bag of magic crystals.|我的宠物龙每次吃完一大袋魔法晶石，都会倒头就睡。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]conk作“晕倒、睡着”时，**必须和out连用**构成固定短语conk out，不能单独说sb conked on the floor（错误），正确表达是sb conked out on the floor。[/ERR][ERR]conk是**口语化词汇**，正式书面语中建议用faint（晕倒）、fall asleep（睡着）、knock unconscious（打晕）等表达，比如作文中不用the guard conked out，而用the guard fainted。[/ERR][ERR]conk的过去式和过去分词是conked，现在分词是conking，不要写成conkeded、conkingg等错误形式，比如he conked out yesterday（正确）。[/ERR][ERR]conk作“猛击”时，后接身体部位需加介词on，不能说conk his head（虽口语可用），规范表达是conk him on the head。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To tell someone to do something with authority (used in the book when Griffith ordered the Finding Feather to find the Dragon Stone)[/EN][CN]命令；指挥（书中指格里菲斯向魔法寻踪羽毛下达寻找龙石的指令）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/kəˈmɑːnd/（英式）/kəˈmænd/（美式）[/PH][DU]"Feather, find the stone!" Griffith commanded.|(原文例句)“羽毛，找到石头！”格里菲斯下令道。[/DU][DU]The king can command all the soldiers in the kingdom to protect the castle.|国王能指挥王国里所有的士兵保护城堡。[/DU][DU]The dragon master can command the dragon to fly up and down freely.|龙法师能指挥龙自由地上下飞行。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/command.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]An order given by someone in authority; the power to give orders[/EN][CN]命令；指挥权（当权者下达的指令；发号施令的权力）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The dragon followed its master's command and landed gently on the ground.|龙听从主人的命令，轻轻降落在地上。[/DU][DU]Griffith has the command of all magic spells to protect the Dragon Stone.|格里菲斯掌握着保护龙石的所有魔法咒语的使用权。[/DU][DU]The soldier will carry out the general's command without hesitation.|士兵会毫不犹豫地执行将军的命令。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]command sb to do sth|命令某人做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The wizard commanded the students to practice magic spells every day.|巫师命令学生们每天练习魔法咒语。[/EX][EX]Emperor Song once commanded Bo to steal the Dragon Stone for him.|宋皇帝曾命令波为他偷取龙石。[/EX][C]command the dragon to fly|指挥龙飞行[/C][C]command the guard to stand watch|命令卫兵站岗[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]carry out a command|执行命令[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Raven Guard are always ready to carry out the emperor's command.|乌鸦卫队随时准备执行皇帝的命令。[/EX][EX]The dragon will never refuse to carry out its master's command.|龙永远不会拒绝执行主人的命令。[/EX][C]follow a command|听从命令[/C][C]give a command|下达命令[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She can command the water dragon to make a big wave with its power.[POS]v.[/POS]|她能指挥水龙用自己的力量掀起大浪。[/EX][EX]The teacher commanded the children to stay away from the dangerous dragon cave.[POS]v.[/POS]|老师命令孩子们远离危险的龙穴。[/EX][EX]The general's command made all the soldiers move forward quickly.[POS]n.[/POS]|将军的命令让所有士兵快速前进。[/EX][EX]He has a good command of magic words and can talk with dragons.[POS]n.[/POS]|他精通魔咒，能和龙交流。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]command作动词“命令”时，后面接不定式作宾补，是command sb to do sth，不要说command sb doing sth（错误），比如不能说The wizard commanded us practicing magic。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆command和order！command更正式，侧重“权威者的正式指令”，如国王、将军的命令；order可通用，口语中也能用，如老师对学生的指令。[/ERR][ERR]command作“掌握、精通”时，固定搭配是have a good command of sth，不要少了a，也不要用in代替of（错误：have a good command in English）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To move very quickly with a sharp sound (used in the book when the Finding Feather flew quickly toward the tunnels)[/EN][CN]飕地移动；飞驰（书中指魔法寻踪羽毛快速飞向隧道，带有飕的声响）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/zɪp/[/PH][DU]The feather zipped toward the tunnels.|(原文例句)羽毛飕地朝隧道飞去。[/DU][DU]The dragon zipped through the sky and disappeared in the clouds at once.|龙飕地划过天空，立刻消失在云层里。[/DU][DU]A black bird zipped past the window and flew into the forest.|一只黑鸟飕地掠过窗户，飞进了森林。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/zip.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To fasten something with a zip (a metal or plastic fastener for clothes, bags etc.)[/EN][CN]用拉链拉上（衣物、包袋等的金属或塑料拉链）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She zipped up her magic coat before riding the dragon into the cold sky.|她骑龙飞向寒冷的天空前，拉上了魔法外套的拉链。[/DU][DU]Please zip the bag tight so the magic crystal won't fall out.|请把包用拉链拉紧，这样魔法晶石就不会掉出来了。[/DU][DU]He zipped his backpack and ran to the dragon training room.|他拉上背包拉链，跑向龙的训练室。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]A fast metal or plastic fastener used to join two parts of something[/EN][CN]拉链[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The zip on the dragon saddle is broken, so we need to fix it at once.|龙鞍上的拉链坏了，我们得马上修好它。[/DU][DU]My magic bag has a golden zip with a dragon pattern on it.|我的魔法包有一个带着龙纹的金色拉链。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]zip toward|朝……飕地飞去[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic arrow zipped toward the target and hit it right in the center.|魔法箭飕地朝靶心飞去，正中中心。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard zipped toward the castle gate and tried to sneak in.|乌鸦卫队飕地朝城堡大门跑去，试图溜进去。[/EX][C]zip into|飕地冲进[/C][C]zip past|飕地掠过[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]zip up|拉上拉链[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Zip up your coat, it's very cold outside the castle.|拉上你的外套，城堡外面特别冷。[/EX][EX]She zipped up the bag and put it on the dragon's back.|她拉上包的拉链，把它放在龙背上。[/EX][C]zip sth up tightly|把某物的拉链拉紧[/C][C]zip up the jacket|拉上夹克的拉链[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The little dragon zipped around the garden and played with the butterflies.[POS]v.[/POS]|小龙在花园里飕地飞来飞去，和蝴蝶玩耍。[/EX][EX]A flash of light zipped across the dark sky and it was the magic dragon flying by.[POS]v.[/POS]|一道光飕地划过黑暗的天空，那是魔法龙飞过。[/EX][EX]I need a new zip for my dragon-shaped schoolbag.[POS]n.[/POS]|我的龙形书包需要换一个新拉链。[/EX][EX]He can't zip up his boots by himself because he is too young.[POS]v.[/POS]|他太小了，自己拉不上靴子的拉链。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]zip作“快速移动”时是不及物动词，接方向需加介词，不要说zip the tunnel（错误），正确是zip toward the tunnel。[/ERR][ERR]zip up作“拉上拉链”时，代词作宾语要放在中间，比如zip it up（拉上它），不要说zip up it（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]zip作名词“拉链”时是可数名词，复数是zips，不要说a lot of zip（错误），正确是a lot of zips。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]On the other side of a place; further than a place (used in the book when the dragons flew to the forest further than the hills)[/EN][CN]在……的另一边；越过（书中指龙飞向了山丘那边的森林）[/CN][POS]prep.[/POS][PH]/bɪˈjɒnd/（英式）/bɪˈjɑːnd/（美式）[/PH][DU]They flew over the hills, to the deep, wide forest beyond.|(原文例句)它们飞过山丘，飞向了那边幽深广阔的森林。[/DU][DU]The dragon cave is beyond that big mountain, so we need to fly there by dragon.|龙穴在那座大山的另一边，所以我们得骑龙飞去那里。[/DU][DU]There is a magical lake beyond the Valley of Clouds, and water dragons live there.|云谷的那边有一个魔法湖，水龙就住在那里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/beyond.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]More than a particular amount, level or limit[/EN][CN]超出（数量、水平、限度）[/CN][POS]prep.[/POS][DU]The power of the Water Dragon is beyond our imagination, she can even break dark spells.|水龙的力量超出了我们的想象，她甚至能破解黑魔法。[/DU][DU]This magic problem is beyond me, so I need to ask Griffith for help.|这个魔法难题我解不出来，得去问格里菲斯帮忙。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]Further away in the distance[/EN][CN]在远处；向那边[/CN][POS]adv.[/POS][DU]We looked far beyond, and saw a dragon flying toward the castle.|我们望向远方，看到一条龙正朝城堡飞来。[/DU][DU]The light of the magic stone can be seen far beyond, even in the dark night.|魔法石的光芒在很远的地方都能看到，即使在黑夜里。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]far beyond|远远超出；在遥远的那边[POS]prep./adv.[/POS][/H][EX]The beauty of the dragon kingdom is far beyond what I described.|龙之国的美景远远超出了我所描述的样子。[/EX][EX]We can see the mountains far beyond the river, they look very grand.|我们能看到河那边遥远的群山，看起来十分壮观。[/EX][C]way beyond|大大超出[/C][C]just beyond|就在……的另一边[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]beyond one's imagination|超出某人的想象[POS]prep.[/POS][/H][EX]The speed of the fire dragon is beyond my imagination, it's faster than the wind.|火龙的速度超出了我的想象，比风还快。[/EX][EX]The magic power of the Dragon Stone is beyond everyone's imagination.|龙石的魔法力量超出了所有人的想象。[/EX][C]beyond one's ability|超出某人的能力[/C][C]beyond one's understanding|超出某人的理解[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The new magic spell is beyond the basic training, so only advanced dragon masters can learn it.[POS]prep.[/POS]|这个新魔咒超出了基础训练的范畴，只有高阶龙法师才能学习。[/EX][EX]Beyond the forest lies a small village where people live in peace with dragons.[POS]prep.[/POS]|森林的那边有一个小村庄，那里的人和龙和平共处。[/EX][EX]We walked along the path and found a magic flower just beyond the tree.[POS]prep.[/POS]|我们沿着小路走，在树的另一边发现了一朵魔法花。[/EX][EX]If you look beyond, you can see the tower of King Roland's castle.[POS]adv.[/POS]|如果你望向远方，就能看到罗德国王城堡的塔楼。[/EX]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]In front of someone or something; further forward (used in the book when Drake saw the Raven Guard moving in front of them in the distance)[/EN][CN]在前面；在前方（书中指德雷克看到乌鸦卫队在远处的前方移动）[/CN][POS]adv.[/POS][PH]/əˈhed/[/PH][DU]Drake kept his eyes on the feather. Up ahead, he could see something moving across the treetops: the Raven Guard!|(原文例句)德雷克目光紧紧盯着羽毛，在前方，他看到有东西在树顶移动——是乌鸦卫队！[/DU][DU]Keep straight ahead, and you will see the dragon training room at the end of the corridor.|一直往前走，你会在走廊尽头看到龙的训练室。[/DU][DU]The fire dragon flew ahead, leading the other dragons to the Valley of Clouds.|火龙飞在前面，带领其他龙飞向云谷。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/ahead.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Earlier than a particular time; in advance[/EN][CN]提前；提早[/CN][POS]adv.[/POS][DU]We need to leave ahead of time, or we will miss the meeting with the wizard.|我们需要提前出发，不然会错过和巫师的会面。[/DU][DU]The dragon masters finished their training ahead of schedule, so they had time to play with the dragons.|龙法师们提前完成了训练，所以有时间和龙玩耍。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]In front of someone or something[/EN][CN]在……前面[/CN][POS]prep.[/POS][DU]Ana rode Kepri and flew ahead of the others to check the road ahead.|安娜骑着凯普丽，飞在其他人前面，查看前方的路。[/DU][DU]The guard stood ahead of the castle gate to stop strangers from coming in.|卫兵站在城堡大门前，阻止陌生人进入。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]up ahead|在前方；在前面[POS]adv.[/POS][/H][EX]Up ahead, there is a big bridge over the river, and we need to cross it by dragon.|前方有一座跨河的大桥，我们得骑龙过去。[/EX][EX]I saw a flash of red light up ahead, it must be the fire dragon's flame.|我看到前方有一道红光，一定是火龙的火焰。[/EX][C]right ahead|就在正前方[/C][C]far ahead|在遥远的前方[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]ahead of|在……前面；比……提前[POS]prep.[/POS][/H][EX]Kepri flew ahead of Vulcan because she is a faster dragon.|凯普丽飞在伏尔坎前面，因为她是速度更快的龙。[/EX][EX]He arrived at the dragon cave ahead of the other dragon masters.|他比其他龙法师提前到达了龙穴。[/EX][C]ahead of sb/sth|在某人/某物前面[/C][C]ahead of time/schedule|提前[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The wizard told us to look ahead and watch out for the Raven Guard's attack.[POS]adv.[/POS]|巫师让我们向前看，提防乌鸦卫队的袭击。[/EX][EX]We need to plan ahead if we want to defeat Maldred and his dark magic.[POS]adv.[/POS]|如果我们想打败马尔德雷德和他的黑魔法，就需要提前计划。[/EX][EX]The water dragon swam ahead of the boat and guided it to the magic island.[POS]prep.[/POS]|水龙游在船的前面，指引它驶向魔法岛。[/EX][EX]She finished the magic test ahead of all the other students in her class.[POS]prep.[/POS]|她比班上其他所有学生都提前完成了魔法测试。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]ahead作副词时，**后面不能接宾语**，不要说ahead the forest（错误），正确是ahead of the forest；单独用ahead表示“向前”，如walk ahead（向前走）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆ahead和forward！ahead侧重“空间上的前方、时间上的提前”，forward侧重“向前的动作”，如step forward（向前迈步），go ahead（往前走）。[/ERR][ERR]固定搭配ahead of time/ahead of schedule，不要混用，两者都表示“提前”，ahead of time更口语，ahead of schedule更正式，不要说in ahead of time（错误，多了in）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To take something quickly and suddenly from a place (used in the book when Griffith took the Finding Feather quickly from the air)[/EN][CN]猛地揪起；迅速摘下（书中指格里菲斯从空中猛地揪起魔法寻踪羽毛）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/plʌk/[/PH][DU]Griffith saw him, too. So he plucked the Finding Feather from the air.|(原文例句)格里菲斯也看到了他，于是他从空中猛地揪起了那根寻踪羽毛。[/DU][DU]She plucked a magic flower from the bush and put it in her hair.|她从灌木丛里摘下一朵魔法花，插在了头发上。[/DU][DU]He plucked a piece of fruit from the tree and gave it to the hungry little dragon.|他从树上摘下一颗果子，递给了饥饿的小龙。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/pluck.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To pull out hair, feathers, or leaves from something or someone[/EN][CN]拔（毛发、羽毛、叶子）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The bird plucked a few feathers from its wing and made a small nest for its baby.|鸟儿从翅膀上拔下几根羽毛，给宝宝做了一个小窝。[/DU][DU]She plucked the dead leaves from the magic plant to help it grow better.|她从魔法植物上摘掉枯叶，帮助它长得更好。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To play a stringed instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers[/EN][CN]弹拨（弦乐器）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The wizard plucked the harp and played a magic song to calm the angry dragon.|巫师弹拨着竖琴，奏出一首魔法歌谣，安抚了愤怒的龙。[/DU][DU]She plucked the guitar and sang a song about the dragon masters.|她弹着吉他，唱了一首关于龙法师的歌。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]pluck sth from sp|从某处猛地揪起/摘下某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Drake plucked the magic stone from the bag and held it tightly in his hand.|德雷克从包里猛地拿出魔法石，紧紧握在手里。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard plucked the key from the guard's hand and opened the door quickly.|乌鸦卫队从卫兵手里抢过钥匙，快速打开了门。[/EX][C]pluck a feather from the air|从空中揪起羽毛[/C][C]pluck an apple from the tree|从树上摘下苹果[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]pluck at sth|拉拽某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The little dragon plucked at Bo's clothes and wanted him to play with it.|小龙拉拽着波的衣服，想让他和自己玩。[/EX][EX]She plucked at the wizard's sleeve and asked him a question about magic.|她拉拽着巫师的袖子，问了他一个关于魔法的问题。[/EX][C]pluck at the rope|拉拽绳子[/C][C]pluck at the coat|拉拽外套[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]He plucked a leaf from the magic tree and it turned into a small dragon at once.[POS]v.[/POS]|他从魔法树上摘下一片叶子，叶子立刻变成了一条小龙。[/EX][EX]The musician plucked the violin and the beautiful music attracted many dragons.[POS]v.[/POS]|音乐家拉着小提琴，优美的音乐吸引了许多龙。[/EX][EX]She plucked the grass from the ground and wove a small ring for her friend.[POS]v.[/POS]|她从地上拔起草，给朋友编了一个小戒指。[/EX][EX]The eagle plucked a small fish from the lake and flew away to its nest.[POS]v.[/POS]|老鹰从湖里抓起一条小鱼，飞向了自己的巢穴。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]pluck作“揪起、摘下”时是及物动词，接“从某处”需加介词from，不要说pluck the feather air（错误），正确是pluck the feather from the air。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆pluck和pick！pluck侧重“猛地、快速地摘/揪”，还可表示“拔毛、弹拨乐器”；pick侧重“普通的采摘”，固定搭配pick sth from sp/pick sp for sth。[/ERR][ERR]pluck的过去式和过去分词是plucked，现在分词是plucking，不要写成pluckted、pluckingg等错误形式。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To shine brightly with a small, sharp light (used in the book when Ana's dark eyes shone with excitement)[/EN][CN]闪烁；发微光；熠熠生辉（书中指安娜的黑眼睛因兴奋而闪闪发光）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ɡliːm/[/PH][DU]"We're catching up to him!" [TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic crystal gleamed in the dark and guided us to the dragon cave.[POS]v.[/POS]|魔法晶石在黑暗中闪闪发光，指引我们来到龙穴。[/EX][EX]His eyes gleamed with determination when he said he would save his family.|当他说要拯救家人时，眼里闪烁着坚定的光芒。[/EX][EX]A gleam of moonlight fell on the dragon's wing and made it look like silver.|一缕月光落在龙的翅膀上，让它看起来像银做的一样。[/EX][EX]There was a gleam of surprise on her face when she saw the dragon fly into the room.|当她看到龙飞进房间时，脸上闪过一丝惊讶。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]gleam作动词“闪烁”时，接情感/光的修饰需加介词with，不要说gleam excitement（错误），正确是gleam with excitement。[/ERR][ERR]gleam作名词“微光、一丝”时，是可数名词，固定搭配a gleam of sth，不要少了a，也不要用of sth（错误：gleam of hope）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆gleam和glow！gleam侧重“短暂、尖锐的微光/闪光”，如眼睛的闪烁、刀剑的寒光；glow侧重“柔和、持续的光芒”，如炉火的光、魔法石的柔光。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To increase speed (used in the book when Kepri increased her flying speed to block the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]加快速度（书中指凯普丽提升飞行速度，阻拦乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/pɪk ʌp/[/PH][DU]Kepri picked up speed. [TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]An amount of something that you can hold in one hand (used in the book when the Raven Guard took out an amount of red dust he could hold in one hand)[/EN][CN]一把（的量）（书中指乌鸦卫队掏出了一把红粉末）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈhændfʊl/[/PH][DU]The guard reached into a pocket. He pulled out a handful of glittering, red dust.|(原文例句)卫兵伸进口袋，掏出了一把闪闪发光的红色粉末。[/DU][DU]She took a handful of magic seeds and sowed them in the soil, and colorful flowers grew at once.|她抓了一把魔法种子撒进土里，五颜六色的花立刻长了出来。[/DU][DU]He gave the little dragon a handful of crystal food, and it ate it happily.|他给了小龙一把水晶饲料，小龙吃得很开心。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/handful.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A small number of people or things[/EN][CN]少数；少量（人或物）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]Only a handful of dragon masters can control the power of the Water Dragon.|只有少数龙法师能掌控水龙的力量。[/DU][DU]There are only a handful of magic stones left in the castle, so we need to save them.|城堡里只剩下少量魔法石了，我们得省着用。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The little girl grabbed a handful of candies from the plate and ran to play with the dragon.[POS]n.[/POS]|小女孩从盘子里抓了一把糖果，跑去和龙玩。[/EX][EX]Only a handful of people know the secret of the Dragon Stone, so it's very safe.|只有少数人知道龙石的秘密，所以它非常安全。[/EX][EX]He put a handful of soil from the magic forest into the box to keep the magic alive.|他往盒子里装了一把魔法森林的泥土，让魔法一直存在。[/EX][EX]There are a handful of books about water dragons in the wizard's library, we can read them.|巫师的图书馆里有几本关于水龙的书，我们可以读一读。[/EX]
