[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A long, thin line or mark of a different colour or material; a flash of light moving quickly (used in the book when a bright line of light flew across the sky with the Raven Guard's movement)[/EN][CN]条纹；斑纹；一道快速闪过的光（书中指乌鸦卫队移动时，一道亮光飞速划过天空）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/striːk/[/PH][DU]A bright red streak shot across the treetops as the Raven Guard fled with the dust.|(原文例句)乌鸦卫队带着粉末逃走时，一道鲜红的光痕划过了树梢。[/DU][DU]The fire dragon has a golden streak on its back, which is the sign of a powerful dragon.|火龙的背上有一道金色斑纹，那是强大巨龙的标志。[/DU][DU]A white streak of light flashed in the dark sky, it was the magic arrow flying by.|黑暗的天空中闪过一道白光，那是魔法箭飞过的痕迹。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/streak.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To move very quickly in a straight line (in a particular direction)[/EN][CN]飞速掠过；疾驰而过[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guard streaked through the forest and tried to escape from the dragon masters.|乌鸦卫队飞速穿过森林，试图摆脱龙法师的追赶。[/DU][DU]The water dragon streaked across the lake and caught the magic fish in an instant.|水龙飞速掠过湖面，一瞬间就抓住了魔法鱼。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a streak of|一道……；一丝……；一条……斑纹[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a streak of blue light in the magic mist, which is the guide of the Dragon Stone.|魔法迷雾中有一道蓝光，那是龙石的指引。[/EX][EX]The little dragon has a black streak on its tail, making it look very special.|小龙的尾巴上有一条黑色斑纹，让它看起来格外特别。[/EX][C]a streak of lightning|一道闪电[/C][C]a streak of hope|一丝希望[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]streak through/across|飞速穿过/掠过[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic bird streaked across the castle sky and delivered the letter to the wizard.|魔法鸟飞速掠过城堡上空，把信送到了巫师手中。[/EX][EX]The Raven Guard streaked through the tunnel and disappeared in the dark.|乌鸦卫队飞速穿过隧道，消失在黑暗中。[/EX][C]streak toward|朝……疾驰而去[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic sword left a silver streak in the air when the wizard swung it hard.[POS]n.[/POS]|巫师用力挥动魔法剑时，剑在空中留下了一道银痕。[/EX][EX]A streak of anger appeared on his face when he knew the Raven Guard stole the magic dust.[POS]n.[/POS]|得知乌鸦卫队偷走了魔法粉末，他的脸上闪过一丝怒意。[/EX][EX]The young dragon streaked around the mountain and showed its amazing speed to the master.[POS]v.[/POS]|小龙绕着山峰疾驰，向主人展示自己惊人的速度。[/EX][EX]A shooting star streaked across the night sky, and the dragon master made a wish at once.[POS]v.[/POS]|一颗流星划过夜空，龙法师立刻许下了心愿。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]streak作名词表示“一道光/痕迹”时，固定搭配是a streak of sth，不要少了a，也不要直接说streak light（错误），正确是a streak of light。[/ERR][ERR]streak作动词“飞速移动”时是不及物动词，接地点/方向需加介词through/across/toward等，不要说streak the forest（错误），正确是streak through the forest。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆streak和stripe！streak侧重“不规则、临时的条纹/光痕”，如光的轨迹、情绪的一闪；stripe侧重“规则、固定的条纹”，如衣服、动物身上的斑纹。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To take and use something that belongs to someone else, and promise to return it (used in the book when Bo asked Griffith to lend him a magic tool to find the dust)[/EN][CN]借；借用（向他人取用某物并承诺归还，书中指波请求格里菲斯借给他一件魔法工具寻找粉末）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈbɒrəʊ/（英式）/ˈbɔːroʊ/（美式）[/PH][DU]"Can I borrow your Finding Feather for a while?" Bo asked Griffith politely.|(原文例句)“我能借你的寻踪羽毛用一会儿吗？”波礼貌地问格里菲斯。[/DU][DU]The young dragon master went to the wizard's library to borrow a book about dragon spells.|年轻的龙法师去巫师的图书馆借了一本关于龙咒的书。[/DU][DU]I need to borrow a magic wand from Ana, because mine is broken in the fight.|我需要向安娜借一根魔法棒，因为我的在战斗中摔坏了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/borrow.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]borrow sth from sb/sp|向某人/从某处借某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Drake decided to borrow a flying cloak from the wizard to chase the Raven Guard.|德雷克决定向巫师借一件飞行斗篷，去追赶乌鸦卫队。[/EX][EX]We can borrow magic potions from the castle's apothecary if we need them.|如果需要，我们可以从城堡的药剂师那里借魔法药剂。[/EX][C]borrow a book from the library|从图书馆借书[/C][C]borrow a knife from the guard|向卫兵借一把刀[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]borrow money from sb|向某人借钱[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The poor traveler wanted to borrow some money from the dragon master to buy food.|可怜的旅人想向龙法师借点钱买吃的。[/EX][EX]He never borrows anything from others, because he likes to solve problems by himself.|他从不向别人借任何东西，因为他喜欢自己解决问题。[/EX]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]Can I borrow your dragon saddle for a trip to the magic lake? It's more comfortable than mine.[POS]v.[/POS]|我能借你的龙鞍去魔法湖一趟吗？它比我的舒服多了。[/EX][EX]She went to the magic shop to borrow a crystal ball to predict the movement of the Raven Guard.[POS]v.[/POS]|她去魔法商店借了一个水晶球，预测乌鸦卫队的动向。[/EX][EX]The little boy wanted to borrow a toy dragon from his friend and promised to return it tomorrow.[POS]v.[/POS]|小男孩想向朋友借一只玩具龙，并承诺明天归还。[/EX][EX]We can borrow a boat from the villagers to cross the magic river to the other side.[POS]v.[/POS]|我们可以向村民借一艘船，渡过魔法河到对岸。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]核心易错：borrow是“借入”（从别人那里借到自己这边），lend是“借出”（把自己的东西借给别人），不要说I lend a book from him（错误），正确是I borrow a book from him；He lends a book to me（正确）。[/ERR][ERR]borrow的固定搭配是borrow sth from sb，不要用to代替from（错误：borrow a pen to her），也不要说borrow sb sth（极少用，规范用borrow sth from sb）。[/ERR][ERR]borrow是瞬间动词，不能和表示一段时间的状语连用，不要说I have borrowed the book for a week（错误），正确是I have kept the book for a week。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]If you do something in person, you do it yourself, not by sending someone else or by phone/letter (used in the book when Griffith decided to go to the forest by himself to find the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]亲自；亲身（自己做某事，而非派别人或通过电话/信件，书中指格里菲斯决定亲自去森林寻找乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]adv. phr.[/POS][PH]/ɪn ˈpɜːsn/（英式）/ɪn ˈpɜːrsn/（美式）[/PH][DU]Griffith said he would go to the dark forest in person to stop the Raven Guard's plan.|(原文例句)格里菲斯说他会亲自去黑森林阻止乌鸦卫队的计划。[/DU][DU]The king came to the dragon training ground in person to watch the young masters' training.|国王亲自来到龙术训练场，观看年轻法师的训练。[/DU][DU]You need to hand in the magic task in person, you can't ask others to do it for you.|你需要亲自交魔法任务，不能让别人替你做。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/in person.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]do sth in person|亲自做某事[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The wizard decided to meet the water dragon king in person to make a peace agreement.|巫师决定亲自去见水龙王，签订和平协议。[/EX][EX]If you want to get the magic crystal, you have to go to the cave in person to get it.|如果你想得到魔法晶石，必须亲自去洞穴里取。[/EX][C]go somewhere in person|亲自去某地[/C][C]talk to sb in person|亲自和某人交谈[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]come in person|亲自前来[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The Raven Guard leader didn't come in person, he sent his men to steal the magic dust.|乌鸦卫队的首领没有亲自前来，他派手下偷走了魔法粉末。[/EX][EX]I hope you can come in person to the dragon party, not just send a gift.|我希望你能亲自来参加龙宴，而不只是送一份礼物。[/EX][C]appear in person|亲自现身[/C][C]check sth in person|亲自检查某物[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon master taught the new spell in person, so all the students could learn it well.[POS]adv. phr.[/POS]|龙法师亲自教授新的咒语，所以所有学生都能学好。[/EX][EX]She went to the castle in person to apologize to the king for her mistake.|她亲自去城堡，为自己的错误向国王道歉。[/EX][EX]This magic ceremony must be held by the elder in person, no one else can take his place.[POS]adv. phr.[/POS]|这场魔法仪式必须由长老亲自主持，其他人都不能代替他。[/EX][EX]He didn't call the wizard, he went to the tower in person to ask for help.[POS]adv. phr.[/POS]|他没有给巫师打电话，而是亲自去塔楼求助。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]in person是固定副词短语，**不能随意拆分**，不要说in the person（错误）、in persons（错误，无复数形式），也不要说by person（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]in person在句中多作状语，放在句末或行为动词后，不要放在句首作主语（错误：In person he went to the forest），正确是He went to the forest in person。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆in person和personally！in person侧重“亲自到场做某事”，强调行为的亲历性；personally侧重“就个人而言、亲自（主观上）”，如Personally, I like this dragon spell. / I personally made this magic potion.。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To believe that someone is honest and will not harm you, or that something is safe and reliable (used in the book when Griffith said he believed Bo would help him stop the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]相信；信任；信赖（认为某人诚实无害、某物安全可靠，书中指格里菲斯说他相信波会帮他阻止乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/trʌst/[/PH][DU]"I trust you, Bo. You will help us find the Raven Guard." Griffith said sincerely.|(原文例句)“我相信你，波。你会帮我们找到乌鸦卫队的。”格里菲斯真诚地说。[/DU][DU]The dragon masters all trust their dragons, and they will never betray each other.|龙法师们都信任自己的龙，它们永远不会互相背叛。[/DU][DU]You can trust this magic lock, it can't be opened by dark magic.|你可以相信这把魔法锁，黑魔法打不开它。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/trust.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A feeling of believing in the honesty, ability or safety of someone or something[/EN][CN]信任；信赖；信心[CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The trust between the dragon and its master is the most important thing in dragon training.|龙和主人之间的信任，是龙术训练中最重要的东西。[/DU][DU]He has lost the trust of the wizard, because he lied about the location of the Dragon Stone.|他失去了巫师的信任，因为他谎报了龙石的位置。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]trust sb/sth|相信某人/某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]We all trust Ana, she is the most careful dragon master in our team.|我们都相信安娜，她是我们队里最细心的龙法师。[/EX][EX]Don't trust the sweet words of the Raven Guard, they are full of lies.|不要相信乌鸦卫队的甜言蜜语，他们满口谎言。[/EX][C]trust sb to do sth|相信某人会做某事[/C][C]trust that + 从句|相信……[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]have trust in sb/sth|信任某人/某物[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The king has great trust in Griffith, so he lets him protect the Dragon Stone.|国王十分信任格里菲斯，所以让他守护龙石。[/EX][EX]We have full trust in the magic shield, it can protect us from the enemy's attack.|我们完全相信这面魔法盾，它能保护我们免受敌人的攻击。[/EX][C]gain/win the trust of sb|赢得某人的信任[/C][C]lose the trust of sb|失去某人的信任[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]I trust that you will return the Finding Feather on time, so I lend it to you.[POS]v.[/POS]|我相信你会按时归还寻踪羽毛，所以才把它借给你。[/EX][EX]The little dragon learned to trust its master after they experienced many dangers together.[POS]v.[/POS]|小龙和主人一起经历了许多危险后，学会了信任主人。[/EX][EX]It takes a long time to build trust between humans and dragons, but it can be lost in a moment.[POS]n.[/POS]|建立人和龙之间的信任需要很久，但失去它只在一瞬间。[/EX][EX]She proved her ability with actions and finally won the trust of all the dragon masters.[POS]n.[/POS]|她用行动证明了自己的能力，最终赢得了所有龙法师的信任。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]trust作动词接从句时，直接加that从句（that可省略），不要加to（错误：trust to he will come），正确是trust (that) he will come。[/ERR][ERR]trust作动词表示“相信某人做某事”，是trust sb to do sth，不要说trust sb doing sth（错误），如I trust you to finish the task。[/ERR][ERR]trust作名词“信任”时，可作可数或不可数名词，固定搭配have trust in sb，不要用on代替in（错误：have trust on sb）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To help someone do something, especially by doing the smaller or less important parts (used in the book when the young dragon masters helped Griffith to find the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]协助；帮助（尤指做次要或辅助性的工作，书中指年轻的龙法师们协助格里菲斯寻找乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/əˈsɪst/[/PH][DU]All the young dragon masters decided to assist Griffith to track down the Raven Guard in the dark forest.|(原文例句)所有年轻的龙法师都决定协助格里菲斯，在黑森林追踪乌鸦卫队。[/DU][DU]The magic elf offered to assist the wizard to make the powerful magic potion.|魔法小精灵主动提出协助巫师制作强力魔法药剂。[/DU][DU]I will assist you to take care of the baby dragon while you are away.|你不在的时候，我会协助你照顾小龙。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/assist.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]An act of helping someone to do something[/EN][CN]协助；帮助[CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/əˈsɪst/[/PH][DU]With the assist of the water dragon, we crossed the magic river safely.|在水龙的协助下，我们安全地渡过了魔法河。[/DU][DU]Your assist is very important, we can't finish the task without you.|你的帮助至关重要，没有你我们完不成这项任务。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]assist sb to do sth|协助某人做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The guard will assist you to open the castle gate with the magic key.|卫兵会用魔法钥匙协助你打开城堡大门。[/EX][EX]She agreed to assist the dragon master to train the new young dragons.|她答应协助龙法师训练新来的小龙。[/EX][C]assist sb in doing sth|协助某人做某事[/C][C]assist with sth|协助做某事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]with the assist of sb/sth|在某人/某物的协助下[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]With the assist of the Finding Feather, we found the hiding place of the Raven Guard quickly.|在寻踪羽毛的协助下，我们很快找到了乌鸦卫队的藏身之处。[/EX][EX]With the assist of the magic crystal, the wizard saw the future of the dragon kingdom.|在魔法晶石的协助下，巫师看到了龙之国的未来。[/EX][C]give an assist to sb|向某人提供帮助[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The students assisted the teacher in cleaning the magic laboratory after the class.[POS]v.[/POS]|课后学生们协助老师打扫魔法实验室。[/EX][EX]He was asked to assist with the preparation of the dragon festival, such as decorating the castle.|他被要求协助筹备龙节，比如装饰城堡。[/EX][EX]With the assist of the flying carpet, we flew to the top of the magic mountain in a short time.[POS]n.[/POS]|在飞毯的协助下，我们很快飞到了魔法山的山顶。[/EX][EX]Her assist in the fight made us defeat the dark wizard easily.[POS]n.[/POS]|她在战斗中的协助，让我们轻松打败了黑巫师。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]assist是正式用语，侧重“辅助、协助”，后接不定式时是assist sb to do sth，接动名词时需加in，即assist sb in doing sth，不要说assist sb do sth（错误，缺少to）。[/ERR][ERR]assist作动词表示“协助做某事”，接事物时用assist with sth，不要用to代替with（错误：assist to the work），正确是assist with the work。[/ERR][ERR]assist作名词“协助”时，多为可数名词，固定搭配with the assist of sb，不要少了the，也不要说in the assist of sb（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆assist和help！assist更正式，侧重“辅助性的帮助”，多用于工作、任务等正式场合；help通用，可用于各种场合，口语和书面语均可。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make something stronger or more powerful; to become stronger or more powerful (used in the book when Griffith used magic to make the Dragon Stone's protection more powerful)[/EN][CN]加强；增强；巩固；使更强大（书中指格里菲斯用魔法增强了龙石的防护力量）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈstreŋθn/（英式）/ˈstrɛŋkθn/（美式）[/PH][DU]Griffith used his most powerful magic to strengthen the protection of the Dragon Stone at once.|(原文例句)格里菲斯立刻用自己最强大的魔法，加强了龙石的防护。[/DU][DU]The dragon master used magic to strengthen the dragon's scales, making them harder than steel.|龙法师用魔法强化了龙的鳞片，让它们比钢铁还坚硬。[/DU][DU]This magic potion can strengthen your magic power for three hours.|这种魔法药剂能增强你的魔力三小时。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/strengthen.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]strengthen sth|加强/增强某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to strengthen the castle walls to prevent the attack of the dark army.|我们需要加固城堡的城墙，抵御黑暗军队的进攻。[/EX][EX]Practicing magic every day can strengthen your ability to control dragons.|每天练习魔法，能增强你操控龙的能力。[/EX][C]strengthen the protection|加强防护[/C][C]strengthen the bond|巩固联系[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]strengthen sb/sth against sth|增强某人/某物抵御某物的能力[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]This spell can strengthen us against the dark magic of the Raven Guard.|这个咒语能增强我们抵御乌鸦卫队黑魔法的能力。[/EX][EX]The magic shield can strengthen the castle against the dragon's fire breath.|这面魔法盾能增强城堡抵御龙焰的能力。[/EX][C]strengthen the body against illness|增强身体的抗病能力[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]strengthen into|逐渐变得强大；巩固成[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The small dragon team strengthened into a powerful army after many battles.|这支小龙队经过多次战斗，逐渐成长为一支强大的军队。[/EX][EX]Their friendship strengthened into a lifelong bond after experiencing the danger together.|一起经历过危险后，他们的友谊巩固成了一生的羁绊。[/EX]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The king decided to strengthen the army to protect the dragon kingdom from enemies.[POS]v.[/POS]|国王决定扩充军队，保护龙之国免受敌人侵袭。[/EX][EX]Drinking this magic water can strengthen your connection with your dragon.[POS]v.[/POS]|喝下这瓶魔法水，能加强你和你的龙之间的联结。[/EX][EX]The wizard used a crystal to strengthen the magic barrier around the forest.[POS]v.[/POS]|巫师用一块晶石，加固了森林周围的魔法屏障。[/EX][EX]Our determination to protect the Dragon Stone has strengthened after the attack of the Raven Guard.[POS]v.[/POS]|遭遇乌鸦卫队的袭击后，我们守护龙石的决心更加坚定了。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]strengthen是动词，由形容词strong变形而来，不要和名词strength混淆（错误：We need to strength the protection），正确是We need to strengthen the protection。[/ERR][ERR]strengthen是及物动词，可直接接宾语，也可作不及物动词（表示“变得强大”），不要在后面多余加up（错误：strengthen up the wall），直接说strengthen the wall。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆strengthen和reinforce！strengthen侧重“从内部增强力量、强度、联系等”，如增强魔力、巩固友谊；reinforce侧重“通过外部添加东西加固、增援”，如加固城墙、增援军队。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To take something away from a place or position; to take something off something/someone (used in the book when Griffith took the magic dust away from the Raven Guard's hand)[/EN][CN]移开；拿走；去掉；脱下（书中指格里菲斯从乌鸦卫队手中拿走了魔法粉末）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/rɪˈmuːv/[/PH][DU]Griffith stretched out his hand and quickly removed the red dust from the guard's palm.|(原文例句)格里菲斯伸出手，迅速从卫兵的手掌中拿走了红色粉末。[/DU][DU]Please remove the magic stones from the table, the dragon will knock them over.|请把魔法晶石从桌子上拿走，龙会把它们碰倒的。[/DU][DU]She removed her magic cloak after entering the warm castle hall.|走进温暖的城堡大厅后，她脱下了魔法斗篷。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/remove.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To dismiss someone from their job or position[/EN][CN]免除；解除（某人的职务）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The king removed the captain of the guard because he let the Raven Guard break into the castle.|国王解除了卫队长的职务，因为他让乌鸦卫队闯入了城堡。[/DU][DU]The wizard removed him from the dragon master team because he broke the magic rules.|巫师把他从龙法师队伍中除名，因为他违反了魔法规则。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]remove sth from sp/sb|从某地/某人身上拿走/去掉某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The dragon used its claw to remove the big stone from the tunnel entrance.|龙用爪子把隧道口的大石头移开了。[/EX][EX]We need to remove the dark magic from his body with the Dragon Stone's power.|我们需要用龙石的力量，把他身上的黑魔法清除掉。[/EX][C]remove the cover from the box|拿掉盒子的盖子[/C][C]remove the spell from sb|解除某人身上的咒语[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]remove sth off sth|从某物上拿掉某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Please remove the dust off the magic mirror, so we can see the future clearly.|请擦掉魔法镜上的灰尘，这样我们就能清楚地看到未来了。[/EX][EX]He removed the wet cloth off the dragon's wing to help it dry quickly.|他把龙翅膀上的湿布拿掉，帮它快点晾干。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]remove sb from one's post/position|免除某人的职务[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The elder removed him from his post as the magic teacher because he didn't teach the students well.|长老免除了他魔法老师的职务，因为他教得不好。[/EX][EX]If you make another mistake, the master will remove you from the dragon training team.|如果你再犯错，主人就会把你从龙术训练队中除名。[/EX]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She removed the thorns from the dragon's paw with a magic knife and healed it at once.[POS]v.[/POS]|她用魔法刀拔掉龙爪子上的刺，立刻为它治好了伤。[/EX][EX]We need to remove the magic barrier to let the friendly dragons come into the castle.[POS]v.[/POS]|我们需要解除魔法屏障，让友好的龙进入城堡。[/EX][EX]He removed his magic hat and bowed to the king when he entered the palace.|进入宫殿时，他摘下魔法帽，向国王鞠躬。[/EX][EX]The magic can remove the memory of the danger from the little dragon's mind.[POS]v.[/POS]|这种魔法能消除小龙脑海中关于危险的记忆。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]remove作“拿走、移开”时，固定搭配是remove sth from sp/sb，不要用out代替from（错误：remove the book out the table），正确是remove the book from the table。[/ERR][ERR]remove是及物动词，可直接接宾语，不要多余加away（错误：remove away the stone），直接说remove the stone（本身已含“拿走、移开”的意思）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆remove和move！remove侧重“将某物从某处拿走、去掉，使其不再存在于该位置”；move侧重“将某物从一个位置移到另一个位置，仍存在”，如remove the cup from the table（把杯子从桌上拿走），move the cup to the chair（把杯子移到椅子上）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To move something so that the other side is facing up; to flip something over (used in the book when Bo flipped the magic box over to find the hidden dust)[/EN][CN]翻转；翻过来；把……翻个儿（书中指波把魔法盒子翻过来，寻找藏起来的粉末）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/tɜːn ˈəʊvə/（英式）/tɜːrn ˈoʊvər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bo picked up the small magic box and turned it over to check the bottom for the red dust.|(原文例句)波拿起小魔法盒，把它翻过来检查盒底，寻找红色粉末。[/DU][DU]Please turn over the magic map, the other side has the route to the dragon cave.|请把魔法地图翻过来，背面有去龙穴的路线。[/DU][DU]The dragon turned over in the sky and showed its shiny belly to the master.|龙在天上翻了个身，向主人展示自己闪闪发光的肚子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/turn over.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To think about something carefully and for a long time[/EN][CN]仔细思考；反复斟酌[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]Griffith turned over the Raven Guard's plan in his mind and tried to find their weakness.|格里菲斯在脑海中反复斟酌乌鸦卫队的计划，试图找到他们的弱点。[/DU][DU]She turned over the problem for a whole night and finally found the solution with magic.|她仔细思考这个问题一整晚，最终用魔法找到了解决办法。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To give something to someone else, especially authority or control[/EN][CN]移交；交出（尤指权力、控制权或某物）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]The old dragon master turned over the control of the dragon team to the young Griffith.|老龙法师把龙队的控制权移交给了年轻的格里菲斯。[/DU][DU]The guard decided to turn over the stolen magic dust to the wizard and apologize for his mistake.|卫兵决定把偷来的魔法粉末交给巫师，并为自己的错误道歉。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]turn over sth/turn sth over|翻转某物[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]Turn over the magic card, and you will see the secret spell on the back.|把魔法卡片翻过来，你会看到背面的秘密咒语。[/EX][EX]He turned the stone over and found a small magic crystal under it.|他把石头翻过来，在下面发现了一颗小魔法晶石。[/EX][C]turn over in the air|在空中翻身[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]turn over sth in one's mind|在脑海中反复思考某事[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]I turned over the wizard's words in my mind and tried to understand their meaning.|我在脑海中反复思考巫师的话，试图理解其中的含义。[/EX][EX]She turned over the plan to save the dragon in her mind for many days.|她为拯救龙的计划反复思考了很多天。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]turn over sth to sb|把某物移交给某人[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The police turned over the captured Raven Guard to the king for punishment.|卫兵把抓获的乌鸦卫队移交给国王处置。[/EX][EX]He turned over all his magic tools to the library after he retired as a dragon master.|他从龙法师的职位退休后，把所有魔法工具都交给了图书馆。[/EX][C]turn over control to sb|把控制权移交给某人[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The little boy turned over the book and drew a small dragon on the blank page.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|小男孩把书翻过来，在空白页上画了一条小龙。[/EX][EX]The water dragon turned over in the lake and splashed a lot of water on the bank.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|水龙在湖里翻了个身，把很多水溅到了岸上。[/EX][EX]The king turned over the problem of the dark magic in his mind and asked the wizard for advice.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|国王反复思考黑魔法的问题，并向巫师寻求建议。[/EX][EX]The old wizard turned over all his magic knowledge to his students before he left.|老巫师离开前，把自己所有的魔法知识都传授给了学生。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]turn over是短语动词，**代词作宾语时必须放在中间**，如turn it over（把它翻过来）、turn them over（把它们翻过来），不要说turn over it/turn over them（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]turn over表示“仔细思考”时，固定搭配是turn over sth in one's mind，不要缺少in one's mind（错误：turn over the plan），完整表达是turn over the plan in my mind。[/ERR][ERR]turn over表示“移交”时，固定搭配是turn over sth to sb，不要用for代替to（错误：turn over the dust for the wizard），正确是turn over the dust to the wizard。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To move upwards; to get up from a sitting, lying or kneeling position (used in the book when the smoke from the magic dust moved up into the air)[/EN][CN]上升；升起；起身；站起（书中指魔法粉末的烟雾飘向空中）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/raɪz/[/PH][DU]A thin cloud of red smoke rose from the guard's palm as the dust met the air.|(原文例句)当粉末接触到空气时，一缕红色烟雾从卫兵的手掌中升起。[/DU][DU]The sun rose behind the magic mountains and lit up the whole dragon kingdom.|太阳从魔法山脉后升起，照亮了整个龙之国。[/DU][DU]Griffith rose from his chair and prepared to go to the dark forest at once.|格里菲斯从椅子上起身，准备立刻前往黑森林。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/rise.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To increase in amount, number, level or price[/EN][CN]（数量、水平、价格等）上升；增长[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The magic power of the Dragon Stone began to rise when the dark magic came near.|当黑魔法靠近时，龙石的魔力开始增强。[/DU][DU]The number of dragon masters in the kingdom is rising year by year.|王国里的龙法师数量逐年增加。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]rise into the air|升入空中[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic feather rose into the air and flew toward the direction of the dragon cave.|魔法羽毛升入空中，朝龙穴的方向飞去。[/EX][EX]A flock of magic birds rose into the air and circled above the castle.|一群魔法鸟升入空中，在城堡上空盘旋。[/EX][C]rise up|升起；奋起；反抗[/C][C]rise from|从……升起；从……起身[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]rise in sth|在某方面上升/增长[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]There has been a sharp rise in the use of dark magic since the Raven Guard appeared.|自从乌鸦卫队出现后，黑魔法的使用量急剧上升。[/EX][EX]The rise in temperature made the magic ice in the cave start to melt.|气温的上升让洞穴里的魔法冰开始融化。[/EX][C]rise in price|价格上涨[/C][C]rise in power|势力增强[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon rose from the lake and spread its huge wings to fly into the sky.[POS]v.[/POS]|龙从湖中升起，展开巨大的翅膀飞向天空。[/EX][EX]She rose slowly from the ground and brushed the dust off her magic robe.[POS]v.[/POS]|她慢慢从地上站起来，掸掉魔法长袍上的灰尘。[/EX][EX]The fog rose from the magic valley and made the whole mountain look mysterious.[POS]v.[/POS]|雾气从魔法山谷升起，让整座山看起来神秘莫测。[/EX][EX]His confidence began to rise after he successfully controlled the fire dragon for the first time.[POS]v.[/POS]|他第一次成功操控火龙后，自信心开始增强。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]核心易错：rise是**不及物动词**，后面不能直接接宾语；raise是**及物动词**，必须接宾语，不要说The sun rose the curtain（错误），正确是The curtain rose / He raised the curtain。[/ERR][ERR]rise的过去式是rose，过去分词是risen，不要记错成raised（错误：The smoke has raised），正确是The smoke has risen。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆rise和arise！rise侧重“具体的位置、数量上升，起身”；arise侧重“抽象的问题、困难出现，产生”，如A problem arose / The sun rose。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A regular arrangement of lines, shapes, colours, etc.; a way of doing something that is repeated regularly (used in the book when Bo found the repeated line design on the magic box)[/EN][CN]图案；花纹；模式；方式；规律（书中指波发现魔法盒子上重复的线条纹路）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpætn/（英式）/ˈpeɪtərn/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bo found a strange star pattern on the bottom of the magic box with the red dust.|(原文例句)波在装着红色粉末的魔法盒底部，发现了一个奇怪的星星图案。[/DU][DU]The water dragon's scales have a blue wave pattern, which is unique to water dragons.|水龙的鳞片有蓝色的波浪花纹，这是水龙独有的特征。[/DU][DU]The Raven Guard always follow the same attack pattern, so we can find their weakness easily.|乌鸦卫队总是遵循相同的攻击模式，所以我们能轻易找到他们的弱点。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/pattern.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make something with a regular arrangement of shapes, colours, etc.[/EN][CN]给……加上图案；用图案装饰[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The wizard patterned the magic wand with dragon carvings to make it more powerful.|巫师在魔法棒上刻上龙的图案作装饰，让它的力量更强。[/DU][DU]She patterned the dragon saddle with golden threads and it looked very beautiful.|她用金线给龙鞍绣上图案，看起来十分精美。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a pattern of sth|……的图案；……的模式[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a pattern of fire on the fire dragon's wings, which glows in the dark.|火龙的翅膀上有火焰的图案，在黑暗中会发光。[/EX][EX]We need to break the old pattern of training and try new ways to teach young dragons.|我们需要打破旧的训练模式，尝试新的方法训练小龙。[/EX][C]a flower pattern|花卉图案[/C][C]a sleeping pattern|睡眠规律[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]pattern sth with sth|用某物给某物装饰图案[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]She patterned the magic cloak with silver stars and it shined at night.|她用银星给魔法斗篷绣上图案，斗篷在夜里会发光。[/EX][EX]The craftsman patterned the stone table with magic runes to protect it from dark magic.|工匠在石桌上刻上魔法符文作图案，保护它不受黑魔法侵袭。[/EX][C]pattern sth on sth|仿照某物制作图案[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic carpet has a colorful dragon pattern and it can fly faster when the pattern glows.[POS]n.[/POS]|魔法地毯有彩色的龙纹图案，图案发光时地毯能飞得更快。[/EX][EX]This pattern of using magic crystals to power the castle has been used for hundreds of years.[POS]n.[/POS]|这种用魔法晶石为城堡供能的方式已经沿用了数百年。[/EX][EX]He patterned the wooden box with the symbol of the dragon kingdom and gave it to the king as a gift.[POS]v.[/POS]|他仿照龙之国的标志给木盒刻上图案，把它当作礼物送给了国王。[/EX][EX]The little girl patterned her notebook with small dragon drawings and showed it to her dragon master teacher.[POS]v.[/POS]|小女孩在笔记本上画满小龙图案作装饰，拿给她的龙法师老师看。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]pattern作名词“模式、规律”时，是可数名词，不要说in pattern of（错误），正确是in a pattern of / in the pattern of。[/ERR][ERR]pattern作动词时，固定搭配是pattern sth with sth，不要用by代替with（错误：pattern the box by stars），正确是pattern the box with stars。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆pattern和design！pattern侧重“重复出现的、有规律的图案或模式”；design侧重“为特定目的设计的图案、构思、设计方案”，如a check pattern / a new design for the dragon saddle。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A tall, straight stone or metal post that supports a building; a long, narrow upright section of something; a line of people or things moving together (used in the book when the Raven Guard moved in a straight line toward the castle gate)[/EN][CN]柱；柱子；圆柱；列；纵队（书中指乌鸦卫队排成一列纵队朝城堡大门移动）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkɒləm/（英式）/ˈkɑːləm/（美式）[/PH][DU]A column of Raven Guard marched toward the castle gate, holding their dark magic wands.|(原文例句)一队乌鸦卫队手持黑魔法棒，排成纵队朝城堡大门行进。[/DU][DU]A huge stone column in the castle hall supports the golden roof of the dragon kingdom.|城堡大厅里的一根巨大石柱，支撑着龙之国的金色屋顶。[/DU][DU]There is a column of magic writing on the wall, which only dragon masters can understand.|墙上有一列魔法文字，只有龙法师能看懂。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/column.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a column of sth|一列……；一队……；一根……柱[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A column of smoke rose from the magic forest, which meant there was a fire there.|一缕烟从魔法森林升起，说明那里着火了。[/EX][EX]A column of dragons flew across the sky, heading for the Valley of Clouds together.|一队龙排成列飞过天空，一同前往云谷。[/EX][C]a column of soldiers|一队士兵[/C][C]a stone column|石柱[/C][C]a column of water|一股水柱[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in column|排成纵队[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon masters marched in column to the training ground, following their teacher.|年轻的龙法师们跟着老师，排成纵队走向训练场。[/EX][EX]The magic wolves moved in column through the forest, not daring to make any noise.|魔法狼排成纵队穿过森林，不敢发出一点声响。[/EX][C]in single column|排成单列[/C][C]in double column|排成双列[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The wizard used magic to repair the broken marble column in the castle courtyard.[POS]n.[/POS]|巫师用魔法修复了城堡庭院里断裂的大理石柱。[/EX][EX]A column of golden light shot from the Dragon Stone and lit up the dark cave.[POS]n.[/POS]|一道金光从龙石中射出，照亮了黑暗的洞穴。[/EX][EX]We can see a column of names of great dragon masters on the stone wall of the castle.[POS]n.[/POS]|我们能在城堡的石墙上看到一列伟大龙法师的名字。[/EX][EX]A column of carriages carrying magic crystals moved slowly toward the castle gate.[POS]n.[/POS]|一队装载着魔法晶石的马车，缓缓朝城堡大门移动。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]column作“纵队、列”时，固定搭配是a column of sth，不要少了a，也不要说column sth（错误：column soldiers），正确是a column of soldiers。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆column和row！column是**竖列**，指垂直方向的一排；row是**横排**，指水平方向的一排，如a column of words（竖列文字）/ a row of chairs（横排椅子）。[/ERR][ERR]column作“柱子”时，是可数名词，表达“一根柱子”用a column，“多根柱子”用columns，不要说many column（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To take action to solve a problem or deal with a difficult person or situation (used in the book when Griffith told the team how to take action against the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]处理；应对；对付；解决（书中指格里菲斯告诉队员们如何对付乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/diːl wɪð/[/PH][DU]"We need to deal with the Raven Guard before they use the red dust for dark magic," Griffith said.|(原文例句)格里菲斯说：“我们必须在乌鸦卫队用红色粉末施展黑魔法前，先对付他们。”[/DU][DU]The wizard taught us how to deal with dark magic spells with our dragon's power.|巫师教我们如何用龙的力量应对黑魔法咒语。[/DU][DU]It's not easy to deal with the magic monsters in the dark forest, for they are very fierce.|处理黑森林里的魔法怪兽并不容易，因为它们十分凶猛。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/deal with.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To be about something; to relate to something[/EN][CN]涉及；关于[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]This magic book deals with the history of dragons and their bond with humans.|这本魔法书讲述的是龙的历史以及它们和人类的羁绊。[/DU][DU]The new spell we learned today deals with how to heal injured dragons quickly.|我们今天学的新咒语，是关于如何快速医治受伤的龙。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]deal with a problem/situation|处理问题/应对情况[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to find a way to deal with the magic fog that blocks the path to the dragon cave.|我们需要找到方法处理阻挡龙穴道路的魔法雾。[/EX][EX]Ana is very good at dealing with difficult young dragons, for she is patient and kind.|安娜很擅长应对调皮的小龙，因为她既耐心又善良。[/EX][C]deal with the enemy|对付敌人[/C][C]deal with the crisis|应对危机[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]deal with sb|对付某人；和某人打交道[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]It's dangerous to deal with the dark wizard, for he has powerful black magic.|和黑巫师打交道很危险，因为他拥有强大的黑魔法。[/EX][EX]He doesn't like to deal with rude people, even if they are powerful dragon masters.|他不喜欢和粗鲁的人打交道，就算对方是强大的龙法师也一样。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]deal with sth/sb|涉及/关于某事/某人[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]This chapter of the book deals with how to make a magic bond with a baby dragon.|这本书的这一章讲的是如何和小龙建立魔法羁绊。[/EX][EX]The speech the king gave today deals with the protection of the Dragon Stone.|国王今天的演讲，是关于龙石的守护工作。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon master used a special potion to deal with the poison on the dragon's paw.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|龙法师用一种特殊药剂，处理掉了龙爪子上的毒素。[/EX][EX]We have to deal with the broken magic barrier first, or the dark magic will come into the castle.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|我们必须先处理破损的魔法屏障，否则黑魔法会侵入城堡。[/EX][EX]This magic course deals with the basic skills of controlling water dragons for beginners.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|这门魔法课程，是为初学者开设的、关于操控水龙的基础技巧。[/EX][EX]He has a lot of experience in dealing with the problems between humans and dragons.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|他在处理人和龙之间的矛盾问题上，有很多经验。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]deal with是**固定短语动词**，不能随意拆分，也不能用do代替deal（错误：do with the problem），表达“处理问题”常用deal with a problem，do with多和what搭配（what to do with）。[/ERR][ERR]询问“如何处理”时，用**how** to deal with，不要用what（错误：what to deal with the enemy），正确是what to do with the enemy / how to deal with the enemy。[/ERR][ERR]deal的过去式和过去分词是dealt，不要记错成dealed（错误：We have dealed with the problem），正确是We have dealt with the problem。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To not succeed in doing something; to not be able to do something; to stop working correctly (used in the book when the magic shield stopped working against the Raven Guard's dust)[/EN][CN]失败；未能；未能做到；失灵；失效（书中指魔法屏障在乌鸦卫队的粉末面前失去了作用）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/feɪl/[/PH][DU]The magic shield around the castle failed to stop the red dust from spreading in the air.|(原文例句)城堡周围的魔法屏障没能阻止红色粉末在空气中扩散。[/DU][DU]We failed to catch the Raven Guard at the forest gate, and they ran into the dark woods.|我们在森林门口没能抓住乌鸦卫队，他们逃进了黑森林。[/DU][DU]The magic crystal in the wand failed, so I can't cast any spells for the moment.|魔法棒里的晶石失灵了，所以我暂时无法施展任何咒语。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/fail.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To not pass an exam or a test[/EN][CN]不及格；未通过（考试）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]No one has ever failed the dragon master test in the kingdom for ten years.|十年来，王国里从来没有人未通过龙法师的考核。[/DU][DU]He was afraid he would fail the magic spell test, so he practiced day and night.|他害怕自己魔法咒语考试不及格，所以日夜练习。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]fail to do sth|未能做某事；没能做到某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon failed to fly over the magic mountain, so it had to go around it.|小龙没能飞过魔法山，所以只能绕路走。[/EX][EX]We must not fail to protect the Dragon Stone, or the whole kingdom will be in danger.|我们绝不能守护不住龙石，否则整个王国都会陷入危险。[/EX][C]fail to keep a promise|未能遵守承诺[/C][C]fail to arrive on time|未能按时到达[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]fail in sth|在某事上失败；未通过某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He failed in the dragon training test, but he decided to try again next year.|他在龙术训练考核中失败了，但他决定明年再试一次。[/EX][EX]The dark wizard failed in his plan to steal the Dragon Stone, and he was driven out of the kingdom.|黑巫师偷取龙石的计划失败了，他被赶出了王国。[/EX][C]fail in an exam|考试不及格[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]sth fail (sb)|某物失灵；某物让某人失望[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]My magic wand failed me in the fight, and I had to use my dragon's power to defend myself.|我的魔法棒在战斗中失灵了，我只能用龙的力量自卫。[/EX][EX]The magic light failed us in the dark cave, and we lost our way for a while.|魔法灯在黑暗的洞穴里熄灭了，我们迷路了一会儿。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic lock failed and the door of the dragon cave opened by itself suddenly.[POS]v.[/POS]|魔法锁失灵了，龙穴的门突然自己打开了。[/EX][EX]She failed to wake up the sleeping dragon, even though she used all her magic spells.[POS]v.[/POS]|尽管用尽了所有魔法咒语，她还是没能唤醒沉睡的龙。[/EX][EX]If you don't practice the spell every day, you will fail in the final magic test.[POS]v.[/POS]|如果你不每天练习咒语，你会在最终的魔法考试中不及格。[/EX][EX]The bridge made of magic wood failed under the heavy rain, and we had to cross the river by dragon.[POS]v.[/POS]|魔法木桥在大雨中坍塌了，我们只能骑龙过河。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]fail后接“做某事”时，必须用**fail to do sth**，不要用fail doing sth（错误：We failed catching the enemy），正确是We failed to catch the enemy。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆fail和lose！fail侧重“未能做到某事、失灵、考试不及格”；lose侧重“失去某物、输掉比赛/战争”，如fail the test / lose the fight。[/ERR][ERR]fail作“不及格”时，是及物动词，可说fail the exam，也可说fail in the exam，但不要说fail to the exam（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To have the courage to do something difficult or dangerous; to be brave enough to do something (used as a modal verb or a main verb) (used in the book when Bo wondered if he had the courage to go into the dark cave)[/EN][CN]敢；胆敢；有勇气做（困难/危险的事）（可作情态动词或实义动词，书中指波不确定自己是否有勇气走进黑森林的洞穴）[/CN][POS]v./modal v.[/POS][PH]/deə(r)/（英式）/der/（美式）[/PH][DU]"Do you dare to go into the dark cave with me to find the Raven Guard?" Griffith asked Bo.|(原文例句)格里菲斯问波：“你敢和我一起走进黑洞穴找乌鸦卫队吗？”[/DU][DU]No one in the kingdom dares to challenge the fire dragon, for it is the most powerful dragon.|王国里没人敢挑战火龙，因为它是最强大的龙。[/DU][DU]She daren't use dark magic, even if it can help her win the dragon master test.|她不敢使用黑魔法，就算它能帮她赢得龙法师考核。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/dare.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To challenge someone to do something, especially something difficult or dangerous[/EN][CN]激将；挑战某人做（难事）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guard dared Bo to steal the Dragon Stone, saying he was too scared to do it.|乌鸦卫队激波去偷龙石，说他根本没胆子做。[/DU][DU]He dared me to fly the dragon through the storm, and I accepted his challenge.|他激我骑着龙穿过暴风雨，我接受了他的挑战。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]dare to do sth（实义动词）|敢做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Do you dare to touch the magic crystal that glows red in the dark?|你敢碰那颗在黑暗中发红光的魔法晶石吗？[/EX][EX]He doesn't dare to tell the wizard about his mistake, for he is afraid of being punished.|他不敢把自己的错误告诉巫师，因为害怕被惩罚。[/EX][C]dare sb to do sth|激某人做某事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]dare do sth/daren't do sth（情态动词）|敢做某事/不敢做某事[POS]modal v.[/POS][/H][EX]No one dare enter the magic cave alone, for there are many terrible monsters in it.|没人敢独自进入魔法洞穴，因为里面有很多可怕的怪兽。[/EX][EX]She daren't fly the dragon at night, because she is afraid of the dark.|她不敢在夜里骑龙，因为她怕黑。[/EX][C]How dare you...?|你竟敢……？（表愤怒）[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]How dare you hurt the baby dragon? The dragon master will punish you for this.[POS]modal v.[/POS]|你竟敢伤害小龙？龙法师会为此惩罚你的。[/EX][EX]He dares to practice magic spells in the forbidden forest, even though it's against the rules.|他竟敢在禁林里练习魔法咒语，尽管这违反了规定。[/EX][EX]The little boy dared his friend to sit on the back of the small dragon, and both of them were very excited.[POS]v.[/POS]|小男孩激他的朋友坐到小龙背上，两人都特别兴奋。[/EX][EX]She daren't tell anyone about the secret she found in the castle tower.[POS]modal v.[/POS]|她不敢把在城堡塔楼发现的秘密告诉任何人。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]dare作**情态动词**时，仅用于否定句、疑问句和条件句，后接**动词原形**，不要加to（错误：She daren't to go），正确是She daren't go；作**实义动词**时，后接**to do sth**，否定式用don't/doesn't/didn't dare to do。[/ERR][ERR]How dare you...? 是固定句式，后接动词原形（错误：How dare you to do that），正确是How dare you do that？[/ERR][ERR]dare的过去式是dared，过去分词也是dared，作实义动词时，过去式否定为didn't dare to do（不要说dared not to do）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Feeling dizzy and sick, as if you are going to faint; feeling confused and not able to think clearly (used in the book when Ana felt dizzy after breathing in the red dust)[/EN][CN]头晕的；昏沉的；发晕的；神志不清的（书中指安娜吸入红色粉末后感到头晕目眩）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈwuːzi/[/PH][DU]Ana felt woozy after breathing in a little of the red dust, and she had to hold on to Kepri's neck.|(原文例句)安娜吸入了一点红色粉末后感到头晕，只能紧紧抓住凯普丽的脖子。[/DU][DU]After flying on the dragon for hours, I felt a little woozy and wanted to land at once.|骑龙飞了几个小时后，我感到有点昏沉，想立刻降落。[/DU][DU]He hit his head on the stone column and felt woozy for a few minutes.|他的头撞到了石柱上，晕乎乎了好几分钟。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/woozy.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]feel woozy|感到头晕；觉得昏沉[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]You will feel woozy if you smell the magic flower in the valley, so don't get close to it.|如果你闻到山谷里的魔法花，会感到头晕，所以不要靠近它。[/EX][EX]She felt woozy after drinking the wrong magic potion, and the wizard had to heal her at once.|她喝错了魔法药剂后感到昏沉，巫师不得不立刻为她医治。[/EX][C]a little woozy|有点头晕[/C][C]feel dizzy and woozy|感到头晕目眩[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]make sb woozy|让某人感到头晕[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The spinning magic circle makes people woozy, so only experienced dragon masters can stand in it.|旋转的魔法阵会让人头晕，所以只有经验丰富的龙法师能站在里面。[/EX][EX]The strong smell of the magic dust makes everyone woozy when they breathe it in.|吸入魔法粉末的浓烈气味，会让所有人都感到头晕。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The little dragon felt woozy after eating the strange fruit in the forest, and its master looked after it carefully.[POS]adj.[/POS]|小龙吃了森林里的奇怪果子后感到头晕，它的主人细心地照顾着它。[/EX][EX]I felt a bit woozy when I stood on the top of the magic mountain, for it was too high.|我站在魔法山顶时感到有点昏沉，因为那里太高了。[/EX][EX]The dark magic mist from the Raven Guard made all the soldiers feel woozy and unable to fight.|乌鸦卫队放出的黑魔法迷雾，让所有士兵都感到头晕，无法战斗。[/EX][EX]She felt woozy for a moment when the magic spell hit her head, but she soon came to her senses.|咒语击中她的头时，她昏沉了片刻，但很快就清醒过来了。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]woozy是**形容词**，只能作表语或定语，不要当作副词使用（错误：She looked at me woozily），表达“头晕地看”可用She looked at me in a woozy way / She felt woozy and looked at me。[/ERR][ERR]woozy的比较级是woozier，最高级是woozier，不要加more/most（错误：more woozy），正确是woozier。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆woozy和dizzy！woozy侧重“因生病、中毒、疲劳等导致的昏沉、头晕，伴神志不清”；dizzy侧重“因旋转、高度等导致的眩晕、眼花”，如feel woozy after poisoning / feel dizzy when spinning around。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Full of mist; not clear because of mist or tears; vague and not clear in the mind (used in the book when the forest became full of mist from the red dust)[/EN][CN]有雾的；雾蒙蒙的；朦胧的；泪眼朦胧的；思绪模糊的（书中指红色粉末让森林变得雾蒙蒙的）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈmɪsti/[/PH][DU]The dark forest became misty at once when the red dust spread, and we could hardly see the path ahead.|(原文例句)红色粉末扩散后，黑森林立刻变得雾蒙蒙的，我们几乎看不清前方的路。[/DU][DU]The magic lake is always misty in the early morning, like a fairyland in the dragon kingdom.|魔法湖清晨总是雾气缭绕，像龙之国的仙境。[/DU][DU]Her eyes were misty with tears when she thought about her lost baby dragon.|想到走失的小龙，她的眼睛因泪水变得朦胧。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/misty.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]misty morning/evening|雾蒙蒙的早晨/傍晚[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]We set off for the dragon cave on a misty morning, with the Finding Feather leading the way.|我们在一个雾蒙蒙的早晨出发前往龙穴，寻踪羽毛在前面引路。[/EX][EX]The castle looks very beautiful in the misty evening, with golden lights shining through the fog.|雾蒙蒙的傍晚，城堡看起来十分美丽，金色的灯光透过雾气闪烁。[/EX][C]misty forest|雾蒙蒙的森林[/C][C]misty mountain|云雾缭绕的山[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]eyes be misty with tears|泪眼朦胧[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]His eyes were misty with tears when the dragon master praised him for his hard work.|当龙法师表扬他的努力时，他的眼睛热泪盈眶，变得朦胧。[/EX][EX]Her eyes were misty with tears as she said goodbye to her dragon before leaving the kingdom.|离开王国前和自己的龙告别时，她泪眼朦胧。[/EX][C]a misty memory|模糊的记忆[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The path to the dragon training ground is misty today, so we need to use magic lights to find the way.[POS]adj.[/POS]|今天去龙术训练场的路雾蒙蒙的，我们需要用魔法灯引路。[/EX][EX]I have only a misty memory of the magic castle I visited when I was a child.|我对小时候去过的魔法城堡，只有模糊的记忆。[/EX][EX]The water dragon likes to swim in the misty lake, for it can hide itself in the fog easily.|水龙喜欢在雾气缭绕的湖里游泳，因为它能轻易地把自己藏在雾里。[/EX][EX]His mind was misty after drinking the sleep potion, and he couldn't think of anything clearly.|喝了睡眠药剂后，他的思绪变得模糊，什么都想不明白。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]misty是**形容词**，不要和名词mist混淆（错误：a mist morning），正确是a misty morning；也不要当作副词使用（错误：it rained misty），正确是it rained mistily / the morning was misty。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆misty和foggy！misty侧重“薄雾笼罩的、朦胧的”，雾较淡，能见度尚可；foggy侧重“大雾的、浓雾的”，雾较浓，能见度低，如a misty river / a foggy street。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆misty和mistaken！misty表示“有雾的、朦胧的”；mistaken表示“错误的、被误解的”，如a misty view / a mistaken idea。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Extremely frightened; very scared (used in the book when the young dragon was extremely scared of the Raven Guard's dark magic)[/EN][CN]极度害怕的；惊恐的；吓坏的（书中指小龙被乌鸦卫队的黑魔法吓坏了）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈterɪfaɪd/[/PH][DU]The baby dragon was terrified when it saw the Raven Guard's dark magic fire, and it hid behind Ana at once.|(原文例句)小龙看到乌鸦卫队的黑魔法火焰后吓坏了，立刻躲到了安娜身后。[/DU][DU]She was terrified of the magic monsters in the dark forest, so she never went there alone.|她极度害怕黑森林里的魔法怪兽，所以从不独自去那里。[/DU][DU]All the soldiers were terrified when the fire dragon roared loudly in front of the castle.|火龙在城堡前大声咆哮时，所有士兵都惊恐不已。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/terrified.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]be terrified of sb/sth|极度害怕某人/某物[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The little boy is terrified of the thunder dragon, for its roar is as loud as thunder.|小男孩极度害怕雷龙，因为它的咆哮声像雷声一样大。[/EX][EX]Many people are terrified of dark magic, for it can hurt people easily.|很多人都害怕黑魔法，因为它能轻易伤害人。[/EX][C]be terrified of doing sth|害怕做某事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]be terrified to do sth|害怕去做某事；吓得不敢做某事[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon master was terrified to fly the dragon through the storm, for he had never done it before.|年轻的龙法师吓得不敢骑着龙穿过暴风雨，因为他从没做过。[/EX][EX]She was terrified to enter the dark cave, even though Griffith was with her.|尽管有格里菲斯陪着，她还是吓得不敢进入黑洞穴。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]be terrified that + 从句|害怕……；担心……[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]He was terrified that the Raven Guard would come back and steal the Dragon Stone again.|他担心乌鸦卫队会回来再次偷取龙石，心里十分害怕。[/EX][EX]She was terrified that the baby dragon would get lost in the forest, so she tied a magic bell to its neck.|她害怕小龙在森林里走失，所以在它脖子上系了一个魔法铃铛。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic rabbit was terrified when it saw the wolf, and it ran into the hole at once.[POS]adj.[/POS]|魔法兔子看到狼后吓坏了，立刻跑进了洞里。[/EX][EX]I was terrified to stand on the edge of the magic cliff, for it was thousands of meters high.|我吓得不敢站在魔法悬崖边，因为那里有几千米高。[/EX][EX]All the dragons in the valley were terrified when the dark wizard came with his army.|黑巫师带着军队到来时，山谷里所有的龙都惊恐不已。[/EX][EX]She was terrified of touching the hot magic crystal, for it could burn her hand easily.|她极度害怕碰那颗滚烫的魔法晶石，因为它能轻易烫伤手。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]核心易错：terrified修饰**人/动物**，表示“（人/动物）感到极度害怕的”；terrifying修饰**事物/场景**，表示“（事物/场景）令人恐惧的”，不要说a terrified monster（错误），正确是a terrifying monster / a terrified child。[/ERR][ERR]terrified后接“做某事”时，用be terrified of doing sth 或 be terrified to do sth，不要直接接动词原形（错误：she was terrified go）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆terrified和scared！terrified的程度远重于scared，terrified表示“极度惊恐、吓坏了”，scared表示“普通的害怕、受惊”，如I was scared of the dog / I was terrified of the fire dragon。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make someone do something that they do not want to do, using threats or violence; to push something hard; physical power or strength (used in the book when the Raven Guard tried to make Bo tell the secret by threats)[/EN][CN]强迫；迫使；用力推；力量；武力；势力（书中指乌鸦卫队试图用威胁逼迫波说出秘密）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/fɔːs/（英式）/fɔːrs/（美式）[/PH][DU]The Raven Guard tried to force Bo to tell them where the Dragon Stone was hidden in the castle.|(原文例句)乌鸦卫队试图逼迫波说出龙石藏在城堡的哪个地方。[/DU][DU]Griffith used his magic force to push the heavy stone column away from the tunnel entrance.|格里菲斯用自己的魔法力量，把沉重的石柱从隧道口推开。[/DU][DU]The fire dragon's force is so strong that it can break a stone wall with one hit.|火龙的力量十分强大，一击就能撞碎石墙。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/force.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A group of people organized for a particular purpose, especially a military group[/EN][CN]部队；军队；兵力[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]A strong force of dragon masters was sent to protect the magic forest from the Raven Guard.|一队强大的龙法师部队被派去守护魔法森林，抵御乌鸦卫队。[/DU][DU]The king ordered his royal force to guard the castle gate day and night.|国王命令他的皇家军队日夜守卫城堡大门。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]force sb to do sth|强迫某人做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The dark wizard didn't force her to work for him, for he wanted her to obey willingly.|黑巫师没有强迫她为自己做事，因为他想让她心甘情愿地服从。[/EX][EX]Don't force the young dragon to fly, it will learn by itself when it is ready.|不要强迫小龙学飞，等它准备好会自己学的。[/EX][C]force sb into doing sth|逼迫某人做某事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]force sth open/away|用力推开某物/推开某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He forced the magic box open with a knife and found the red dust inside.|他用刀撬开了魔法盒子，发现里面装着红色粉末。[/EX][EX]The dragon forced the big rock away with its head and opened the path for us.|龙用头推开了大石头，为我们打开了道路。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]by force|用武力；强行[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Raven Guard tried to break into the castle by force, but they were stopped by the magic shield.|乌鸦卫队试图强行闯入城堡，但被魔法屏障拦住了。[/EX][EX]You can't make the dragon obey you by force, you need to build a magic bond with it.|你不能用武力让龙服从你，你需要和它建立魔法羁绊。[/EX][C]the force of sth|……的力量[/C][C]a force of|一队……；一股……势力[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The strong wind forced us to land the dragon on a small hill in the forest.[POS]v.[/POS]|大风迫使我们把龙降落在森林里的一座小山上。[/EX][EX]He forced himself to practice the magic spell for an hour every day, even when he was tired.[POS]v.[/POS]|他强迫自己每天练习一小时魔法咒语，就算累了也不中断。[/EX][EX]The force of the water dragon's spray can put out the fire in the forest in a short time.[POS]n.[/POS]|水龙喷水的力量，能在短时间内扑灭森林里的大火。[/EX][EX]A new force of young dragon masters has joined the protection of the Dragon Stone.[POS]n.[/POS]|一队新的年轻龙法师部队，加入了守护龙石的队伍。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]force作动词“强迫”时，固定搭配是**force sb to do sth**，不要用force sb doing sth（错误：They forced him telling the secret），正确是They forced him to tell the secret。[/ERR][ERR]by force是固定短语，**不加the**（错误：by the force），表示“用武力”；the force of sth 中必须加the，表“……的力量”。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆force和power！force侧重“具体的物理力量、武力、强迫的力量，或部队”；power侧重“抽象的权力、能力、魔力、电力”，如the force of a punch / the power of magic。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A large group of insects, birds or small animals moving together (usually flying or crawling); a huge crowd of people[/EN][CN]一大群（昆虫、鸟类、小动物，尤指飞/爬行动物）；一大群人[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/swɔːm/（英式）/swɔːrm/（美式）[/PH][DU]A swarm of magic bats flew out of the dark cave and flew toward the dragon masters.|(原文例句)一大群魔法蝙蝠从黑洞穴里飞出来，朝龙法师们飞去。[/DU][DU]A thick swarm of magic bees surrounded the honey tree in the middle of the dark forest.|一大群密密麻麻的魔法蜜蜂围着黑森林中央的蜜树。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/swarm.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To move somewhere in a large group, crowding together; to be full of a large number of things moving around[/EN][CN]成群结队地移动；蜂拥而至；挤满（成群移动的事物）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guard swarmed toward the castle gate, ready to break in with dark magic.|乌鸦卫队朝城堡大门蜂拥而去，准备用黑魔法闯入。[/DU][DU]The magic lake swarms with glowing fish after the sun goes down in the dragon kingdom.|龙之国的太阳落山后，魔法湖里就挤满了会发光的鱼。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a swarm of sth|一大群……[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A swarm of fireflies danced around the magic grass in the valley at night.|夜晚，一大群萤火虫围着山谷里的魔法草飞舞。[/EX][EX]A swarm of crows hovered over the forest, which was the signal of the Raven Guard's arrival.|一大群乌鸦在森林上空盘旋，这是乌鸦卫队到来的信号。[/EX][C]a swarm of ants|一大群蚂蚁[/C][C]a swarm of locusts|一大群蝗虫[/C][C]a swarm of people|一大群人[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]swarm into/out of sp|成群结队地涌入/涌出某地[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon masters swarmed into the training hall when the wizard began the class.|巫师开始上课后，年轻的龙法师们成群结队地涌进训练大厅。[/EX][EX]The magic birds swarmed out of the woods when they smelled the danger of dark magic.|魔法鸟闻到黑魔法的危险后，成群结队地飞出了树林。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]swarm toward/to sb/sth|朝某人/某物蜂拥而去[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic wolves swarmed toward the intruders and stopped them from entering the dragon valley.|魔法狼朝入侵者蜂拥而去，阻止他们进入龙谷。[/EX][EX]All the small animals swarmed to the water spring when the magic rain stopped.|魔法雨停后，所有小动物都朝清泉蜂拥而去。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]swarm with sth|挤满……；遍布……[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The old castle swarms with magic spiders, so no one dares to enter it alone.|那座老城堡里挤满了魔法蜘蛛，没人敢独自进去。[/EX][EX]The summer sky of the dragon kingdom swarms with colorful magic butterflies.|龙之国的夏日天空中，遍布着五彩斑斓的魔法蝴蝶。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]A swarm of dragonflies flew above the magic river, reflecting the golden light of the Dragon Stone.[POS]n.[/POS]|一大群蜻蜓在魔法河上空飞舞，映着龙石的金光。[/EX][EX]When the castle gate opened, a swarm of villagers ran in to seek protection from the dragon masters.[POS]n.[/POS]|城堡大门打开时，一大群村民跑进来寻求龙法师的保护。[/EX][EX]The students swarmed around the wizard to ask questions about the new dragon spell.[POS]v.[/POS]|学生们围着巫师蜂拥而上，询问关于新龙咒的问题。[/EX][EX]The cave swarms with glowing worms, which light up the whole path to the dragon treasure.[POS]v.[/POS]|洞穴里布满了会发光的虫子，照亮了通往龙之宝的整条路。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]swarm作名词“一大群”时，固定搭配是**a swarm of + 可数名词复数**，不要接单数名词（错误：a swarm of bat），正确是a swarm of bats。[/ERR][ERR]swarm作动词时是**不及物动词**，表示“朝某地/某物移动”时必须加介词into/out of/toward/to等，不要直接接宾语（错误：swarm the castle），正确是swarm toward the castle。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆swarm、flock和crowd！swarm侧重“成群的昆虫、小型飞/爬行动物，或人群杂乱地蜂拥”；flock侧重“成群的鸟类、牛羊等牲畜，移动较有序”；crowd仅指“人群的聚集、拥挤”，如a swarm of bees / a flock of sheep / a crowd of people。[/ERR][ERR]swarm with表示“挤满”时，主语多为**地点**，不要用人作主语（错误：We swarmed with fireflies），正确是The garden swarmed with fireflies。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To hurt someone or damage something; physical or emotional damage or injury[/EN][CN]伤害；损害（某人/某物）；伤害；损害（身体或情感上的）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/hɑːm/（英式）/hɑːrm/（美式）[/PH][DU]The red dust from the Raven Guard won't harm you if you don't breathe it in, Griffith warned the young dragon masters.|(原文例句)格里菲斯提醒年轻的龙法师们，只要不吸入，乌鸦卫队的红色粉末就不会伤害到大家。[/DU][DU]The dark magic spell can harm the bond between a dragon and its master if it is cast on them.|黑魔法咒语如果施加在龙和主人身上，会破坏他们之间的羁绊。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/harm01.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]harm sb/sth|伤害某人/损害某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]This magic herb won't harm the baby dragon, it can even help it grow stronger.|这种魔法草药不会伤害小龙，甚至能帮它长得更强壮。[/EX][EX]Don't touch the black crystal, it will harm your magic power and make you weak.|不要碰黑色晶石，它会损害你的魔力，让你变得虚弱。[/EX][C]harm one's health|损害某人的健康[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]do harm to sb/sth|对某人/某物造成伤害/损害[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Breathing in too much red dust will do great harm to your lungs, even for dragon masters.|吸入过多红色粉末会对你的肺部造成巨大伤害，即使是龙法师也不例外。[/EX][EX]Ignoring the dragon's feelings will do harm to your magic bond with it.|忽视龙的感受，会破坏你和它之间的魔法羁绊。[/EX][C]mean no harm|并无恶意[/C][C]come to harm|遭受伤害[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]no harm done|没什么损失；没关系（用于道歉后）[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]I accidentally knocked over your magic bottle, but no harm done, the potion is still there.|我不小心碰倒了你的魔法瓶，不过没关系，药剂还在。[/EX][EX]The dragon bumped into the castle wall by mistake, no harm done, just a small scratch on the stone.|龙不小心撞到了城堡墙，没什么事，石头上只留了一道小划痕。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic shield can stop any spell that tries to harm the Dragon Stone and the castle.[POS]v.[/POS]|这面魔法盾能阻挡所有试图伤害龙石和城堡的咒语。[/EX][EX]She would never harm a dragon, for she has loved them since she was a child.[POS]v.[/POS]|她绝不会伤害龙，因为她从小就喜爱它们。[/EX][EX]There is no harm in trying the new magic spell, it's safe for both humans and dragons.[POS]n.[/POS]|试试这个新咒语没什么坏处，它对人类和龙都很安全。[/EX][EX]The old wizard told us that greed would do great harm to a dragon master's heart and magic power.[POS]n.[/POS]|老巫师告诉我们，贪婪会对龙法师的内心和魔力造成极大的损害。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]harm作动词时是**及物动词**，可直接接宾语，不要多余加to（错误：harm to the dragon），正确是harm the dragon；作名词时表“伤害”，固定搭配do harm to sth，此处to不可少。[/ERR][ERR]harm是**不可数名词**，表“一种伤害”也不要加a（错误：a great harm），正确是great harm / a lot of harm。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆harm、hurt和injure！harm侧重“长期或抽象的损害、伤害”，可指身体/情感/事物；hurt侧重“身体的疼痛或情感的伤心”，口语化；injure侧重“意外事故造成的身体受伤”，如harm the bond / hurt my feelings / injure his leg。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]The quality of being brave; courage to do something dangerous or difficult[/EN][CN]勇敢；英勇；无畏（做危险或困难之事的勇气）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbreɪvəri/[/PH][DU]Bo's bravery to face the Raven Guard alone made Griffith decide to trust him with the Finding Feather.|(原文例句)波独自面对乌鸦卫队的勇气，让格里菲斯决定将寻踪羽毛托付给他。[/DU][DU]The bravery of the young dragon to protect its master from the dark monster moved all the dragon masters.|小龙为保护主人对抗黑暗怪兽的英勇，打动了所有龙法师。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/bravery.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]show bravery (in doing sth)|（在做某事时）表现出勇敢[/POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The little dragon master showed great bravery in fighting the dark wizard even though he was scared.|这位小龙法师尽管害怕，却在对抗黑巫师时表现出了极大的勇气。[/EX][EX]She showed her bravery in entering the misty cave alone to find the lost magic crystal.|她独自走进雾蒙蒙的洞穴寻找丢失的魔法晶石，展现了自己的勇敢。[/EX][C]act with bravery|英勇行动[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]the bravery of sb (to do sth)|某人（做某事的）勇气[/POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The king praised the bravery of the dragon masters to protect the kingdom from the Raven Guard.|国王赞扬了龙法师们守护王国抵御乌鸦卫队的英勇。[/EX][EX]We all admire the bravery of the baby dragon to stand in front of the fire monster.|我们都敬佩小龙站在火焰怪兽面前的勇气。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]praise sb for one's bravery|因某人的勇敢赞扬某人[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The wizard praised Bo for his bravery and gave him a magic medal as a reward.|巫师因波的勇敢表扬了他，并送了一枚魔法勋章作为奖励。[/EX][EX]All the villagers praised the dragon for its bravery to drive away the magic wolves.|所有村民都赞扬龙赶走魔法狼的英勇。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]Bravery is not the absence of fear, but the courage to move forward even when you are afraid.|勇敢不是没有恐惧，而是即使害怕也有前进的勇气。[/EX][EX]The young dragon master's bravery inspired all the other students to face the magic test bravely.|这位年轻龙法师的勇气，激励了其他所有学生勇敢面对魔法考核。[/EX][EX]We will always remember the bravery of those who fought to protect the Dragon Stone from the dark magic.|我们会永远记住那些为守护龙石对抗黑魔法而战的人们的英勇。[/EX][EX]Her bravery to try the difficult dragon spell surprised everyone, for she was just a beginner.|她敢于尝试难度极高的龙咒，让所有人都感到惊讶，因为她还只是个初学者。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]bravery是**不可数名词**，永远不能加a/an，也没有复数形式（错误：a bravery / braveries），表“极大的勇气”用great bravery / immense bravery。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆bravery和courage！二者都表“勇气”，bravery更侧重“面对危险、战斗时的英勇无畏，偏具体行动”；courage更侧重“面对困难、挫折时的内心勇气，偏抽象品质”，如the bravery of a soldier / the courage to admit mistakes。[/ERR][ERR]bravery的形容词是brave，副词是bravely，不要用bravery作形容词（错误：a bravery boy），正确是a brave boy；不要用brave作副词（错误：he fought brave），正确是he fought bravely。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small bed for a baby or young child; a simple narrow bed that can be folded, used for camping or in temporary places[/EN][CN]婴儿床；幼儿床；帆布床；折叠床（露营或临时使用的简易窄床）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/kɒt/（英式）/kɑːt/（美式）[/PH][DU]Ana put a soft magic blanket on the cot beside her bed for the tiny baby dragon to sleep on.|(原文例句)安娜在床边的小床上铺了一张柔软的魔法毯子，让小龙崽在上面睡觉。[/DU][DU]The dragon masters set up cots by the forest campfire for the night, as they had to watch for the Raven Guard.|龙法师们在森林的篝火旁支起折叠床过夜，因为他们要提防乌鸦卫队的出现。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/cot.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a baby cot|婴儿床[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The castle nursery has ten baby cots for the young baby dragons born in the dragon kingdom.|城堡的育儿室有十张婴儿床，供龙之国刚出生的小龙崽使用。[/EX][EX]She made a small baby cot with magic wood for her new baby dragon, and it was very warm.|她用魔法木为自己的新小龙崽做了一张婴儿床，特别暖和。[/EX][C]a camp cot|露营折叠床[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]on the cot|在小床上/折叠床上[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The tired dragon master lay on the cot and fell asleep at once after the long fight with the Raven Guard.|疲惫的龙法师在折叠床上躺下，经过和乌鸦卫队的长时间战斗，立刻就睡着了。[/EX][EX]The baby dragon curled up on the cot and hugged its small magic toy dragon.|小龙崽蜷缩在小床上，抱着它的魔法小龙玩具。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]set up a cot|支起折叠床[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to set up more cots for the villagers who fled to the castle to escape the dark magic.|我们需要为躲避黑魔法逃到城堡的村民支起更多折叠床。[/EX][EX]He set up a cot near the dragon cave to watch over the sleeping fire dragon.|他在龙穴旁支起一张折叠床，守着沉睡的火龙。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic cot can change its size as the baby dragon grows, so it doesn't need to be replaced.|这张魔法婴儿床能随着小龙崽的成长改变大小，所以不用更换。[/EX][EX]All the cots in the castle's temporary camp are made of soft magic cloth, so they are very comfortable.|城堡临时营地的所有折叠床都是用柔软的魔法布做的，所以特别舒服。[/EX][EX]She put a glowing magic pillow on the cot, so the baby dragon won't be afraid of the dark at night.|她在小床上放了一个发光的魔法枕头，这样小龙崽夜里就不怕黑了。[/EX][EX]The wizard set up a cot in his laboratory to rest, for he often works late making magic potions.|巫师在实验室里支了一张折叠床休息，因为他经常熬夜制作魔法药剂。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]cot是**可数名词**，表“一张床”用a cot，表“多张床”用cots，不要说many cot（错误），正确是many cots。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆cot和bed！cot特指“婴儿/幼儿的小床，或可折叠的简易露营床”，尺寸小、结构简单；bed是通用词，指“成年人的床，各类床具”，如a baby cot / a big bed in the castle bedroom。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆英式和美式含义！英式中cot主要指“婴儿床”，美式中cot主要指“折叠床/帆布床”，美式表“婴儿床”常用crib，但日常使用中cot的含义可通用，无需刻意区分。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To unfasten something that is fastened or tied; to cancel or reverse the effect of something that has been done (past tense: undid; past participle: undone)[/EN][CN]解开；拆开；解开（系紧的东西）；撤销；消除；逆转（已做之事的效果）（过去式：undid；过去分词：undone）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ʌnˈduː/[/PH][DU]Griffith used a light magic spell to undo the magic knot on Bo's wrist, which was tied by the Raven Guard.|(原文例句)格里菲斯用一道轻魔法咒语解开了波手腕上被乌鸦卫队系上的魔法结。[/DU][DU]This special spell can undo the damage of the red dust to your magic power, but it needs a magic crystal as a medium.|这个特殊咒语能消除红色粉末对你魔力的损害，但需要一颗魔法晶石作为媒介。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/undo.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]undo a knot/button/zip|解开结/纽扣/拉链[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]She used her magic to undo the tight magic knot on the dragon's wing, which made the dragon feel much better.|她用魔法解开了龙翅膀上系得紧紧的魔法结，龙立刻感觉舒服多了。[/EX][EX]He undid the zip of his magic bag and took out a bottle of healing potion for the injured baby dragon.|他拉开魔法包的拉链，拿出一瓶疗伤药剂给受伤的小龙崽。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]undo sth (that sb has done)|撤销/消除某人所做之事的影响[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The old wizard's powerful spell can undo the dark magic that the Raven Guard cast on the castle.|老巫师的强大咒语能撤销乌鸦卫队施加在城堡上的黑魔法。[/EX][EX]It will take a lot of magic power to undo the damage that the fire monster did to the magic forest.|要消除火焰怪兽对魔法森林造成的损害，需要耗费大量魔力。[/EX][C]undo the effect of sth|消除某物的影响[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]undo oneself|自毁；弄糟自己的事情[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The dark wizard undid himself by using too much dark magic, and his own power destroyed him in the end.|黑巫师因使用过多黑魔法而自毁，最终被自己的力量反噬。[/EX][EX]If you break the dragon kingdom's rules, you will undo yourself and lose your status as a dragon master.|如果你违反龙之国的规则，就会自毁前程，失去龙法师的身份。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]He undid the magic rope that tied the baby dragon to the tree and set it free at once.|他解开绑着小龙崽在树上的魔法绳子，立刻放了它。[/EX][EX]This magic crystal can help us undo the spell that makes the forest misty all the time.|这颗魔法晶石能帮我们消除让森林一直雾蒙蒙的咒语。[/EX][EX]The dragon master undid the mistake he made by apologizing to the dragon and making a magic gift for it.|龙法师通过向龙道歉并为它制作魔法礼物，弥补了自己犯下的错误。[/EX][EX]No one can undo what has happened, but we can use magic to make things better.|没人能逆转已经发生的事，但我们可以用魔法让一切变好。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]undo的过去式是**undid**，过去分词是**undone**，不要记错成undoed/undoed（错误：He undoed the knot），正确是He undid the knot / The knot has been undone。[/ERR][ERR]undo是**及物动词**，可直接接宾语，不要多余加介词（错误：undo with the knot），正确是undo the knot。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆undo和unlock！undo侧重“解开系紧、绑住的东西，或撤销/消除事情的影响”；unlock侧重“解开锁、解锁，或开启某物”，如undo a magic knot / unlock the castle gate with a magic key。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Full of mist; not clear because of mist, smoke or tears; vague and not clear in the mind or memory[/EN][CN]有雾的；雾蒙蒙的；（因雾、烟或眼泪）模糊的；（思绪、记忆）模糊的；朦胧的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈmɪsti/[/PH][DU]The path to the dragon cave became even mistier after the Raven Guard spread the red dust, and we lost our way for a while.|(原文例句)乌鸦卫队撒开红色粉末后，通往龙穴的路变得更雾蒙蒙了，我们迷路了一会儿。[/DU][DU]Her eyes were misty with happy tears when she saw her lost baby dragon come back safely.|看到走失的小龙崽平安回来，她的眼睛因喜悦的泪水变得模糊。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/misty.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]misty morning/forest/mountain|雾蒙蒙的早晨/森林/山[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]We started our journey to the Cloud Valley on a misty morning, with the dragon leading the way.|我们在一个雾蒙蒙的早晨出发前往云谷，由龙在前面引路。[/EX][EX]The misty mountain in the east of the dragon kingdom is the home of the water dragons.|龙之国东边那座云雾缭绕的山，是水龙的家园。[/EX][C]misty air|雾气弥漫的空气[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]eyes be misty with tears|泪眼朦胧；眼睛因泪水变得模糊[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]His eyes were misty with sad tears when he heard that the old dragon master passed away.|听到老龙法师去世的消息，他的眼睛因悲伤的泪水变得模糊。[/EX][EX]All the dragon masters' eyes were misty with proud tears when the young students passed the dragon test.|看到年轻的学生们通过了龙术考核，所有龙法师的眼睛都因骄傲的泪水变得朦胧。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]misty memory/thought|模糊的记忆/思绪[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]I have only a misty memory of the magic castle I visited when I was a little child.|我对小时候去过的那座魔法城堡，只有模糊的记忆。[/EX][EX]Her mind was misty after breathing in a little red dust, and she couldn't think clearly for a while.|吸入一点红色粉末后，她的思绪变得模糊，好一会儿都无法清晰思考。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The misty lake at the foot of the magic mountain is the most beautiful scenery in the dragon kingdom.|魔法山脚下那片雾蒙蒙的湖，是龙之国最美的风景。[/EX][EX]The smoke from the magic campfire made the tent a little misty, but it was warm and comfortable inside.|魔法篝火的烟让帐篷里有点朦胧，但里面温暖又舒服。[/EX][EX]I tried to remember the wizard's words, but they were just a misty thought in my mind.|我努力回想巫师的话，但那只是我脑海中一个模糊的念头。[/EX][EX]The misty sky at dawn looks like a soft magic cloth covering the dragon kingdom.|黎明时雾蒙蒙的天空，像一块柔软的魔法布笼罩着龙之国。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]misty是**形容词**，只能作表语或定语，不要当作副词使用（错误：it rained misty），正确是it rained mistily / the air was misty；也不要和名词mist混淆（错误：a mist forest），正确是a misty forest。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆misty和foggy！misty侧重“薄雾笼罩的、朦胧的”，雾较淡，能见度尚可，也可指思绪/记忆的模糊；foggy侧重“大雾的、浓雾的”，雾较浓，能见度低，仅形容环境，如a misty river / a foggy street。[/ERR][ERR]misty的比较级是mistier，最高级是mistiest，不要加more/most（错误：more misty），正确是mistier。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]In one's basic character; naturally; as a result of one's innate qualities[/EN][CN]天生地；生性；本性上；出于本性[/CN][POS]adv. phr.[/POS][PH]/baɪ ˈneɪtʃə(r)/（英式）/baɪ ˈneɪtʃər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Dragons are by nature protective of their masters, and they will fight anyone who tries to harm them.|(原文例句)龙生性护主，会对抗任何试图伤害主人的人。[/DU][DU]Bo is by nature a curious boy, so he always wants to explore the dark forest and find new magic things.|波天生是个好奇的孩子，所以总想去探索黑森林，发现新奇的魔法事物。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/by nature.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]sb is + adj. + by nature|某人天生……；某人本性上是……[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The water dragon is gentle by nature, and it never hurts small animals in the magic lake.|水龙本性温顺，从不伤害魔法湖里的小动物。[/EX][EX]He is honest by nature, so he will never lie about the location of the Dragon Stone to the Raven Guard.|他天生诚实，绝不会向乌鸦卫队谎报龙石的位置。[/EX][C]be kind by nature|天生善良[/C][C]be brave by nature|天生勇敢[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]by nature, sb/sth + v.|本性上，某人/某物会……；天生，某人/某物……[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]By nature, fire dragons are hot-tempered, so you need to be patient when training them.|本性上，火龙脾气暴躁，所以训练它们时你需要有耐心。[/EX][EX]By nature, magic birds like to fly in the clear sky, and they hate the misty air made by dark magic.|天生，魔法鸟喜欢在晴朗的天空飞翔，讨厌黑魔法制造的雾气弥漫的空气。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]act by nature|凭本性行事；出于本能行动[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The baby dragon acted by nature and hid behind its master when it saw the strange dark monster.|小龙崽出于本能行动，看到陌生的黑暗怪兽就躲到了主人身后。[/EX][EX]When in danger, dragons will act by nature and use their power to protect their masters.|遇到危险时，龙会凭本性行事，用自己的力量保护主人。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She is creative by nature, and she always makes unique magic toys for the baby dragons in the castle.|她天生富有创造力，总为城堡里的小龙崽制作独一无二的魔法玩具。[/EX][EX]By nature, the magic wolf is a social animal, and it lives in groups with other wolves in the forest.|本性上，魔法狼是群居动物，会和森林里的其他狼一起成群生活。[/EX][EX]He is careful by nature, so he never makes mistakes when mixing magic potions for the dragons.|他天生细心，为龙调配魔法药剂时从不出错。[/EX][EX]By nature, all living things in the dragon kingdom love peace, and they hate the wars caused by the Raven Guard.|天生，龙之国的所有生灵都热爱和平，厌恶乌鸦卫队挑起的战争。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]by nature是**固定副词短语**，**不能随意拆分或替换单词**（错误：by the nature / in nature），in nature表“本质上；在自然界中”，和by nature含义不同，需区分。[/ERR][ERR]by nature在句中多作**状语**，可放在句首、句中或句末，放在句首时后面常用逗号隔开（正确：By nature, he is brave.），不要遗漏逗号。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆by nature和naturally！by nature侧重“天生的、本性的特质，从出生就具备的”；naturally侧重“自然而然地，顺理成章地，或天生地（可通用）”，但by nature更强调“本性本质”，如He is kind by nature / He naturally knows how to talk to dragons。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To become gradually quieter and then stop; to become less clear or stop suddenly when speaking; to move slowly away into the distance[/EN][CN]（声音）逐渐变弱直至消失；（说话）声音渐低而止；话语断断续续；慢慢消失在远方；渐行渐远[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/treɪl ɒf/（英式）/treɪl ɔːf/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bo's voice trailed off when he saw the huge Raven Guard standing in front of him, and he couldn't say another word.|(原文例句)波看到高大的乌鸦卫队站在自己面前，声音渐渐低了下去，一句话也说不出来了。[/DU][DU]The red light from the magic dust trailed off into the misty air, and we could no longer see where it went.|红色粉末发出的红光在雾蒙蒙的空气中渐渐消失，我们再也看不到它飘向了哪里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/trail off.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]one's voice trail off|某人的声音渐渐变弱；某人说话渐低而止[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]Her voice trailed off when she talked about the lost baby dragon, and she was too sad to continue.|谈到走失的小龙崽时，她的声音渐渐低了下去，悲伤得无法继续说下去。[/EX][EX]The young dragon master's voice trailed off when he was asked about his fight with the dark wizard, for he was ashamed of his failure.|当被问到和黑巫师的战斗时，这位年轻龙法师的声音渐渐变弱，因为他为自己的失败感到羞愧。[/EX][C]trail off into silence|声音渐低直至沉默[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]sth trail off (into sp)|某物渐渐消失在（某处）；某物渐行渐远至（某处）[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic birds flew toward the misty mountain, and their figures trailed off into the white fog.|魔法鸟朝云雾缭绕的山飞去，身影渐渐消失在白雾中。[/EX][EX]The path trail off into the dark forest, and no one dares to walk further alone.|这条路慢慢消失在黑森林深处，没人敢独自往前走。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]trail off (when doing sth)|（做某事时）声音渐低；（做某事时）渐渐消失[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]He trailed off when he was explaining the magic spell, because he forgot the next step.|他讲解魔法咒语时突然语塞，因为忘了接下来的步骤。[/EX][EX]The glow from the Dragon Stone trailed off when the dark magic came near, as if it was hiding its power.|当黑魔法靠近时，龙石发出的光芒渐渐变弱，仿佛在隐藏自己的力量。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The sound of the dragon's roar trailed off into the distance, and the forest became quiet again.|龙的咆哮声渐渐消失在远方，森林又恢复了平静。[/EX][EX]His voice trailed off into silence when he saw the wizard standing behind him, for he was talking about him secretly.|看到巫师站在自己身后，他的声音渐渐低至沉默，因为他正在偷偷议论对方。[/EX][EX]The small boat sailed on the misty lake, and its wake trailed off into the calm water.|小船在雾蒙蒙的湖面上航行，船尾的水痕渐渐消失在平静的水中。[/EX][EX]She trailed off when she was asked to sing the dragon song, because she was too nervous in front of all the dragon masters.|被要求唱龙之歌时，她的歌声渐渐弱了下去，因为在所有龙法师面前她太紧张了。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]trail off是**不及物短语动词**，后面**不能直接接宾语**，表示“声音渐低”直接用one's voice trail off，无需加宾语；表示“消失在某处”需加介词into（正确：trail off into the fog）。[/ERR][ERR]trail off的过去式是**trailed off**，不要记错成trail offed（错误），也不要拆分写（错误：trailed it off），该短语无被动形式。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆trail off和die down！二者都表“逐渐变弱”，trail off侧重“声音、身影、痕迹的渐渐消失，或说话的语塞渐低”；die down侧重“声音、火焰、风暴、情绪等的逐渐平息、减弱”，如her voice trailed off / the fire died down slowly。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To do something even though it may be dangerous or have bad results; the possibility of something bad or dangerous happening[/EN][CN]冒险做；冒……的险（明知可能有危险或不良后果仍去做）；风险；危险（坏事或危险发生的可能性）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/rɪsk/[/PH][DU]Griffith decided to risk entering the misty dark forest alone, for he had to find the Raven Guard before they used the red dust.|(原文例句)格里菲斯决定冒险独自进入雾蒙蒙的黑森林，因为他必须在乌鸦卫队使用红色粉末前找到他们。[/DU][DU]There is a great risk that the red dust will spread to the castle if we don't stop the Raven Guard in time.|如果我们不及时阻止乌鸦卫队，红色粉末很有可能扩散到城堡里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/risk.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]risk doing sth|冒险做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon master risked touching the hot magic crystal to get the healing potion inside for his injured dragon.|这位年轻的龙法师冒险触碰滚烫的魔法晶石，只为拿到里面的疗伤药剂给受伤的龙。[/EX][EX]She risked flying the dragon in the storm to send the magic letter to the wizard in the Cloud Valley.|她冒着暴风雨骑龙飞行，只为把魔法信送到云谷的巫师手中。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]take a risk (in doing sth)|（做某事时）冒险；冒一次险[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We have to take a risk in crossing the magic river at night, because the Raven Guard is chasing us from behind.|我们不得不冒险在夜里渡过魔法河，因为乌鸦卫队正在身后追赶我们。[/EX][EX]He took a big risk in using the forbidden magic to save the dragon, and he almost lost his own magic power.|他冒险使用禁术拯救龙，差点失去自己的魔力。[/EX][C]take the risk of doing sth|冒做某事的风险[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a risk (that)...|……的风险；有可能……[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a small risk that the magic potion will make the dragon sleepy for a few hours, but it's not dangerous.|这瓶魔法药剂有可能让龙昏睡几个小时，但并不危险。[/EX][EX]There is no risk that the Dragon Stone will be stolen if we keep it in the magic shield.|如果把龙石放在魔法屏障里，就没有被偷走的风险。[/EX][C]a great/big risk|巨大的风险[/C][C]no risk|没有风险[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]at risk|处于危险中；有风险[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The baby dragons are at risk if they stay in the misty forest alone, because there are many dark monsters there.|小龙崽如果独自待在雾蒙蒙的森林里，会处于危险之中，因为那里有很多黑暗怪兽。[/EX][EX]Your magic power will be at risk if you breathe in too much red dust from the Raven Guard.|如果你吸入过多乌鸦卫队的红色粉末，你的魔力会面临受损的风险。[/EX][C]put sb/sth at risk|使某人/某物处于危险中[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The wizard warned us not to risk going to the forbidden cave, for it's full of powerful dark magic.|巫师警告我们不要冒险去禁洞，因为里面充满了强大的黑魔法。[/EX][EX]He risked his life to protect the baby dragon from the fire monster, and all the dragon masters admired him for it.|他冒着生命危险保护小龙崽免受火焰怪兽的伤害，所有龙法师都为此敬佩他。[/EX][EX]There is no need to take a risk, we can use the Finding Feather to find the Raven Guard safely.|没必要冒险，我们可以用寻踪羽毛安全地找到乌鸦卫队。[/EX][EX]Putting the Dragon Stone outside the magic shield will put the whole dragon kingdom at risk.|把龙石放在魔法屏障外面，会让整个龙之国处于危险之中。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]risk作动词时，固定搭配是**risk doing sth**，**绝对不能接to do sth**（错误：risk to enter the forest），这是最核心易错点，正确是risk entering the forest。[/ERR][ERR]risk作名词“风险”时，可作可数或不可数名词，表“一种风险”用a risk，表“多种风险”用risks；take a risk是固定搭配，a不可少（错误：take risk），正确是take a risk。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆risk和danger！risk侧重“可能发生危险的**概率或风险**，也可作动词表冒险”；danger侧重“实际存在的**危险、险境**，仅作名词”，如There is a risk of danger / The dragon is in great danger。[/ERR][ERR]at risk是固定短语，**不加the**（错误：at the risk）；the risk of doing sth 中必须加the，表“做某事的风险”。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To move quietly and secretly so that no one notices you; to take something secretly (used in the book when Dad and the kid moved quietly downstairs to make breakfast for Mom)[/EN][CN] 潜行；偷偷走；偷偷拿；窃取（书中指爸爸和孩子悄悄下楼给妈妈做早餐）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/sniːk/[/PH][DU] Dad and I sneak downstairs. Quietly, quietly, quietly.|(原文例句) 爸爸和我悄悄下楼，轻手轻脚，不发出一点声音。[/DU][DU] She sneaked a cookie from the jar when her mom wasn't looking.| 趁妈妈不注意，她从罐子里偷偷拿了一块饼干。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/sneak.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] sneak + 地点 (downstairs/into/out of)[/POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy sneaked into the kitchen to steal a piece of bread before dinner.| 小男孩晚饭前偷偷溜进厨房，想偷一块面包。[/EX][EX] He sneaked out of the classroom to watch the bird outside the window.| 他偷偷溜出教室去看窗外的小鸟。[/EX][C] sneak in | 偷偷进入 [/C][C] sneak out | 偷偷溜走 [/C][/COLL][COLL][H] sneak sth (from sb/sth)| 偷偷拿某物（从某人 / 某处）[POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The girl sneaked an apple from the fruit bowl when her dad fell asleep.| 爸爸睡着时，小女孩从果盘里偷偷拿了一个苹果。[/EX][EX] She sneaked a look at the storybook during the math class.| 数学课上，她偷偷看了一眼故事书。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The student sneaked through the crowded hallway to avoid the teacher's patrol.| 学生潜行穿过拥挤的走廊，躲避老师的巡视。[/EX][EX] He sneaked his favorite snack into the school bag without his mom knowing.| 他瞒着妈妈，把自己最爱的零食偷偷放进了书包。[/EX][EX] The cat sneaked up to the bird feeder and caught a sparrow.| 小猫悄悄靠近喂鸟器，抓住了一只麻雀。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] sneak 的过去式和过去分词有两种形式：sneaked 或 snuck（美式口语常用），不要记错成 sneakeded（错误），正确：She sneaked/snuck out last night。[/ERR][ERR] sneak 是不及物动词，表示 “偷偷拿某物” 时必须加介词 from/into 等，不要直接接宾语（错误：sneak the cookie），正确是 sneak the cookie from the jar。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 sneak 和 creep！sneak 侧重 “偷偷摸摸、带有目的的潜行”；creep 侧重 “缓慢、小心翼翼地爬行或移动”，如 sneak out of the room /creep along the wall。[/ERR]

I help crack the eggs in the bowl. Scramble, scramble, scramble.|(原文例句) 我们先给她做鸡蛋。我帮忙把鸡蛋磕进碗里，搅拌，搅拌，不停地搅拌。[/DU][DU] The young boy scrambled up the hill to reach the picnic area.| 小男孩笨拙地爬上小山，想去野餐的地方。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/scramble.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] scramble 作 “搅拌鸡蛋” 时是及物动词，直接接 eggs，不要加介词（错误：scramble with eggs），正确是 scramble eggs。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 scramble 和 mix！scramble 特指 “快速用力搅拌（鸡蛋等）”；mix 侧重 “混合多种物质，搅拌力度较温和”，如 scramble eggs /mix flour and water。[/ERR][ERR] scramble 的现在分词是 scrambling，过去式和过去分词是 scrambled，不要记错成 scrambleing（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Salted or smoked meat from the back or sides of a pig, often eaten for breakfast (used in the book when making breakfast for Mom on Mother's Day)[/EN][CN] 培根；咸肉；熏肉（通常由猪背或猪肋部的肉腌制或熏制而成，常作为早餐食用，书中指母亲节给妈妈做早餐时用到）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbeɪkən/[/PH][DU] I help lay the bacon in the pan. Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle.|(原文例句) 我帮忙把培根放进平底锅，滋滋滋，香味四溢。[/DU][DU] The cook prepared bacon and eggs for the guests after the overnight trip.| 厨师为过夜旅行回来的客人准备了培根和鸡蛋。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/bacon.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] cook/fry bacon | 烹饪 / 煎培根 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Dad fried the bacon until it was crispy and served it with toast.| 爸爸把培根煎得酥脆，搭配吐司一起端上桌。[/EX][EX] She cooked the bacon in a non-stick pan that didn't burn food.| 她用一口不粘锅煎培根，不会烧糊。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] bacon and eggs | 培根和鸡蛋（经典早餐搭配）[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Bacon and eggs is a popular breakfast in many Western countries.| 培根和鸡蛋是许多西方国家很受欢迎的早餐。[/EX][EX] The traveler ordered bacon and eggs at the small inn to regain energy.| 旅行者在小客栈点了培根和鸡蛋，以便恢复体力。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] eat bacon | 吃培根 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy was curious and tried a piece of bacon, but he preferred eggs.| 小男孩很好奇，尝了一块培根，但他还是更喜欢鸡蛋。[/EX][EX] We ate bacon with fresh fruit for breakfast before starting our trip.| 出发前，我们早餐吃了培根和新鲜水果。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The crispy bacon is perfect for making sandwiches for school lunches.| 酥脆的培根很适合做学校午餐的三明治。[/EX][EX] Mom wrapped the leftover bacon in plastic wrap to keep it fresh.| 妈妈用保鲜膜把剩下的培根包起来，以保持新鲜。[/EX][EX] The chef added chopped bacon to the soup to make it more flavorful.| 厨师往汤里加了切碎的培根，让味道更浓郁。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] bacon 是不可数名词，表示 “一片培根” 用 a slice of bacon，“多片培根” 用 slices of bacon，不要直接说 a bacon（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 bacon 和 ham！bacon 是 “培根，咸熏肉”，通常切薄片煎制；ham 是 “火腿”，多为熟肉，可直接食用或加热，如 fried bacon /baked ham。[/ERR][ERR]“煎培根” 的正确表达是 fry bacon，不要用 cook bacon with oil（错误），因为培根本身含有油脂，煎制时无需额外加油。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To add something to make a place or object more attractive; to adorn (used in the book when decorating the breakfast tray for Mom with a flower and a card)[/EN][CN] 装饰；点缀；布置（书中指用花和卡片装饰给妈妈的早餐托盘）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ˈdekəreɪt/[/PH][DU] I help decorate the tray with a flower and a card.|(原文例句) 我帮忙用一朵花和一张卡片装饰托盘。[/DU][DU] The villagers decorated the town square with balloons to celebrate the festival.| 村民们用气球装饰小镇广场，庆祝节日。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/decorate.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] decorate sth with sth | 用某物装饰某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She decorated the Christmas tree with colorful lights and small gifts.| 她用彩色的灯和小礼物装饰圣诞树。[/EX][EX] The children decorated their party masks with feathers and stickers.| 孩子们用羽毛和贴纸装饰他们的派对面具。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] decorate a place (for sth)|（为某事）装饰某个地方 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] They decorated the classroom with streamers and balloons for the birthday party.| 他们用彩带和气球装饰教室，准备生日派对。[/EX][EX] The students decorated the school hallway with drawings to welcome the new term.| 学生们用画作装饰学校走廊，迎接新学期。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] decorate sth with sb | 和某人一起装饰某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Mom and I decorated the living room with garlands for the holiday.| 妈妈和我一起用花环装饰客厅，迎接节日。[/EX][EX] The classmates decorated the classroom bulletin board with photos together.| 同学们一起用照片装饰教室的公告栏。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] He decorated the gift box with ribbons before giving it to his friend.| 他在礼物盒子上系了丝带，然后送给了朋友。[/EX][EX] The park was decorated with lanterns that glowed in different colors at night.| 公园里装饰着灯笼，晚上会发出不同颜色的光。[/EX][EX] She decorated her backpack with patches that had her favorite cartoon characters.| 她用印有自己最爱的卡通人物的补丁装饰书包。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] decorate 是及物动词，直接接被装饰的对象，后接 “用某物装饰” 时必须加介词 with，不要用 by（错误：decorate the tray by flowers），正确是 decorate the tray with flowers。[/ERR][ERR] decorate 的名词形式是 decoration（可数 / 不可数），不要用 decoratement（错误），如 Christmas decorations（圣诞装饰品）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 decorate 和 ornament！decorate 侧重 “为某个场合或目的进行装饰，动作性强”；ornament 侧重 “用精美物品点缀，强调装饰效果”，如 decorate the house for a party /ornament the shelf with small dolls。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] The quality of using money and other resources carefully and not wasting them; a shop that sells second-hand clothes, furniture, etc., often to raise money for charity (used in the book when Jen went to a thrift store to find a bike)[/EN][CN] 节俭；节约；旧货店；慈善商店（出售二手衣物、家具等，常为慈善筹款，书中指珍去旧货店找自行车）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/θrɪft/[/PH][DU]“Maybe the thrift store has a bike,” Dad said.|(原文例句) 爸爸说：“也许旧货店里有自行车。”[/DU][DU] Thrift is an important quality for everyone, as resources are precious.| 节俭是每个人的重要品质，因为资源十分珍贵。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/thrift.webp [/IMG]
