[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] thrift store | 旧货店；慈善商店 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She found a beautiful dress at the thrift store for a low price.| 她在旧货店以低价买到了一件漂亮的裙子。[/EX][EX] Many people donate their unused clothes to thrift stores to help those in need.| 很多人把不用的衣服捐给慈善商店，帮助有需要的人。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the spirit of thrift | 节俭精神 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher taught the students the spirit of thrift, telling them not to waste paper and pencils.| 老师教导学生们要节俭，不要浪费纸张和铅笔。[/EX][EX] Our family encourages the spirit of thrift to save money for travel.| 我们家倡导节俭精神，为旅行存钱。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] practice thrift | 厉行节俭 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We should practice thrift in daily life, such as reusing water bottles.| 我们在日常生活中应该厉行节俭，比如重复使用水杯。[/EX][EX] The family practiced thrift by repairing old toys instead of buying new ones.| 这家人通过修理旧玩具而不是买新的来厉行节俭。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The thrift store in our neighborhood sells not only second-hand goods but also handmade crafts.| 我们小区的旧货店不仅卖二手物品，还卖手工工艺品。[/EX][EX] His thrift helped him save enough money to buy a new school bag.| 他的节俭让他攒够了钱，买到了一个新书包。[/EX][EX] The school teaches students the value of thrift through various activities.| 学校通过各种活动教导学生们节俭的价值。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] thrift 作 “旧货店” 时是可数名词，“一家旧货店” 用 a thrift store，“多家旧货店” 用 thrift stores，不要说 a thrift（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 thrift 和 saving！thrift 侧重 “节俭的品质或行为”；saving 侧重 “节省下来的钱或物”，如 a life of thrift /savings from monthly pocket money。[/ERR][ERR] thrift 的形容词是 thrifty（节俭的），不要用 thrift 作形容词（错误：a thrift person），正确是 a thrifty person。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To grow too big for clothes, shoes, etc.; to grow faster or taller than someone or something; to stop being interested in something because you are older (used in the book when Jen had grown too big for her old bike)[/EN][CN] 长得穿不下（衣服、鞋子等）；长得比…… 高 / 快；因长大而不再感兴趣（书中指珍长得穿不下旧自行车了）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ˌaʊtˈɡrəʊ/（英式）/ˌaʊtˈɡroʊ/（美式）[/PH][DU] Jen had outgrown her bike. She wanted a new one.|(原文例句) 珍长得骑不下她的旧自行车了，她想要一辆新的。[/DU][DU] The little girl outgrew her favorite dress in just six months because she was growing so fast.| 这个小女孩长得太快了，短短六个月就穿不下她最爱的裙子了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/outgrow.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] outgrow sth | 长得穿不下某物；因长大而不再需要 / 感兴趣某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He outgrew his winter boots in just one year and needed a new pair.| 他仅用一年就穿不下冬靴了，需要一双新的。[/EX][EX] Many children outgrow their love for stuffed animals as they get older.| 很多孩子长大后就不再喜欢毛绒玩具了。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] outgrow sb | 长得比某人高 / 快 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy outgrew his older sister by the time he was ten.| 这个小男孩十岁时就长得比他姐姐还高了。[/EX][EX] The puppy outgrew its mother in just eight months, which was surprising.| 这只小狗仅用八个月就长得比妈妈还大，让人惊讶。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] outgrow the need for sth | 不再需要某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] As she learned more skills, she outgrew the need for her mom's help with homework.| 随着她学会了更多技能，她不再需要妈妈帮忙辅导作业了。[/EX][EX] The town outgrew the old playground and built a new one with more equipment.| 这个小镇不再需要那座旧操场，建了一座设备更全的新操场。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She outgrew her interest in collecting stickers and started collecting postcards instead.| 她不再对收集贴纸感兴趣，转而开始收集明信片。[/EX][EX] The plant outgrew its small pot and had to be transplanted to the garden.| 这株植物长得超出了小花盆，不得不移栽到花园里。[/EX][EX] He outgrew the small desk and needed a bigger one for his school books.| 他长得太高，小书桌容不下了，需要一张更大的书桌放课本。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] outgrow 的过去式是 outgrew，过去分词是 outgrown，不要记错成 outgrowed（错误），正确：She outgrew her coat last winter。[/ERR][ERR] outgrow 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：outgrow from the bike），正确是 outgrow the bike。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 outgrow 和 grow out of！二者含义基本相同，outgrow 更正式，grow out of 更口语化，如 outgrow a dress /grow out of a dress。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long, narrow piece of paper, cloth, or plastic used for decorating rooms, parties, etc. (used in the book when Jen found streamers to decorate her second-hand bike)[/EN][CN]（装饰用的）彩带；彩条；飘带（通常由纸、布或塑料制成，用于装饰房间、派对等，书中指珍找到彩带来装饰她的二手自行车）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈstriːmə(r)/[/PH][DU] Jen found streamers. “Cool,” she said. She thought maybe the bike could look cool, too.|(原文例句) 珍找到了彩带。“真酷，” 她说。她觉得也许自行车也能变得很酷。[/DU][DU] The children hung colorful streamers around the classroom for the end-of-year party.| 孩子们在教室周围挂上了彩色彩带，准备年终派对。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/streamer.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] colorful streamers | 彩色彩带 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Colorful streamers fluttered in the wind, making the birthday party more lively.| 彩色彩带在风中飘动，让生日派对更加热闹。[/EX][EX] She bought a roll of colorful streamers to decorate her tree house.| 她买了一卷彩色彩带，装饰她的树屋。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] hang streamers | 挂彩带 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We hung streamers from the ceiling to celebrate the team's success.| 我们从天花板上垂下彩带，庆祝团队取得成功。[/EX][EX] The villagers hung streamers across the streets to welcome the visiting performers.| 村民们在街道上悬挂彩带，欢迎来访的表演者。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] decorate with streamers | 用彩带装饰 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The party room was decorated with streamers and balloons during the holiday season.| 节日期间，派对房间用彩带和气球装饰得很漂亮。[/EX][EX] They decorated the bike with red and gold streamers to make it stand out in the parade.| 他们用红色和金色的彩带装饰自行车，让它在游行中更加显眼。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The streamers on the school gate sparkled in the sun, attracting many students to take photos.| 学校大门上的彩带在阳光下闪闪发光，吸引了很多学生拍照。[/EX][EX] She tied streamers to her backpack to make it easier to find in the crowd.| 她把彩带系在书包上，以便在人群中更容易找到。[/EX][EX] The wind blew the streamers away, but we quickly tied them back up.| 风把彩带吹走了，但我们很快就把它们重新系好了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] streamer 是可数名词，“一根彩带” 用 a streamer，“多根彩带” 用 streamers，不要说 many streamer（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 streamer 和 ribbon！streamer 特指 “用于装饰的长彩带、彩条”，通常较长较宽；ribbon 特指 “丝带、缎带”，通常较窄较精致，如 party streamers /a silk ribbon。[/ERR][ERR]“挂彩带” 的正确表达是 hang streamers，不要用 put streamers（错误），put 更侧重 “放置”，hang 侧重 “悬挂”。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To start to love someone or something very much (used in the book when Jen started to love the second-hand bike after decorating it)[/EN][CN] 爱上；喜欢上（某人或某物）（书中指珍装饰完二手自行车后，开始喜欢上它）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/fɔːl ɪn lʌv wɪð/（英式）/fɔːl ɪn lʌv wɪð/（美式）[/PH][DU] Jen went to work on the bike. She fell in love with it.|(原文例句) 珍开始打理这辆自行车，她爱上了它。[/DU][DU] The little girl fell in love with the puppy the first time she saw it.| 这个小女孩第一次见到小狗就爱上了它。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/fallinlove.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] fall in love with sb | 爱上某人 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] He fell in love with the girl who shared the same hobby as him.| 他爱上了那位和他有相同爱好的女孩。[/EX][EX] The old man fell in love with a kind-hearted woman who lived next door.| 老人爱上了住在隔壁的善良女士。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] fall in love with sth | 喜欢上某物 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She fell in love with the old storybook because of its interesting pictures.| 她因为那些有趣的插图，喜欢上了这本旧故事书。[/EX][EX] The traveler fell in love with the beautiful scenery of the small town at first sight.| 旅行者第一眼就爱上了小镇的美丽景色。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] fall in love with sth at first sight | 一见钟情于某物 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] He fell in love with the guitar at first sight and decided to learn to play it.| 他第一眼就看中了这把吉他，决定学习弹奏。[/EX][EX] The children fell in love with the amusement park at first sight.| 孩子们第一眼就喜欢上了这个游乐园。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] After spending time with the little cat, she fell in love with its lovely personality.| 和小猫相处一段时间后，她爱上了它可爱的性格。[/EX][EX] He fell in love with the quiet life in the countryside and decided to stay there.| 他爱上了乡村宁静的生活，决定留在那里。[/EX][EX] She fell in love with the old library and visited it every weekend.| 她喜欢上了这座古老的图书馆，每个周末都去参观。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] fall in love with 是固定短语，中间不能加冠词（错误：fall in a love with），也不能漏掉 in（错误：fall love with）。[/ERR][ERR] fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen，不要记错成 fall in love with 的过去式是 fall in loved with（错误），正确：She fell in love with the bike。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 fall in love with 和 like！fall in love with 侧重 “深深爱上、非常喜欢”，情感强度更强；like 侧重 “普通的喜欢”，如 I like this book / I fell in love with this book。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A section at the beginning of a book, speech, etc., that introduces the topic; the act of introducing someone to another person (used in the book as the first section introducing community workers)[/EN][CN] 引言；导论；介绍；引言部分（书籍、演讲等开头介绍主题的部分；把某人介绍给另一人的行为，书中作为介绍社区工作者的开篇部分）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃn/[/PH][DU] Introduction: Community workers are people who work in a community.|(原文例句) 引言：社区工作者是在社区里工作的人。[/DU][DU] The book has a short introduction that explains what community workers do.| 这本书有一个简短的引言，解释了社区工作者的工作内容。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/introduction.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a brief/short/long introduction | 简短 / 简短 / 长篇的引言 / 介绍 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher gave a brief introduction to the new community worker who came to the school.| 老师给新来学校的社区工作者做了一个简短的介绍。[/EX][EX] The article includes a long introduction about the history of community service.| 这篇文章有一个长篇引言，讲述了社区服务的历史。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] introduction to sth | 对某物的介绍 / 引言 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] This is an introduction to the different types of community workers.| 这是对不同类型社区工作者的介绍。[/EX][EX] The introduction to the book helps readers understand the importance of community workers.| 这本书的引言帮助读者理解社区工作者的重要性。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] give an introduction | 做介绍；发表引言 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The mayor gave an introduction at the meeting to welcome the new community workers.| 市长在会议上做了介绍，欢迎新来的社区工作者。[/EX][EX] She gave an introduction about the community's new service center.| 她就社区新的服务中心做了介绍。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The introduction of the new community program has helped many families.| 新社区项目的推出帮助了很多家庭。[/EX][EX] He asked the teacher for an introduction to the community volunteer group.| 他请求老师把他介绍给社区志愿者小组。[/EX][EX] The introduction in the manual explains how to contact community workers when in need.| 手册中的引言部分说明了需要时如何联系社区工作者。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] introduction 是可数名词，“一个引言 / 介绍” 用 an introduction，“多个引言 / 介绍” 用 introductions，不要说 a introduction（错误），注意元音音素前用 an。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 introduction 和 intro！intro 是 introduction 的缩写，多用于口语或非正式场合，正式写作中应使用完整形式 introduction。[/ERR][ERR]“对…… 的介绍” 用 introduction to sth，不要用 introduction of sth（错误），如 an introduction to community workers（正确）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A person whose job is to collect and deliver mail to people's homes or offices (used in the book as a type of community worker who helps people keep in touch)[/EN][CN] 邮递员；邮差（负责收集和投递邮件到人们家中或办公室的人，书中作为帮助人们保持联系的社区工作者类型）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈmeɪl ˌkæriə(r)/（英式）/ˈmeɪl ˌkæriər/（美式）[/PH][DU] He is a mail carrier. He helps people keep in touch.|(原文例句) 他是一名邮递员，他帮助人们保持联系。[/DU][DU] The mail carrier delivers letters and packages to every house in the neighborhood every day.| 邮递员每天给小区里的每家每户投递信件和包裹。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/mail carrier.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a mail carrier | 一名邮递员 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The mail carrier wears a uniform and carries a big bag for mail.| 邮递员穿着制服，背着一个装邮件的大袋子。[/EX][EX] We saw a mail carrier riding a bike to deliver mail in the rain.| 我们看到一名邮递员在雨中骑自行车投递邮件。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] mail carrier + 动词（deliver/collect 等）| 邮递员做……（投递 / 收集等）[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The mail carrier collects mail from the post box every morning.| 邮递员每天早上从邮箱里收集邮件。[/EX][EX] Our neighborhood mail carrier is very kind and always greets people with a smile.| 我们小区的邮递员非常善良，总是微笑着和人们打招呼。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] thank the mail carrier | 感谢邮递员 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The children made cards to thank the mail carrier for his hard work during the holiday.| 孩子们制作了卡片，感谢邮递员在节日期间的辛勤工作。[/EX][EX] We should thank the mail carrier for delivering important letters on time.| 我们应该感谢邮递员准时投递重要信件。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The mail carrier had to walk up many stairs to deliver the package to the top floor.| 邮递员不得不爬很多楼梯，把包裹送到顶楼。[/EX][EX] During snow days, the mail carrier still works hard to make sure mail is delivered.| 下雪天，邮递员仍然努力工作，确保邮件按时投递。[/EX][EX] My uncle used to be a mail carrier and traveled all over the town every day.| 我叔叔以前是一名邮递员，每天走遍全镇。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] mail carrier 是复合名词，由 mail 和 carrier 组成，中间必须空格，不要连写成 mailcarrier（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] mail carrier 是可数名词，“一名邮递员” 用 a mail carrier，“多名邮递员” 用 mail carriers，不要遗漏冠词 a（错误：mail carrier）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 mail carrier 和 postman！mail carrier 是通用表达，男女通用；postman 特指 “男邮递员”，对应的 “女邮递员” 是 postwoman，如 a mail carrier /a postman。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To continue to communicate with someone, especially by writing, calling, or meeting (used in the book to describe how mail carriers help people stay connected)[/EN][CN] 保持联系（尤指通过写信、打电话或见面继续与某人交流，书中指邮递员帮助人们保持联系）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/kiːp ɪn tʌtʃ/[/PH][DU] He is a mail carrier. He helps people keep in touch.|(原文例句) 他是一名邮递员，他帮助人们保持联系。[/DU][DU] We keep in touch with our grandparents by calling them every weekend.| 我们每个周末给祖父母打电话，保持联系。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/keep in touch.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] keep in touch with sb | 与某人保持联系 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She keeps in touch with her old classmates by sending messages.| 她通过发信息与老同学保持联系。[/EX][EX] It's important to keep in touch with family members who live far away.| 与住在远方的家人保持联系很重要。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] keep in touch by sth | 通过某物保持联系 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] They keep in touch by email because they are in different countries.| 他们因为在不同的国家，通过电子邮件保持联系。[/EX][EX] We keep in touch by meeting for coffee once a month.| 我们每个月聚在一起喝一次咖啡，保持联系。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] stay in touch (与 keep in touch 同义)| 保持联系 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] Stay in touch and let me know how your new school is.| 保持联系，让我知道你的新学校怎么样。[/EX][EX] We promised to stay in touch after graduation.| 我们承诺毕业后保持联系。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Even though we moved to different cities, we still keep in touch with each other.| 尽管我们搬到了不同的城市，我们仍然保持着联系。[/EX][EX] The old friends kept in touch by sending each other postcards during travels.| 老朋友们在旅行期间通过互寄明信片保持联系。[/EX][EX] Technology makes it easier for people to keep in touch no matter how far they are.| 科技让人们无论相隔多远，都能更容易地保持联系。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] keep in touch 是固定短语，中间不能漏掉 in（错误：keep touch），也不能加多余的冠词（错误：keep in a touch）。[/ERR][ERR] keep in touch 后接 “与某人” 时必须加介词 with，不要直接接宾语（错误：keep in touch my friend），正确是 keep in touch with my friend。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 keep in touch 和 contact！keep in touch 侧重 “长期持续保持联系”；contact 侧重 “单次联系或取得联系”，如 keep in touch with him /contact him by phone。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] The end part of a book, speech, or piece of writing that summarizes the main points; a decision or judgment made after considering all the facts (used in the book as the final section about community workers)[/EN][CN] 结论；结尾；总结（书籍、演讲或文章的最后部分，总结主要观点；考虑所有事实后做出的决定或判断，书中作为关于社区工作者的最后部分）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/kənˈkluːʒn/[/PH][DU] Conclusion: Community workers help people everywhere.|(原文例句) 结论：社区工作者在各个地方帮助人们。[/DU][DU] The conclusion of the report summarizes the importance of protecting the environment.| 报告的结论总结了保护环境的重要性。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/conclusion.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] in conclusion | 总之；最后（用于文章或演讲结尾）[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] In conclusion, community workers play an important role in our daily lives.| 总之，社区工作者在我们的日常生活中扮演着重要角色。[/EX][EX] In conclusion, we should try our best to help those in need.| 最后，我们应该尽力帮助那些有需要的人。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] draw a conclusion | 得出结论 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] After discussing for a long time, we drew a conclusion about the activity plan.| 经过长时间的讨论，我们就活动计划得出了结论。[/EX][EX] Scientists draw conclusions based on careful research.| 科学家们基于仔细的研究得出结论。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the conclusion of sth | 某物的结尾 / 结论 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We read the conclusion of the story to know how it ended.| 我们读了故事的结尾，想知道它是如何结束的。[/EX][EX] The conclusion of the meeting was that we would start the project next month.| 会议的结论是我们下个月开始这个项目。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The teacher asked us to write a conclusion for our science experiment report.| 老师让我们为科学实验报告写一个结论。[/EX][EX] The conclusion of the film surprised everyone because it was so unexpected.| 电影的结尾让所有人都很惊讶，因为它太出人意料了。[/EX][EX] She came to the conclusion that she should study harder to improve her grades.| 她得出结论，为了提高成绩，她应该更加努力学习。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] conclusion 是可数名词，“一个结论” 用 a conclusion，“多个结论” 用 conclusions，不要说 draw conclusion（错误），正确是 draw a conclusion。[/ERR][ERR] in conclusion 是固定短语，不要写成 on conclusion（错误），且后面通常接逗号，引出总结内容。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 conclusion 和 summary！conclusion 侧重 “基于事实的结论或文章的结尾总结”；summary 侧重 “对内容的简要概括，不一定在结尾”，如 the conclusion of the essay /a summary of the book。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Doing things or moving around a lot; busy with activities; (of animals) active at a particular time (used in the book to describe animals that are busy at night)[/EN][CN] 活跃的；积极的；好动的；（动物）在特定时间活动的（书中指在夜间活动的动物）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈæktɪv/[/PH][DU] Some animals are active at night, when it is dark.|(原文例句) 有些动物在天黑的晚上很活跃。[/DU][DU] The little boy is very active and loves to play sports after school.| 这个小男孩非常活跃，放学后喜欢做运动。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/active.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] be active at + 时间 | 在某个时间活跃 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Owls are active at night and sleep during the day.| 猫头鹰在夜间活跃，白天睡觉。[/EX][EX] Many children are active in the morning and feel tired in the afternoon.| 很多孩子早上很活跃，下午会感到疲惫。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be active in sth | 在某事中积极参与 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] She is active in the school's music club and sings in every performance.| 她积极参与学校的音乐俱乐部，每场表演都参加演唱。[/EX][EX] People should be active in protecting the natural environment.| 人们应该积极参与保护环境。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] an active lifestyle | 积极的生活方式 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Keeping an active lifestyle helps people stay healthy.| 保持积极的生活方式有助于人们保持健康。[/EX][EX] My grandparents have an active lifestyle, walking every morning and gardening in the afternoon.| 我的祖父母生活方式很积极，每天早上散步，下午种花种草。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The active puppy runs around the yard all day and never seems to get tired.| 这只好动的小狗整天在院子里跑来跑去，似乎永远不会累。[/EX][EX] Bees are active in collecting nectar from flowers during spring and summer.| 蜜蜂在春夏季节积极地从花中采集花蜜。[/EX][EX] The old man is still active in community activities even though he is over 70.| 这位老人虽然已经 70 多岁了，仍然积极参与社区活动。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] active 是形容词，不要当作副词使用（错误：he works active），正确是 he works actively；其名词形式是 activity（活动），不要混淆（错误：an active of reading），正确是 an activity of reading。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 active 和 energetic！active 侧重 “好动的、积极参与的”；energetic 侧重 “精力充沛的”，如 an active child /an energetic athlete。[/ERR][ERR]“在夜间活跃” 的正确表达是 active at night，不要用 active in night（错误），in 用于较长的时间段，如 in the evening。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A sweet liquid produced by flowers, which bees and other insects collect to make honey; a sweet drink (used in the book when bats eat fruit and nectar at night)[/EN][CN] 花蜜（花产生的甜味液体，蜜蜂和其他昆虫采集来制作蜂蜜）；甜饮料（书中指蝙蝠在夜间食用的食物）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈnektə(r)/[/PH][DU] This bat is active at night. It eats fruit and nectar in the dark.|(原文例句) 这只蝙蝠在夜间活跃，它在黑暗中吃水果和花蜜。[/DU][DU] Bees fly from flower to flower to collect nectar for honey.| 蜜蜂从一朵花飞到另一朵花，采集花蜜制作蜂蜜。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/nectar.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] collect nectar | 采集花蜜 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Butterflies also collect nectar from colorful flowers in the garden.| 蝴蝶也从花园里五颜六色的花中采集花蜜。[/EX][EX] The little bird uses its long beak to collect nectar from deep flowers.| 这只小鸟用它长长的喙从深花中采集花蜜。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] nectar of + 花名 | 某种花的花蜜 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The nectar of roses is very sweet and attracts many bees.| 玫瑰的花蜜非常甜，吸引了很多蜜蜂。[/EX][EX] Hummingbirds feed on the nectar of tropical flowers.| 蜂鸟以热带花朵的花蜜为食。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] sweet nectar | 甜花蜜 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The sweet nectar from clover is a favorite food of many insects.| 三叶草的甜花蜜是许多昆虫最爱的食物。[/EX][EX] We tasted the sweet nectar from the apple blossoms and it was delicious.| 我们尝了尝苹果花的甜花蜜，味道很好。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The bees store the collected nectar in honeycombs to make honey.| 蜜蜂把采集到的花蜜储存在蜂巢里制作蜂蜜。[/EX][EX] Flowers produce nectar to attract insects that help them pollinate.| 花产生花蜜是为了吸引昆虫帮助它们授粉。[/EX][EX] The little girl enjoyed the sweet nectar from the orange blossoms in her backyard.| 小女孩喜欢后院橘子花的甜花蜜。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] nectar 是不可数名词，表示 “一滴花蜜” 用 a drop of nectar，“许多花蜜” 用 much nectar，不要直接说 a nectar（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 nectar 和 honey！nectar 是 “花蜜”，是花产生的原始甜味液体；honey 是 “蜂蜜”，是蜜蜂加工花蜜后形成的产物，如 collect nectar /eat honey。[/ERR][ERR]“采集花蜜” 的正确表达是 collect nectar，不要用 gather nectar（错误，虽可理解但不常用），collect 更侧重 “有目的的收集”。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A type of shellfish with a soft body inside two hard shells that close tightly; to close tightly (used in the book when nurse sharks find clams in the dark)[/EN][CN] 蛤蜊；蚌；紧闭（一种贝类，柔软的身体包裹在两个能紧密闭合的硬壳中，书中指护士鲨在黑暗中寻找蛤蜊作为食物）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/klæm/[/PH][DU] This nurse shark is active at night. It finds crabs and clams in the dark.|(原文例句) 这只护士鲨在夜间活跃，它在黑暗中寻找螃蟹和蛤蜊。[/DU][DU] The little boy tried to open the clam, but it clamped tightly shut.| 小男孩想打开蛤蜊，但它紧紧地闭着壳。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/clam.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] eat clams | 吃蛤蜊 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We went to the beach and ate fresh clams for dinner.| 我们去了海滩，晚餐吃了新鲜的蛤蜊。[/EX][EX] Seagulls often eat small clams they find on the sand.| 海鸥经常吃在沙滩上找到的小蛤蜊。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] open a clam | 打开蛤蜊 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Dad used a small knife to open the clam carefully.| 爸爸用一把小刀小心地打开蛤蜊。[/EX][EX] It's not easy to open a clam because its shell is hard.| 打开蛤蜊不容易，因为它的壳很硬。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] clam up|（非正式）突然闭口不言；守口如瓶 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] When the teacher asked who broke the vase, the student clammed up.| 老师问谁打碎了花瓶，那个学生突然闭口不言。[/EX][EX] He clammed up when his mom asked about his test score.| 妈妈问他考试成绩时，他守口如瓶。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Many people like to dig for clams at low tide on the beach.| 很多人喜欢在海滩退潮时挖蛤蜊。[/EX][EX] The clam buried itself in the sand to avoid being found by predators.| 蛤蜊把自己埋在沙子里，避免被掠食者发现。[/EX][EX] She added chopped clams to the soup to make it more delicious.| 她往汤里加了切碎的蛤蜊，让味道更浓郁。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] clam 作 “蛤蜊” 时是可数名词，“一个蛤蜊” 用 a clam，“多个蛤蜊” 用 clams，不要说 many clam（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 clam 和 oyster！clam 是 “蛤蜊，蚌”，壳较圆且薄；oyster 是 “牡蛎，蚝”，壳较厚且不规则，如 fresh clams /raw oysters。[/ERR][ERR] clam 作动词 “紧闭” 时，过去式和过去分词是 clamped，不要记错成 clammed（错误），正确：The door clamped shut in the wind。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A game played on ice or grass where players use sticks to hit a small puck or ball into the opponent's goal; a sport that helps people exercise and make friends (used in the book when talking about fun ways to exercise)[/EN][CN] 曲棍球（在冰面或草地上进行的运动，球员用球杆将小冰球或小球击入对方球门）；一项能帮助人们锻炼和交友的运动（书中指有趣的锻炼方式）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈhɒki/（英式）/ˈhɑːki/（美式）[/PH][DU] You are exercising when you play hockey.|(原文例句) 打曲棍球时，你就在锻炼啦。[/DU][DU] We played hockey with our classmates on the school field after class.| 课后我们和同学在学校操场上打曲棍球。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/hockey.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] play hockey | 打曲棍球 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He learns to play hockey every Saturday at the community center.| 他每周六在社区中心学习打曲棍球。[/EX][EX] Girls can play hockey too—our school has a girls' hockey team.| 女孩也能打曲棍球，我们学校有一支女子曲棍球队。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] ice hockey | 冰球 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Ice hockey is a popular sport in cold countries like Canada.| 冰球在加拿大等寒冷国家是很受欢迎的运动。[/EX][EX] We watched an exciting ice hockey game on TV last night.| 昨晚我们在电视上看了一场精彩的冰球比赛。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] field hockey | 草地曲棍球 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Field hockey is played on grass, and players use a small ball instead of a puck.| 草地曲棍球在草地上进行，球员用小球而不是冰球。[/EX][EX] Our PE teacher taught us how to hold a field hockey stick correctly.| 体育老师教我们如何正确握草地曲棍球杆。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The hockey puck slid across the ice and into the goal.| 冰球滑过冰面，进了球门。[/EX][EX] She bought a new hockey stick for her brother's birthday.| 她给弟弟买了一根新的曲棍球杆作为生日礼物。[/EX][EX] Playing hockey helps improve teamwork and speed.| 打曲棍球有助于提高团队合作能力和速度。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] hockey 是不可数名词，表示 “一场曲棍球比赛” 用 a hockey game，不要说 a hockey（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 hockey 和 soccer！hockey 是 “曲棍球”，用球杆击球；soccer 是 “足球”，用脚踢球，如 play hockey /play soccer。[/ERR][ERR]“打曲棍球” 的正确表达是 play hockey，不要用 play the hockey（错误），球类运动前不加定冠词 the。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A form of exercise that involves moving the body into different positions to stay strong and relaxed; a fun activity that makes people healthy (used in the book about different yoga poses)[/EN][CN] 瑜伽（一种通过摆出不同姿势来保持强壮和放松的运动；一种能让人保持健康的有趣活动，书中介绍了多种瑜伽姿势）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈjəʊɡə/（英式）/ˈjoʊɡə/（美式）[/PH][DU] We Do Yoga. Yoga makes us strong. Yoga is fun.|(原文例句) 我们做瑜伽。瑜伽让我们变得强壮，瑜伽很有趣。[/DU][DU] My mom does yoga every morning to keep her body flexible.| 我妈妈每天早上做瑜伽，保持身体柔韧性。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/yoga.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] do yoga | 做瑜伽 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We do yoga in PE class to stretch our bodies.| 我们在体育课上做瑜伽，拉伸身体。[/EX][EX] She likes to do yoga before going to bed to relax.| 她喜欢睡前做瑜伽放松身心。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] yoga pose | 瑜伽姿势 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher showed us how to do the tree yoga pose correctly.| 老师教我们如何正确做树式瑜伽姿势。[/EX][EX] This yoga pose helps improve balance and focus.| 这个瑜伽姿势有助于提高平衡感和专注力。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] yoga class | 瑜伽课 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] I joined a yoga class at the community center last month.| 上个月我在社区中心报了一节瑜伽课。[/EX][EX] The yoga class starts at 7 o'clock in the evening.| 瑜伽课晚上 7 点开始。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Yoga teaches us to breathe slowly and stay calm.| 瑜伽教我们缓慢呼吸，保持冷静。[/EX][EX] You don't need special equipment to do yoga at home.| 在家做瑜伽不需要特殊装备。[/EX][EX] Many people do yoga to relieve stress from work or study.| 很多人通过做瑜伽来缓解工作或学习的压力。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] yoga 是不可数名词，不要加 a/an（错误：a yoga），也没有复数形式（错误：yogas）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 yoga 和 exercise！yoga 是 “瑜伽”，特指一种拉伸放松的运动；exercise 是 “锻炼” 的总称，范围更广，如 do yoga /do exercise。[/ERR][ERR]“做瑜伽” 的正确表达是 do yoga，不要用 play yoga（错误），play 多用于球类或游戏类运动。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A position of the body; to put the body into a particular position (used in the book about different yoga positions and clown faces)[/EN][CN] 姿势；摆姿势（身体的一种姿态；将身体摆出特定姿势，书中涉及瑜伽姿势和小丑扮相）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/pəʊz/（英式）/poʊz/（美式）[/PH][DU] I do a dog pose. I try to stretch down like my dog.|(原文例句) 我做狗式姿势，试着像我的小狗一样向下拉伸。[/DU][DU] The clown posed for photos with the children after the show.| 表演结束后，小丑和孩子们一起摆姿势拍照。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pose.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] yoga pose | 瑜伽姿势 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Can you hold this yoga pose for one minute?| 你能保持这个瑜伽姿势一分钟吗？[/EX][EX] She learned three new yoga poses in today's class.| 她在今天的课上学了三个新的瑜伽姿势。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] strike a pose | 摆姿势（拍照或展示）[POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The model struck a pose and smiled at the camera.| 模特摆了个姿势，对着镜头微笑。[/EX][EX] We struck funny poses for the family photo.| 我们为全家福摆了有趣的姿势。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] pose for sb | 为某人摆姿势 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The little girl posed for her dad while he painted a picture of her.| 爸爸给小女孩画画时，她为爸爸摆了姿势。[/EX][EX] They posed for a group photo in front of the school gate.| 他们在学校大门前摆姿势拍集体照。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] His favorite yoga pose is the airplane pose—he feels like flying.| 他最喜欢的瑜伽姿势是飞机式，他觉得自己像在飞。[/EX][EX] The dancer held a beautiful pose at the end of the performance.| 舞者在表演结束时摆出了一个优美的姿势。[/EX][EX] It's not easy to keep a pose for a long time without moving.| 长时间不动保持一个姿势并不容易。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] pose 作名词 “姿势” 时是可数名词，“一个姿势” 用 a pose，“多个姿势” 用 poses，不要说 many pose（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 pose 和 position！pose 特指 “为展示、拍照等摆出的姿势”；position 泛指 “身体的位置或姿态”，如 strike a pose /sit in a comfortable position。[/ERR][ERR] pose 作动词时是及物动词，直接接宾语，如 pose a question（提出问题），不要遗漏宾语（错误：pose for the photo），正确是 pose for the photo（为照片摆姿势）或 pose a photo（拍摄照片，较少用）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To bend into a curved shape; a curved structure (used in the book when talking about the cat yoga pose where the back is bent)[/EN][CN] 弓起；使成弓形；拱门；拱形结构（弯曲成曲线形状；弯曲的结构，书中指猫式瑜伽姿势中弓起背部）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ɑːtʃ/（英式）/ɑːrtʃ/（美式）[/PH][DU] I do a cat pose. My cat and I both arch our backs.|(原文例句) 我做猫式姿势，我和我的猫都弓起背部。[/DU][DU] The bridge has a big arch that looks like a rainbow.| 这座桥有一个大大的拱门，看起来像彩虹。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/arch.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] arch one's back | 弓起背部 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The cat arched its back when it saw a dog nearby.| 猫看到附近有狗时，弓起了背部。[/EX][EX] You need to arch your back slightly for this yoga pose.| 做这个瑜伽姿势时，你需要轻轻弓起背部。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] arch the eyebrows | 皱起眉毛 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She arched her eyebrows when she heard the surprising news.| 听到这个令人惊讶的消息，她皱起了眉毛。[/EX][EX] He arched his eyebrows and asked, “Are you sure?”| 他皱了皱眉毛，问道：“你确定吗？”[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a stone arch | 石拱门 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We walked through a small stone arch to enter the garden.| 我们穿过一个小小的石拱门进入花园。[/EX][EX] The old building has many beautiful arches on the windows.| 这座老建筑的窗户上有许多漂亮的拱形结构。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The rainbow arched across the sky after the rain.| 雨后，彩虹在天空中拱起一道弧线。[/EX][EX] She arched her legs and stretched them towards the ceiling.| 她弓起双腿，向天花板方向伸展。[/EX][EX] The arch of the door is decorated with colorful flowers.| 门的拱形部分装饰着五颜六色的花。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] arch 作动词 “弓起” 时是及物动词，直接接宾语（如 back/eyebrows），不要加介词（错误：arch up the back），正确是 arch the back。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 arch 和 bend！arch 特指 “弓成弧形”，弯曲程度较明显；bend 泛指 “弯曲”，可指任何角度的弯曲，如 arch the back /bend the knees。[/ERR][ERR] arch 作名词 “拱门” 时是可数名词，“一个拱门” 用 an arch（元音音素开头），不要说 a arch（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A type of poisonous snake with a wide hood on its head; a yoga pose where the upper body is lifted off the ground (used in the book about yoga poses and Indian animals)[/EN][CN] 眼镜蛇（一种头部有宽阔兜帽状皮褶的毒蛇）；眼镜蛇式瑜伽姿势（上半身抬离地面的瑜伽动作，书中涉及瑜伽姿势和印度动物）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkəʊbrə/（英式）/ˈkoʊbrə/（美式）[/PH][DU] I do a cobra pose. I won’t bite if you won’t!|(原文例句) 我做眼镜蛇式姿势，你不咬我，我也不咬你哦！[/DU][DU] The king cobra is one of the most dangerous snakes in the world.| 眼镜王蛇是世界上最危险的蛇之一。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/cobra.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] cobra pose | 眼镜蛇式瑜伽姿势 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The cobra pose helps stretch the chest and back muscles.| 眼镜蛇式姿势有助于拉伸胸部和背部肌肉。[/EX][EX] She learned how to do the cobra pose in her first yoga class.| 她在第一节瑜伽课上学会了做眼镜蛇式姿势。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] king cobra | 眼镜王蛇 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] King cobras live in forests in Asia, including India.| 眼镜王蛇生活在亚洲的森林里，包括印度。[/EX][EX] The zookeeper told us that king cobras can grow up to 5 meters long.| 动物园管理员告诉我们，眼镜王蛇能长到 5 米长。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] poisonous cobra | 有毒的眼镜蛇 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We saw a poisonous cobra at the zoo, but it was in a safe cage.| 我们在动物园看到了一条有毒的眼镜蛇，但它在安全的笼子里。[/EX][EX] People should stay away from wild cobras because they are dangerous.| 人们应该远离野生眼镜蛇，因为它们很危险。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] In the cobra pose, you lie on your stomach and lift your chest up.| 做眼镜蛇式姿势时，你趴在地上，抬起胸部。[/EX][EX] The cobra spread its hood to scare away the other animal.| 眼镜蛇展开兜帽状皮褶，吓跑了另一只动物。[/EX][EX] Yoga teachers often teach the cobra pose after the cat pose.| 瑜伽老师通常在猫式姿势之后教眼镜蛇式姿势。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] cobra 是可数名词，“一条眼镜蛇” 用 a cobra，“多条眼镜蛇” 用 cobras，不要说 many cobra（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 cobra 和 snake！cobra 是 “眼镜蛇”，是蛇的一种，特指有毒且有兜帽的蛇；snake 是 “蛇” 的总称，如 a king cobra /a small snake。[/ERR][ERR]“眼镜蛇式瑜伽姿势” 的正确表达是 cobra pose，不要说 cobra's pose（错误），不需要所有格形式。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A large bird with long legs and a long beak; a yoga pose where you balance on one leg (used in the book about yoga poses and African watering hole animals)[/EN][CN] 鹳（一种长腿、长喙的大鸟）；鹳式瑜伽姿势（单腿站立保持平衡的瑜伽动作，书中涉及瑜伽姿势和非洲水坑边的动物）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/stɔːk/（英式）/stɔːrk/（美式）[/PH][DU] I do a stork pose. I balance on one leg.|(原文例句) 我做鹳式姿势，单腿保持平衡。[/DU][DU] A flock of storks came to the watering hole to drink water.| 一群鹳飞到水坑边喝水。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/stork.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] stork pose | 鹳式瑜伽姿势 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The stork pose is good for improving balance and leg strength.| 鹳式姿势有助于提高平衡感和腿部力量。[/EX][EX] It takes practice to hold the stork pose for more than 10 seconds.| 要保持鹳式姿势超过 10 秒需要练习。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a flock of storks | 一群鹳 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We saw a big flock of storks flying south for the winter.| 我们看到一大群鹳向南飞去过冬。[/EX][EX] A flock of storks rested on the roof of the old building.| 一群鹳在老建筑的屋顶上休息。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] white stork | 白鹳 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] White storks build large nests on top of trees or buildings.| 白鹳在树顶或建筑物上筑大型巢穴。[/EX][EX] White storks are considered a symbol of good luck in some countries.| 在一些国家，白鹳被视为好运的象征。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] In the stork pose, you stand on one leg and put the other foot against your knee.| 做鹳式姿势时，你单腿站立，另一只脚靠在膝盖上。[/EX][EX] The stork used its long beak to catch fish in the river.| 鹳用它长长的喙在河里捕鱼。[/EX][EX] She struggled to balance in the stork pose at first, but now she can do it easily.| 起初她很难在鹳式姿势中保持平衡，但现在她能轻松做到了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] stork 是可数名词，“一只鹳” 用 a stork，“多只鹳” 用 storks，不要说 many stork（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 stork 和 crane！stork 是 “鹳”，喙较粗短，常栖息在屋顶或树顶；crane 是 “鹤”，喙细长，常栖息在湿地，如 a white stork /a red-crowned crane。[/ERR][ERR]“鹳式瑜伽姿势” 的正确表达是 stork pose，不要说 stork's pose（错误），不需要所有格形式。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To stay steady on one's feet or in a particular position; a state of being steady (used in the book about yoga poses and daily activities)[/EN][CN] 平衡；保持平衡（双脚或在特定姿势中保持稳定；稳定的状态，书中涉及瑜伽姿势和日常活动）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbæləns/[/PH][DU] I do a tree pose. My arms are like branches that reach up high. I balance on one leg.|(原文例句) 我做树式姿势，我的手臂像树枝一样高高举起，单腿保持平衡。[/DU][DU] You need good balance to ride a bike without falling.| 骑自行车不摔倒需要良好的平衡感。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/balance.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] balance on one leg | 单腿平衡 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy practiced balancing on one leg in the park.| 小男孩在公园里练习单腿平衡。[/EX][EX] Can you balance on one leg for a minute?| 你能单腿平衡一分钟吗？[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] keep balance | 保持平衡 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She spread her arms out to keep balance while walking on the narrow path.| 她在狭窄的小路上行走时，张开手臂保持平衡。[/EX][EX] Yoga helps you learn how to keep balance in daily life.| 瑜伽帮助你学会在日常生活中保持平衡。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] lose balance | 失去平衡 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] He lost his balance and fell off the skateboard.| 他失去了平衡，从滑板上摔了下来。[/EX][EX] Be careful not to lose balance on the wet floor.| 小心不要在湿滑的地板上失去平衡。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The gymnast showed amazing balance on the balance beam.| 体操运动员在平衡木上展现了惊人的平衡感。[/EX][EX] You need to balance work and rest to stay healthy.| 你需要平衡工作和休息，才能保持健康。[/EX][EX] She balanced a book on her head and walked across the room.| 她把一本书顶在头上，穿过了房间。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] balance 作动词 “平衡” 时是及物或不及物动词，不及物时直接用（如 balance on one leg），及物时接宾语（如 balance a book），不要加介词（错误：balance on a book）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 balance 和 steady！balance 侧重 “通过调整保持平衡”；steady 侧重 “使稳定，不晃动”，如 balance on a rope /steady the table。[/ERR][ERR] balance 作名词 “平衡感” 时是不可数名词，不要加 a/an（错误：a good balance），正确是 good balance（如 She has good balance）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To place clothing, shoes, etc., on one's body; to turn on a machine or device (used in the book about getting dressed and preparing for activities)[/EN][CN] 穿上；戴上；打开（把衣服、鞋子等穿在身上；启动机器或设备，书中涉及穿衣和准备活动）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/pʊt ɒn/（英式）/pʊt ɑːn/（美式）[/PH][DU] First, she puts on white face paint. Next, she puts on big, fuzzy eyebrows.|(原文例句) 首先，她涂上白色的脸谱漆，然后戴上大大的毛茸茸的眉毛。[/DU][DU] I put on my coat and boots before going out in the snow.| 下雪天出门前，我穿上了外套和靴子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/put on.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] put on + 衣物 / 饰品 | 穿上 / 戴上……[POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She put on her favorite dress for the birthday party.| 她穿上最喜欢的裙子去参加生日派对。[/EX][EX] He put on a hat and sunglasses to protect himself from the sun.| 他戴上帽子和太阳镜，防晒。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] put on + 电器 / 设备 | 打开……[POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] Can you put on the TV? I want to watch the cartoon.| 你能打开电视吗？我想看动画片。[/EX][EX] She put on the radio and listened to music while cooking.| 她打开收音机，边做饭边听音乐。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] put on a show | 表演节目 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The children put on a show for their parents at the end of the semester.| 学期结束时，孩子们为父母表演了节目。[/EX][EX] We put on a talent show to raise money for the school library.| 我们举办了才艺表演，为学校图书馆筹款。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Put on your gloves—it's cold outside!| 戴上手套，外面很冷！[/EX][EX] He put on his backpack and walked to school.| 他背上书包，步行去上学。[/EX][EX] She put on the lights because it was getting dark.| 天变黑了，她打开了灯。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] put on 是短暂性动词短语，表示 “穿 / 戴” 的动作，不要与 wear（表示 “穿 / 戴” 的状态）混淆，如 He put on his jacket and went out.（他穿上夹克出去了）/ He is wearing a jacket today.（他今天穿了一件夹克）。[/ERR][ERR] put on 的过去式和过去分词还是 put on，不要记错成 putted on（错误），正确：She put on her shoes five minutes ago。[/ERR][ERR]“穿上衣服” 的正确表达是 put on clothes，不要说 put clothes on（虽然可理解，但不如 put on clothes 常用），且不要遗漏 on（错误：put clothes）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Covered with soft, short hair or fur; not clear or sharp (used in the book about clown costumes and soft toys)[/EN][CN] 毛茸茸的；模糊的（覆盖着柔软的短毛；不清晰的，书中涉及小丑服装和毛绒玩具）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈfʌzi/[/PH][DU] Next, she puts on big, fuzzy eyebrows.|(原文例句) 然后，她戴上大大的毛茸茸的眉毛。[/DU][DU] The little girl hugged her fuzzy teddy bear and fell asleep.| 小女孩抱着她毛茸茸的泰迪熊睡着了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/fuzzy.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] fuzzy + 名词（玩具 / 毛发 / 物体）| 毛茸茸的……；模糊的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] He bought a fuzzy rabbit toy for his little sister.| 他给妹妹买了一个毛茸茸的兔子玩具。[/EX][EX] The baby has fuzzy hair on his head.| 这个小宝宝头上长着柔软的绒毛。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] fuzzy picture/memory | 模糊的照片 / 记忆 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The old photo is fuzzy, but we can still recognize our grandparents.| 这张老照片很模糊，但我们仍然能认出祖父母。[/EX][EX] I have a fuzzy memory of my first day at school.| 我对上学第一天的记忆很模糊。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] fuzzy sweater | 毛茸茸的毛衣 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] She wore a fuzzy sweater to keep warm in the cold weather.| 寒冷的天气里，她穿了一件毛茸茸的毛衣保暖。[/EX][EX] The fuzzy sweater is made of sheep's wool.| 这件毛茸茸的毛衣是羊毛做的。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The cat's paws are fuzzy and soft to touch.| 猫的爪子毛茸茸的，摸起来很软。[/EX][EX] The fuzzy blanket feels comfortable on the couch.| 沙发上的毛茸茸毯子摸起来很舒服。[/EX][EX] The TV screen went fuzzy because of the bad signal.| 由于信号不好，电视屏幕变得模糊。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] fuzzy 是形容词，不要当作名词使用（错误：a fuzzy），正确是 a fuzzy toy（一个毛茸茸的玩具）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 fuzzy 和 fluffy！fuzzy 侧重 “短而密的绒毛，手感柔软”；fluffy 侧重 “蓬松的，像棉花一样的”，如 a fuzzy cat /a fluffy cloud。[/ERR][ERR] fuzzy 的比较级是 fuzzier，最高级是 fuzziest，不要加 more/most（错误：more fuzzy），正确：This teddy bear is fuzzier than that one。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Having small round dots on a surface; a pattern of small round dots (used in the book about clown costumes and colorful clothes)[/EN][CN] 带圆点的；圆点图案的（表面有小圆点；小圆点组成的图案，书中涉及小丑服装和彩色衣物）[/CN][POS] adj./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpɒlkə dɒt/（英式）/ˈpoʊlkə dɑːt/（美式）[/PH][DU] She puts on a polka-dot jacket and striped pants.|(原文例句) 她穿上带圆点的夹克和条纹裤子。[/DU][DU] My mom bought me a polka-dot dress for the party.| 妈妈给我买了一条带圆点的裙子去参加派对。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/polka-dot.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] polka-dot + 衣物 / 物品 | 带圆点的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The little girl wore a red polka-dot skirt to school.| 小女孩穿着红色带圆点的裙子去上学。[/EX][EX] We wrapped the gift in polka-dot paper.| 我们用带圆点的纸包装了礼物。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a polka-dot pattern | 圆点图案 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The curtains have a blue and white polka-dot pattern.| 窗帘是蓝白相间的圆点图案。[/EX][EX] She likes clothes with a polka-dot pattern because they look lively.| 她喜欢带圆点图案的衣服，因为看起来很活泼。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] polka-dot socks | 圆点袜子 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] He put on his polka-dot socks and sneakers before playing basketball.| 打篮球前，他穿上了圆点袜子和运动鞋。[/EX][EX] These polka-dot socks match my new shoes perfectly.| 这双圆点袜子和我的新鞋很配。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The clown's polka-dot jacket made all the children laugh.| 小丑带圆点的夹克让所有孩子都笑了。[/EX][EX] I saw a polka-dot umbrella in the store— it was very cute.| 我在商店里看到一把圆点雨伞，非常可爱。[/EX][EX] Her backpack has a polka-dot design on the front.| 她的书包正面有圆点图案。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] polka-dot 作形容词时，中间必须加连字符（-），不要写成 polkadot（错误）或 polka dot（错误，分开写是名词短语），正确：a polka-dot shirt。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 polka-dot 和 striped！polka-dot 是 “圆点图案的”；striped 是 “条纹图案的”，如 a polka-dot dress /a striped shirt。[/ERR][ERR] polka-dot 作名词 “圆点图案” 时，通常用复数形式 polka dots，如 The dress is covered with polka dots（这条裙子布满了圆点）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Hanging loosely or bending easily; not firm or stiff (used in the book about clown costumes and soft objects)[/EN][CN] 松软的；下垂的；易弯曲的（松散地垂着或容易弯曲；不坚硬的，书中涉及小丑服装和柔软物品）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈflɒpi/（英式）/ˈflɑːpi/（美式）[/PH][DU] And she puts on big, floppy shoes.|(原文例句) 然后她穿上大大的松软鞋子。[/DU][DU] The puppy has floppy ears that hang down to its cheeks.| 这只小狗有松软的耳朵，垂到脸颊上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/floppy.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] floppy + 名词（鞋子 / 耳朵 / 毛发）| 松软的……；下垂的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] She wore floppy sandals to the beach because they are comfortable.| 她穿了松软的凉鞋去海滩，因为很舒服。[/EX][EX] The old teddy bear has floppy arms and legs.| 这只旧泰迪熊的胳膊和腿都很松软。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] floppy hair | 松软的头发 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Her floppy hair fell over her shoulders as she read the book.| 她看书时，松软的头发垂落在肩膀上。[/EX][EX] He has curly floppy hair that looks very cute.| 他有一头卷曲的松软头发，看起来很可爱。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] floppy hat | 宽边软帽 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] She put on a floppy straw hat to protect her face from the sun.| 她戴上宽边软草帽，保护脸不被太阳晒。[/EX][EX] The floppy hat kept the rain off her head.| 宽边软帽挡住了她头上的雨。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The flowers in the vase are floppy because they haven't been watered.| 花瓶里的花因为没浇水而枯萎下垂了。[/EX][EX] These floppy socks are perfect for wearing around the house.| 这双松软的袜子很适合在家穿。[/EX][EX] The clown's floppy shoes made a funny sound when he walked.| 小丑的松软鞋子走路时发出了有趣的声音。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] floppy 是形容词，不要当作名词使用（错误：a floppy），正确是 a floppy hat（一顶宽边软帽）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 floppy 和 soft！floppy 侧重 “松软且下垂、易弯曲”；soft 侧重 “质地柔软，不坚硬”，如 floppy ears /soft fur。[/ERR][ERR] floppy 的比较级是 floppier，最高级是 floppiest，不要加 more/most（错误：more floppy），正确：This toy rabbit's ears are floppier than that one。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A way that a person or thing moves or faces; instructions on how to do something (used in the book about following steps and finding places)[/EN][CN] 方向；指示；说明（人或物体移动或面对的方向；做某事的步骤说明，书中涉及遵循步骤和寻找地点）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/dəˈrekʃn/[/PH][DU] Why is it important to follow directions?|(原文例句) 遵循指示为什么很重要？[/DU][DU] The teacher gave us clear directions on how to finish the project.| 老师给了我们明确的指示，告诉我们如何完成项目。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/direction1.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] follow directions | 遵循指示 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] You must follow the directions on the medicine bottle carefully.| 你必须仔细遵循药瓶上的说明。[/EX][EX] The students who follow directions can finish the task quickly.| 遵循指示的学生能快速完成任务。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] in the direction of | 朝…… 方向 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We walked in the direction of the park after dinner.| 晚饭后，我们朝公园的方向走去。[/EX][EX] The bird flew in the direction of the sun.| 小鸟朝着太阳的方向飞去。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] give directions | 给出指示 / 指路 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Can you give me directions to the nearest library?| 你能告诉我去最近的图书馆怎么走吗？[/EX][EX] She gave clear directions on how to bake the cake.| 她详细说明了如何烤蛋糕。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The map shows the directions of north, south, east, and west.| 地图上标有东、南、西、北四个方向。[/EX][EX] I asked a stranger for directions when I got lost.| 我迷路时向一个陌生人问了路。[/EX][EX] Read the directions before using the new machine.| 使用新机器前，请阅读说明书。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] direction 作 “指示、说明” 时是可数名词，常用复数形式 directions，不要用单数（错误：follow the direction），正确：follow the directions。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 direction 和 instruction！direction 侧重 “行动的方向或简单指示”；instruction 侧重 “详细的操作说明或命令”，如 ask for directions（问路）/follow the instructions（遵循操作说明）。[/ERR][ERR]“朝…… 方向” 的正确表达是 in the direction of，不要用 to the direction of（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long, narrow space that connects two places; a short section of a book, speech, or piece of writing (used in the book about tunnels and reading comprehension)[/EN][CN] 通道；走廊；（文章、演讲等的）段落（连接两个地方的狭长空间；书籍、演讲或文章的短节，书中涉及隧道和阅读理解）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpæsɪdʒ/[/PH][DU] Tunnels are long, narrow, covered passages.|(原文例句) 隧道是长长的、狭窄的、有遮盖的通道。[/DU][DU] The teacher asked us to read the third passage and answer the questions.| 老师让我们读第三段并回答问题。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/passage.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] underground passage | 地下通道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We walked through an underground passage to cross the busy street.| 我们穿过地下通道，穿过繁忙的街道。[/EX][EX] The underground passage is safe and dry even on rainy days.| 即使在下雨天，地下通道也安全干燥。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a passage from a book | 书中的一段文字 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher read a passage from her favorite novel to the class.| 老师给全班同学读了她最喜欢的小说中的一段。[/EX][EX] I highlighted an interesting passage in the textbook.| 我在课本中划出了一段有趣的文字。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] narrow passage | 狭窄的通道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The narrow passage between the two buildings leads to a small garden.| 两栋楼之间的狭窄通道通向一个小花园。[/EX][EX] We had to walk single file through the narrow passage.| 我们不得不排成一列穿过狭窄的通道。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The old castle has many secret passages that few people know about.| 这座老城堡有许多秘密通道，很少有人知道。[/EX][EX] Can you find the passage that talks about climate change in the article?| 你能在文章中找到谈论气候变化的段落吗？[/EX][EX] The passage of time makes us grow older and wiser.| 时间的流逝让我们变得更成熟、更聪明。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] passage 是可数名词，“一个通道 / 段落” 用 a passage，“多个通道 / 段落” 用 passages，不要说 many passage（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 passage 和 path！passage 侧重 “人工建造的狭长通道”；path 侧重 “自然形成的小路或路径”，如 an underground passage /a path in the forest。[/ERR][ERR]“一段文章” 的正确表达是 a passage from a book，不要用 a part of a book（虽然可理解，但 passage 更准确，特指文章段落）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To stop operating or working; to close a business, machine, or service completely (used in the book when subways stop running due to heavy snow)[/EN][CN] 关闭；停止运转；停业（停止运行或工作；彻底关闭企业、机器或服务，书中指地铁因大雪而停运）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/ʃʌt daʊn/[/PH][DU] Let it snow so much that the subways are shut down.|(原文例句) 让雪下得再大些，让地铁都停运吧！[/DU][DU] The factory shut down for two weeks during the holiday.| 这家工厂在假期期间停工了两周。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/shut down.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] shut down + 机器 / 服务 / 企业 | 关闭……；使…… 停运 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] They had to shut down the computer because it kept crashing.| 电脑总是死机，他们不得不把它关掉。[/EX][EX] The city shut down the bus service during the heavy storm.| 暴雨期间，这座城市暂停了公交服务。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be shut down | 被关闭；被停运 [POS] v. phr.（被动）[/POS][/H][EX] The restaurant was shut down because it didn't meet health standards.| 这家餐厅因为不符合卫生标准而被关闭了。[/EX][EX] Many schools were shut down due to the bad weather.| 由于天气恶劣，许多学校停课了。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] shut down completely | 彻底关闭 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The company decided to shut down its overseas branch completely.| 这家公司决定彻底关闭其海外分公司。[/EX][EX] Please shut down the power completely before leaving the room.| 离开房间前，请彻底关闭电源。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The app shuts down automatically if there's no activity for 10 minutes.| 如果 10 分钟内没有操作，这个应用会自动关闭。[/EX][EX] The government ordered all non-essential businesses to shut down during the emergency.| 紧急情况下，政府下令所有非必需企业停业。[/EX][EX] The old factory was shut down to protect the environment.| 为了保护环境，这家旧工厂被关闭了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] shut down 是固定短语，中间不能加介词（错误：shut down with the machine），直接接宾语即可，正确：shut down the machine。[/ERR][ERR] shut 的过去式和过去分词是 shut，不要记错成 shut down 的过去式是 shutted down（错误），正确：The subway shut down yesterday。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 shut down 和 close！shut down 侧重 “彻底停止运转（机器、服务等）”；close 侧重 “关闭（门窗、店铺等）”，如 shut down the factory /close the door。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A letter or group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning or form a new word (used in the book when Princess Prefix adds letters to words to make new ones)[/EN][CN] 前缀（加在单词开头以改变其含义或构成新词的一个或一组字母，书中指前缀公主通过添加字母创造新词）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpriːfɪks/[/PH][DU] Princess Prefix likes to change things. Add a prefix, change a meaning.|(原文例句) 前缀公主喜欢改变事物。加上一个前缀，就能改变意思。[/DU][DU] The prefix “un-” added to “happy” makes “unhappy”, which means not happy.| 在 “happy” 前加上前缀 “un-”，就变成了 “unhappy”，意思是不高兴。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/prefix.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] prefix + 介词 “to”| 前缀…… 加在…… 前 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We often add the prefix “pre-” to words to mean “before”.| 我们经常在单词前加前缀 “pre-”，表示 “在…… 之前”。[/EX][EX] The prefix “over-” can be added to “load” to make “overload”.| 前缀 “over-” 可以加在 “load” 前，构成 “overload”（超载）。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] common prefixes | 常见前缀 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Some common prefixes are “un-”, “pre-”, “over-”, and “im-”.| 一些常见的前缀有 “un-”“pre-”“over-” 和 “im-”。[/EX][EX] The prefix “im-” added to “possible” makes “impossible” (not possible).| 在 “possible” 前加前缀 “im-”，构成 “impossible”（不可能的）。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] with a prefix | 带有前缀的 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX]“Preschool” is a word with the prefix “pre-”, meaning “before school”.|“Preschool” 是一个带有前缀 “pre-” 的单词，意思是 “学前的”。[/EX][EX]“Nonsense” has the prefix “non-”, which means “not”.|“Nonsense” 带有前缀 “non-”，表示 “不”。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Can you think of another word with the prefix “un-”?| 你能再想一个带有 “un-” 前缀的单词吗？[/EX][EX] The prefix “mis-” added to “understand” makes “misunderstand” (understand wrongly).| 在 “understand” 前加前缀 “mis-”，构成 “misunderstand”（误解）。[/EX][EX] We learned three new prefixes in English class today.| 今天英语课上我们学了三个新前缀。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] prefix 是可数名词，“一个前缀” 用 a prefix，“多个前缀” 用 prefixes，不要说 many prefix（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 prefix 和 suffix！prefix 是 “前缀”，加在单词开头；suffix 是 “后缀”，加在单词结尾，如 prefix “un-” /suffix “-ful”。[/ERR][ERR] 添加前缀时不要改变原单词的拼写，错误：pre-school（正确是 preschool），un-happy（正确是 unhappy）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To put something into a vehicle, machine, or container; the amount of something that is carried or transported (used in the book when talking about loading things onto trucks or machines)[/EN][CN] 装载；装填；负载；负荷（把东西放进交通工具、机器或容器里；被搬运或运输的量，书中涉及往卡车或机器上装载物品）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ləʊd/（英式）/loʊd/（美式）[/PH][DU] Princess Prefix changes “load” to “overload” by adding a prefix.|(原文例句) 前缀公主通过加前缀，把 “load” 变成了 “overload”（超载）。[/DU][DU] We need to load the boxes onto the truck before noon.| 我们需要在中午前把箱子装上卡车。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/load.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] load sth into/onto sth | 把某物装载到某物上 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Dad helped load the luggage onto the car.| 爸爸帮忙把行李装上了车。[/EX][EX] She loaded the paper into the printer carefully.| 她小心地把纸装进打印机。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a heavy load | 沉重的负荷 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Carrying a heavy load for a long time will make you tired.| 长时间扛重物会让你很累。[/EX][EX] The truck was carrying a heavy load of vegetables.| 这辆卡车装载着沉重的蔬菜。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] load a machine | 给机器装料 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He loaded the washing machine with dirty clothes.| 他把脏衣服放进洗衣机。[/EX][EX] The worker loaded the machine with coal to keep it running.| 工人给机器加煤，让它继续运转。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The computer is loading the game—please wait a minute.| 电脑正在加载游戏，请稍等。[/EX][EX] She carried a load of books in her backpack.| 她的书包里装着一堆书。[/EX][EX] They need three people to load the furniture onto the truck.| 他们需要三个人把家具装上卡车。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] load 作动词 “装载” 时是及物动词，直接接宾语，后接 “到某处” 需加介词 into/onto，不要直接接地点（错误：load the truck with boxes），正确是 load boxes onto the truck 或 load the truck with boxes。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 load 和 unload！load 是 “装载”；unload 是 “卸载”，动作相反，如 load the ship /unload the ship。[/ERR][ERR] load 作名词 “负荷” 时是可数 / 不可数名词，表示 “一次装载的量” 用 a load，不要说 a heavy loads（错误），正确是 a heavy load。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To put too much of something into or onto a vehicle, machine, or container; too much of a load (used in the book when Princess Prefix adds the prefix “over-” to “load” to make a new word)[/EN][CN] 使超载；使过载；超载；过载（往交通工具、机器或容器里装太多东西；过多的负荷，书中指前缀公主给 “load” 加前缀 “over-” 构成新词）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˌəʊvəˈləʊd/（英式）/ˌoʊvərˈloʊd/（美式）[/PH][DU] Your load becomes an overload. Oh, Princess.|(原文例句) 你的负荷变成了超载，哦，公主。[/DU][DU] Don't overload the shelf— it might break.| 别给架子装太多东西，它可能会坏。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/overload.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] overload sth with sth | 用某物使某物超载 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] People often overload their backpacks with books at the beginning of the semester.| 学期开始时，人们经常在书包里装太多书，导致超载。[/EX][EX] Don't overload the washing machine with clothes— it won't work well.| 别往洗衣机里塞太多衣服，它会运转不好的。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] an overload of sth | 某物过多；超载 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] An overload of homework makes students feel stressed.| 过多的作业让学生感到压力很大。[/EX][EX] The truck had an overload of goods and was stopped by the police.| 这辆卡车货物超载，被警察拦下了。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] electrical overload | 电路过载 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The electrical overload caused the lights to go out.| 电路过载导致灯灭了。[/EX][EX] We need to fix the problem to avoid electrical overload.| 我们需要解决这个问题，避免电路过载。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The computer crashed because of an overload of data.| 电脑因为数据过载而崩溃了。[/EX][EX] She overloaded the table with food for the party.| 她为派对在桌子上摆满了食物，显得太多了。[/EX][EX] Overloading the bike with bags is dangerous when riding.| 骑自行车时，车筐里装太多包很危险。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] overload 作动词时是及物动词，后接宾语，不要遗漏（错误：overload with books），正确是 overload the backpack with books。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 overload 和 load！overload 强调 “过量装载”，而 load 是 “正常装载”，如 load the car /overload the car。[/ERR][ERR] overload 的名词形式是 overload（不可数）或 overloads（可数），不要写成 overloadment（错误），正确：an overload of work。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To be easy to understand; to have a clear meaning; to be logical (used in the book when talking about words that have a clear meaning before adding a prefix)[/EN][CN] 讲得通；有意义；合乎逻辑（容易理解；有明确含义；符合逻辑，书中指加前缀前有明确含义的单词）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/meɪk sens/[/PH][DU] What makes sense becomes nonsense. Oh, Princess.|(原文例句) 有意义的东西变成了无意义的胡言，哦，公主。[/DU][DU] Your explanation doesn't make sense— can you say it again?| 你的解释讲不通，你能再说一遍吗？[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/makesense.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] make sense | 讲得通；有意义 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] This sentence makes sense— everyone can understand it.| 这个句子讲得通，每个人都能理解。[/EX][EX] It doesn't make sense to wear a coat in summer.| 夏天穿外套是不合情理的。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] make sense to sb | 对某人来说讲得通 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The math problem makes sense to me now.| 这道数学题现在我能理解了。[/EX][EX] His idea makes sense to most of the students.| 他的想法对大多数学生来说是有道理的。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] make sense of sth | 理解某物；弄明白某物 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] I can't make sense of this note— it's too messy.| 我看不懂这张便条，太乱了。[/EX][EX] She helped me make sense of the difficult story.| 她帮我弄明白了这个难懂的故事。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Does this plan make sense to you?| 你觉得这个计划有道理吗？[/EX][EX] The rules make sense because they keep us safe.| 这些规则是有意义的，因为它们能保护我们。[/EX][EX] I need time to make sense of all the new information.| 我需要时间来理解所有的新信息。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] make sense 是固定短语，中间不能加冠词（错误：make a sense），也不能加介词（错误：make sense with）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 make sense 和 understand！make sense 侧重 “事物本身有意义、讲得通”；understand 侧重 “人主动理解”，如 This book makes sense / I understand this book。[/ERR][ERR] make sense of sth 是固定搭配，不要漏掉 of（错误：make sense this problem），正确是 make sense of this problem。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Ideas, words, or statements that have no meaning or are not true; silly talk (used in the book when Princess Prefix changes meaningful words into meaningless ones)[/EN][CN] 胡说；废话；无意义的话或想法（没有意义或不真实的想法、话语或陈述；愚蠢的言论，书中指前缀公主把有意义的单词变成无意义的话）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈnɒnsns/（英式）/ˈnɑːnsens/（美式）[/PH][DU] What makes sense becomes nonsense. Oh, Princess.|(原文例句) 有意义的东西变成了无意义的胡言，哦，公主。[/DU][DU] Don't talk nonsense— tell me the truth about what happened.| 别胡说八道，告诉我发生了什么事的真相。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/nonsense.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] talk nonsense | 胡说八道；说废话 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy likes to talk nonsense to make his friends laugh.| 这个小男孩喜欢说废话逗朋友们笑。[/EX][EX] Stop talking nonsense and listen to the teacher.| 别胡说了，听老师讲课。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] that's nonsense | 那是胡说；那毫无意义 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] That's nonsense— cats can't fly!| 那是胡说，猫不会飞！[/EX][EX] He said he could run faster than a car— that's nonsense.| 他说他能跑得比汽车还快，那纯属胡说。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a lot of nonsense | 很多废话 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The story has a lot of nonsense, but it's very funny.| 这个故事有很多无厘头的内容，但非常有趣。[/EX][EX] She wasted time on a lot of nonsense instead of doing homework.| 她浪费时间说废话，而不是做作业。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] His explanation was full of nonsense— no one believed him.| 他的解释全是废话，没人相信他。[/EX][EX] Don't write nonsense in your homework— be serious.| 别在作业里写无意义的内容，认真点。[/EX][EX] The old man told stories that were not nonsense— they taught us lessons.| 这位老人讲的故事不是废话，它们给了我们启示。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] nonsense 是不可数名词，不要加 a/an（错误：a nonsense），也没有复数形式（错误：nonsenses）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 nonsense 和 rubbish！nonsense 侧重 “无意义的话、胡说”；rubbish 侧重 “垃圾” 或 “糟糕的东西”，如 talk nonsense /throw rubbish。[/ERR][ERR] nonsense 前可以加 much/lots of/a lot of，不要加 many（错误：many nonsense），正确：much nonsense。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A school for young children who are not yet old enough to go to primary school; relating to the time before a child starts primary school (used in the book when Princess Prefix adds the prefix “pre-” to “school”)[/EN][CN] 学前班；幼儿园；学前的（为尚未到上小学年龄的幼儿开设的学校；与孩子上小学前相关的，书中指前缀公主给 “school” 加前缀 “pre-” 构成新词）[/CN][POS] n./adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈpriːskuːl/[/PH][DU] Your school becomes a preschool. Oh, Princess.|(原文例句) 你的学校变成了学前班，哦，公主。[/DU][DU] My little sister goes to a preschool near our home.| 我的小妹妹在我们家附近的一所幼儿园上学。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/preschool.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] go to preschool | 上幼儿园；上学前班 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Most children go to preschool when they are three or four years old.| 大多数孩子在三四岁时上幼儿园。[/EX][EX] She started to go to preschool last month and made many friends.| 她上个月开始上学前班，交了很多朋友。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] preschool teacher | 学前教师；幼儿园老师 [POS] adj.+n.[/POS][/H][EX] The preschool teacher sang songs with the children.| 幼儿园老师和孩子们一起唱歌。[/EX][EX] My aunt is a kind preschool teacher— all the kids like her.| 我的姑姑是一位善良的幼儿园老师，所有孩子都喜欢她。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] preschool education | 学前教育 [POS] adj.+n.[/POS][/H][EX] Preschool education is very important for children's growth.| 学前教育对孩子的成长非常重要。[/EX][EX] Many families pay attention to preschool education for their kids.| 很多家庭都重视孩子的学前教育。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The preschool has a big playground for children to play on.| 这所幼儿园有一个大操场，供孩子们玩耍。[/EX][EX] We bought some preschool books to help her learn letters.| 我们买了一些学前读物，帮助她学习字母。[/EX][EX] Preschool children learn through playing games.| 学前儿童通过玩游戏学习。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] preschool 是可数名词（作 “学前班、幼儿园” 时），“一所幼儿园” 用 a preschool，不要写成 pre-school（错误，虽可理解但规范写法是 preschool）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 preschool 和 kindergarten！preschool 是 “学前班、幼儿园” 的统称，年龄范围更广；kindergarten 特指 “幼儿园大班”，更侧重正式的学前教育阶段，如 a preschool /a kindergarten。[/ERR][ERR] preschool 作形容词时，直接修饰名词，不要加连字符（错误：pre-school teacher），正确是 preschool teacher。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To govern or have control over a place or group of people; to be in charge of (used in the book when Momma Dog describes a fair king's authority)[/EN][CN] 统治；管辖；支配（治理或控制某个地方或人群；负责管理，书中指狗妈妈描述公正国王的权力）[/CN][POS] v. phr.[/POS][PH]/ruːl ˈəʊvə/（英式）/ruːl ˈoʊvər/（美式）[/PH][DU]“I see a fair king ruling over me.” said Momma Dog.|(原文例句)“我看见一位公正的国王在统治着我。” 狗妈妈说。[/DU][DU] The wise queen ruled over the kingdom with kindness for many years.| 这位贤明的女王以仁慈统治这个王国多年。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/rule-over.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] rule over + 地点 / 人群 | 统治 / 管辖……[POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The king ruled over a large and peaceful land.| 国王统治着一片广阔而和平的土地。[/EX][EX] For centuries, the dynasty ruled over the region.| 这个王朝统治该地区长达几个世纪。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] rule over sb/sth with + 形容词 | 以…… 方式统治某人 / 某物 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] She ruled over her family with love and patience.| 她以爱和耐心管理着家人。[/EX][EX] The leader ruled over the team with fairness and respect.| 这位领导者以公正和尊重管理着团队。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Legends say that a powerful wizard once ruled over the magical forest.| 传说一位强大的巫师曾统治着这片魔法森林。[/EX][EX] No one should rule over others without their consent.| 未经他人同意，任何人都不应支配他人。[/EX][EX] The company’s founder ruled over the business until he retired at 70.| 这家公司的创始人一直掌管着业务，直到 70 岁退休。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] rule over 是固定短语，中间不能加介词（错误：rule over with the kingdom），直接接宾语即可，正确：rule over the kingdom。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 rule over 和 govern！rule over 更侧重 “君主或权威者的统治”，语气较正式；govern 侧重 “通过法律或制度治理”，范围更广，如 rule over a country /govern a city。[/ERR][ERR] rule over 的过去式和过去分词为 ruled over，不要遗漏 ed（错误：rule overed），正确：The emperor ruled over the empire 200 years ago。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of geese (especially when they are on the ground); a noisy crowd of people (used in the book about animal group names)[/EN][CN] 一群鹅（尤指在地面上的）；一群吵闹的人（书中涉及动物群体名称）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡæɡl/[/PH][DU] A group of geese is a gaggle. A gaggle of geese stands together.|(原文例句) 一群鹅被称为 “gaggle”，一群鹅会聚集在一起。[/DU][DU] We saw a large gaggle of geese flying south for the winter.| 我们看到一大群鹅向南飞去过冬。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/gaggle.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a gaggle of + 鹅 / 人 | 一群……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A gaggle of geese wandered around the farm looking for food.| 一群鹅在农场周围闲逛找食物。[/EX][EX] A gaggle of children laughed loudly in the playground.| 一群孩子在操场上大声笑着。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] gaggle of geese | 鹅群 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The farmer fed the gaggle of geese with corn.| 农夫用玉米喂这群鹅。[/EX][EX] The gaggle of geese crossed the road slowly, making cars stop.| 这群鹅慢慢穿过马路，让车辆停了下来。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A gaggle of tourists followed the guide through the museum.| 一群游客跟着导游穿过博物馆。[/EX][EX] The gaggle of geese settled by the lake to rest for the night.| 这群鹅在湖边停下来过夜。[/EX][EX] I heard a gaggle of voices coming from the next room.| 我听到隔壁房间传来一群人的嘈杂声。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] gaggle 是可数名词，“一群鹅” 用 a gaggle of geese，不要直接说 a gaggle（错误），也不要混淆单复数（错误：a gaggle of goose）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 gaggle 和 flock！gaggle 特指 “鹅群”（尤其在地面）；flock 可指 “鸟群、羊群” 等多种动物群体，如 a gaggle of geese /a flock of birds。[/ERR][ERR] gaggle 修饰人时是 “吵闹的一群”，带有轻微贬义，不要用于正式场合描述人群（错误：a gaggle of experts），正确：a group of experts。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of certain animals or insects that live together; a country or area controlled by another country (used in the book about animal group names, referring to bats)[/EN][CN] 群体（某些共居的动物或昆虫）；殖民地（被他国控制的国家或地区，书中涉及动物群体名称，特指蝙蝠群）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkɒləni/（英式）/ˈkɑːləni/（美式）[/PH][DU] A group of bats is a colony. A colony of bats may leave its cave all at once.|(原文例句) 一群蝙蝠被称为 “colony”，一群蝙蝠可能会同时飞出洞穴。[/DU][DU] We visited a colony of penguins on the Antarctic island.| 我们在南极岛上参观了一群企鹅。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/colony.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a colony of + 蝙蝠 / 企鹅 / 蚂蚁等 | 一群……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A colony of bats lives in the old cave near the village.| 一群蝙蝠住在村庄附近的旧洞穴里。[/EX][EX] Scientists studied a colony of ants to learn about their social behavior.| 科学家研究了一群蚂蚁，了解它们的社会行为。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] animal colony | 动物群体 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The nature reserve is home to a large animal colony.| 这个自然保护区是一个大型动物群体的家园。[/EX][EX] The colony of bees worked together to build a big hive.| 这群蜜蜂一起建造了一个大蜂巢。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The colony of flamingos gathered around the lake to feed.| 一群火烈鸟聚集在湖边觅食。[/EX][EX] Many birds return to the same colony to breed every year.| 许多鸟类每年都会回到同一个群体繁殖。[/EX][EX] The former colony gained independence in 1960.| 这个前殖民地于 1960 年获得独立。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] colony 是可数名词，“一个群体” 用 a colony，“多个群体” 用 colonies，不要说 many colony（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 colony 和 group！colony 特指 “有组织的共居动物群体”；group 是 “群体” 的统称，范围更广，如 a colony of bats /a group of students。[/ERR][ERR] colony 作 “殖民地” 时，不要遗漏大写（特定殖民地名称），如 the American colonies（美洲殖民地）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of crows; the crime of killing someone intentionally (used in the book about special animal group names)[/EN][CN] 一群乌鸦；谋杀（特指一群乌鸦的特殊群体名称，书中涉及动物群体的专属叫法）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈmɜːdə(r)/（英式）/ˈmɜːrdər/（美式）[/PH][DU] A murder is a group of crows. This murder gathers at sunset.|(原文例句) 一群乌鸦被称为 “murder”，这群乌鸦会在日落时聚集。[/DU][DU] We spotted a murder of crows sitting on the roof of the old building.| 我们看到一群乌鸦停在旧建筑的屋顶上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/murder.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a murder of crows | 一群乌鸦 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A murder of crows flew over the forest, making loud calls.| 一群乌鸦飞过森林，发出响亮的叫声。[/EX][EX] The farmer chased away the murder of crows that were eating his crops.| 农夫赶走了那群偷吃庄稼的乌鸦。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] murder (犯罪含义)| 谋杀 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The police are investigating a murder that happened last night.| 警方正在调查昨晚发生的一起谋杀案。[/EX][EX] It is a crime to commit murder in any country.| 在任何国家，谋杀都是犯罪行为。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A murder of crows is often seen in urban parks looking for food.| 经常能在城市公园看到一群乌鸦找食物。[/EX][EX] The old legend says that a murder of crows brings bad luck.| 古老的传说称一群乌鸦会带来坏运气。[/EX][EX] He was arrested for the murder of his business partner.| 他因谋杀商业伙伴而被捕。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] murder 作 “一群乌鸦” 时是可数名词，仅用于乌鸦，不要用于其他动物（错误：a murder of birds），正确：a murder of crows。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 murder 的两种含义！表示 “乌鸦群” 时是特殊群体名词，无贬义；表示 “谋杀” 时是严重犯罪，语气严肃，需根据语境区分。[/ERR][ERR] murder 作 “谋杀” 时是不可数名词，表示 “一起谋杀案” 用 a murder case，不要说 a murder（虽可，但 case 更清晰）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of whales, dolphins, or seals that live and swim together (used in the book about animal group names for sea animals)[/EN][CN] 一群鲸；一群海豚；一群海豹（共同生活和游动的鲸、海豚或海豹群体，书中涉及海洋动物群体名称）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/pɒd/（英式）/pɑːd/（美式）[/PH][DU] A group of whales is a pod. A pod of whales swims together.|(原文例句) 一群鲸被称为 “pod”，一群鲸会一起游动。[/DU][DU] We watched a pod of dolphins jumping out of the water near the boat.| 我们看到一群海豚在船附近跃出水面。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pod.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a pod of + 鲸 / 海豚 / 海豹 | 一群……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A pod of humpback whales migrated thousands of miles to warm waters.| 一群座头鲸迁徙了数千英里到温暖的海域。[/EX][EX] The pod of seals rested on the ice floe in the Arctic.| 这群海豹在北极的浮冰上休息。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] whale pod/dolphin pod | 鲸群 / 海豚群 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Scientists tracked the whale pod using sound technology.| 科学家用声音技术追踪这群鲸。[/EX][EX] The dolphin pod played with each other in the calm sea.| 这群海豚在平静的海里互相嬉戏。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A pod of orcas hunted for fish in the deep ocean.| 一群虎鲸在深海捕食鱼类。[/EX][EX] The tourists took photos of the pod of dolphins swimming alongside the ship.| 游客们拍下了这群海豚跟着船游动的照片。[/EX][EX] The pod of whales communicated with each other through loud calls.| 这群鲸通过响亮的叫声互相交流。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] pod 是可数名词，“一群海豚” 用 a pod of dolphins，不要说 a pod dolphins（错误），也不要混淆单复数（错误：a pod of dolphin）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 pod 和 school！pod 特指 “鲸、海豚等海洋哺乳动物群体”；school 特指 “鱼群”，如 a pod of dolphins /a school of fish。[/ERR][ERR] pod 不能用于描述陆地上的动物群体（错误：a pod of elephants），正确：a herd of elephants。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of jellyfish; to hit something with a sharp sound (used in the book about special animal group names for sea creatures)[/EN][CN] 一群水母；啪地击打（特指一群水母的群体名称；发出尖锐声音的击打动作，书中涉及海洋生物群体名称）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/smæk/[/PH][DU] A smack is a group of jellyfish. A smack travels on ocean waves.|(原文例句) 一群水母被称为 “smack”，一群水母会随着海浪漂流。[/DU][DU] The child smacked the ball with a bat and ran to first base.| 孩子用球棒啪地击中球，然后跑向一垒。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/smack.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a smack of jellyfish | 一群水母 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We saw a smack of jellyfish floating near the beach, so we didn’t swim.| 我们看到一群水母在海滩附近漂浮，所以没去游泳。[/EX][EX] A large smack of jellyfish blocked the diver’s path.| 一大群水母挡住了潜水员的路。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] smack + 宾语 | 啪地击打……[POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She smacked her hand on the table to get everyone’s attention.| 她啪地一拍桌子，吸引了所有人的注意力。[/EX][EX] The rain smacked against the window during the storm.| 暴风雨中，雨点啪嗒啪嗒地打在窗户上。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A smack of jellyfish can be dangerous because some are poisonous.| 一群水母可能很危险，因为有些是有毒的。[/EX][EX] He smacked his lips after eating the delicious cake.| 他吃完美味的蛋糕后咂了咂嘴。[/EX][EX] The smack of jellyfish moved slowly with the ocean current.| 这群水母随着洋流缓慢移动。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] smack 作 “一群水母” 时是可数名词，仅用于水母，不要用于其他动物（错误：a smack of fish），正确：a smack of jellyfish。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 smack 的两种含义！表示 “水母群” 时是特殊群体名词；表示 “击打” 时是动词或名词，语气较口语化，如 a smack of jellyfish /a smack on the face。[/ERR][ERR] smack 作动词 “击打” 时是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：smack on the table），正确：smack the table（但 “打在脸上” 用 smack sb in the face）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A large group of animals that live and move together, especially cattle, zebras, or elephants (used in the book about animal groups and African savanna animals)[/EN][CN] 兽群（尤指牛、斑马、大象等一起生活和移动的大型动物群体，书中涉及动物群体和非洲稀树草原动物）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/hɜːd/（英式）/hɜːrd/（美式）[/PH][DU] A group of zebras is a herd. Sometimes a herd races together.|(原文例句) 一群斑马被称为 “herd”，有时一群斑马会一起奔跑。[/DU][DU] A herd of cattle grazed on the grassland under the sun.| 一群牛在阳光下的草地上吃草。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/herd.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a herd of + 牛 / 斑马 / 大象等 | 一群……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We drove through a herd of wildebeest during our safari in Africa.| 我们在非洲狩猎旅行时，开车穿过了一群角马。[/EX][EX] A herd of elephants crossed the river to find water.| 一群大象过河找水喝。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] herd + 动物 | 驱赶兽群 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The farmer herded the cows into the barn before the storm.| 农夫在暴风雨前把牛赶进了牛棚。[/EX][EX] The cowboys herded the cattle across the plain.| 牛仔们赶着牛群穿过平原。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A herd of deer ran into the forest when they heard the noise.| 一群鹿听到响声后跑进了森林。[/EX][EX] The herd of sheep followed the shepherd to a new pasture.| 这群羊跟着牧羊人去了新的牧场。[/EX][EX] It’s amazing to see a large herd of animals moving together in the wild.| 在野外看到一大群动物一起移动真是令人惊叹。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] herd 作 “兽群” 时是可数名词，“一群斑马” 用 a herd of zebras，不要说 a herd zebra（错误），也不要用于鸟类（错误：a herd of birds）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 herd 和 flock！herd 用于 “大型陆地哺乳动物群”；flock 用于 “鸟类、羊群”，如 a herd of elephants /a flock of sheep。[/ERR][ERR] herd 作动词 “驱赶” 时，不要遗漏宾语（错误：herd into the barn），正确：herd the cows into the barn。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A group of wild animals, especially wolves or dogs, that hunt together; to put things into a bag or container (used in the book about animal groups and African watering hole animals)[/EN][CN] 兽群（尤指一起狩猎的狼、狗等野生动物群体）；打包；装箱（将物品放入袋子或容器中，书中涉及动物群体和非洲水坑边的动物）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/pæk/[/PH][DU] A pack is a group of wolves. A pack works together to hunt.|(原文例句) 一群狼被称为 “pack”，一群狼会一起合作狩猎。[/DU][DU] I need to pack my suitcase before the trip tomorrow.| 我明天旅行前需要收拾行李。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pack.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a pack of + 狼 / 狗 / 狐狸等 | 一群……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A pack of wolves howled at the moon in the quiet night.| 一群狼在寂静的夜晚对着月亮嚎叫。[/EX][EX] We saw a small pack of wild dogs chasing a rabbit.| 我们看到一小群野狗在追一只兔子。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] pack + 物品 | 打包……[POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She packed some snacks and water for the picnic.| 她为野餐打包了一些零食和水。[/EX][EX] He packed his books into a box when moving house.| 搬家时，他把书装进了箱子里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] pack up | 收拾行李；打包 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] We need to pack up and leave before noon.| 我们需要在中午前收拾好离开。[/EX][EX] She packed up her toys after playing with her friends.| 和朋友们玩完后，她收拾好了玩具。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A pack of hyenas waited nearby for the lions to finish eating.| 一群鬣狗在附近等着狮子吃完东西。[/EX][EX] The hiker packed a tent and sleeping bag for the camping trip.| 徒步旅行者为露营旅行打包了帐篷和睡袋。[/EX][EX] The pack of wolves worked together to take down a deer.| 这群狼一起合作捕获了一只鹿。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] pack 作 “兽群” 时是可数名词，“一群狼” 用 a pack of wolves，不要说 a pack wolf（错误），也不要用于大型哺乳动物（错误：a pack of elephants）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 pack 和 herd！pack 用于 “狼、狗等小型群居狩猎动物”；herd 用于 “牛、大象等大型食草动物”，如 a pack of wolves /a herd of cows。[/ERR][ERR] pack 作动词 “打包” 时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：pack into the suitcase），正确：pack clothes into the suitcase。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A sport where people climb up, down, or across rocks or artificial climbing walls; a fun activity that needs strength and courage (used in the book about outdoor sports and safety)[/EN][CN] 攀岩（一种在岩石或人工岩壁上向上、向下或横向攀爬的运动；一项需要力量和勇气的有趣活动，书中涉及户外运动和安全知识）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/rɒk ˈklaɪmɪŋ/（英式）/rɑːk ˈklaɪmɪŋ/（美式）[/PH][DU] Rock climbing is fun. You can climb with friends and family.|(原文例句) 攀岩很有趣，你可以和朋友、家人一起攀爬。[/DU][DU] We went rock climbing at the outdoor center last weekend.| 上周末我们去户外中心攀岩了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/rock climbing.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] go rock climbing | 去攀岩 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He goes rock climbing every Saturday to exercise.| 他每周六都去攀岩锻炼。[/EX][EX] We plan to go rock climbing in the mountains next month.| 我们计划下个月去山里攀岩。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] rock climbing + 地点 | 在…… 攀岩 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Rock climbing on cliffs needs professional equipment.| 在悬崖上攀岩需要专业装备。[/EX][EX] She likes rock climbing on indoor walls because it’s safer.| 她喜欢在室内岩壁上攀岩，因为更安全。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] rock climbing safety | 攀岩安全 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher taught us rock climbing safety rules before we started.| 开始前，老师教了我们攀岩安全规则。[/EX][EX] Wearing a helmet is important for rock climbing safety.| 戴头盔对攀岩安全很重要。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Rock climbing helps improve strength and balance.| 攀岩有助于增强力量和平衡感。[/EX][EX] My brother is good at rock climbing—he can climb very fast.| 我哥哥擅长攀岩，他能爬得很快。[/EX][EX] We need to learn basic skills before trying rock climbing.| 尝试攀岩前，我们需要学习基本技巧。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] rock climbing 是不可数名词，表示 “一次攀岩活动” 用 a rock climbing trip，不要说 a rock climbing（错误），也不要分开写（错误：rock climb）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 rock climbing 和 climb rocks！rock climbing 是正式的 “攀岩运动”；climb rocks 是 “爬石头” 的普通动作，如 go rock climbing /climb rocks by the river。[/ERR][ERR]“攀岩装备” 的正确表达是 rock climbing equipment，不要说 rock climbing tools（错误，tools 特指工具，equipment 泛指装备）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Willing to face danger, pain, or difficulty without fear; having courage (used in the book about rock climbing and brave animals like mongooses)[/EN][CN] 勇敢的；无畏的（愿意无惧地面对危险、痛苦或困难；有勇气的，书中涉及攀岩和 mongoose 等勇敢的动物）[/CN][POS] adj./v.[/POS][PH]/breɪv/[/PH][DU] When you get to the top, you can feel strong and brave.|(原文例句) 当你爬到顶端时，你会感觉自己既强壮又勇敢。[/DU][DU] The little girl was brave enough to help the lost puppy find its way home.| 这个小女孩很勇敢，帮助迷路的小狗找到了家。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/brave.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] brave + 名词 | 勇敢的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] He is a brave firefighter who saves people from fires.| 他是一位勇敢的消防员，从火中救人。[/EX][EX] The brave soldier protected his teammates during the mission.| 这位勇敢的士兵在任务中保护了队友。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be brave enough to do sth | 足够勇敢做某事 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] She is brave enough to speak in front of a large crowd.| 她足够勇敢，能在一大群人面前说话。[/EX][EX] He was brave enough to try rock climbing for the first time.| 他足够勇敢，第一次尝试了攀岩。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] brave the storm/danger | 冒着风暴 / 危险 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] They braved the heavy rain to help the old man cross the road.| 他们冒着大雨帮助老人过马路。[/EX][EX] The hikers braved the cold to reach the top of the mountain.| 徒步旅行者们冒着寒冷登上了山顶。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] It’s brave of you to tell the truth to the teacher.| 你敢把真相告诉老师，真勇敢。[/EX][EX] The brave mongoose fights snakes to protect its family.| 勇敢的猫鼬会为了保护家人而与蛇搏斗。[/EX][EX] She felt brave after finishing the difficult rock climbing route.| 完成那条艰难的攀岩路线后，她感觉自己很勇敢。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] brave 是形容词，不要当作名词使用（错误：a brave），正确是 a brave boy（一个勇敢的男孩）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 brave 和 courageous！brave 是常用词，指 “面对危险不害怕”；courageous 更正式，指 “有坚定的勇气”，如 a brave child /a courageous decision。[/ERR][ERR] brave 的比较级是 braver，最高级是 bravest，不要加 more/most（错误：more brave），正确：She is braver than her brother。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long, narrow wooden or plastic sled without runners, used for sliding down snow-covered hills; to ride on a toboggan (used in the book about winter sleds and snow activities)[/EN][CN] 平底雪橇（一种无滑板的长而窄的木制或塑料雪橇，用于从积雪的山坡上滑下）；乘平底雪橇（书中涉及冬季雪橇和雪地活动）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/təˈbɒɡən/（英式）/təˈbɑːɡən/（美式）[/PH][DU] This sled is long and wooden. It glides quickly on the snow. It’s a toboggan.|(原文例句) 这种雪橇又长又木，在雪上滑得很快，它就是平底雪橇。[/DU][DU] We went tobogganing down the hill behind the park.| 我们去公园后面的山坡上乘平底雪橇滑雪了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/toboggan.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] ride a toboggan | 乘平底雪橇 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The children laughed as they rode the toboggan down the snow hill.| 孩子们乘平底雪橇滑下雪山时，笑得很开心。[/EX][EX] We borrowed a toboggan from the ski resort to play in the snow.| 我们从滑雪场借了一个平底雪橇在雪地里玩。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] toboggan down + 地点 | 从…… 乘平底雪橇滑下 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] They tobogganed down the steep hill again and again.| 他们一次又一次地从陡峭的山坡上乘平底雪橇滑下。[/EX][EX] We tobogganed down the gentle slope because it’s safer for kids.| 我们从缓坡上乘平底雪橇滑下，因为对孩子来说更安全。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] wooden/plastic toboggan | 木制 / 塑料平底雪橇 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The wooden toboggan has been in our family for many years.| 这个木制平底雪橇在我们家已经很多年了。[/EX][EX] The plastic toboggan is lighter and easier to carry.| 这个塑料平底雪橇更轻，也更容易携带。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] We built a snow ramp to make the toboggan go faster.| 我们堆了一个雪坡，让平底雪橇滑得更快。[/EX][EX] Tobogganing is a popular winter activity in cold countries.| 乘平底雪橇是寒冷国家流行的冬季活动。[/EX][EX] The kids decorated their toboggan with colorful stickers.| 孩子们用彩色贴纸装饰了他们的平底雪橇。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] toboggan 作 “平底雪橇” 时是可数名词，“一个平底雪橇” 用 a toboggan，不要说 a toboggan sled（重复，错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 toboggan 和 bobsled！toboggan 是 “无滑板的平底雪橇”，适合休闲；bobsled 是 “有滑板的四人雪橇”，用于专业比赛，如 ride a toboggan /ride a bobsled。[/ERR][ERR] toboggan 作动词时，常用 - ing 形式 tobogganing（乘平底雪橇），不要说 go toboggan（错误），正确：go tobogganing。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A circular inflatable tube, originally part of a tire, used as a sled for sliding down snow hills or as a float in water (used in the book about fun sleds for winter activities)[/EN][CN] 内胎；充气滑圈（一种圆形充气橡胶管，原是轮胎的一部分，用作雪地滑行的雪橇或水中漂浮的浮圈，书中涉及冬季活动的趣味雪橇）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɪnə tjuːb/（英式）/ˈɪnər tuːb/（美式）[/PH][DU] This sled is filled with air. Spinning down a hill is fun. It’s an inner tube.|(原文例句) 这种雪橇是充气的，从山坡上旋转滑下很有趣，它就是充气滑圈。[/DU][DU] We used an inner tube to slide down the snow hill in the park.| 我们用充气滑圈在公园的雪山上滑行。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/inner tube.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] ride an inner tube | 乘充气滑圈 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The kids had a great time riding inner tubes down the snow slope.| 孩子们乘充气滑圈从雪坡上滑下，玩得很开心。[/EX][EX] We rented inner tubes at the water park to float in the pool.| 我们在水上公园租了充气滑圈，在泳池里漂浮。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] inner tube + 用途 | 用于…… 的充气滑圈 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] a snow inner tube | 雪地充气滑圈 [/EX][EX] a water inner tube | 水上充气滑圈 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] blow up an inner tube | 给充气滑圈充气 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Dad helped blow up the inner tube before we went to the snow hill.| 去雪山前，爸爸帮我们给充气滑圈充了气。[/EX][EX] You need to blow up the inner tube carefully to avoid breaking it.| 你需要小心给充气滑圈充气，避免弄破它。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The inner tube spun quickly as it slid down the steep snow hill.| 充气滑圈从陡峭的雪坡上滑下时，旋转得很快。[/EX][EX] We tied two inner tubes together to slide down the hill with friends.| 我们把两个充气滑圈绑在一起，和朋友们一起滑下山。[/EX][EX] The inner tube is safe for kids because it’s soft and inflatable.| 充气滑圈对孩子来说很安全，因为它柔软且是充气的。[/EX]
