[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] inner tube 是可数名词，中间必须加空格（错误：innertube），“一个充气滑圈” 用 an inner tube（元音音素开头），不要说 a inner tube（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 inner tube 和 toboggan！inner tube 是 “充气的圆形滑圈”，适合旋转滑行；toboggan 是 “长条形的木制 / 塑料雪橇”，适合快速滑行，如 ride an inner tube /ride a toboggan。[/ERR][ERR]“给充气滑圈充气” 的正确表达是 blow up an inner tube，不要说 fill air into an inner tube（虽可理解，但不常用）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long, narrow sled with a steering mechanism and runners, designed for racing down icy tracks with teams of two or four people; to ride or race in a bobsled (used in the book about sport sleds and winter competitions)[/EN][CN] 有舵雪橇；雪车（一种长而窄的雪橇，带有转向装置和滑板，专为 2 人或 4 人团队在冰道上比赛而设计）；乘有舵雪橇比赛（书中涉及运动型雪橇和冬季竞赛）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈbɒbsled/（英式）/ˈbɑːbsled/（美式）[/PH][DU] This sled holds four people. Riders steer around sharp bends. It’s a bobsled.|(原文例句) 这种雪橇能容纳四个人，骑手们会绕着急弯转向，它就是有舵雪橇。[/DU][DU] The team trained hard to compete in the bobsled race at the Winter Olympics.| 这支队伍刻苦训练，参加冬奥会的有舵雪橇比赛。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/bobsled.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] ride a bobsled | 乘有舵雪橇 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We watched athletes ride the bobsled down the icy track at high speed.| 我们观看了运动员们乘有舵雪橇在冰道上高速滑行。[/EX][EX] It’s exciting to ride a bobsled, but it needs team work.| 乘有舵雪橇很刺激，但需要团队合作。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] bobsled race | 有舵雪橇比赛 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The bobsled race will be held at the new icy track next month.| 有舵雪橇比赛将于下个月在新建的冰道上举行。[/EX][EX] Their team won the gold medal in the bobsled race.| 他们的队伍在有舵雪橇比赛中获得了金牌。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] bobsled team | 有舵雪橇队 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The bobsled team practiced together every day to improve their speed.| 有舵雪橇队每天一起训练，提高速度。[/EX][EX] She is the captain of the national bobsled team.| 她是国家有舵雪橇队的队长。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The bobsled can reach speeds of over 100 kilometers per hour.| 有舵雪橇的速度能超过每小时 100 公里。[/EX][EX] The athletes wore special suits and helmets for the bobsled race.| 运动员们为有舵雪橇比赛穿上了特制的服装和头盔。[/EX][EX] Building a bobsled track is very expensive because it needs to be icy and smooth.| 建造有舵雪橇冰道非常昂贵，因为它需要结冰且光滑。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] bobsled 是可数名词，“一个有舵雪橇” 用 a bobsled，不要说 a bobsled sled（重复，错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 bobsled 和 luge！bobsled 是 “有舵、有座位的团队雪橇”；luge 是 “无舵、俯卧式的单人雪橇”，如 a bobsled team /a luge athlete。[/ERR][ERR] bobsled 作动词时，常用 - ing 形式 bobsledding（乘有舵雪橇比赛），不要说 go bobsled（错误），正确：go bobsledding。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To control the direction of a vehicle, sled, or boat by turning a wheel, handlebars, or other device; to guide something in a particular direction (used in the book about bobsleds and steering around turns)[/EN][CN] 驾驶；掌舵；引导（通过转动轮子、车把或其他装置控制车辆、雪橇或船的方向；引导某物向特定方向移动，书中涉及有舵雪橇和转弯时的转向）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/stɪə(r)/（英式）/stɪr/（美式）[/PH][DU] Riders steer around sharp bends on the bobsled track.|(原文例句) 骑手们在有舵雪橇冰道上绕着急弯转向。[/DU][DU] He learned how to steer a bike when he was five years old.| 他五岁时学会了骑自行车。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/steer.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] steer + 交通工具 | 驾驶……[POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She steered the bobsled carefully around the sharp bend.| 她小心地驾驶有舵雪橇绕过急弯。[/EX][EX] Dad steered the boat toward the shore as the sun set.| 太阳下山时，爸爸把船驶向岸边。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] steer + 方向 | 朝…… 方向行驶 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The driver steered the car to the left to avoid hitting the dog.| 司机把车向左打方向，避免撞到狗。[/EX][EX] We need to steer the conversation back to the main topic.| 我们需要把话题引导回正题。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] steer clear of | 避开；远离 [POS] v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] Steer clear of the icy road— it’s very dangerous.| 远离结冰的道路，非常危险。[/EX][EX] You should steer clear of bad habits like staying up late.| 你应该远离熬夜这样的坏习惯。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The captain steered the ship through the storm safely.| 船长安全地驾驶船穿过了暴风雨。[/EX][EX] He steered his skateboard around the rocks in the park.| 他驾驶滑板绕过了公园里的石头。[/EX][EX] The teacher steered the students to work together on the project.| 老师引导学生们一起完成这个项目。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] steer 是及物动词，直接接宾语（交通工具或方向），不要加介词（错误：steer on the bobsled），正确：steer the bobsled。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 steer 和 drive！steer 侧重 “控制方向”；drive 侧重 “整体驾驶动作”，如 steer the car around a bend /drive the car to school。[/ERR][ERR] steer 的过去式和过去分词是 steered，不要记错成 steared（错误），正确：She steered the boat to safety yesterday。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A turn or curve that changes direction quickly and sharply; a sudden bend in a road, track, or path (used in the book about bobsled tracks and navigating turns)[/EN][CN] 急弯；急转弯（快速且急剧改变方向的转弯；道路、轨道或小径上的突然转弯，书中涉及有舵雪橇冰道和转弯行驶）[/CN][POS] n. phr.[/POS][PH]/ʃɑːp bend/（英式）/ʃɑːrp bend/（美式）[/PH][DU] Riders steer around sharp bends on the bobsled track.|(原文例句) 骑手们在有舵雪橇冰道上绕着急弯转向。[/DU][DU] We slowed down the car when we saw the sharp bend ahead.| 看到前面的急弯，我们放慢了车速。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/sharp bend.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] around a sharp bend | 绕过急弯 [POS] n. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The bobsled raced around the sharp bend at high speed.| 有舵雪橇高速绕过急弯。[/EX][EX] The cyclist carefully rode around the sharp bend on the mountain road.| 自行车手小心翼翼地骑过山路的急弯。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a sharp bend in + 道路 / 轨道 |…… 上的急弯 [POS] n. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] There is a sharp bend in the road ahead— be careful.| 前面的路上有一个急弯，小心点。[/EX][EX] The sharp bend in the bobsled track is the most difficult part.| 有舵雪橇冰道上的急弯是最困难的部分。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] take a sharp bend | 拐急弯 [POS] n. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The car took a sharp bend to the right and disappeared around the hill.| 汽车向右拐了一个急弯，消失在山后。[/EX][EX] The train slowed down before taking the sharp bend.| 火车在拐急弯前放慢了速度。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The sign warns drivers of a sharp bend ahead.| 这个标志警告司机前面有急弯。[/EX][EX] We had to walk carefully around the sharp bend on the narrow path.| 我们必须小心翼翼地走过狭窄小径上的急弯。[/EX][EX] The athlete practiced many times to master the sharp bend on the track.| 这位运动员练习了很多次，以熟练掌握轨道上的急弯。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] sharp bend 是可数名词短语，“一个急弯” 用 a sharp bend，不要说 sharp bend（错误），也不要混淆 sharp 和 sudden（错误：sudden bend，虽可理解，但 sharp 更侧重 “角度小的急弯”）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 sharp bend 和 gentle bend！sharp bend 是 “急弯”，角度小；gentle bend 是 “缓弯”，角度大，如 a sharp bend in the road /a gentle bend in the river。[/ERR][ERR]“在急弯处” 的正确表达是 at a sharp bend，不要说 in a sharp bend（错误），正确：The accident happened at a sharp bend。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] One after another without interruption; consecutively (used in the book when rain keeps Andy inside for three consecutive days)[/EN][CN] 连续地；一连串地（一个接一个没有中断；连续发生，书中指雨水连续三天把安迪困在室内）[/CN][POS] adv. phr.[/POS][PH]/ɪn ə rəʊ/（英式）/ɪn ə roʊ/（美式）[/PH][DU] Andy wanted to play outside. Rain kept him inside for three days in a row.|(原文例句) 安迪想出去玩，但雨水连续三天把他困在了家里。[/DU][DU] She won the singing competition three times in a row.| 她连续三次赢得歌唱比赛。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/in a row.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] for + 数字 + days/weeks/times + in a row | 连续…… 天 / 周 / 次 [POS] adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] It rained for five days in a row, so the playground was muddy.| 连续下了五天雨，操场变得泥泞不堪。[/EX][EX] He has been late for school twice in a row.| 他已经连续两次上学迟到了。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] do sth in a row | 连续做某事 [POS] adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX] The little boy read ten picture books in a row without stopping.| 这个小男孩一口气连续读了十本绘本。[/EX][EX] They watched three movies in a row on weekends.| 他们周末连续看了三部电影。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The team won six games in a row and became the champion.| 这支队伍连续赢了六场比赛，成为了冠军。[/EX][EX] I haven’t eaten breakfast for two days in a row— that’s not healthy.| 我已经连续两天没吃早饭了，这很不健康。[/EX][EX] The temperature stayed above 30 degrees Celsius for a week in a row.| 气温连续一周保持在 30 摄氏度以上。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] in a row 是固定短语，中间不能加其他词（错误：in three days a row，语序错误），正确语序是 for three days in a row。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 in a row 和 one after another！in a row 强调 “连续无中断”，语气更正式；one after another 强调 “一个接一个”，更口语化，如 three days in a row /three days one after another（均可，但语境正式度不同）。[/ERR][ERR] 表示 “连续几次” 时，不能漏掉 in（错误：three times a row），正确是 three times in a row。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Plants grown in large quantities on a farm, such as wheat, rice, or vegetables; to cut or trim something to a desired shape (used in the book when talking about farmers needing rain for their plants)[/EN][CN] 庄稼；农作物；修剪（农场大面积种植的植物，如小麦、水稻或蔬菜；将某物切割或修剪成想要的形状，书中指农民需要雨水灌溉农作物）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/krɒp/（英式）/krɑːp/（美式）[/PH][DU]“Farmers need rain to grow their crops,” the cloud said.|(原文例句)“农民需要雨水来种植庄稼，” 云朵说。[/DU][DU] The farmers harvested the corn crop before the storm came.| 农民们在暴风雨来临前收割了玉米作物。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/crop.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] grow crops | 种植庄稼 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Many families in the village grow crops to make a living.| 村里很多家庭靠种植庄稼谋生。[/EX][EX] They grow different crops every year to keep the soil healthy.| 他们每年种植不同的作物，以保持土壤肥沃。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] harvest crops | 收割庄稼 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] It’s time to harvest the rice crops— everyone in the village is busy.| 是时候收割水稻了，村里每个人都很忙。[/EX][EX] The machine helps farmers harvest crops more efficiently.| 这台机器帮助农民更高效地收割庄稼。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] crop + 名词（作物种类）|…… 作物 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] wheat crop 小麦作物 [/EX][EX] vegetable crop 蔬菜作物 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] crop sth（修剪）| 修剪某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She cropped her hair short for the summer.| 她夏天把头发剪短了。[/EX][EX] The gardener cropped the bushes into round shapes.| 园丁把灌木丛修剪成了圆形。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The dry weather damaged most of the crops in the field.| 干旱天气损坏了田里的大部分庄稼。[/EX][EX] They planted a new crop of tomatoes in the greenhouse.| 他们在温室里种了一茬新的西红柿。[/EX][EX] He cropped the photo to focus on the main subject.| 他裁剪了照片，突出主要人物。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] crop 作 “庄稼” 时是可数 / 不可数名词，表示 “一种作物” 用 a crop，“多种作物” 用 crops，不要说 many crop（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 crop 和 plant！crop 特指 “农田里种植的农作物”；plant 是 “植物” 的统称，范围更广，如 wheat crop /a plant in the garden。[/ERR][ERR] crop 作动词 “修剪” 时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：crop on the hair），正确：crop the hair。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A wall built across a river to hold back water and form a reservoir; to block or restrict the flow of something (used in the book when talking about dams needing rain to make power)[/EN][CN] 水坝；堤坝；筑坝拦水（横跨河流建造的墙，用于阻挡水流形成水库；阻挡或限制某物的流动，书中指水坝需要雨水来发电）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/dæm/[/PH][DU]“Dams need rain to make power,” the cloud said.|(原文例句)“水坝需要雨水来发电，” 云朵说。[/DU][DU] The big dam on the river provides water for the whole city.| 这条河上的大水坝为整个城市提供水源。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/dam.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] build a dam | 建造水坝 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The government decided to build a dam to prevent floods.| 政府决定建造一座水坝来防洪。[/EX][EX]It took five years to build the large dam across the river.| 建造这座横跨河流的大水坝花了五年时间。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] dam + 河流名称 |…… 河上的水坝 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] the Three Gorges Dam 三峡大坝 [/EX][EX] the dam on the Yellow River 黄河上的水坝 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] dam up sth（筑坝拦挡）| 阻挡某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX]They dammed up the small river to make a lake for fishing.| 他们筑坝拦挡了这条小河，形成了一个钓鱼用的湖。[/EX][EX] The rocks dammed up the flow of the stream.| 岩石阻挡了小溪的水流。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The dam stores water in winter for use in summer.| 水坝在冬天储存水，供夏天使用。[/EX][EX] Engineers check the dam every year to ensure safety.| 工程师每年都会检查水坝，以确保安全。[/EX][EX] The heavy rain filled the dam to its maximum capacity.| 暴雨使水坝的水位达到了最大容量。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] dam 作 “水坝” 时是可数名词，“一座水坝” 用 a dam，不要说 dam（单独使用错误，需加冠词或限定词）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 dam 和 reservoir！dam 是 “水坝（建筑物）”；reservoir 是 “水库（蓄水的区域）”，如 build a dam /a large reservoir。[/ERR][ERR] dam 作动词时，常用短语 dam up，不要遗漏 up（错误：dam the river），正确：dam up the river（虽可省略 up，但 up 更强调 “拦挡” 的动作）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A routine task that is done regularly, especially a household duty (used in the book when Abby has to do household tasks like cleaning her room)[/EN][CN] 日常琐事；家务杂活（定期做的常规任务，尤指家务事，书中指艾比要做打扫房间等家务）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/tʃɔː(r)/（英式）/tʃɔːr/（美式）[/PH][DU]“I have chores to do,” says Abby.|(原文例句)“我有家务要做，” 艾比说。[/DU][DU] Washing dishes is one of my daily chores.| 洗碗是我每天的家务之一。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/chore.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] do chores | 做家务；做杂活 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She helps her mom do chores after school every day.| 她每天放学后帮妈妈做家务。[/EX][EX] My brother hates doing chores, but he has to.| 我弟弟讨厌做家务，但他不得不做。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] household chores | 家务杂活 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We divide household chores between family members.| 我们在家庭成员之间分配家务杂活。[/EX][EX] Cooking and cleaning are common household chores.| 做饭和打扫是常见的家务杂活。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] daily/weekly chores | 日常 / 每周杂活 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] I set aside 30 minutes every morning to do daily chores.| 我每天早上留出 30 分钟做日常杂活。[/EX][EX] Mowing the lawn is one of his weekly chores.| 修剪草坪是他每周的杂活之一。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Taking out the trash is a simple chore, but it’s important.| 倒垃圾是件简单的杂活，但很重要。[/EX][EX] The children learn to do chores to develop a sense of responsibility.| 孩子们学习做家务，以培养责任感。[/EX][EX] She finished all her chores and then went out to play.| 她做完所有家务后，就出去玩了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] chore 是可数名词，“一件杂活” 用 a chore，“多件杂活” 用 chores，不要说 many chore（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 chore 和 job！chore 特指 “重复性的家务或杂活”；job 是 “工作” 的统称，可指职业或临时任务，如 do household chores /a part-time job。[/ERR][ERR]“做家务” 的正确表达是 do chores 或 do household chores，不要说 make chores（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To act in a particular way, especially in a good or appropriate way; to conduct oneself (used in the book when asking how people should act at the movies)[/EN][CN] 表现；举止；行为得体（以特定方式行事，尤指表现好或恰当；自律行为，书中指询问人们在电影院应如何表现）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/bɪˈheɪv/[/PH][DU] How should people behave at the movies?|(原文例句) 人们在电影院应该如何表现？[/DU][DU] The children behaved well during the class trip.| 孩子们在班级旅行中表现得很好。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/behave.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] behave well/badly | 表现好 / 差 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She behaved well at the party and got praise from adults.| 她在派对上表现得很好，得到了大人们的表扬。[/EX][EX] The boy behaved badly in the restaurant and disturbed others.| 这个男孩在餐厅里表现很差，打扰了别人。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] behave oneself | 举止得体；守规矩 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Please behave yourself when we visit grandma.| 我们去看望奶奶时，你要守规矩。[/EX][EX] The teacher told the students to behave themselves in the library.| 老师告诉学生们在图书馆里要举止得体。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] behave + 副词 | 以…… 方式表现 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He behaved politely to everyone at the meeting.| 他在会议上对每个人都很有礼貌。[/EX][EX] The dog behaved calmly when guests came.| 客人来的时候，这只狗表现得很平静。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] It’s important to behave properly in public places.| 在公共场所举止得体很重要。[/EX][EX] The little girl behaved bravely when she saw the snake.| 这个小女孩看到蛇时表现得很勇敢。[/EX][EX] He didn’t behave as expected in the interview, so he didn’t get the job.| 他在面试中的表现不如预期，所以没得到那份工作。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] behave 是不及物动词，后面不能直接接宾语（错误：behave good behavior），正确是 behave well（用副词修饰）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 behave 和 behavior！behave 是动词 “表现”；behavior 是名词 “行为”，如 The child behaves well / The child has good behavior。[/ERR][ERR] behave oneself 的反身代词不能省略（错误：behave），正确：Behave yourself!（对单数）/ Behave yourselves!（对复数）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A small or specific part of something; to describe something thoroughly (used in the book when talking about what fossils can show)[/EN][CN] 细节；详情；详述（某物的微小或特定部分；详细描述某事，书中指化石能显示的具体信息）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈdiːteɪl/（英式）/dɪˈteɪl/（美式，名词）；/dɪˈteɪl/（英美，动词）[/PH][DU] The stony fossils show details about how living things looked or lived.|(原文例句) 石质化石能显示出生物的外貌和生活方式的细节。[/DU][DU] She told me all the details of her trip to the museum.| 她把去博物馆旅行的所有详情都告诉了我。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/detail.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] details of sth | 某事的细节 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Can you tell me the details of the party, like time and place?| 你能告诉我派对的细节吗，比如时间和地点？[/EX][EX] The report includes important details about the project.| 这份报告包含了项目的重要细节。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] in detail | 详细地 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He explained the plan in detail so everyone could understand.| 他详细解释了这个计划，让每个人都能明白。[/EX][EX] We discussed the problem in detail and found a solution.| 我们详细讨论了这个问题，找到了解决办法。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] detail sth | 详述某事 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The teacher detailed the steps of the experiment on the blackboard.| 老师在黑板上详细说明了实验的步骤。[/EX][EX] She detailed her experience as a volunteer in her essay.| 她在作文中详述了自己做志愿者的经历。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Don’t miss any small details— they might be important.| 不要遗漏任何小细节，它们可能很重要。[/EX][EX] The painting is beautiful because of its careful details.| 这幅画因为细致的细节而很美。[/EX][EX] The guide detailed the history of the old castle to the tourists.| 导游向游客们详述了这座古堡的历史。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] detail 作 “细节” 时是可数名词，“一个细节” 用 a detail，“多个细节” 用 details，不要说 many detail（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 detail 和 specific！detail 是 “具体的细节”；specific 是形容词 “具体的”，如 important details /specific information。[/ERR][ERR] in detail 是固定短语，不要说 in details（错误），正确：We talked about it in detail。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Things that are provided or available for use; to provide something that is needed (used in the book when talking about needing things to add details to a snow person)[/EN][CN] 供应品；物资；提供；供应（可供使用的物品；提供所需之物，书中指制作雪人时需要的装饰物资）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/səˈplaɪ/（英美，动词）；/ˈsəplaɪ/（英美，名词）[/PH][DU] You need supplies to add details, too.|(原文例句) 你还需要一些物资来添加细节。[/DU][DU] The store sells office supplies like pens and paper.| 这家商店出售钢笔、纸张等办公用品。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/supply.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] supplies of sth | 某物的供应品 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We need to buy more supplies of food and water for the trip.| 我们需要为旅行购买更多的食物和水供应品。[/EX][EX] The hospital has enough supplies of medicine for the patients.| 医院有足够的药品供应给病人。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] office/school/camping supplies | 办公 / 学校 / 露营用品 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She bought a set of camping supplies for the weekend trip.| 她为周末旅行买了一套露营用品。[/EX][EX] The teacher asked students to bring their school supplies to class.| 老师让学生们把学习用品带到课堂上。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] supply sb with sth /supply sth to sb | 向某人提供某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The company supplies fresh vegetables to local restaurants.| 这家公司向当地餐馆供应新鲜蔬菜。[/EX][EX] The government supplied the homeless with warm clothes in winter.| 政府在冬天为无家可归者提供了温暖的衣服。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The supply of electricity was cut off during the storm.| 暴风雨期间电力供应被切断了。[/EX][EX] They supplied the team with all the necessary equipment.| 他们为球队提供了所有必要的设备。[/EX][EX] We need to check the supplies before starting the project.| 开始项目前，我们需要检查物资。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] supply 作 “供应品” 时是可数名词，常用复数形式 supplies（错误：a supply of pens，可，但更常用 supplies of pens）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 supply 和 provide！两者都有 “提供” 之意，supply 更侧重 “持续供应物资”；provide 更侧重 “提供需要的东西”，搭配不同：supply sth to sb /provide sth for sb。[/ERR][ERR] supply 作动词时，是及物动词，不要遗漏宾语（错误：supply to the school），正确：supply books to the school。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] The bottom part of something that supports it; a foundation or starting point (used in the book when making a snow person’s bottom as the support)[/EN][CN] 底部；基座；基础；基地（支撑某物的底部部分；基础或起点，书中指制作雪人的底部作为支撑）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/beɪs/[/PH][DU] First, roll up a big ball. This will be the bottom of the snow person.|(原文例句) 首先，滚一个大球，这将是雪人的底部（基座）。[/DU][DU] The lamp stands on a solid base made of wood.| 这盏灯放在一个坚固的木质基座上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/base.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] the base of sth | 某物的底部 / 基础 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The base of the mountain is covered with green trees.| 山脚下覆盖着绿树。[/EX][EX] We need to build a strong base for the building.| 我们需要为这座大楼建造坚固的地基。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] base sth on sth | 以某物为基础；基于某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The story is based on a real event that happened last year.| 这个故事基于去年发生的一个真实事件。[/EX][EX] She based her decision on the advice of her friends.| 她的决定是基于朋友们的建议。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] military/base camp | 军事基地 / 大本营 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The soldiers returned to the military base after the mission.| 任务结束后，士兵们回到了军事基地。[/EX][EX] They set up a base camp at the foot of the mountain before climbing.| 他们爬山前在山脚下建立了大本营。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The statue’s base is made of stone and weighs a lot.| 这座雕像的基座是石头做的，很重。[/EX][EX] His argument has no solid base— it’s just a guess.| 他的论点没有坚实的基础，只是一个猜测。[/EX][EX] The company plans to base its new office in the city center.| 这家公司计划将新办公室设在市中心。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] base 作 “底部 / 基础” 时是可数名词，“一个基座” 用 a base，不要说 base（单独使用错误，需加冠词或限定词）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 base 和 basis！base 特指 “具体事物的底部或实体基础”；basis 特指 “抽象的基础或依据”，如 the base of the table /the basis of the theory。[/ERR][ERR] base 作动词 “基于” 时，常用被动形式 be based on（错误：base on the fact），正确：The film is based on a novel。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A substance used to make something; information or ideas used to create something (used in the book when talking about what tunnels are made of)[/EN][CN] 材料；原料；素材（用于制作某物的物质；用于创作的信息或想法，书中指建造隧道所用的物质）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/məˈtɪəriəl/（英式）/məˈtɪriəl/（美式）[/PH][DU] Think of the different materials that tunnels can be made of.|(原文例句) 想一想隧道可以用哪些不同的材料建造。[/DU][DU] We need to buy some building materials to repair the house.| 我们需要买一些建筑材料来修房子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/material.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] building/materials | 建筑 / 材料 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The store sells various building materials like bricks and cement.| 这家商店出售砖头、水泥等各种建筑材料。[/EX][EX] They transported the materials to the construction site by truck.| 他们用卡车把材料运到了建筑工地。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] raw materials | 原材料 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The factory imports raw materials from other countries.| 这家工厂从其他国家进口原材料。[/EX][EX] Plants use water and sunlight as raw materials to make food.| 植物以水和阳光为原材料制造食物。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] materials for sth | 某物的材料 / 素材 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She collected materials for her science project.| 她为科学项目收集了素材。[/EX][EX] We need to prepare materials for the meeting tomorrow.| 我们需要为明天的会议准备材料。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] This dress is made of a soft material that feels comfortable.| 这条裙子是用柔软的材料做的，摸起来很舒服。[/EX][EX] The writer used his own life experiences as material for his novel.| 这位作家用自己的生活经历作为小说的素材。[/EX][EX] The company is looking for new materials to make the product lighter.| 这家公司正在寻找新的材料，使产品更轻便。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] material 作 “材料” 时是可数 / 不可数名词，表示 “多种材料” 用 materials，不要说 many material（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 material 和 substance！material 特指 “用于制作某物的材料”；substance 特指 “化学物质或具体实物”，如 building materials /chemical substances。[/ERR][ERR]“材料” 表示 “素材” 时，不可数（错误：a material for the report），正确：material for the report。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To be similar or suitable for something; a small stick that produces fire when struck; a sports competition (used in the book when talking about using materials that fit the desired shapes)[/EN][CN] 匹配；相配；火柴；比赛（与某物相似或合适；划燃后能生火的小木棍；体育比赛，书中指使用与想要的形状相匹配的材料）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/mætʃ/[/PH][DU] Try to use materials that match the shapes you want.|(原文例句) 尽量使用与你想要的形状相匹配的材料。[/DU][DU] Her shirt matches her skirt— they are both blue.| 她的衬衫和裙子很相配，都是蓝色的。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/match.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] match sth to/with sth | 使某物与某物匹配 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Can you match the keys to the doors?| 你能把钥匙和门对应起来吗？[/EX][EX] She matched the curtains with the wallpaper in the room.| 她让窗帘和房间的墙纸相配。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a match between A and B|A 和 B 之间的比赛 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] There will be a football match between our school and theirs next week.| 下周我们学校和他们学校将有一场足球比赛。[/EX][EX] The match was very exciting and ended in a draw.| 这场比赛非常精彩，最终以平局结束。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a box of matches | 一盒火柴 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He bought a box of matches to light the candles.| 他买了一盒火柴来点燃蜡烛。[/EX][EX] Be careful with matches— they can start a fire.| 小心火柴，它们可能会引起火灾。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The color of the sofa doesn’t match the room’s style.| 沙发的颜色与房间的风格不相配。[/EX][EX] She won the tennis match easily because she practiced a lot.| 她因为练习得多，轻松赢得了网球比赛。[/EX][EX] These two pieces of puzzle don’t match— they can’t be put together.| 这两块拼图不相配，拼不在一起。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] match 作动词 “匹配” 时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：match with the color），正确：match the color。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 match 和 fit！match 侧重 “风格、颜色等相配”；fit 侧重 “尺寸、大小合身”，如 The shoes fit me well / The shoes match my dress。[/ERR][ERR] match 作 “比赛” 时是可数名词，“一场比赛” 用 a match，不要说 match（单独使用错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To eat something quickly and greedily; to swallow something in large mouthfuls (used in the book when Bruno eats the cake quickly)[/EN][CN] 狼吞虎咽；大口吞咽（快速而贪婪地吃某物；大口吞下某物，书中指布鲁诺快速吃掉了蛋糕）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡɒbl/（英式）/ˈɡɑːbl/（美式）[/PH][DU] Bruno catches it in his mouth. In seconds, he gobbles it up.|(原文例句) 布鲁诺用嘴接住了它，几秒钟内就狼吞虎咽地吃了下去。[/DU][DU] The children gobbled up the cookies as soon as they got them.| 孩子们一拿到饼干就狼吞虎咽地吃了起来。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/gobble.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] gobble up sth | 狼吞虎咽地吃某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He gobbled up the bowl of noodles because he was very hungry.| 他因为很饿，狼吞虎咽地吃完了一碗面条。[/EX][EX] The dog gobbled up the meat before the cat could get it.| 狗在猫拿到肉之前就狼吞虎咽地吃了下去。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] gobble down sth | 大口吞下某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She gobbled down her breakfast and rushed to school.| 她大口吃完早餐，匆忙赶去学校。[/EX][EX] The little boy gobbled down the ice cream before it melted.| 小男孩在冰淇淋融化前大口吃完了它。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] They gobbled up all the snacks at the party.| 他们在派对上把所有零食都狼吞虎咽地吃完了。[/EX][EX] The bird gobbled the seed from his hand in one bite.| 那只鸟一口就吞下了他手里的种子。[/EX][EX] Don’t gobble your food— it’s not good for digestion.| 不要狼吞虎咽地吃东西，这对消化不好。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] gobble 是及物动词，直接接宾语，常用短语 gobble up/down，不要遗漏 up/down（错误：gobble the food），正确：gobble up the food。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 gobble 和 eat！gobble 强调 “快速、贪婪地吃”；eat 是 “吃” 的普通表达，无感情色彩，如 gobble up the cake /eat the cake slowly。[/ERR][ERR] gobble 的现在分词是 gobbling，不要双写 b（错误：gobbeling），正确：He is gobbling his dinner。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To ask someone to come to a place or take part in an activity; to request someone’s presence (used in the book when Bruno is not asked to go for ice cream)[/EN][CN] 邀请；邀请参加（邀请某人去某地或参与某项活动；请求某人出席，书中指布鲁诺没有被邀请去吃冰淇淋）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ɪnˈvaɪt/[/PH][DU] Bruno isn’t invited!|(原文例句) 布鲁诺没有被邀请！[/DU][DU] We invited our neighbors to dinner at our house this weekend.| 我们邀请了邻居这周末来家里吃晚饭。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/invite.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] invite sb to sth | 邀请某人参加某事 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She invited me to her birthday party next Saturday.| 她邀请我下周六参加她的生日派对。[/EX][EX] The company invited him to the meeting about the new project.| 公司邀请他参加关于新项目的会议。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] invite sb to do sth | 邀请某人做某事 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] They invited us to visit their new house in the countryside.| 他们邀请我们去参观他们在乡下的新房子。[/EX][EX] The teacher invited the student to give a speech in class.| 老师邀请那位学生在课堂上发言。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] invite sb over | 邀请某人来家里 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] We invited our friends over for coffee and cookies.| 我们邀请朋友们来家里喝咖啡、吃饼干。[/EX][EX] She invited her cousin over to stay for the weekend.| 她邀请表妹来家里度周末。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] He was invited to join the school’s music club because he plays the piano well.| 他因为钢琴弹得好，被邀请加入学校的音乐俱乐部。[/EX][EX] Did you invite Tom to the picnic?
