[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small fierce fish with sharp teeth, native to the rivers of Brazil and South America (used in the book about animals from Brazil)[/EN][CN]水虎鱼；食人鱼（一种小型凶猛的鱼类，牙齿锋利，原产于巴西及南美的河流，出自巴西动物主题书籍）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/pɪˈrɑːnə/（英式）/pɪˈrɑːnə/（美式）[/PH][DU]Watch out if you swim in the river. My teeth are sharp.|(原文例句)如果你在河里游泳，要小心哦，我的牙齿很锋利。[/DU][DU]Piranhas are known for their sharp teeth and aggressive feeding behavior.|水虎鱼以其锋利的牙齿和凶猛的进食行为而闻名。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/piranha.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]sharp-teethed piranha|锋利牙齿的水虎鱼[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The sharp-teethed piranha can bite through flesh easily.|牙齿锋利的水虎鱼可以轻易咬穿肌肉。[/EX][EX]People often fear piranhas because of their sharp teeth.|人们通常因为水虎鱼锋利的牙齿而害怕它们。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]live in rivers of Brazil|生活在巴西的河流中[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Piranhas are abundant in the Amazon and Orinoco rivers of Brazil.|水虎鱼在巴西的亚马逊河和奥里诺科河数量众多。[/EX][EX]We saw a school of piranhas swimming in the river during our trip to Brazil.|我们去巴西旅行时，看到一群水虎鱼在河里游动。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H]school of piranhas|一群水虎鱼[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A school of piranhas can take down large prey quickly.|一群水虎鱼可以快速制服大型猎物。[/EX][EX]Fishermen sometimes catch schools of piranhas in their nets.|渔民有时会在渔网中捕获成群的水虎鱼。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]Piranhas are omnivores, eating both meat and plants.|水虎鱼是杂食动物，既吃肉也吃植物。[/EX][EX]Contrary to popular belief, piranhas rarely attack humans unless provoked.|与普遍看法相反，水虎鱼很少攻击人类，除非受到挑衅。[/EX][EX]The piranha’s teeth are replaced throughout its life.|水虎鱼的牙齿在其一生中会不断更换。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]piranha是**可数名词**，复数形式是piranhas或piranha（均可），不要说many piranhas（正确）或many piranha（口语中可接受，书面语建议用piranhas）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆piranha和other fish！piranha的核心特征是“锋利牙齿和群居捕猎”，其他淡水鱼多为独居或牙齿较钝。[/ERR][ERR]注意拼写：不要写成pirana（错误），规范写法是piranha。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A person who makes glass objects by blowing air into molten glass; someone skilled in glassblowing (used in the book about glassblowing craft)[/EN][CN] 吹玻璃的人；玻璃工匠（通过向熔融玻璃中吹气制作玻璃制品的人；擅长吹玻璃工艺的人，出自吹玻璃主题书籍）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡlɑːsbləʊə(r)/（英式）/ˈɡlæsbloʊər/（美式）[/PH][DU] I am a glassblower. Watch me make a beautiful glass bowl.|(原文例句) 我是一名玻璃工匠，请看我制作一个漂亮的玻璃碗。[/DU][DU] The glassblower used a long pipe to shape the hot glass.| 玻璃工匠用一根长管塑造热玻璃的形状。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/glassblower.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a skilled glassblower | 熟练的玻璃工匠 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The skilled glassblower made a delicate vase in just 20 minutes.| 这位熟练的玻璃工匠仅用 20 分钟就制作了一个精致的花瓶。[/EX][EX] We visited a glassblower’s workshop and watched him create glass art.| 我们参观了玻璃工匠的工作室，观看他创作玻璃艺术品。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] glassblower + 名词（作品 / 工具）| 玻璃工匠的……[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] glassblower’s creations 玻璃工匠的作品 [/EX][EX] glassblower’s tools 玻璃工匠的工具 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] work as a glassblower | 从事玻璃工匠工作 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He has worked as a glassblower for over 30 years.| 他从事玻璃工匠工作已有 30 多年了。[/EX][EX] She decided to train as a glassblower after seeing the craft at a fair.| 在博览会上看到这项工艺后，她决定接受培训成为一名玻璃工匠。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The glassblower heated the glass in a hot oven before shaping it.| 玻璃工匠先将玻璃放入高温炉中加热，然后再塑形。[/EX][EX] Many tourists buy glassblowers’ handiworks as souvenirs.| 许多游客购买玻璃工匠的手工艺品作为纪念品。[/EX][EX] The young glassblower learned the craft from his grandfather.| 这位年轻的玻璃工匠从祖父那里学到了这项手艺。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] glassblower 是复合名词，由 glass + blower 组成，不要分开写（错误：glass blower），规范写法是 glassblower。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 glassblower 和 glassmaker！glassblower 特指 “吹制玻璃的工匠”；glassmaker 是 “玻璃制造者” 的统称，范围更广。[/ERR][ERR] glassblower 是可数名词，复数形式是 glassblowers，不要说 many glassblower（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Flowing easily; not thick or solid; (of a nose) producing a lot of liquid (used in the book about glassblowing to describe molten glass)[/EN][CN] 易流动的；稀薄的；（鼻子）流鼻涕的（容易流动的；不浓稠或不固态的；用于吹玻璃主题书籍中描述熔融玻璃）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈrʌni/（英美）[/PH][DU] The hot glass is runny, like honey.|(原文例句) 热玻璃易流动，就像蜂蜜一样。[/DU][DU] She has a runny nose because of the cold.| 她感冒了，流鼻涕。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/runny.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] runny + 名词（液体 / 物质 / 身体部位）| 易流动的……；流鼻涕的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] runny syrup 稀薄的糖浆 [/EX][EX] runny paint 易流淌的油漆 [/EX][EX] runny eyes 流泪的眼睛 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be runny | 呈易流动状态 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The sauce will be runny if you add too much water.| 如果加太多水，酱汁会变得稀薄。[/EX][EX] The melted chocolate is runny enough to pour into molds.| 融化的巧克力足够易流动，可以倒入模具中。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The soup is too runny—we need to add more thickener.| 这汤太稀了，我们需要加更多增稠剂。[/EX][EX] Babies often have runny stools when they are teething.| 婴儿长牙时经常会拉肚子（大便稀薄）。[/EX][EX] The candle wax becomes runny when heated.| 蜡烛蜡加热后会变得易流动。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] runny 的比较级和最高级是 runnier /runniest，不要写成 more runny /most runny（虽可接受，但更规范的是变 y 为 i 加 - er/-est）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 runny 和 liquid！runny 强调 “易流动的状态”，是形容词；liquid 是 “液体”，可作名词或形容词，如 runny honey /liquid honey（均可，但 runny 更侧重 “易流” 的特性）。[/ERR][ERR] 描述 “流鼻涕” 时，正确表达是 have a runny nose，不要说 runny nose（单独使用错误，需加冠词）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long tube made of metal, glass, or plastic used for carrying liquids, gases, or smoke; a long tool used by glassblowers to shape glass (used in the book about glassblowing)[/EN][CN] 管子；管道；烟斗；吹玻璃管（由金属、玻璃或塑料制成的长管，用于输送液体、气体或烟雾；玻璃工匠用于塑形的长工具，出自吹玻璃主题书籍）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/paɪp/（英美）[/PH][DU] I dip my long pipe into the hot glass.|(原文例句) 我把我的长吹玻璃管浸入热玻璃中。[/DU][DU] Water flows through the pipe to the house.| 水通过管道输送到房子里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pipe.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] glassblowing pipe | 吹玻璃管 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The glassblower held the glassblowing pipe carefully to control the molten glass.| 玻璃工匠小心地拿着吹玻璃管，控制熔融玻璃。[/EX][EX] This glassblowing pipe is made of heat-resistant material.| 这根吹玻璃管由耐热材料制成。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] pipe + 名词（用途）|…… 管道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] water pipe 水管 [/EX][EX] gas pipe 煤气管 [/EX][EX] smoking pipe 烟斗 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] pipe sth（用管道输送）| 用管道输送某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Oil is piped from the well to the refinery.| 石油通过管道从油井输送到炼油厂。[/EX][EX] Hot water is piped to every room in the hotel.| 热水通过管道输送到酒店的每个房间。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The plumber repaired the broken pipe in the kitchen.| 水管工修好了厨房的破损管道。[/EX][EX] He smoked a pipe while reading the newspaper.| 他一边看报纸一边抽烟斗。[/EX][EX] The glassblower blew air through the pipe to make a bubble in the glass.| 玻璃工匠通过管子吹气，在玻璃中吹出一个气泡。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] pipe 作 “吹玻璃管” 时，是可数名词，“一根吹玻璃管” 用 a glassblowing pipe，不要说 a pipe（单独使用易歧义）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 pipe 和 tube！pipe 特指 “较粗的管道”（如水管、煤气管）；tube 特指 “较细的管子”（如试管、吸管），如 a water pipe /a test tube。[/ERR][ERR] pipe 作动词 “输送” 时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：pipe to the factory），正确：pipe gas to the factory。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Sticky, soft, and viscous; having a thick, gluey consistency (used in the book about glassblowing to describe molten glass)[/EN][CN] 黏糊糊的；胶质的；黏稠的（黏腻、柔软且有黏性的；具有浓稠、胶状质地的，出自吹玻璃主题书籍中描述熔融玻璃）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡuːi/（英美）[/PH][DU] I blow a bubble in the gooey glass.|(原文例句) 我在黏糊糊的玻璃中吹出一个气泡。[/DU][DU] The cake has a gooey chocolate center.| 这个蛋糕中间有黏腻的巧克力夹心。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/gooey.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] gooey + 名词（物质 / 食物）| 黏糊糊的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] gooey mud 黏糊糊的泥巴 [/EX][EX] gooey caramel 黏腻的焦糖 [/EX][EX] gooey slime 黏液 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be gooey | 呈黏腻状态 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The candy becomes gooey when it’s heated.| 这糖果加热后会变得黏腻。[/EX][EX] The paint is still gooey—don’t touch it yet.| 油漆还黏糊糊的，先别碰。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The children played with gooey clay to make small sculptures.| 孩子们用黏糊糊的黏土制作小雕塑。[/EX][EX] Her fingers got covered in gooey glue while making the craft.| 她做手工时，手指上沾满了黏糊糊的胶水。[/EX][EX] The melted cheese on the pizza is hot and gooey.| 披萨上融化的奶酪又热又黏。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] gooey 的比较级和最高级是 gooier /gooiest，不要写成 more gooey /most gooey（虽可接受，但更规范的是变 y 为 i 加 - er/-est）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 gooey 和 sticky！gooey 强调 “黏稠且柔软的黏”；sticky 强调 “表面粘手的黏”，如 gooey honey /sticky tape。[/ERR][ERR] gooey 是形容词，不要误用作名词（错误：the gooey of the glass），正确：the gooey glass（黏糊糊的玻璃）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A bowl-shaped hollow on the surface of a planet, moon, or other celestial body, formed by the impact of a meteorite or volcanic activity (used in the book about the Moon)[/EN][CN] 陨石坑；火山口（行星、月球或其他天体表面上的碗状凹陷，由陨石撞击或火山活动形成，出自月球主题书籍）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkreɪtə(r)/（英美）[/PH][DU] The Moon has many craters. Rocks fly through space, hit the Moon, and create craters.|(原文例句) 月球上有许多陨石坑，太空中的岩石撞击月球，形成了这些陨石坑。[/DU][DU] Scientists studied the large crater on the planet Mars.| 科学家研究了火星上的那个大型陨石坑。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/crater.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] lunar crater | 月球陨石坑 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Astronauts took samples from the lunar crater during their mission.| 宇航员在任务期间从月球陨石坑采集了样本。[/EX][EX] The lunar crater is over 100 kilometers wide.| 这个月球陨石坑宽超过 100 公里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] volcanic crater | 火山口 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Smoke and lava came out of the volcanic crater.| 烟雾和熔岩从火山口喷出。[/EX][EX] We hiked to the top of the mountain to see the volcanic crater.| 我们徒步登上山顶，观看火山口。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] create/form a crater | 形成陨石坑 / 火山口 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The meteorite impact created a huge crater on the Earth’s surface.| 陨石撞击在地球表面形成了一个巨大的陨石坑。[/EX][EX] Volcanic eruptions formed many craters in this region.| 火山喷发在这个地区形成了许多火山口。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The crater is so deep that you can’t see the bottom.| 这个陨石坑太深了，看不到底部。[/EX][EX] Satellite images show new craters on the far side of the Moon.| 卫星图像显示月球背面有新的陨石坑。[/EX][EX] Tourists visit the famous crater lake in Oregon every year.| 游客们每年都会参观俄勒冈州著名的火山口湖。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] crater 是可数名词，“一个陨石坑” 用 a crater，复数形式是 craters，不要说 many crater（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 crater 和 hole！crater 特指 “天体表面或火山形成的碗状凹陷”；hole 是 “洞” 的统称，范围更广，如 a lunar crater /a hole in the wall。[/ERR][ERR] 注意发音：/ˈkreɪtə(r)/，不要读成 /ˈkrætə(r)/（错误），正确发音类似 “克雷特”。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] The force that attracts a body towards the center of the Earth, or towards any other physical body having mass; seriousness (used in the book about the Moon)[/EN][CN] 重力；地心引力；严重性（将物体吸引向地球中心或任何有质量的物理体的力；严重性，出自月球主题书籍）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡrævəti/（英美）[/PH][DU] The Moon has less gravity than Earth. People can jump high on the Moon.|(原文例句) 月球的重力比地球小，人们在月球上能跳得很高。[/DU][DU] Gravity keeps us from floating away into space.| 重力让我们不会飘到太空中去。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/gravity.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] gravity of + 名词（星球 / 情况）|…… 的重力；…… 的严重性 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] the gravity of the Earth 地球的重力 [/EX][EX] the gravity of the situation 情况的严重性 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] less/more gravity | 重力更小 / 更大 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Planets with more mass have more gravity.| 质量更大的行星重力更大。[/EX][EX] Astronauts train in low-gravity environments to prepare for space missions.| 宇航员在低重力环境中训练，为太空任务做准备。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] zero gravity | 零重力 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Astronauts experience zero gravity in space.| 宇航员在太空中体验零重力。[/EX][EX] Some experiments can only be done in zero gravity.| 有些实验只能在零重力环境下进行。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The gravity on Mars is about one-third of that on Earth.| 火星上的重力约为地球的三分之一。[/EX][EX] She didn’t realize the gravity of her mistake until it was too late.| 直到为时已晚，她才意识到自己错误的严重性。[/EX][EX] Gravity causes objects to fall to the ground when dropped.| 物体掉落时，重力会让它们落到地面上。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] gravity 是不可数名词，不要加 s（错误：gravities），表示 “不同星球的重力” 用 the gravity of different planets。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 gravity 和 gravitation！gravity 是日常用语，指 “重力”；gravitation 是科学术语，指 “万有引力”，如 the law of universal gravitation（万有引力定律）。[/ERR][ERR] 表示 “重力小” 用 less gravity，不要用 small gravity（错误），正确：The Moon has less gravity。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Colorful papier-mâché containers filled with candy and small prizes, hung up at parties for people to break open with a stick (used in the book about party piñatas, note: capitalized as a cultural term)[/EN][CN] 彩罐（派对上悬挂的彩色纸浆容器，内装糖果和小奖品，人们用棍子将其打破，出自派对彩罐主题书籍，注：作为文化术语首字母大写）[/CN][POS] n.（复数形式，单数：piñata）[/POS][PH]/pɪnˈjɑːtəz/（英美）[/PH][DU] Piñatas are made of paper and glue. They come in all shapes and sizes.|(原文例句) 彩罐由纸和胶水制成，它们有各种形状和大小。[/DU][DU] We hung a piñata at the birthday party for the kids to break.| 我们在生日派对上挂了一个彩罐，让孩子们来打破。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pinatas.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] break a piñata | 打破彩罐 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The children took turns swinging a stick to break the piñata.| 孩子们轮流挥舞棍子打破彩罐。[/EX][EX] It took three tries to break the piñata open.| 花了三次尝试才把彩罐打破。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] piñata party | 彩罐派对 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We’re having a piñata party this weekend—bring your friends!| 我们这周末要举办彩罐派对，带上你的朋友来！[/EX][EX] The piñata party was a big hit with the children.| 彩罐派对深受孩子们的喜爱。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] fill a piñata with sth | 给彩罐装满某物 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] They filled the piñata with candy and small toys.| 他们给彩罐装满了糖果和小玩具。[/EX][EX] We filled the piñata with stickers and pencils for the students.| 我们给彩罐装满了贴纸和铅笔，给学生们准备的。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The piñata was shaped like a unicorn—very popular with the girls.| 这个彩罐做成了独角兽的形状，很受女孩们的欢迎。[/EX][EX] When the piñata broke, candy and prizes fell all over the floor.| 彩罐打破时，糖果和奖品掉得满地都是。[/EX][EX] She made a homemade piñata for her little brother’s party.| 她为弟弟的派对做了一个自制彩罐。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] Piñatas 是复数形式，单数是 piñata，不要误写为 piñatas（单数错误），正确：a piñata /two piñatas。[/ERR][ERR] 注意拼写：不要漏掉 ñ（错误：pinatas），规范写法是 piñata（单数）/piñatas（复数），ñ 的发音类似 “ny”。[/ERR][ERR] Piñata 是可数名词，表示 “一个彩罐” 用 a piñata，不要说 piñata（单独使用错误，需加冠词或限定词）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A thing given as a reward to the winner of a competition or game; something of value gained or won (used in the book about piñatas, where prizes fall out when broken)[/EN][CN] 奖品；奖赏；战利品（作为竞赛或游戏获胜者的奖励而给予的东西；获得或赢得的有价值的东西，出自彩罐主题书籍，彩罐打破时会掉出奖品）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/praɪz/（英美）[/PH][DU] Candy and prizes fall out when the piñata breaks open.|(原文例句) 当彩罐被打破时，糖果和奖品会掉出来。[/DU][DU] She won first prize in the drawing competition.| 她在绘画比赛中获得了一等奖。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/prize.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] win a prize | 赢得奖品 [/H][EX] He won a prize for his science project.| 他的科学项目赢得了一个奖品。[/EX][EX] Did you win any prizes at the fair?| 你在博览会上赢得奖品了吗？[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] prize + 名词（奖品类型）|…… 奖品 [/H][EX] cash prize 现金奖品 [/EX][EX] book prize 书籍奖品 [/EX][EX] first/second/third prize 一 / 二 / 三等奖 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] prize sth（珍视）| 珍视某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She prizes the necklace her grandmother gave her.| 她珍视祖母送给她的项链。[/EX][EX] We prize honesty and kindness in our family.| 我们家珍视诚实和善良。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The prize for the best performance is a trip to the zoo.| 最佳表现的奖品是去动物园的旅行。[/EX][EX] They gave out small prizes to all the participants.| 他们给所有参与者都颁发了小奖品。[/EX][EX] The team worked hard to win the prize.| 这支队伍为了赢得奖品而努力奋斗。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] prize 作 “奖品” 时是可数名词，“一个奖品” 用 a prize，不要说 many prize（错误），正确：many prizes。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 prize 和 award！prize 侧重 “竞赛或游戏的奖品”；award 侧重 “官方或正式的奖励”，如 win a prize in a game /receive an award for bravery。[/ERR][ERR] prize 作动词 “珍视” 时是及物动词，直接接宾语，不要加介词（错误：prize for the gift），正确：prize the gift。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A unit of length equal to 2.54 centimeters; to move very slowly and carefully (used in the book about making a sunflower hut, referring to digging depth)[/EN][CN] 英寸（长度单位，等于 2.54 厘米）；慢慢移动（非常缓慢且小心地移动，出自制作向日葵小屋主题书籍，指挖掘深度）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/ɪntʃ/（英美）[/PH][DU] Make sure you dig an inch into the dirt.|(原文例句) 确保你在泥土里挖一英寸深。[/DU][DU] The snail inched along the edge of the table.| 蜗牛沿着桌子边缘慢慢爬行。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/inch.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] an inch of + 名词（长度 / 深度）| 一英寸的……[/H][EX] an inch of rain 一英寸的降雨量 [/EX][EX] an inch of snow 一英寸厚的雪 [/EX][EX] dig an inch into the ground 挖一英寸深到地里 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] inch + 副词（forward/along/up 等）| 慢慢…… 移动 [/H][EX] The car inched forward in the heavy traffic.| 汽车在拥堵的交通中慢慢前进。[/EX][EX] She inched up the ladder carefully.| 她小心地慢慢爬上梯子。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] by inches | 逐渐地；一点点地 [/H][EX] The project was completed by inches.| 这个项目一点点地完成了。[/EX][EX] He escaped danger by inches.| 他差一点就陷入危险，侥幸逃脱。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The book is about an inch thick.| 这本书大约有一英寸厚。[/EX][EX] We need to move the sofa an inch to the left.| 我们需要把沙发向左移动一英寸。[/EX][EX] The cat inched closer to the bird, waiting to pounce.| 猫慢慢靠近那只鸟，准备扑上去。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] inch 作 “英寸” 时是可数名词，复数形式是 inches，不要说 three inch（错误），正确：three inches（作定语时可用 three-inch，如 a three-inch hole）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 inch 和 centimeter！inch 是英制长度单位（1 英寸 = 2.54 厘米）；centimeter 是公制长度单位，如 an inch /a centimeter。[/ERR][ERR] inch 作动词 “慢慢移动” 时是不及物动词，后接介词短语表示方向，不要直接接宾语（错误：inch the road），正确：inch along the road。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] An adult; a person who is fully grown (used in the book about making a sunflower hut, referring to an adult helper)[/EN][CN] 成年人； grown-up 的变体（完全长大的人，出自制作向日葵小屋主题书籍，指成年帮手）[/CN][POS] n./adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡrəʊnʌp/（英式）/ˈɡroʊnʌp/（美式）[/PH][DU] A grownup can tie some taller flowers together to make a roof.|(原文例句) 成年人可以把一些较高的花绑在一起做成屋顶。[/DU][DU] The little girl asked a grownup for help with her bag.| 小女孩向一位成年人求助，帮忙拿她的包。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/grownup.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] ask a grownup for help | 向成年人求助 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Always ask a grownup for help if you have trouble.| 如果你遇到困难，一定要向成年人求助。[/EX][EX] The child couldn’t reach the shelf, so she asked a grownup for help.| 孩子够不到架子，所以她向一位成年人求助。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] grownup + 名词（事物 / 决定）| 成年人的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] grownup decisions 成年人的决定 [/EX][EX] grownup responsibilities 成年人的责任 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] act like a grownup | 表现得像个成年人 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] It’s time for you to act like a grownup and take responsibility.| 是时候让你表现得像个成年人，承担起责任了。[/EX][EX] He acted like a grownup and solved the problem by himself.| 他表现得像个成年人，自己解决了问题。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Grownups need to set a good example for children.| 成年人需要为孩子树立好榜样。[/EX][EX] The party is for both kids and grownups.| 这个派对既适合孩子也适合成年人。[/EX][EX] She wants to be a grownup so she can make her own choices.| 她想成为一名成年人，这样她就能自己做决定了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] grownup 的复数形式是 grownups，不要写成 growns-up（错误），也可写作 grown-ups（加连字符，更规范）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 grownup 和 adult！grownup 更口语化，常用于儿童用语；adult 是正式用语，适用范围更广，如 a grownup /an adult。[/ERR][ERR] grownup 作形容词时，不要分开写（错误：grown up），正确：grownup clothes（成年人的衣服）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To talk with excessive pride and self-satisfaction about one’s achievements, possessions, or abilities (used in the book The Tortoise and the Hare, describing the hare’s behavior)[/EN][CN] 吹嘘；夸耀（过分骄傲和自满地谈论自己的成就、财产或能力，出自《龟兔赛跑》主题书籍，描述兔子的行为）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/bræɡ/（英美）[/PH][DU] The hare liked to brag about how fast he could run.|(原文例句) 兔子喜欢吹嘘自己能跑得有多快。[/DU][DU] He always brags about his new car to his friends.| 他总是向朋友们吹嘘他的新车。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/brag.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] brag about sth | 吹嘘某事；夸耀某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She brags about her test scores to everyone.| 她向所有人吹嘘自己的考试成绩。[/EX][EX] Don’t brag about your wealth— it’s not polite.| 不要吹嘘你的财富，这是不礼貌的。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] brag that + 从句 | 吹嘘……[POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He brags that he can speak five languages.| 他吹嘘自己会说五种语言。[/EX][EX] She bragged that she won the competition easily.| 她吹嘘自己轻易就赢得了比赛。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] brag to sb about sth | 向某人吹嘘某事 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He bragged to his classmates about his football skills.| 他向同学们吹嘘自己的足球技术。[/EX][EX] She bragged to me about her trip to Europe.| 她向我吹嘘她的欧洲之旅。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] It’s not nice to brag about your success—be humble.| 吹嘘你的成功是不好的，要谦虚。[/EX][EX] The athlete never brags about his achievements, even though he’s very successful.| 这位运动员从不吹嘘自己的成就，尽管他非常成功。[/EX][EX] She bragged that she could finish the work in one hour.| 她吹嘘自己能在一小时内完成这项工作。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] brag 是及物 / 不及物动词，后接 about + 宾语或 that 从句，不要直接接宾语（错误：brag his success），正确：brag about his success。[/ERR][ERR] brag 的过去式和过去分词是 bragged，不要双写 g（错误：bragg），正确：He bragged about his win yesterday。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 brag 和 boast！两者含义相近，brag 更口语化，侧重 “炫耀式吹嘘”；boast 更正式，侧重 “自豪地提及”，如 brag about a new phone /boast of one’s courage。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Regular, uniform, and continuous in rate or progress; not easily disturbed or upset; firm in position (used in the book The Tortoise and the Hare, with the saying “Slow and steady wins the race”)[/EN][CN] 稳定的；稳步的；沉着的；稳固的（速度或进展规律、均匀且持续的；不易被打扰或心烦的；位置稳固的，出自《龟兔赛跑》主题书籍，谚语 “稳扎稳打方能赢”）[/CN][POS] adj./adv./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈstedɪ/（英美）[/PH][DU]“Slow and steady wins the race!” Tortoise said.|(原文例句)“稳扎稳打方能赢！” 乌龟说。[/DU][DU] She walked at a steady pace to the finish line.| 她以稳定的步伐走向终点线。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/steady1.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] steady + 名词（速度 / 进步 / 工作等）| 稳定的……[POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] steady progress 稳步的进步 [/EX][EX] steady job 稳定的工作 [/EX][EX] steady speed 稳定的速度 [/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] at a steady pace | 以稳定的速度 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The project is moving forward at a steady pace.| 这个项目正以稳定的速度推进。[/EX][EX] He ran at a steady pace and didn’t get tired easily.| 他以稳定的速度跑步，不容易感到累。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] steady sb/sth（使稳定）| 使…… 稳定 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She put her hand on the table to steady herself.| 她把手放在桌子上稳住自己。[/EX][EX] The government took measures to steady the economy.| 政府采取措施稳定经济。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The rain fell at a steady rate all afternoon.| 整个下午雨都在下，雨量稳定。[/EX][EX] He kept a steady hand while drawing the picture.| 他画画时手很稳。[/EX][EX] Her voice remained steady even when she was nervous.| 即使她很紧张，声音仍然很平稳。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] steady 的比较级和最高级是 steadier /steadiest，不要写成 more steady /most steady（虽可接受，但更规范的是加 - er/-est）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 steady 和 stable！steady 侧重 “持续、有规律的稳定”；stable 侧重 “坚固、不易改变的稳定”，如 steady growth /stable prices。[/ERR][ERR] steady 作副词时，常用短语 steady on（小心；慢慢来），不要单独作状语（错误：walk steady），正确：walk steadily（用副词形式）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A machine for washing dishes automatically; a person who washes dishes, especially in a restaurant (used in the book about saving energy, comparing hand-washing and machine-washing)[/EN][CN] 洗碗机；洗碗工（自动洗碗的机器；洗碗的人，尤指餐厅里的洗碗工，出自节约能源主题书籍，比较手洗和机洗）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈdɪʃwɒʃə(r)/（英式）/ˈdɪʃwɑːʃər/（美式）[/PH][DU] My hands use less energy than a dishwasher.|(原文例句) 我的手比洗碗机消耗的能源少。[/DU][DU] We bought a new dishwasher to make housework easier.| 我们买了一台新洗碗机，让家务更轻松。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/dishwasher.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] run the dishwasher | 开洗碗机；使用洗碗机 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] I’ll run the dishwasher after dinner.| 晚饭后我会开洗碗机。[/EX][EX] She forgot to run the dishwasher last night.| 她昨晚忘了开洗碗机。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] dishwasher safe | 可用于洗碗机的 [POS] n.+adj.[/POS][/H][EX] These plates are dishwasher safe—you don’t have to wash them by hand.| 这些盘子可用于洗碗机，你不必手洗。[/EX][EX] The label says the mug is dishwasher safe.| 标签上写着这个马克杯可用于洗碗机。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] work as a dishwasher | 当洗碗工 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] He worked as a dishwasher in a restaurant during college.| 他大学期间在一家餐厅当洗碗工。[/EX][EX] The restaurant is hiring a dishwasher—no experience needed.| 这家餐厅正在招聘洗碗工，无需经验。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The dishwasher can hold up to 12 place settings.| 这台洗碗机最多能容纳 12 套餐具。[/EX][EX] We need to load the dishwasher before it gets too full.| 我们需要在洗碗机太满之前把餐具放进去。[/EX][EX] The dishwasher uses less water than hand-washing if it’s fully loaded.| 如果洗碗机装满了，它比手洗更省水。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] dishwasher 是复合名词，由 dish + washer 组成，不要分开写（错误：dish washer），规范写法是 dishwasher。[/ERR][ERR] dishwasher 是可数名词，“一台洗碗机” 用 a dishwasher，复数形式是 dishwashers，不要说 many dishwasher（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 dishwasher 和 dishwashing！dishwasher 是 “洗碗机 / 洗碗工”（名词）；dishwashing 是 “洗碗”（名词 / 形容词），如 a dishwasher /dishwashing liquid（洗洁精）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A small, round cake made of flour, butter, and milk, usually eaten with jam or cream; a sweet baked good (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, with chocolate and scones as a snack)[/EN][CN] 司康饼；烤饼（用面粉、黄油和牛奶制作的小圆糕饼，通常搭配果酱或奶油食用；甜味烘焙点心，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，是公主与女公爵的点心，搭配热巧克力食用）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/skɒn/（英式）/skoʊn/（美式）[/PH][DU] Princess Magnolia was having chocolate and scones with Duchess Wigtower.|(原文例句) 玛格诺莉亚公主正和维格塔女公爵一起享用热巧克力和司康饼。[/DU][DU] The scones were sweet and matched the hot chocolate perfectly.| 司康饼甜甜的，和热巧克力搭配得天衣无缝。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/scone.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] chocolate and scones | 热巧克力配司康饼 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We often have chocolate and scones for afternoon tea.| 我们下午茶常吃热巧克力配司康饼。[/EX][EX] The princess prepared chocolate and scones for her guest.| 公主为客人准备了热巧克力和司康饼。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] sweet/savory scone | 甜味 / 咸味司康饼 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] I prefer sweet scones with strawberry jam.| 我更喜欢搭配草莓果酱的甜味司康饼。[/EX][EX] Savory scones with cheese are popular for breakfast.| 芝士咸味司康饼是很受欢迎的早餐。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a plate of scones | 一盘司康饼 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The maid brought a plate of scones to the tower room.| 女仆端着一盘司康饼送到了塔楼房间。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She baked a batch of fresh scones for the afternoon tea party.| 她为下午茶派对烤了一批新鲜的司康饼。[/EX][EX] The scone is soft and fluffy when it’s just out of the oven.| 刚出炉的司康饼松软又蓬松。[/EX][EX] He spread some cream on the scone before eating it.| 他吃司康饼前在上面抹了些奶油。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] scone 是可数名词，复数形式是 scones，不要说 many scone（错误），正确：many scones。[/ERR][ERR] 注意发音差异：英式 /skɒn/，美式 /skoʊn/，不要将美式发音读成 /skɒn/。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 scone 和 muffin！scone 质地更紧实，多为圆形；muffin 更蓬松，杯状烘焙，口感差异大。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A light, gentle wind; to move quickly and easily (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, describing the warm wind from the window)[/EN][CN] 微风；轻风；轻快地走（轻柔的小风；快速轻松地移动，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，形容从窗户吹进来的温暖风儿）[/CN][POS] n./v.[/POS][PH]/briːz/（英美）[/PH][DU] The breeze from the window was warm and wishy.|(原文例句) 从窗户吹进来的微风温暖又轻柔。[/DU][DU] The breeze knocked her curls into her face.| 微风把她的卷发吹到了脸上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/breeze.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] warm breeze | 温暖的微风 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] A warm breeze blew through the castle window in summer.| 夏天，一阵温暖的微风从城堡的窗户吹进来。[/EX][EX] The warm breeze made her feel a little sleepy.| 温暖的微风让她觉得有点犯困。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a breeze through sth | 轻松完成某事 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She breezed through the princess’s etiquette lesson.| 她轻松完成了公主的礼仪课。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the breeze from...| 从…… 吹来的微风 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The breeze from the forest carried the smell of flowers.| 从森林吹来的微风带着花香。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] A cool breeze swept across the goat pasture in the evening.| 傍晚，一阵凉风掠过山羊牧场。[/EX][EX] He breezed into the room with a big smile on his face.| 他笑容满面，轻快地走进了房间。[/EX][EX] The leaves danced in the soft breeze.| 树叶在轻柔的微风中舞动。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] breeze 作 “微风” 时多为不可数名词，表 “阵阵微风” 可用 breezes，不要随意加 s（错误：a light breezes），正确：a light breeze。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 breeze 和 wind！breeze 特指 “轻柔的微风”；wind 是通用词，可指任何风，大风用 strong wind 而非 strong breeze。[/ERR][ERR] breeze 作动词时是不及物动词，后接介词时需搭配正确，不要直接接宾语（错误：breeze the room）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To find out or discover something that is hidden or secret; to remove a cover from something (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, the duchess’s hobby to find others’ secrets)[/EN][CN] 揭露；发现；揭开（发现隐藏或秘密的事情；移去某物的遮盖物，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，是维格塔女公爵的爱好，喜欢发现别人的秘密）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ʌnˈkʌvə(r)/（英式）/ʌnˈkʌvər/（美式）[/PH][DU]“I love to meet people in their homes,” said Duchess Wigtower. “I always uncover secrets.”|(原文例句) 维格塔女公爵说：“我喜欢去别人家里做客，总能发现一些秘密。”[/DU][DU] She was afraid the duchess would uncover her huge secret.| 她害怕女公爵会揭露她那个天大的秘密。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/uncover.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] uncover a secret | 揭露一个秘密 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The duchess was determined to uncover a secret in Princess Magnolia’s castle.| 女公爵下定决心要在玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡里发现一个秘密。[/EX][EX] No one could uncover the princess’s secret identity as the Princess in Black.| 没人能揭露公主作为黑衣公主的秘密身份。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] uncover the truth | 发现真相 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She tried to uncover the truth about the strange noise in the castle.| 她试图找出城堡里奇怪声响的真相。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] uncover sth hidden | 发现隐藏的东西 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The duchess yanked the door and uncovered something stuck beneath it.| 女公爵猛拉门，发现了卡在门底下的东西。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The detective worked hard to uncover the mystery of the missing treasure.| 侦探努力揭开失踪宝藏的谜团。[/EX][EX] She uncovered the bowl and found a big red apple inside.| 她掀开碗，发现里面有一个大红苹果。[/EX][EX] It took a long time to uncover the truth about the monster’s rule.| 花了很久才发现关于怪兽规则的真相。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] uncover 是及物动词，可直接接宾语，不要加多余介词（错误：uncover about the secret），正确：uncover the secret。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 uncover 和 discover！uncover 侧重 “揭开被隐藏、刻意掩盖的事物”；discover 侧重 “发现原本存在但不为人知的事物”。[/ERR][ERR] uncover 的过去式和过去分词是 uncovered，不要漏写 ed（错误：uncover），正确：She uncovered the stockings under the door。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Very neat and proper in appearance and behavior; formal and not relaxed, often in a way that seems a little stiff (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, describing Princess Magnolia’s outward look)[/EN][CN] 端庄的；一本正经的；拘谨的（外表和行为非常整洁得体；正式且不放松，有时显得有点僵硬，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，形容玛格诺莉亚公主的外在模样）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/prɪm/（英美）[/PH][DU]“You seem so prim and perfect.” Duchess Wigtower leaned forward.|(原文例句) 维格塔女公爵探过身来说：“你看起来如此端庄完美。”[/DU][DU] She tried to look prim and calm when the monster alarm rang.| 怪兽警报响起时，她努力装出端庄平静的样子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/prim.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] prim and perfect | 端庄又完美 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Everyone thought the princess was prim and perfect with no secrets.| 所有人都觉得这位公主端庄完美，毫无秘密。[/EX][EX] She always looked prim and perfect in her pink frilly dress.| 她穿着粉色荷叶边裙子，总是显得端庄又完美。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a prim smile | 拘谨的微笑 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Princess Magnolia gave the duchess a prim smile before leaving the room.| 玛格诺莉亚公主离开房间前，给了女公爵一个拘谨的微笑。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] prim behavior | 端庄的行为 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess’s prim behavior made the duchess more curious about her secret.| 公主端庄的行为让女公爵对她的秘密更加好奇。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She sat in a prim position on the couch, with her hands on her knees.| 她双手放在膝盖上，拘谨地坐在沙发上。[/EX][EX] The lady spoke in a prim voice and never laughed loudly.| 这位女士说话的语气一本正经，从不高声大笑。[/EX][EX] He thought her prim look was just a disguise for her bold personality.| 他觉得她端庄的外表只是她大胆性格的伪装。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] prim 的比较级是 primmer，最高级是 primmest，不要用 more prim/most prim（错误），这是不规则变化的形容词。[/ERR][ERR] prim 多用来形容人的外表、行为或表情，不要用来形容事物（错误：a prim cake），可换用 neat/pretty。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 prim 和 proper！prim 侧重 “过于拘谨、一本正经的得体”；proper 侧重 “符合规范、恰当的得体”，语气更中性。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Having many frills (small, decorative folds of cloth); decorated with frills, usually used to describe clothes for girls or princesses (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, describing Princess Magnolia’s pink dress)[/EN][CN] 饰有褶边的；带荷叶边的（有许多装饰性的小布褶；用褶边装饰的，通常用来形容女孩或公主的衣服，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，形容玛格诺莉亚公主的粉色裙子）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈfrɪli/（英美）[/PH][DU] Princess Magnolia brushed crumbs off her frilly pink dress.|(原文例句) 玛格诺莉亚公主拂掉了她粉色荷叶边裙子上的面包屑。[/DU][DU] Princesses do not stuff frilly pink dresses into broom closets.|(原文例句) 公主们可不会把粉色荷叶边裙子塞进扫帚间。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/frilly.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] frilly pink dress | 粉色荷叶边裙子 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess’s favorite clothes are her frilly pink dresses.| 公主最喜欢的衣服就是她的粉色荷叶边裙子。[/EX][EX] She had to take off her frilly pink dress to become the Princess in Black.| 她必须脱下粉色荷叶边裙子，才能变身成黑衣公主。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] frilly skirt/bonnet | 荷叶边裙子 / 荷叶边软帽 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The little princess wore a frilly bonnet on her head.| 小公主头上戴着一顶荷叶边软帽。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] frilly clothes | 荷叶边衣服 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] All her princess clothes are frilly clothes with bright colors.| 她所有的公主裙都是色彩鲜艳的荷叶边衣服。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She sewed some lace on the frilly dress to make it more beautiful.| 她在荷叶边裙子上缝了些蕾丝，让它变得更漂亮。[/EX][EX] The frilly sleeves of the dress are a little too long for her.| 这条裙子的荷叶边袖子对她来说有点太长了。[/EX][EX] She didn’t like wearing frilly clothes when she was fighting monsters.| 她打怪兽的时候，一点也不喜欢穿荷叶边衣服。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] frilly 的比较级是 frillier，最高级是 frilliest，需变 y 为 i 加 - er/-est，不要写成 more frilly/most frilly（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 注意拼写：frilly 是双 l 加 y，不要漏写一个 l（错误：frily），正确拼写为 frilly。[/ERR][ERR] frilly 是形容词，不要误用作名词（错误：the frilly of the dress），正确：the frilly dress（荷叶边裙子）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A small stone that shines and sparkles; a decorative stone with glitter, used to make jewelry or ornaments (used in The Princess in Black, as the material of the monster alarm ring and horseshoe)[/EN][CN] 闪光石；镶闪石的（能闪闪发光的小石头；带有闪粉的装饰石，用于制作首饰或饰品，出自《黑衣公主》，是怪兽警报戒指和马蹄铁的制作材料）[/CN][POS] n.（复合名词）[/POS][PH]/ˈɡlɪtə stəʊn/（英式）/ˈɡlɪtər stoʊn/（美式）[/PH][DU] Just then, Princess Magnolia’s glitter-stone ring rang.|(原文例句) 就在这时，玛格诺莉亚公主的闪光石戒指响了。[/DU] [DU] Frimplepants’s glitter-stone horse shoe rang. The monster alarm!|(原文例句) 弗林普潘茨的闪光石马蹄铁响了，是怪兽警报！[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/glitter-stone.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] glitter-stone ring | 闪光石戒指 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The glitter-stone ring is the princess’s monster alarm and her secret tool.| 闪光石戒指是公主的怪兽警报，也是她的秘密工具。[/EX][EX] The glitter-stone ring rang loudly when the monster came out of the hole.| 怪兽从洞里出来时，闪光石戒指大声响了起来。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] glitter-stone horse shoe | 闪光石马蹄铁 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The glitter-stone horse shoe is the unicorn’s monster alarm too.| 闪光石马蹄铁也是这只独角兽的怪兽警报。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] glitter-stone jewelry | 闪光石首饰 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess has a lot of glitter-stone jewelry in her castle.| 公主的城堡里有许多闪光石首饰。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She made a small necklace with a glitter-stone for her pony.| 她用一颗闪光石给她的小马做了一条小项链。[/EX][EX] The glitter-stone on the ring sparkled in the sunlight.| 戒指上的闪光石在阳光下闪闪发光。[/EX][EX] The glitter-stone horse shoe would ring when monsters were coming.| 怪兽要来的时候，闪光石马蹄铁就会响。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] glitter-stone 是复合名词，规范写法带连字符，不要分开写（错误：glitter stone），作定语时也需保留连字符（glitter-stone ring）。[/ERR][ERR] glitter-stone 是可数名词，复数形式是 glitter-stones，不要说 many glitter-stone（错误），正确：many glitter-stones。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 glitter-stone 和 diamond！glitter-stone 是普通的闪光装饰石；diamond 是钻石，质地坚硬且珍贵，二者价值和材质不同。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To walk with small, quick steps, in a way that is typical of a prim and proper princess; to cut food into very small pieces (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, describing Princess Magnolia’s walking way)[/EN][CN] 小步快走；迈碎步（迈着小巧、快速的步子走，是端庄得体的公主的典型走路方式；将食物切成碎末，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，形容玛格诺莉亚公主的走路姿态）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/mɪns/（英美）[/PH][DU] Princess Magnolia minced to the door.|(原文例句) 玛格诺莉亚公主迈着碎步走向门口。[/DU][DU] Her glass slippers went tink-tink-tink-tink as she minced to the door.| 她迈着碎步走向门口，玻璃鞋发出叮叮叮的声响。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/mince.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] mince to the door | 迈着碎步走向门口 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She had to mince to the door to keep her princess image.| 为了维持公主的形象，她不得不迈着碎步走向门口。[/EX][EX] The little girl minced to her mother with a small gift in her hand.| 小女孩手里拿着小礼物，迈着碎步走向妈妈。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] mince across/along sp | 迈着碎步穿过 / 沿着某地走 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She minced across the ballroom to greet the guests.| 她迈着碎步穿过舞厅，去迎接宾客。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] mince meat/vegetables | 把肉 / 蔬菜切成碎末 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The cook would mince meat to make dumplings for the princess.| 厨师会把肉切成碎末，给公主做饺子。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] She stopped mincing and ran as fast as she could when no one was looking.| 没人看见的时候，她不再迈碎步，而是拼命地跑。[/EX][EX] The cat minced along the wall, afraid of the big dog.| 小猫沿着墙迈着小碎步走，害怕那只大狗。[/EX][EX] He taught his daughter how to mince carrots for the salad.| 他教女儿如何把胡萝卜切成碎末做沙拉。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] mince 作 “迈碎步” 时是不及物动词，后接地点需加介词（to/across/along），不要直接接宾语（错误：mince the door），正确：mince to the door。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 mince 的两个含义，结合语境区分：描述走路时是 “迈碎步”；描述食物时是 “切碎”。[/ERR][ERR] mince 的过去式和过去分词是 minced，不要加 ed 以外的后缀（错误：mincinged），正确：She minced to the door and then ran away。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A slipper made of glass, a typical shoe for a fairy-tale princess; a delicate glass shoe (used in Chapter 1 of The Princess in Black, Princess Magnolia’s princess shoes that make tinkling sounds)[/EN][CN] 玻璃鞋；水晶鞋（用玻璃做的拖鞋，是童话公主的经典鞋子；精致的玻璃鞋子，出自《黑衣公主》第一章，是玛格诺莉亚公主的公主鞋，走路会发出叮叮的声响）[/CN][POS] n.（名词短语）[/POS][PH]/ɡlɑːs ˈslɪpə(r)/（英式）/ɡlæ sˈslɪpər/（美式）[/PH][DU] Her glass slippers went tink-tink-tink-tink.|(原文例句) 她的玻璃鞋发出叮叮叮叮的声响。[/DU][DU] No one would suspect a girl in glass slippers to be a monster fighter.|(原文例句) 没人会怀疑一个穿着玻璃鞋的女孩是打怪兽的勇士。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/glass slipper.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] wear glass slippers | 穿着玻璃鞋 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Princess Magnolia had to wear glass slippers to keep her princess look.| 玛格诺莉亚公主必须穿着玻璃鞋，维持她的公主模样。[/EX][EX] She took off her glass slippers before sliding down the secret chute.| 她滑下秘密滑道前，脱掉了她的玻璃鞋。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a pair of glass slippers | 一双玻璃鞋 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess has a beautiful pair of glass slippers in her closet.| 公主的衣橱里有一双漂亮的玻璃鞋。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the sound of glass slippers | 玻璃鞋的声响 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The duchess heard the sound of glass slippers from the hallway.| 女公爵听到走廊里传来玻璃鞋的声响。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The glass slippers sparkled like stars in the castle’s light.| 玻璃鞋在城堡的灯光下像星星一样闪闪发光。[/EX][EX] She didn’t want to wear glass slippers when she was galloping on her pony.| 她骑着小马飞奔的时候，一点也不想穿玻璃鞋。[/EX][EX] A girl in glass slippers is the last person people would think of as a hero.| 穿着玻璃鞋的女孩，是人们最不会想到的英雄。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] glass slipper 是名词短语，复数形式是 glass slippers，只需给 slipper 加 s，不要写成 glass slipperes（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] 规范写法为分开写的 glass slipper，不要连写（错误：glassslipper），作定语时可写 glass-slipper（如 glass-slipper sound）。[/ERR][ERR] glass slipper 表 “玻璃鞋” 时，常用 a pair of 修饰，不要单独说 a glass slipper（虽语法正确，但不符合童话和原文的表达习惯）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To push or put something into a small space quickly and carelessly; to fill a space with something (used in Chapter 2 of The Princess in Black, describing hiding the princess dress)[/EN][CN] 把…… 塞进；胡乱填满（快速、随意地把东西推进或放进小空间里；用某物填满某个空间，出自《黑衣公主》第二章，形容藏公主裙的动作）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/stʌf/（英美）[/PH][DU] Princesses do not stuff frilly pink dresses into broom closets.|(原文例句) 公主们可不会把粉色荷叶边裙子塞进扫帚间。[/DU][DU] She had to stuff her princess dress into the closet and put on her black clothes.| 她不得不把公主裙塞进衣橱，换上黑色的衣服。[/DU][/DEF] [IMG] infopic01/stuff.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] stuff sth into sp | 把某物塞进某地 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She had to stuff her glass slippers into a box before becoming the Princess in Black.| 变身黑衣公主前，她不得不把玻璃鞋塞进盒子里。[/EX][EX] He stuffed the popcorn into his mouth while watching the monster battle.| 他一边看怪兽大战，一边把爆米花塞进嘴里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] stuff sth with sth | 用某物填满某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She stuffed the bag with her black clothes and scepter.| 她把黑色的衣服和权杖塞进了包里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] stuff (n.)| 东西；物品（口语）[POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] There are a lot of strange stuff in the princess’s broom closet.| 公主的扫帚间里有许多奇怪的东西。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Don’t stuff too many books into your schoolbag—it’s too heavy.| 别往书包里塞太多书，太重了。[/EX][EX] He stuffed the letter into his pocket and ran out of the room.| 他把信塞进口袋，跑出了房间。[/EX][EX] The box is stuffed with all kinds of princess jewelry.| 这个盒子里塞满了各种各样的公主首饰。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] stuff 作动词 “塞进” 时是及物动词，stuff into 是固定搭配，不要漏掉 into（错误：stuff the dress the closet），正确：stuff the dress into the closet。[/ERR][ERR] stuff 的过去式和过去分词是 stuffed，无需双写 f，不要写成 stufffed（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] stuff 作不可数名词 “东西” 时，不要加 s（错误：stuffs），正确：There is a lot of stuff in the room。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A small closet or room where brooms, mops and other cleaning tools are kept; Princess Magnolia’s secret place to change into the Princess in Black (used in Chapter 2 of The Princess in Black, the hidden chute entrance)[/EN][CN] 扫帚间；杂物间（存放扫帚、拖把和其他清洁工具的小储藏室；玛格诺莉亚公主变身黑衣公主的秘密地点，出自《黑衣公主》第二章，是秘密滑道的入口）[/CN][POS] n.（名词短语）[/POS][PH]/bruːm ˈklɒzɪt/（英式）/bruːm ˈklɑːzɪt/（美式）[/PH][DU] Princesses do not stuff frilly pink dresses into broom closets.|(原文例句) 公主们可不会把粉色荷叶边裙子塞进扫帚间。[/DU][DU] The tunnel ended in the broom closet.|(原文例句) 那条秘密通道的尽头就是扫帚间。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/broom closet.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] stuff sth into the broom closet | 把某物塞进扫帚间 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Princess Magnolia stuffed her pink dress into the broom closet quickly.| 玛格诺莉亚公主迅速把她的粉色裙子塞进了扫帚间。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] in the broom closet | 在扫帚间里 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The duchess found a pair of black stockings in the broom closet.| 女公爵在扫帚间里发现了一双黑色长袜。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the entrance of the broom closet | 扫帚间的入口 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The secret chute’s entrance is at the back of the broom closet.| 秘密滑道的入口在扫帚间的深处。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] No one was allowed to enter the broom closet in Princess Magnolia’s castle.| 玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡里，没人被允许进入那个扫帚间。[/EX][EX] She emerged from the broom closet as the Princess in Black, ready to fight monsters.| 她从扫帚间出来，变身成黑衣公主，准备迎战怪兽。[/EX][EX] The broom closet looked ordinary, but it had a secret chute inside.| 这个扫帚间看起来平平无奇，里面却有一条秘密滑道。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] broom closet 是名词短语，规范写法分开写，不要连写（错误：broomcloset），作定语时可加连字符（broom-closet door）。[/ERR][ERR] broom closet 是可数名词，复数形式是 broom closets，不要说 many broom closet（错误），正确：many broom closets。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 broom closet 和 storage room！broom closet 是小型的、专门放清洁工具的储藏室；storage room 是大型的、存放各类物品的储藏室，空间更大。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A narrow, steep passage that things or people can slide down; a secret slide in Princess Magnolia’s castle (used in Chapter 2 of The Princess in Black, the secret passage to the courtyard)[/EN][CN] 滑道；滑槽；滑筒（供人或物滑下的狭窄陡峭通道；玛格诺莉亚公主城堡里的秘密滑筒，出自《黑衣公主》第二章，是通往庭院的秘密通道）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ʃuːt/（英美）[/PH][DU] And princesses most definitely do not slide down secret chutes and highjump castle walls.|(原文例句) 公主们当然更不会滑下秘密滑道，跳过高高的城墙。[/DU][DU] She crawled up the secret chute. Going up was much slower than going down.|(原文例句) 她爬上了秘密滑道，往上爬可比往下滑慢多了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/chute.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] secret chute | 秘密滑道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The secret chute in the castle leads straight to the courtyard.| 城堡里的秘密滑道直通庭院。[/EX][EX] Only Princess Magnolia knew where the secret chute was.| 只有玛格诺莉亚公主知道秘密滑道在哪里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] slide down a chute | 滑下滑道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She would slide down the secret chute to meet her pony Blacky.| 她会滑下秘密滑道，去见她的小马小黑。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] crawl up a chute | 爬上滑道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] It was hard for her to crawl up the chute with her black clothes on.| 她穿着黑色的衣服，爬上滑道很费劲。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] There were some spiders and bats in the secret chute, but she was not afraid.| 秘密滑道里有几只蜘蛛和蝙蝠，但她一点也不害怕。[/EX][EX] The chute was dark and narrow, but it was the fastest way to the courtyard.| 这条滑道又黑又窄，却是到庭院最快的路。[/EX][EX] She held on to the side of the chute to slow down when sliding down.| 她滑下滑道时，抓着滑道边缘减速。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] chute 是可数名词，复数形式是 chutes，不要说 many chute（错误），正确：many chutes。[/ERR][ERR] 注意拼写和词义区分：不要和 shoot 混淆！chute 是 /ʃuːt/（滑道），名词；shoot 是 /ʃuːt/（射击、发射），动词 / 名词，二者同音不同形不同义。[/ERR][ERR] chute 前常用冠词 a/the，不要单独使用（错误：slide down chute），正确：slide down the chute。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To jump high over something; the sport of jumping as high as possible over a bar (used in Chapter 2 of The Princess in Black, describing Princess Magnolia’s action to leave the castle)[/EN][CN] 跳过高；跳高（高高地跳过某物；越过横杆跳得尽可能高的运动，出自《黑衣公主》第二章，形容玛格诺莉亚公主离开城堡的动作）[/CN][POS] v./n.（复合词）[/POS][PH]/ˈhaɪdʒʌmp/（英美）[/PH][DU] And princesses most definitely do not slide down secret chutes and highjump castle walls.|(原文例句) 公主们当然更不会滑下秘密滑道，跳过高高的城墙。[/DU][DU] The Princess in Black high-jumped the castle wall and landed on Blacky’s back.|(原文例句) 黑衣公主跳过高高的城墙，落在了小黑的背上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/highjump.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] highjump the castle wall | 跳过高高的城墙 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] She could highjump the castle wall easily when she was the Princess in Black.| 变身黑衣公主后，她能轻松地跳过高高的城墙。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] highjump a fence/bar | 跳过栅栏 / 横杆 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The pony Blacky could highjump a fence to run into the forest.| 小马小黑能跳过栅栏，跑进森林里。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] do a highjump | 跳高；跳一下高跳 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] She did a highjump and landed lightly on the grass.| 她跳了一个高跳，轻轻落在了草地上。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The Princess in Black can highjump any wall in the castle with her ninja skills.| 黑衣公主靠着她的忍者技能，能跳过城堡里的任何一道墙。[/EX][EX] He practiced to highjump the big stone to meet the princess.| 他练习跳过大石头，去见公主。[/EX][EX] The monster was too big to highjump the small hole back to Monster Land.| 这只怪兽太大了，跳不回怪兽之地的那个小洞。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] highjump 作动词时，过去式和过去分词是highjumped，无需双写 p，不要写成 highjumpped（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] highjump 是复合词，可连写（highjump）也可加连字符（high-jump），不要分开写（错误：high jump）作动词，分开写多作名词（the high jump）。[/ERR][ERR] highjump 作动词时是及物动词，直接接被跳过的事物（错误：highjump over the wall），无需加 over，正确：highjump the wall。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] An open area of ground surrounded by the walls of a castle or building, usually with a paved or grassy surface; the open space in Princess Magnolia’s castle (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, where Frimplepants was nibbling an apple)[/EN][CN] 庭院；院子（被城堡或建筑的墙壁环绕的露天空地，通常铺有地砖或长有青草；玛格诺莉亚公主城堡里的露天场地，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，弗林普潘茨在这儿啃苹果）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkɔːtjɑːd/（英式）/ˈkɔːrtjɑːrd/（美式）[/PH][DU] In the courtyard, Frimplepants was nibbling an apple.|(原文例句) 在庭院里，弗林普潘茨正啃着一个苹果。[/DU][DU] The secret passage in the castle leads from the broom closet to the courtyard.| 城堡里的秘密通道从扫帚间通往庭院。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/courtyard.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] in the courtyard | 在庭院里 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess’s pony waited for her in the courtyard every time the monster alarm rang.| 每次怪兽警报响起，公主的小马都会在庭院里等她。[/EX][EX] We saw a unicorn nibbling an apple in the castle’s courtyard.| 我们看到一只独角兽在城堡的庭院里啃苹果。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] castle courtyard | 城堡庭院 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The castle courtyard is a quiet place with green grass and beautiful flowers.| 城堡庭院是个安静的地方，长着青草，开着漂亮的花。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] walk in the courtyard | 在庭院里散步 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Duchess Wigtower wanted to walk in the courtyard when she toured the castle.| 维格塔女公爵参观城堡时，想在庭院里散散步。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The children played with a ball in the big courtyard of the palace.| 孩子们在宫殿的大庭院里玩球。[/EX][EX] A small fountain stands in the middle of the castle courtyard.| 城堡庭院的中央立着一座小喷泉。[/EX][EX] She met her faithful pony in the courtyard before charging into the forest.| 她在庭院里见到了忠实的小马，然后冲进了森林。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] courtyard 是可数名词，复数形式是 courtyards，不要说 many courtyard（错误），正确：many courtyards。[/ERR][ERR] 表示 “在庭院里” 用介词 in，不要用 on（错误：on the courtyard），正确：in the courtyard。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 courtyard 和 garden！courtyard 是建筑环绕的露天空地，多为硬地或短草；garden 是专门种植花草的花园，侧重绿植景观。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To eat something in small, gentle bites; to take tiny mouthfuls of food (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing Frimplepants eating an apple)[/EN][CN] 小口咬；啃；一点点地吃（用小巧、轻柔的咬动吃东西；小口小口地进食，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容弗林普潘茨吃苹果的样子）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈnɪbl/（英美）[/PH][DU] In the courtyard, Frimplepants was nibbling an apple.|(原文例句) 在庭院里，弗林普潘茨正小口啃着一个苹果。[/DU][DU] Duff nibbled some popcorn while watching the Princess in Black battle the monster.|(原文例句) 达夫一边看黑衣公主和怪兽战斗，一边小口吃着爆米花。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/nibble.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] nibble an apple | 小口啃苹果 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The unicorn nibbled an apple and pranced on its golden hooves in the courtyard.| 独角兽在庭院里小口啃着苹果，迈着金蹄腾跃。[/EX][EX] She likes to nibble an apple as a snack in the afternoon.| 她喜欢下午小口啃苹果当点心。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] nibble at sth | 小口咬某物；慢慢啃某物 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The goat nibbled at the grass by the fence of the pasture.| 山羊在牧场的围栏边小口啃着草。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] nibble some popcorn | 小口吃爆米花 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The boy nibbled some popcorn while watching the cartoon.| 小男孩看动画片时，小口吃着爆米花。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The rabbit nibbled the carrot until there was nothing left.| 兔子小口啃着胡萝卜，直到啃得一干二净。[/EX][EX] She nibbled at a cookie and drank a cup of hot chocolate.| 她小口咬着饼干，喝着一杯热巧克力。[/EX][EX] The pony nibbled the grass in the courtyard after returning from the forest.| 小马从森林回来后，在庭院里小口啃着草。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] nibble 的过去式和过去分词是 nibbled，无需双写 l，不要写成 nibbledd（错误）。[/ERR][ERR] nibble 作动词表 “啃食” 时，后接具体食物可直接用 nibble sth，接表示食物的介词短语用 nibble at sth，不要漏用 at（错误：nibble the grass），二者均可，nibble at 更侧重 “轻轻啃”。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 nibble 和 bite！nibble 是 “小口、轻柔地咬”；bite 是 “用力咬、啃”，动作幅度更大，如 nibble a cake /bite a sandwich。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To walk or move with quick, lively steps, lifting the feet high; to move in a proud, playful way (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing Frimplepants’s movement on golden hooves)[/EN][CN] 腾跃；昂首阔步；欢快地蹦跳（迈着轻快、活泼的步子走或移动，抬脚很高；以骄傲、嬉戏的方式走动，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容弗林普潘茨踩着金蹄的样子）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/prɑːns/（英式）/præns/（美式）[/PH][DU] He pranced on his golden hooves.|(原文例句) 他踩着金色的蹄子昂首腾跃。[/DU][DU] The pony pranced around the courtyard when it saw the Princess in Black.| 小马见到黑衣公主后，在庭院里欢快地蹦跳。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/prance.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] prance on hooves | 踩着蹄子腾跃 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The unicorn pranced on its golden hooves and swished its sparkly tail.| 独角兽踩着金蹄腾跃，甩动着闪亮的尾巴。[/EX][EX] The horse pranced on its strong hooves when it heard the call of its master.| 马儿听到主人的呼唤，踩着健壮的蹄子腾跃。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] prance around sp | 在某地四处蹦跳 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The little dog pranced around the garden when it got a new toy.| 小狗得到新玩具后，在花园里四处蹦跳。[/EX][EX] The pony pranced around the courtyard before charging into the forest.| 小马在庭院里四处蹦跳，然后冲进了森林。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] prance forward | 欢快地向前蹦跳 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The faithful pony pranced forward to meet the Princess in Black.| 忠实的小马欢快地向前蹦跳，迎接黑衣公主。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The children pranced around the room when they heard the good news.| 孩子们听到好消息后，在房间里欢快地蹦跳。[/EX][EX] The peacock pranced about the lawn, showing off its beautiful tail.| 孔雀在草坪上昂首阔步，炫耀着它漂亮的尾巴。[/EX][EX] She pranced into the ballroom in her new frilly dress.| 她穿着新的荷叶边裙子，欢快地蹦跳着走进舞厅。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] prance 的过去式和过去分词是 pranced，无需双写 n，不要写成 prannced（错误），正确：pranced。[/ERR][ERR] prance 是不及物动词，后接地点需加介词（around/on/in），不要直接接宾语（错误：prance the courtyard），正确：prance around the courtyard。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 prance 和 skip！prance 侧重 “抬脚高、骄傲或欢快的蹦跳”，多形容动物或骄傲的人；skip 侧重 “轻快的小步跳”，多形容孩子。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A mythical animal that looks like a white horse with a single long, pointed horn on its forehead; Frimplepants’s disguise in the castle (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, a fake unicorn that turns into a pony)[/EN][CN] 独角兽（神话中的动物，形似白马，前额有一只长长的尖角；弗林普潘茨在城堡里的伪装，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，是能变成小马的假独角兽）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈjuːnɪkɔːn/（英式）/ˈjuːnɪkɔːrn/（美式）[/PH][DU] Clearly, Frimplepants was a unicorn. Or was he?|(原文例句) 很明显，弗林普潘茨是一只独角兽。可他真的是吗？[/DU][DU] The unicorn’s horn lifted off, and it turned into a faithful black pony.| 这只独角兽的角摘了下来，变成了一匹忠实的小黑马。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/unicorn.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a fake unicorn | 假独角兽 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Frimplepants was a fake unicorn in the castle, and his real identity was Blacky the pony.| 弗林普潘茨是城堡里的假独角兽，他的真实身份是小马小黑。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a unicorn with a golden horn | 长着金角的独角兽 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The children drew a unicorn with a golden horn and a sparkly mane.| 孩子们画了一只长着金角、有着闪亮鬃毛的独角兽。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] disguise as a unicorn | 伪装成独角兽 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The pony disguised as a unicorn to stay with the Princess in the castle.| 这匹小马伪装成独角兽，在城堡里陪伴公主。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] Unicorns are popular mythical animals in fairy tales for little girls.| 独角兽是小女孩童话里很受欢迎的神话动物。[/EX][EX] The fake unicorn nibbled an apple and pranced in the castle courtyard every day.| 这只假独角兽每天都在城堡庭院里啃苹果、腾跃。[/EX][EX] No one in the castle knew the pretty unicorn was actually a pony in disguise.| 城堡里没人知道这只漂亮的独角兽其实是一匹伪装的小马。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] unicorn 是可数名词，复数形式是 unicorns；其发音以辅音音素/j/开头，英美通用**a unicorn**，不要误写an unicorn（传统英式偶用，现不推荐）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要将 unicorn 拼写错误，注意是 uni-+corn，不要写成 unicornn/unicron。[/ERR][ERR] unicorn 是神话动物，描述书中的角色时要注意区分fake unicorn（假独角兽）和 mythical unicorn（神话独角兽），避免语境混淆。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A narrow way through a building or wall; a secret path that leads from one place to another (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, the path Frimplepants took to change his form)[/EN][CN] 通道；走廊；暗道（穿过建筑或墙壁的狭窄小路；连接一个地方到另一个地方的秘密小路，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，弗林普潘茨变身时走的小路）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpæsɪdʒ/（英美）[/PH][DU] No one was watching. So Frimplepants entered a secret passage.|(原文例句) 没人看见，于是弗林普潘茨走进了一条秘密通道。[/DU][DU] The secret passage in the castle led the unicorn to a place where he could turn into a pony.| 城堡里的秘密通道，把这只独角兽带到了他能变身成小马的地方。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/passage2.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] a secret passage | 秘密通道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Only Frimplepants and the Princess knew where the secret passage in the castle was.| 只有弗林普潘茨和公主知道城堡里的秘密通道在哪里。[/EX][EX] The secret passage was hidden behind a wall in the castle courtyard.| 秘密通道藏在城堡庭院的一面墙后。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] enter a passage | 走进通道 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The pony entered the secret passage and came out as a unicorn minutes later.| 这匹小马走进秘密通道，几分钟后变成独角兽走了出来。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a narrow passage | 狭窄的通道 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The narrow passage connected the broom closet to the castle courtyard.| 这条狭窄的通道连接着扫帚间和城堡庭院。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] We found a dark passage behind the bookshelf in the castle tower.| 我们在城堡塔楼的书架后，发现了一条黑暗的通道。[/EX][EX] The secret passage was small, so only the pony and the princess could walk through it.| 秘密通道很小，只有小马和公主能走过去。[/EX][EX] He walked through the passage and saw his faithful pony waiting for him outside.| 他走过通道，看到忠实的小马在外面等他。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] passage 是可数名词，复数形式是 passages，不要说 many passage（错误），正确：many passages。[/ERR][ERR] 表示 “走进通道” 用 enter a passage 或 walk through a passage，不要用 walk in a passage（错误），in 侧重 “在通道里”，through 侧重 “穿过通道”。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 passage 和 path！passage 多指建筑内部、墙壁中的狭窄通道；path 多指户外的小路、小径，如 a secret passage in the castle /a small path in the forest。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] The long thick hair growing on the neck of a horse, unicorn, or lion; the sparkly hair on Frimplepants’s neck (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, part of Frimplepants’s unicorn disguise)[/EN][CN] 鬃毛（马、独角兽或狮子等动物颈部生长的又长又密的毛发；弗林普潘茨颈部的闪亮毛发，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，是他独角兽伪装的一部分）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/meɪn/（英美）[/PH][DU] Sparkly mane and tail shook free.|(原文例句) 闪亮的鬃毛和尾巴舒展开来。[/DU][DU] The unicorn’s sparkly mane fell off when he turned into a black pony.| 这只独角兽变身成小黑马时，闪亮的鬃毛就掉了下来。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/mane1.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] sparkly mane | 闪亮的鬃毛 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] Frimplepants had a sparkly mane as a unicorn, and it was part of his disguise.| 弗林普潘茨作为独角兽，有一头闪亮的鬃毛，这是他伪装的一部分。[/EX][EX] The little girl drew a unicorn with a sparkly golden mane on the paper.| 小女孩在纸上画了一只长着闪亮金鬃毛的独角兽。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] the mane of a pony/unicorn | 小马/独角兽的鬃毛 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The mane of the black pony was short and black, very different from the unicorn’s sparkly one.| 小黑马的鬃毛又短又黑，和独角兽那闪亮的鬃毛大不相同。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] shake one’s mane | 甩动鬃毛 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The unicorn shook its mane and pranced on its golden hooves in the courtyard.| 独角兽甩动鬃毛，在庭院里踩着金蹄腾跃。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The horse’s brown mane flowed in the wind when it galloped through the forest.| 马儿飞奔穿过森林时，棕色的鬃毛在风中飘动。[/EX][EX] She stroked the pony’s soft mane and patted its head gently.| 她抚摸着小马柔软的鬃毛，轻轻拍了拍它的头。[/EX][EX] The lion’s thick mane made it look very powerful in the zoo.| 动物园里，狮子浓密的鬃毛让它看起来威风凛凛。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] mane 表“整体鬃毛”时为不可数名词，表“一缕鬃毛”用a lock of mane，不要单独说a mane（易产生歧义）。[/ERR][ERR] 注意发音：/meɪn/，和 main（主要的）同音，不要读成 /mæn/（错误），避免发音混淆。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 mane 和 fur！mane 特指动物颈部的长鬃毛；fur 是动物全身的皮毛，如 the unicorn’s sparkly mane /the pony’s black fur。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] Loyal and reliable; always staying with and supporting someone (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing Blacky the pony’s attitude to the Princess in Black)[/EN][CN] 忠实的；忠诚的；可靠的（始终陪伴、支持某人，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容小马小黑对黑衣公主的态度）[/CN][POS] adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈfeɪθfl/（英美）[/PH][DU] He came out the other side. He was no longer Frimplepants the unicorn. He was Blacky, the Princess in Black’s faithful pony!|(原文例句) 他从通道另一头走出来，不再是弗林普潘茨独角兽，而是黑衣公主忠实的小马小黑！[/DU][DU] The faithful pony always followed the Princess in Black to fight monsters.| 这匹忠实的小马总是跟着黑衣公主去打怪兽。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/faithful.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] faithful pony | 忠实的小马 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] Blacky is the Princess in Black’s faithful pony and her best friend in fighting monsters.| 小黑是黑衣公主忠实的小马，也是她打怪兽时最好的伙伴。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] faithful friend | 忠实的朋友 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess has a few faithful friends who know her secret identity.| 公主有几个忠实的朋友，他们知道她的秘密身份。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] be faithful to sb | 对某人忠诚 [POS] adj.[/POS][/H][EX] The faithful pony is always faithful to the Princess in Black, no matter what happens.| 无论发生什么，这匹忠实的小马都始终对黑衣公主忠心耿耿。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The dog is a faithful animal and always stays with its owner.| 狗是一种忠实的动物，总是陪伴着主人。[/EX][EX] She is a faithful reader of the Princess in Black series of books.| 她是《黑衣公主》系列书籍的忠实读者。[/EX][EX] The faithful pony galloped with the princess through the forest to the goat pasture.| 忠实的小马载着公主，飞奔穿过森林来到山羊牧场。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] faithful 的副词形式是 faithfully，不要写成 faithfuly（错误），需双写l加y，正确：She followed her master faithfully。[/ERR][ERR] faithful 是形容词，修饰名词时放于其前，不要放于其后（错误：pony faithful），正确：faithful pony。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 faithful 和 loyal！faithful 侧重 “始终陪伴、不离不弃的忠实”，多形容宠物、朋友；loyal 侧重 “对信念、国家、主人的忠诚”，语气更正式，如 a faithful pony /a loyal soldier。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A small horse; Blacky, the Princess in Black’s loyal animal friend who helps her fight monsters (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, Frimplepants’s real identity)[/EN][CN] 小马；矮马（黑衣公主忠诚的动物伙伴小黑，帮她一起打怪兽，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，是弗林普潘茨的真实身份）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpəʊni/（英式）/ˈpoʊni/（美式）[/PH][DU] He was Blacky, the Princess in Black’s faithful pony!|(原文例句) 他是黑衣公主忠实的小马小黑！[/DU][DU] The black pony galloped into the goat pasture with the Princess in Black on its back.| 小黑马载着黑衣公主，飞奔进了山羊牧场。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/pony.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] faithful pony | 忠实的小马 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The faithful pony is the Princess in Black’s most important helper in stopping monsters.| 这匹忠实的小马是黑衣公主阻止怪兽时最重要的帮手。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] black pony | 小黑马 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The black pony’s real disguise in the castle is a sparkly unicorn.| 这匹小黑马在城堡里的伪装，是一只闪亮的独角兽。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] ride a pony | 骑小马 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The Princess in Black rode her pony and charged through the forest to the goat pasture.| 黑衣公主骑着小马，冲过森林来到山羊牧场。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The little girl learned to ride a pony in the countryside during the holiday.| 小女孩假期在乡下学会了骑小马。[/EX][EX] The pony neighed loudly to warn the princess that the monster was coming.| 小马大声嘶鸣，提醒公主怪兽来了。[/EX][EX] After the battle, the princess patted her pony’s head and fed it an apple.| 战斗结束后，公主拍了拍小马的头，喂了它一个苹果。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] pony 是可数名词，复数形式是 ponies，需变 y 为 i 加 es，不要写成 ponys（错误），正确：many ponies。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 pony 和 horse！pony 是体型矮小的小马，多为儿童骑乘或作为伙伴；horse 是体型较大的马，可用于骑行、劳作等，如 a small pony /a big horse。[/ERR][ERR] 表示 “骑小马” 用 ride a pony，不要用 ride on a pony（错误，虽可理解，但规范用法是直接 ride a pony）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To fly or rise high in the air; to move quickly and smoothly over something (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing the Princess in Black jumping over the castle wall)[/EN][CN] 翱翔；高飞；腾空跃过（在空中高飞；快速平稳地跃过某物，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容黑衣公主跳过高高的城墙）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/sɔː(r)/（英式）/sɔːr/（美式）[/PH][DU] Just then, the Princess in Black was soaring over the castle wall. She landed on Blacky’s back.|(原文例句) 就在这时，黑衣公主腾空跃过城墙，落在了小黑的背上。[/DU][DU] The birds soar high in the sky when they see the pony charging through the forest.| 鸟儿看到小马冲过森林时，便在天空中高飞。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/soar.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] soar over the castle wall | 腾空跃过城墙 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The Princess in Black can soar over the castle wall easily with her ninja skills.| 黑衣公主靠着她的忍者技能，能轻松地腾空跃过城墙。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] soar into the sky | 飞向天空；翱翔在天空 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Eagles soar into the sky and look for food on the ground.| 老鹰翱翔在天空，寻找地上的食物。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] soar over the forest | 飞跃森林 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess soared over the forest and landed on her pony’s back.| 公主飞跃森林，落在了她的小马背上。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The airplane soared high in the blue sky and flew to the far city.| 飞机在蓝天上高飞，飞向遥远的城市。[/EX][EX] She soared over the fence and ran to the other side of the field.| 她腾空跃过栅栏，跑到了田野的另一边。[/EX][EX] The kite soared in the wind, and the children laughed happily.| 风筝在风中高飞，孩子们笑得很开心。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] soar 的过去式和过去分词是 soared，无需双写 r，不要写成 soarrd（错误），正确：soared。[/ERR][ERR] soar 是不及物动词，后接地点需加介词（over/into/above），不要直接接宾语（错误：soar the wall），正确：soar over the wall。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 soar 和 fly！soar 侧重 “无动力地高飞、滑翔或腾空跃过”；fly 侧重 “依靠翅膀或工具主动飞行”，如 the princess soared over the wall /birds fly in the sky。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To move forward quickly and bravely; to rush forward with force (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing the Princess and Blacky moving through the forest)[/EN][CN] 猛冲；冲锋；疾驰（快速勇敢地向前移动；用力向前冲，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容公主和小黑穿过森林的样子）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/tʃɑːdʒ/（英式）/tʃɑːrdʒ/（美式）[/PH][DU] They charged through the forest.|(原文例句) 他们猛冲穿过森林。[/DU][DU] The faithful pony charged toward the goat pasture with the princess on its back.| 忠实的小马载着公主，朝山羊牧场疾驰而去。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/charge.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] charge through the forest | 猛冲穿过森林 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The Princess in Black and her pony charged through the forest to save the goats.| 黑衣公主和她的小马猛冲穿过森林，去拯救山羊。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] charge toward sp | 朝某地疾驰/冲去 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The pony charged toward the big blue monster to help the princess.| 小马朝蓝色大怪兽冲去，去帮助公主。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] charge at sb/sth | 向某人/某物冲去 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The dog charged at the stranger who came to the door.| 小狗朝走到门口的陌生人冲去。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The soldiers charged forward and fought with the enemy bravely.| 士兵们向前冲锋，勇敢地和敌人战斗。[/EX][EX] The children charged into the park when the gate opened.| 大门打开时，孩子们冲进了公园。[/EX][EX] After soaring over the wall, they charged through the forest to the goat pasture.| 腾空跃过城墙后，他们猛冲穿过森林，来到了山羊牧场。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] charge 作动词 “猛冲” 时是不及物动词，后接地点需加介词（through/toward/at），不要直接接宾语（错误：charge the forest），正确：charge through the forest。[/ERR][ERR] charge 的过去式和过去分词是 charged，无需双写 g，不要写成 charrged（错误），正确：charged。[/ERR][ERR] 注意 charge 的多义，不要和 “收费；指控” 混淆，结合语境区分：描述动作时是 “猛冲”；描述交易时是 “收费”；描述法律时是 “指控”，如 charge through the forest /charge 10 yuan for the cake。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To make a loud, harsh noise like a parrot or a large bird; the loud cry of a bird (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing the birds’ noise when scared)[/EN][CN] 发出粗厉的叫声；嘎嘎叫（像鹦鹉或大鸟一样发出响亮、刺耳的声音；鸟类的粗厉叫声，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容鸟儿受惊时的叫声）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/skwɔːk/（英美）[/PH][DU] The birds squawked. The birds cheeped. The birds sounded nothing like a ringing ring.|(原文例句) 鸟儿们嘎嘎叫，鸟儿们吱吱鸣，这些声音和戒指的铃声一点也不像。[/DU][DU] The big bird squawked loudly when the pony charged near its nest.| 小马冲到鸟巢附近时，这只大鸟大声地嘎嘎叫。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/squawk.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] the birds squawk | 鸟儿嘎嘎叫 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The birds squawk when they see something dangerous coming near them.| 鸟儿看到危险靠近时，就会嘎嘎叫。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] squawk loudly | 大声地嘎嘎叫 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The parrot squawked loudly when someone walked into the room.| 有人走进房间时，这只鹦鹉大声地嘎嘎叫。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a loud squawk | 一声响亮的粗厉叫声 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] We heard a loud squawk from the tree and saw a big bird flying away.| 我们听到树上传来一声响亮的粗厉叫声，然后看到一只大鸟飞走了。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The seagulls squawked over the sea and looked for fish to eat.| 海鸥在海面上嘎嘎叫，寻找鱼吃。[/EX][EX] The bird squawked and flew away when the cat tried to catch it.| 小猫想抓这只鸟时，它嘎嘎叫着飞走了。[/EX][EX] All the birds squawked and cheeped when the princess and her pony charged through the forest.| 公主和她的小马猛冲穿过森林时，所有的鸟儿都嘎嘎叫、吱吱鸣。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] squawk 的过去式和过去分词是 squawked，直接加 ed，不要写成 squawkked（错误），正确：squawked。[/ERR][ERR] squawk 多用来形容大鸟的粗厉叫声，不要用来形容小鸟（小鸟用 cheep），避免语境搭配错误。[/ERR][ERR] squawk 作动词时是不及物动词，后接原因可加 at，不要直接接宾语（错误：squawk the pony），正确：squawk at the pony。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To make a soft, high-pitched noise like a small bird or a chick; the quiet cry of a baby bird (used in Chapter 3 of The Princess in Black, describing the small birds’ soft noise)[/EN][CN] 吱吱叫；啾啾鸣（像小鸟或小鸡一样发出轻柔、尖细的声音；雏鸟的轻柔叫声，出自《黑衣公主》第三章，形容小鸟的轻柔叫声）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/tʃiːp/（英美）[/PH][DU] The birds squawked. [TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] cheep 的过去式和过去分词是 cheeped，直接加 ed，不要写成 cheepped（错误），正确：cheeped。[/ERR][ERR] cheep 多用来形容小鸟/雏鸟的轻柔叫声，不要用来形容大鸟（大鸟用 squawk），避免语境搭配错误。[/ERR][ERR] 注意拼写：cheep 是 ch+ee+p，不要写成 cheap（错误），cheap 是 “便宜的”，二者同音不同形不同义。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To let saliva flow out of the mouth, usually because of hunger or wanting something very much; to slobber (used in Chapter 4 of The Princess in Black, describing the big blue monster’s reaction to the smell of goats)[/EN][CN] 流口水；垂涎（口水从嘴里流出来，通常因为饥饿或非常想要某物，出自《黑衣公主》第四章，形容蓝色大怪兽闻到山羊气味后的反应）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/druːl/（英美）[/PH][DU] The big blue monster began to drool.|(原文例句) 这只蓝色大怪兽开始流口水。[/DU][DU] The monster drooled at the smell of plump goats from the hole in the ceiling.| 怪兽闻到从天花板的洞里飘来的肥山羊的味道，开始垂涎三尺。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/drool.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] drool 的过去式和过去分词是 drooled，直接加 ed，不要写成 droolded（错误），正确：drooled。[/ERR][ERR] drool 作动词表 “因某物流口水” 时，后接介词 at/over，不要直接接宾语（错误：drool the goats），正确：drool at the goats。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 drool 和 slobber！drool 侧重 “因饥饿、渴望而流口水”；slobber 侧重 “因笨拙、年幼而口水直流”，如 the monster drools at goats /the baby slobbers on his clothes。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To come out of a dark or hidden place; to appear or become visible (used in Chapter 5 of The Princess in Black, describing the big blue monster coming out of the hole)[/EN][CN] 出现；浮现；从隐蔽处走出（从黑暗或隐蔽的地方出来；显现、变得可见，出自《黑衣公主》第五章，形容蓝色大怪兽从洞里钻出来）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/ɪˈmɜːdʒ/（英式）/ɪˈmɜːrdʒ/（美式）[/PH][DU] A blue monster emerged. [TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] emerge from sp | 从某处出现/走出 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The big blue monster emerged from the hole in the ceiling of Monster Land.| 蓝色大怪兽从怪兽之地天花板的洞里钻了出来。[/EX][EX] She emerged from the broom closet and turned back into Princess Magnolia.| 她从扫帚间走出来，变回了玛格诺莉亚公主。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] emerge into the open | 出现在开阔处 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The monster emerged into the open goat pasture and wanted to eat the goats.| 怪兽出现在开阔的山羊牧场，想要吃掉山羊。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] emerge 是不及物动词，后接地点必须加介词 from，不要直接接宾语（错误：emerge the hole），正确：emerge from the hole。[/ERR][ERR] emerge 的过去式和过去分词是 emerged，直接加 ed，不要写成 emergedd（错误），注意不要漏写 e。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 emerge 和 appear！emerge 侧重 “从隐蔽、封闭的地方出来而显现”；appear 侧重 “凭空出现或突然看见”，如 the monster emerged from the hole /a star appeared in the sky。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] A long stick with a curved end, used by farmers to control sheep or goats; Duff the goat boy’s tool for herding goats (used in Chapter 5 of The Princess in Black, the tool Duff picked up to face the monster)[/EN][CN] 牧羊杖；弯柄杖（一端弯曲的长棍子，农夫用来驱赶牛羊；牧羊男孩达夫的放羊工具，出自《黑衣公主》第五章，达夫面对怪兽时拿起的工具）[/CN][POS] n.[/POS][PH]/krʊk/（英美）[/PH][DU]“Not another one,” said Duff. [TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] pick up one’s crook | 捡起牧羊杖 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The goat boy picked up his crook and walked to the pasture to herd the goats.| 牧羊男孩捡起牧羊杖，走向牧场放羊。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] drop one’s crook | 扔掉牧羊杖 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Duff dropped his crook when he saw the huge blue monster coming out of the hole.| 达夫看到巨大的蓝色怪兽从洞里出来，吓得扔掉了牧羊杖。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] a goat crook | 牧羊杖 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The wooden goat crook is Duff’s most important tool for taking care of goats.| 木质牧羊杖是达夫照看山羊最重要的工具。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To speak in a rough, low voice because of fear or illness; to make a deep, hoarse sound like a frog (used in Chapter 5 of The Princess in Black, describing Duff’s scared voice when calling for help)[/EN][CN] 用沙哑的声音说；呱呱叫（因恐惧或生病而用粗哑、低沉的声音说话；发出像青蛙一样低沉沙哑的叫声，出自《黑衣公主》第五章，形容达夫求救时害怕的声音）[/CN][POS] v.[/POS][PH]/krəʊk/（英式）/kroʊk/（美式）[/PH][DU]“H-h-help!” he croaked.|(原文例句)“救、救命！” 他用沙哑的声音喊道。[/DU][DU] The frog croaked loudly by the pond while the princess and her pony passed by.| 公主和她的小马经过时，池塘边的青蛙呱呱地大声叫着。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/croak.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] croak for help | 沙哑地呼救 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The goat boy croaked for help when he saw the big monster coming to eat the goats.| 牧羊男孩看到大怪兽要来吃山羊，沙哑地大声呼救。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] croak out a word/sentence | 沙哑地说出一个词/一句话 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] He was so scared that he could only croak out a few words to ask for help.| 他吓得只能沙哑地说出几个字求救。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] frogs croak | 青蛙呱呱叫 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] Frogs croak day and night in the pond near the goat pasture.| 山羊牧场附近的池塘里，青蛙日夜呱呱叫。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX] The old man croaked his answer because he had a sore throat.| 这位老人因为嗓子疼，沙哑地说出了答案。[/EX][EX] She was so nervous that her voice croaked when she spoke to the duchess.| 她和女公爵说话时紧张得声音都沙哑了。[/EX][EX] The raven croaked on the tree branch, and the wind blew through the forest.| 渡鸦在树枝上发出沙哑的叫声，风吹过了森林。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] croak 的过去式和过去分词是 croaked，直接加 ed，不要写成 croakedd（错误），也不要漏写 e。[/ERR][ERR] croak 作 “说话沙哑” 时是不及物动词，后接说话的内容需加介词 out（croak out a cry），不要直接接宾语（错误：croak a cry）。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 croak 和 squeak！croak 是 “低沉沙哑的叫声/说话声”；squeak 是 “尖细的吱吱声”，如 the boy croaked for help /the mouse squeaked in the corner。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN] To run very fast, especially of a horse or pony; the fastest speed of a horse (used in Chapter 6 of The Princess in Black, describing Blacky running fast to the goat pasture)[/EN][CN]（马、小马）飞奔；疾驰；奔驰（以极快的速度奔跑，尤指马类；马的最快速度，出自《黑衣公主》第六章，形容小黑马飞快地奔向山羊牧场）[/CN][POS] v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈɡæləp/（英美）[/PH][DU] The Princess in Black galloped into the goat pasture.|(原文例句) 黑衣公主策马飞奔进了山羊牧场。[/DU][DU] Blacky galloped toward the big tree with the Princess in Black on his back.|(原文例句) 小黑马载着黑衣公主，朝那棵大树飞奔而去。[/DU][/DEF][IMG] infopic01/gallop.webp [/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H] gallop into sp | 飞奔进入某地 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The pony galloped into the forest and left the castle far behind.| 小马飞奔进森林，把城堡远远甩在了身后。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] gallop toward sp | 朝某地飞奔 [POS] v.[/POS][/H][EX] The faithful pony galloped toward the monster to help the princess fight it.| 忠实的小马朝怪兽飞奔而去，帮公主对抗它。[/EX][/COLL][COLL][H] at a gallop | 以飞奔的速度 [POS] n.[/POS][/H][EX] The princess rode her pony at a gallop and arrived at the goat pasture in minutes.| 公主骑着小马疾驰，几分钟就到了山羊牧场。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR] gallop 作动词时是不及物动词，后接地点需加介词（into/toward/across），不要直接接宾语（错误：gallop the pasture），正确：gallop into the pasture。[/ERR][ERR] gallop 的过去式和过去分词是 galloped，直接加 ed，不要写成 galloppped（错误），注意中间是两个 l。[/ERR][ERR] 不要混淆 gallop 和 run！gallop 专指马、小马等马科动物的飞奔；run 是通用词，指所有动物和人的跑，如 the pony galloped /the boy ran fast。[/ERR]
