[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make a firm decision to do something you really want to do; to try your best to find out something[/EN][CN]下决心；决意；努力查明，弄清[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/dɪˈtɜːmɪn/（英式）/dɪˈtɜːrmɪn/（美式）[/PH][DU]The duchess was determined to uncover a secret in Princess Magnolia’s castle.|(原文例句) 女公爵下定决心要在玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡里发现一个秘密。[/DU][DU]I determine to finish my puzzle today.|我下决心今天拼完我的拼图。[/DU][DU]Mom tries to determine where the little cat hides.|妈妈努力想弄清小猫咪藏在哪里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/determine.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN](adj. determined) Having a strong wish to do something, and not giving up[/EN][CN]（形容词）下定决心的；坚决的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/dɪˈtɜːmɪnd/（英式）/dɪˈtɜːrmɪnd/（美式）[/PH][DU]She is determined to learn to ride a bike.|她下定决心要学会骑自行车。[/DU][DU]The little boy is determined to catch the butterfly.|小男孩坚决要抓到那只蝴蝶。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]be determined to do sth|下定决心做某事[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess was determined to uncover a secret in the castle.|女公爵下定决心要在城堡里发现一个秘密。[/EX][EX]Lily is determined to grow a big sunflower in her garden.|莉莉下定决心要在花园里种出一朵大向日葵。[/EX][C]be determined to study hard|下定决心努力学习[/C][C]be determined to try again|下定决心再试一次[/C][C]be determined to finish homework|下定决心完成作业[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]determine to do sth|决心做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]I determine to get up early to see the sunrise.|我决心早起去看日出。[/EX][EX]He determines to share his toys with his friends.|他决心把玩具分享给小伙伴。[/EX][C]determine to get up early|决心早起[/C][C]determine to help mom|决心帮妈妈[/C][C]determine to read a storybook|决心读一本故事书[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]determine sth|努力查明某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]We determine the reason why the little bird leaves its nest.|我们努力查明小鸟离开鸟巢的原因。[/EX][EX]Dad determines the place where the rabbit lives.|爸爸努力弄清小兔子住的地方。[/EX][C]determine the reason of crying|努力查明哭的原因[/C][C]determine the place of the toy car|努力弄清玩具车的位置[/C][C]determine the time of the party|努力查明派对的时间[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The duchess was determined to uncover a secret in Princess Magnolia’s castle.|（原文例句）女公爵下定决心要在玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡里发现一个秘密。[/EX][EX]Princess Magnolia is determined to get back to the tower on time.|玛格诺莉亚公主下定决心要准时回到塔楼。[/EX][EX]We determine to finish our drawing before dinner.|我们决心在晚饭前画完我们的画。[/EX][EX]The teacher determines to find out who breaks the glass.|老师努力想弄清是谁打碎了玻璃杯。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]不要把动词determine当作形容词用，错误：be determine to do sth，正确：be determined to do sth[/ERR][ERR]determine作动词时，后面接to do sth，不能接doing sth，错误：determine climbing the hill，正确：determine to climb the hill[/ERR][ERR]现在分词拼写错误，错误：determineing，正确：determining（需要双写e加ing）[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆determine和decide，determine是“坚定地下决心”，decide只是“简单做选择”，不要随便替换[/ERR][ERR]过去式/过去分词直接加d，错误：determineded，正确：determined[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To look at something quickly and secretly, especially from a hidden place (used in Chapter 9 of The Princess in Black, the duchess looked under the table secretly to find Princess Magnolia's secret)[/EN][CN]偷看；窥视（快速且偷偷地看某物，尤指从隐蔽处看，出自《黑衣公主》第九章，女公爵偷偷看桌子底下，想找出玛格诺莉亚公主的秘密）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/piːk/（英美）[/PH][DU]The duchess peeked under a table.|(原文例句) 女公爵偷偷看了看桌子底下。[/DU][DU]She peeked from behind the door and saw the monster leaving.|她从门后偷偷看，发现怪兽走了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/peek.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To look at something quickly and briefly, without secrecy; a quick and brief look[/EN][CN]匆匆一瞥；快速看一眼（无秘密性的、短暂的看；快速的一瞥）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][DU]I peeked at the clock and found it was already noon.|我快速看了眼钟表，发现已经中午了。[/DU][DU]She took a peek at the new book and wanted to read it at once.|她匆匆瞥了眼新书，立刻就想读。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]peek under sth|偷偷看某物下面[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess peeked under a chair to find something amiss in the castle.|女公爵偷偷看了看椅子底下，想在城堡里找出不对劲的地方。[/EX][C]peek behind the door|偷偷看门后[/C][C]peek into the closet|偷偷往壁橱里看[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]peek at sth|快速看一眼某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He peeked at the blackboard and copied the homework quickly.|他快速看了眼黑板，赶紧抄下了作业。[/EX][C]peek at the phone|快速看一眼手机[/C][C]peek at the calendar|快速看一眼日历[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]take a peek|瞥一眼；看一下[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]She took a quick peek at the gift and put it back carefully.|她快速瞥了眼礼物，又小心地放了回去。[/EX][C]take a little peek|匆匆看一眼[/C][C]have a peek|看一眼[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The boy peeked at the answer when the teacher wasn't looking.|老师不注意时，小男孩偷偷看了答案。[/EX][EX]She peeked through the window and saw the Princess in Black fighting the monster.|她透过窗户偷看，看到了黑衣公主正在和怪兽战斗。[/EX][EX]I just peeked at the movie trailer and it seemed very interesting.|我只是看了眼电影预告片，看起来特别有意思。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆peek和peel/pique，peek是“看”，peel是“剥皮、削皮”，pique是“激怒、使恼怒”，三者发音和词义完全不同。[/ERR][ERR]peek作动词时后接宾语需加介词at/under/into等，不可直接接宾语，错误：peek the room，正确：peek into the room。[/ERR][ERR]peek的过去式和过去分词为peeked，直接加ed，不要写成peekt或peekedd。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small mass or ball of something soft or flexible that is pressed together (used in Chapter 9 of The Princess in Black, the duchess found not even a small ball of gum under the table)[/EN][CN]（软的或可弯曲物的）团；块（被压在一起的一小团/一小块软物，出自《黑衣公主》第九章，女公爵在桌子底下连一小团口香糖都没找到）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/wɒd/（英式）/wɑːd/（美式）[/PH][DU]Not so much as a wad of gum!|(原文例句) 连一小团口香糖都没有！[/DU][DU]She crumpled the paper into a wad and threw it into the bin.|她把纸揉成一团，扔进了垃圾桶。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/wad.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A thick roll or bundle of paper money, especially in large amounts (informal); to press or roll something into a mass[/EN][CN]（一叠/一卷）现金（尤指大额，口语）；把……揉成一团；把……卷成一卷[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]He took a wad of cash from his pocket and bought a new bike for his son.|他从口袋里掏出一卷现金，给儿子买了一辆新自行车。[/DU][DU]She wadded the cloth into a ball and wiped the table with it.|她把布揉成一团，用它擦了桌子。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]a wad of gum|一小团口香糖[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess checked every corner but found not a wad of gum in the tower.|女公爵检查了每个角落，却在塔楼里连一小团口香糖都没找到。[/EX][C]a wad of paper|一团纸[/C][C]a wad of hair|一团头发[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a wad of cash|一卷现金；一叠钞票[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The millionaire pulled out a wad of cash and paid for the painting at once.|这位百万富翁掏出一叠现金，立刻买下了这幅画。[/EX][C]a thick wad of cash|一大卷现金[/C][C]a small wad of cash|一小卷现金[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]wad up sth|把某物揉成一团[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He wadded up the letter and didn't want anyone to read its content.|他把信揉成一团，不想让任何人看到里面的内容。[/EX][C]wad up the napkin|把餐巾揉成一团[/C][C]wad up the poster|把海报揉成一团[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The little boy made a wad of clay and shaped it into a small monster.|小男孩把黏土揉成一团，捏成了一个小怪兽。[/EX][EX]There was a wad of cloth under the bed and she picked it up to fold.|床底下有一块布团，她捡起来叠好了。[/EX][EX]She keeps a wad of banknotes in her bag for emergency use.|她包里放着一叠钞票，以备不时之需。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]wad作“团、块、卷”讲时为可数名词，复数形式是wads，直接加s，不要写成wades或wadies。[/ERR][ERR]wad作动词表示“揉成一团”时，常用搭配为wad up，不可漏掉up，错误：wad the paper，正确：wad up the paper。[/ERR][ERR]不要把wad拼写为wud或wadde，注意音标与拼写的对应，英式/wɒd/，美式/wɑːd/。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A large room in a castle or palace where balls and big parties are held (used in Chapter 9 of The Princess in Black, the duchess checked the big party room in the castle to find secrets)[/EN][CN]舞厅；宴会厅（城堡或宫殿里举行舞会和大型派对的大房间，出自《黑衣公主》第九章，女公爵检查了城堡里的宴会厅，想要找出秘密）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbɔːlruːm/（英美）[/PH][DU]She examined the ballroom.|(原文例句) 她仔细检查了宴会厅。[/DU][DU]The princess danced with the knight in the beautiful ballroom at night.|夜晚，公主和骑士在漂亮的舞厅里跳舞。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/ballroom.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]the castle ballroom|城堡的宴会厅[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Duchess Wigtower walked around the castle ballroom and found nothing amiss.|维格塔女公爵在城堡的宴会厅里走来走去，没发现任何不对劲的地方。[/EX][C]the palace ballroom|宫殿的舞厅[/C][C]a royal ballroom|皇家舞厅[/C][/COLL][H]in the ballroom|在舞厅里[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]All the nobles and princesses gathered in the ballroom for the princess's birthday party.|所有的贵族和公主都聚集在舞厅里，参加公主的生日派对。[/EX][C]dance in the ballroom|在舞厅里跳舞[/C][C]hold a banquet in the ballroom|在宴会厅里举办宴会[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a huge ballroom|巨大的舞厅[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The new castle has a huge ballroom that can hold hundreds of people.|这座新城堡有一个巨大的舞厅，能容纳数百人。[/EX][C]a fancy ballroom|精致的舞厅[/C][C]a bright ballroom|明亮的宴会厅[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The ballroom was decorated with many flowers and lights for the royal wedding.|为了这场皇家婚礼，宴会厅里装饰了许多鲜花和彩灯。[/EX][EX]The Princess in Black never appeared in the ballroom because she was always busy fighting monsters.|黑衣公主从不出现在舞厅里，因为她总是忙着对抗怪兽。[/EX][EX]The floor of the ballroom is made of marble and is very smooth for dancing.|宴会厅的地板是大理石做的，跳舞时特别光滑。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]ballroom是复合名词，规范写法为连写单字，不要分开写（错误：ball room），也不要加连字符（错误：ball-room）。[/ERR][ERR]ballroom是可数名词，复数形式为ballrooms，直接加s，不要写成ballroomes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆ballroom和bathroom，ballroom是“舞厅、宴会厅”，bathroom是“卫生间、浴室”，二者词义和发音差异明显。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To look at something carefully and thoroughly to check its condition or find something (used in Chapter 9 of The Princess in Black, the duchess looked at the cookies carefully while snooping in the castle)[/EN][CN]仔细查看；检查（认真、全面地看某物，检查其状况或寻找某物，出自《黑衣公主》第九章，女公爵在城堡里窥探时，仔细查看了那些饼干）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ɪnˈspekt/（英美）[/PH][DU]She even paused to inspect the cookies.|(原文例句) 她甚至停下来，仔细查看了那些饼干。[/DU][DU]The guard inspected every corner of the castle to ensure safety.|守卫仔细检查了城堡的每个角落，以确保安全。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/inspect.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To examine something officially or professionally to make sure it meets standards; to inspect a place or group of people as an official[/EN][CN]视察；检阅；正式检查（以官方或专业身份检查某物，确保其符合标准；作为官员视察某地或检阅人员）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The king came to inspect the army and praised the soldiers for their training.|国王前来检阅军队，表扬了士兵们的训练成果。[/DU][DU]The workers will inspect the bridge to make sure it is not damaged.|工作人员会对这座桥进行正式检查，确保其没有损坏。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]inspect sth carefully|仔细检查某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duchess Wigtower inspected every corner of the tower carefully to find Princess Magnolia's secret.|维格塔女公爵仔细检查了塔楼的每个角落，想找出玛格诺莉亚公主的秘密。[/EX][C]inspect the food carefully|仔细检查食物[/C][C]inspect the gift carefully|仔细查看礼物[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]inspect the army|检阅军队[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The general went to the camp to inspect the army every month.|这位将军每个月都会去军营检阅军队。[/EX][C]inspect the school|视察学校[/C][C]inspect the factory|视察工厂[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]officially inspect|正式检查[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The experts will officially inspect the building next week to check its quality.|专家们下周会对这栋建筑进行正式检查，检测其质量。[/EX][C]inspect officially|官方视察[/C][C]professionally inspect|专业检查[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The teacher inspected the students' homework and found many careless mistakes.|老师检查了学生的作业，发现了许多粗心的错误。[/EX][EX]She inspected the broken scepter and tried to fix it for the Princess in Black.|她仔细查看了坏掉的权杖，想帮黑衣公主修好它。[/EX][EX]The mayor came to inspect the new park and was satisfied with its design.|市长前来视察新公园，对其设计感到满意。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]inspect是及物动词，可直接接宾语，无需额外加介词at，错误：inspect at the cookies，正确：inspect the cookies。[/ERR][ERR]inspect的名词形式是inspection，不要写成inspectment；形容词形式是inspective，注意正确的词形变化。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆inspect和check，inspect侧重“专业、细致、正式的检查/视察”，check侧重“日常、简单的核对、查看”。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]As black as coal; very black (used in Chapter 9 of The Princess in Black, describing the completely black stockings the duchess found under the broom closet door)[/EN][CN]像煤一样黑的；乌黑的；漆黑的（和煤炭一样黑，出自《黑衣公主》第九章，形容女公爵在扫帚间门底下发现的那双纯黑的长袜）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˌkəʊl ˈblæk/（英式）/ˌkoʊl ˈblæk/（美式）[/PH][DU]A pair of coal-black stockings.|(原文例句) 一双漆黑的长袜。[/DU][DU]The Princess in Black wears a coal-black cape when fighting monsters.|黑衣公主对抗怪兽时，穿着一件乌黑的斗篷。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/coal-black.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]coal-black stockings|漆黑的长袜[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess was surprised to find a pair of coal-black stockings in the princess's castle.|女公爵在公主的城堡里发现了一双漆黑的长袜，感到十分惊讶。[/EX][C]coal-black gloves|漆黑的手套[/C][C]coal-black boots|乌黑的靴子[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]coal-black hair|乌黑的头发[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The little girl has coal-black hair and big bright eyes, which makes her very lovely.|这个小女孩有着乌黑的头发和明亮的大眼睛，显得格外可爱。[/EX][C]coal-black eyes|漆黑的眼睛[/C][C]coal-black fur|乌黑的皮毛[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]coal-black clothing|漆黑的衣物[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black's coal-black clothing makes her hard to see in the dark forest.|黑衣公主漆黑的衣物，让她在黑暗的森林里难以被发现。[/EX][C]coal-black cape|乌黑的斗篷[/C][C]coal-black mask|漆黑的面具[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The cat has a coal-black fur and white paws, which looks very cute.|这只小猫有着乌黑的皮毛和白色的爪子，看起来特别可爱。[/EX][EX]The monster has coal-black skin and big red eyes, which scared the goats a lot.|这只怪兽有着漆黑的皮肤和红色的大眼睛，把山羊们吓坏了。[/EX][EX]She wore a coal-black dress to the royal ball in the castle's ballroom.|她穿了一件漆黑的裙子，去城堡的宴会厅参加皇家舞会。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]coal-black是复合形容词，中间必须加连字符-，不要分开写（错误：coal black），也不要连写（错误：coalblack）。[/ERR][ERR]coal-black仅作定语修饰名词，不可单独作表语，错误：The cape is coal-black.，更规范的表达：The cape is as black as coal.。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆coal-black和black-coal，coal-black是形容词“像煤一样黑的”，black-coal是名词“黑煤、原煤”，二者语序不同，词性和词义完全不同。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To fall or drop heavily or suddenly with a soft sound; the soft sound of something falling (used in Chapter 11 of The Princess in Black, the big blue monster fell heavily into Monster Land)[/EN][CN]（重重地、突然地）扑通一声落下；掉下；扑通声（重物突然落下的轻柔声响，出自《黑衣公主》第十一章，蓝色大怪兽重重地掉进了怪兽之地）[/CN][POS]v./n./adv.[/POS][PH]/plɒp/（英式）/plɑːp/（美式）[/PH][DU]The big blue monster plopped down into Monster Land.|(原文例句) 蓝色大怪兽扑通一声掉进了怪兽之地。[/DU][DU]The apple plopped from the tree and fell on the grass.|苹果从树上扑通一声掉下来，落在了草地上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/plop.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To put or place something somewhere casually or carelessly with a soft sound; to sit down suddenly and heavily (informal)[/EN][CN]（随意地、漫不经心地）扑通一声放；撂下；（突然重重地）坐下（口语）[/CN][POS]v./adv.[/POS][DU]She plopped her bag on the sofa and lay down to rest at once.|她把包扑通一声撂在沙发上，立刻躺下休息。[/DU][DU]He plopped into the chair after a long day of work.|忙活了一整天，他扑通一声坐在了椅子上。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]plop down|扑通一声落下；重重地坐下[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The tired monster plopped down on the ground and didn't want to fight anymore.|疲惫的怪兽扑通一声倒在地上，不想再战斗了。[/EX][C]plop down into the hole|扑通一声掉进洞里[/C][C]plop down on the bed|扑通一声躺在床上[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]plop sth on sth|把某物扑通一声放在某物上[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]She plopped the book on the table and told us the story of the Princess in Black.|她把书扑通一声放在桌子上，给我们讲起了黑衣公主的故事。[/EX][C]plop the cup on the desk|把杯子扑通一声放在书桌上[/C][C]plop the toy on the floor|把玩具扑通一声放在地上[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]with a plop|扑通一声[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The small stone fell into the water with a plop and made ripples.|小石子扑通一声掉进水里，漾起了层层涟漪。[/EX][C]drop with a plop|扑通一声掉下[/C][C]fall with a plop|扑通一声落下[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The raindrop plopped on the window and slid down slowly.|雨滴扑通一声打在窗户上，慢慢滑了下来。[/EX][EX]Blacky plopped to the ground and rested for a while after running a long way.|小黑马跑了很远后，扑通一声倒在地上休息了一会儿。[/EX][EX]He plopped a piece of candy into his mouth and watched the cartoon.|他把一颗糖扑通一声塞进嘴里，看起了动画片。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]plop作动词表示“落下、放置”时为不及物动词，后接地点需加介词on/into/down等，错误：plop the ground，正确：plop on the ground。[/ERR][ERR]plop的过去式和过去分词为plopped，直接加ed，不要双写p（错误：ploppped），也不要漏写e。[/ERR][ERR]plop是拟声词，多用于口语和非正式语境，正式书面语中可替换为fall heavily/place casually等。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A hard piece of skin that grows on the top of each toe (used in Chapter 11 of The Princess in Black, the big blue monster found a pile of toenail clippings in Monster Land)[/EN][CN]脚趾甲（每个脚趾顶端长出的坚硬角质层，出自《黑衣公主》第十一章，蓝色大怪兽在怪兽之地发现了一堆趾甲屑）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈtəʊneɪl/（英式）/ˈtoʊneɪl/（美式）[/PH][DU]The big blue monster found a pile of toenail clippings.|(原文例句) 蓝色大怪兽发现了一堆趾甲屑。[/DU][DU]The little girl cut her toenail carefully with a nail clipper.|小女孩用指甲刀仔细地剪了脚趾甲。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/toenail.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]toenail clippings|趾甲屑[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The monster thought the toenail clippings were yummy and ate them at once.|这只怪兽觉得趾甲屑很好吃，立刻就吃了下去。[/EX][C]a pile of toenail clippings|一堆趾甲屑[/C][C]clean toenail clippings|清理趾甲屑[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]cut one's toenail|剪脚趾甲[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Princess Magnolia cuts her toenail every week to keep tidy as a prim princess.|作为一位端庄的公主，玛格诺莉亚每周都会剪脚趾甲，保持整洁。[/EX][C]trim one's toenail|修剪脚趾甲[/C][C]file one's toenail|磨平脚趾甲[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a broken toenail|断掉的脚趾甲[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The goat boy hurt his toenail and had a broken toenail when he ran to the pasture.|牧羊男孩跑向牧场时弄伤了脚趾，断了一块脚趾甲。[/EX][C]a long toenail|长长的脚趾甲[/C][C]a thick toenail|厚厚的脚趾甲[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The monster's toenail is very long and sharp, which can scratch the trees easily.|怪兽的脚趾甲又长又尖，能轻易抓破树木。[/EX][EX]She wore beautiful sandals and showed her painted toenails at the castle party.|她穿着漂亮的凉鞋，在城堡派对上露出了涂了指甲油的脚趾甲。[/EX][EX]The doctor told him to keep his toenail clean to avoid infection.|医生叮嘱他保持脚趾甲清洁，避免感染。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]toenail是复合名词，规范写法为连写单字，不要分开写（错误：toe nail），也不要加连字符（错误：toe-nail）。[/ERR][ERR]toenail是可数名词，复数形式为toenails，直接加s，不要写成toenailes或toenailses。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆toenail和fingernail，toenail是“脚趾甲”，fingernail是“手指甲”，二者切勿混用。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small piece that is cut off from something; a thin piece of hair, nail, etc. that is cut off (used in Chapter 11 of The Princess in Black, the small pieces of toenail the big blue monster found in Monster Land)[/EN][CN]剪下来的小片；碎屑（从某物上剪下的小块，尤指头发、指甲等的碎屑，出自《黑衣公主》第十一章，蓝色大怪兽在怪兽之地发现的趾甲碎屑）[/CN][POS]n.（复数）[/POS][PH]/ˈklɪpɪŋ/（英美）[/PH][DU]The big blue monster found a pile of toenail clippings.|(原文例句) 蓝色大怪兽发现了一堆趾甲屑。[/DU][DU]She swept the hair clippings off the floor after cutting her hair.|她剪完头发后，把地上的头发屑扫干净了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/clipping.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A piece of newspaper or magazine that has been cut out; a short extract from a radio or television program (also clip); the act of cutting something with scissors or clippers[/EN][CN]剪报；（电台/电视节目的）剪辑片段；剪取物；修剪；剪切（用剪刀或剪子修剪某物的动作）[/CN][POS]n./v.（单数/复数）[/POS][DU]She keeps a lot of fashion clippings from magazines in a book.|她把很多杂志上的时尚剪报收在一本书里。[/DU][DU]The clipping of the movie is very exciting and makes people want to watch the whole film.|这部电影的剪辑片段非常精彩，让人想看完整部影片。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]toenail clippings|趾甲屑[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The big blue monster ate the toenail clippings because it thought they were yummy.|蓝色大怪兽吃了趾甲屑，因为它觉得那些碎屑很好吃。[/EX][C]hair clippings|头发屑[/C][C]nail clippings|指甲屑[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]newspaper clippings|报纸剪报[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The old man collected many newspaper clippings about history for many years.|这位老人多年来收集了许多关于历史的报纸剪报。[/EX][C]magazine clippings|杂志剪报[/C][C]fashion clippings|时尚剪报[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]film clippings|电影剪辑片段[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The director showed us some film clippings to introduce the new movie.|导演给我们看了一些电影剪辑片段，介绍这部新影片。[/EX][C]video clippings|视频剪辑[/C][C]news clippings|新闻片段[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]There were some paper clippings on the table after she cut the paper into small pieces.|她把纸剪成小块后，桌子上留下了一些纸屑。[/EX][EX]She put the flower clippings into the pot and let them become fertilizer for the plants.|她把剪下的花瓣碎屑放进花盆里，让它们成为植物的肥料。[/EX][EX]He made a collection of sports clippings from newspapers and watches them every day.|他收集了报纸上的体育剪报，每天都会翻看。[/EX][EX]The clipping of the song is very popular on the Internet and many people share it.|这首歌的剪辑片段在网上很火，很多人都在分享。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]clipping表示“指甲、头发等的碎屑”时，**只能用复数形式clippings**，不可用单数，错误：a toenail clipping，正确：toenail clippings。[/ERR][ERR]clipping的拼写需双写p再加ing，不要漏写p（错误：cliping），其动词原形为clip，注意词形变化。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆clipping和clip，clipping侧重“剪下来的碎片、剪报、剪辑片段”，clip可作动词“剪、夹”，也可作名词“夹子、短片”，作“短片”时二者可通用。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make a high sound by blowing air through the lips, often to show happiness or to signal (used in Chapter 12 of The Princess in Black, Duff made the sound while walking his goats home)[/EN][CN]吹口哨（通过嘴唇吹气发出高音，常表开心或示意，出自《黑衣公主》第十二章，达夫赶着山羊回家时吹口哨）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈwɪsl/（英美）[/PH][DU]Duff whistled as he walked his goats home.|(原文例句) 达夫赶着山羊回家时吹着口哨。[/DU][DU]The boy whistled a happy tune on his way to the forest.|男孩哼着欢快的调子吹着口哨往森林走去。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/whistle.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make a high, clear sound because of the wind or moving air; a high sound made by blowing through the lips or a small instrument[/EN][CN]（风、物体）呼啸；鸣响；口哨声；哨子声；哨子[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][DU]The wind whistled through the castle windows at night.|夜晚，风从城堡的窗户呼啸而过。[/DU][DU]He blew a whistle to call the goats back to the pasture.|他吹了声哨子，把山羊叫回牧场。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]whistle a tune|吹口哨哼曲子[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duff whistled a soft tune as he fed the goats in the morning.|达夫早上喂山羊时，轻声吹着口哨哼着曲子。[/EX][C]whistle happily|开心地吹口哨[/C][C]whistle to sb|朝某人吹口哨[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]blow a whistle|吹哨子[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The goat boy blew a whistle to warn the Princess in Black of the monster.|牧羊男孩吹哨子提醒黑衣公主有怪兽来了。[/EX][C]the sound of a whistle|哨子声[/C][C]a police whistle|警哨[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]whistle through sth|呼啸着穿过某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The wind whistled through the trees in the forest near the castle.|风呼啸着穿过城堡附近森林里的树林。[/EX][C]whistle past sth|鸣响着经过某物[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]She whistled to her pony and it ran to her at once.|她朝小马吹了声口哨，小马立刻跑到了她身边。[/EX][EX]The train whistle could be heard from far away in the monster land.|在怪兽之地，很远就能听到火车的鸣笛声。[/EX][EX]He likes to whistle while he does his work every day.|他每天干活的时候都喜欢吹口哨。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]whistle的拼写不要漏写末尾的e，错误：whistl，正确：whistle。[/ERR][ERR]whistle作“吹口哨示意”时，后接对象需加介词to，错误：whistle the pony，正确：whistle to the pony。[/ERR][ERR]whistle的过去式和过去分词为whistled，直接加ed，不要双写l，错误：whistlled。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A way of changing your appearance so that people cannot recognize you; to change your appearance to hide who you are (used in Chapter 12&13 of The Princess in Black, referring to Princess Magnolia's change to Princess in Black and Duff's Goat Avenger look)[/EN][CN]n.伪装；装扮；假扮；v.伪装；假扮；乔装（改变外貌让人认不出，出自《黑衣公主》第十二、十三章，指玛格诺莉亚公主变黑衣公主、达夫扮山羊复仇者的装扮）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/dɪsˈɡaɪz/（英美）[/PH][DU]What a clever disguise that would be!|(原文例句) 那会是多么巧妙的伪装啊！[/DU][DU]Most goat boys are not the Goat Avenger in disguise.|(原文例句) 大多数牧羊男孩都不会是伪装的山羊复仇者。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/disguise.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To hide or cover up a feeling, opinion, or fact so that people cannot see or know it[/EN][CN]掩饰；隐瞒（情感、观点、事实等）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She tried to disguise her nervousness when the duchess talked to her.|女公爵和她说话时，她努力掩饰自己的紧张。[/DU][DU]He disguised his disappointment with a big smile on his face.|他脸上挂着大大的笑容，掩饰自己的失望。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]in disguise|伪装；假扮[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black is Princess Magnolia in disguise when fighting monsters.|黑衣公主就是玛格诺莉亚公主变身的伪装形象，专门对抗怪兽。[/EX][C]a clever disguise|巧妙的伪装[/C][C]a perfect disguise|完美的装扮[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]disguise oneself as sb/sth|把自己伪装成某人/某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duff wanted to disguise himself as the Goat Avenger to fight monsters with the Princess in Black.|达夫想把自己伪装成山羊复仇者，和黑衣公主一起对抗怪兽。[/EX][C]disguise as a goat|伪装成一只山羊[/C][C]disguise as a knight|假扮成一名骑士[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]disguise one's feelings|掩饰某人的情感[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Princess Magnolia disguised her worry with a sweet smile when leaving the duchess.|玛格诺莉亚公主离开女公爵时，用甜美的笑容掩饰了自己的担忧。[/EX][C]disguise the truth|隐瞒真相[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The monster tried to disguise itself as a rock to sneak into the goat pasture.|怪兽试图把自己伪装成一块石头，偷偷溜进牧羊场。[/EX][EX]She wore a hat and a mask as a disguise to walk in the forest at night.|她戴着帽子和面具作为伪装，在夜晚的森林里行走。[/EX][EX]He could not disguise his excitement when he saw the Princess in Black fight the monster.|看到黑衣公主对抗怪兽，他无法掩饰自己的兴奋。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]disguise的拼写不要漏写s，错误：diguise，正确：disguise。[/ERR][ERR]disguise作动词表示“伪装成”时，必须加介词as，错误：disguise a goat，正确：disguise oneself as a goat。[/ERR][ERR]in disguise是固定搭配，中间不可加冠词，错误：in a disguise，正确：in disguise。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To think that something is probably true, or that someone has done something wrong or illegal (used in Chapter 12 of The Princess in Black, no one would think Princess Magnolia was the Princess in Black)[/EN][CN]怀疑；猜想；觉得（某事可能是真的，或某人做了错事，出自《黑衣公主》第十二章，没人会想到玛格诺莉亚公主就是黑衣公主）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/səˈspekt/（英美，动词）[/PH][DU]No one would suspect a girl in glass slippers.|(原文例句) 没人会怀疑一个穿着水晶鞋的女孩。[/DU][DU]I suspect that he knows the secret of the Princess in Black.|我猜想他知道黑衣公主的秘密。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/suspect.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A person who is thought to have committed a crime or done something wrong[/EN][CN]嫌疑犯；可疑分子[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈsʌspekt/（英美，名词）[/PH][DU]The guard watched the suspect carefully to make sure he didn't enter the castle.|守卫仔细盯着可疑分子，确保他没有进入城堡。[/DU][DU]The police found the suspect who stole the princess's crystal bracelet.|警察找到了偷走公主水晶手链的嫌疑犯。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]Thought to be possibly true or likely, but not certain; not to be trusted[/EN][CN]可疑的；不可信的；可能的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/səˈspekt/（英美，形容词）[/PH][DU]There was a suspect noise coming from the broom closet of the castle.|城堡的扫帚间传来了可疑的声音。[/DU][DU]His excuse for being late was suspect and no one believed him.|他迟到的借口很可疑，没人相信他。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]suspect (that) sth|怀疑/猜想某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]No one would suspect that Princess Magnolia is the Princess in Black.|没人会猜想玛格诺莉亚公主就是黑衣公主。[/EX][C]suspect sb of doing sth|怀疑某人做了某事[/C][C]suspect a secret|怀疑有秘密[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a murder suspect|谋杀嫌疑犯[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The castle guards caught a suspect who tried to hurt the goats in the pasture.|城堡守卫抓住了一名试图伤害牧场山羊的可疑分子。[/EX][C]a prime suspect|主要嫌疑犯[/C][C]a robbery suspect|抢劫嫌疑犯[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a suspect sound|可疑的声音[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black heard a suspect sound from Monster Land and went to check at once.|黑衣公主听到怪兽之地传来可疑的声音，立刻前去查看。[/EX][C]a suspect man|可疑的男人[/C][C]suspect behavior|可疑的行为[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]She suspected that the duchess was snooping around the castle for her secret.|她怀疑女公爵在城堡里四处窥探，想找出她的秘密。[/EX][EX]The police questioned the suspect for hours but he didn't say anything.|警察审问了嫌疑犯几个小时，但他什么都没说。[/EX][EX]There is a suspect light in the forest at night and no one dares to go there.|夜晚的森林里有一盏可疑的灯，没人敢去那里。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]suspect是多音词，**动词/形容词发音/səˈspekt/**，**名词发音/ˈsʌspekt/**，不要混淆重音和发音。[/ERR][ERR]suspect作动词表示“怀疑某人做某事”时，搭配为suspect sb of doing sth，错误：suspect sb to do sth，正确：suspect sb of stealing。[/ERR][ERR]suspect作形容词时只能作定语，不可作表语，错误：The man is suspect.，正确：The man is suspicious./He is a suspect man.。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make or create something using the materials you have available (used in Chapter 13 of The Princess in Black, Duff made masks and capes with old goat blankets)[/EN][CN]制作；打造（用现有材料制作某物，出自《黑衣公主》第十三章，达夫用旧山羊毛毯做面具和斗篷）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈfæʃn/（英美）[/PH][DU]Goat boys do not fashion masks and capes out of old goat blankets.|(原文例句) 牧羊男孩可不会用旧山羊毛毯做面具和斗篷。[/DU][DU]She fashioned a small bag out of a piece of colorful cloth for the princess.|她用一块花布为公主做了一个小包包。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/fashion.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A popular style or trend, especially in clothes, hair, and makeup; a way of doing something[/EN][CN]n.时尚；流行款式（尤指服饰、发型）；方式；样式[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The princess likes to follow the latest fashion in the castle with her beautiful dresses.|公主喜欢穿着漂亮的裙子，追随城堡里最新的时尚潮流。[/DU][DU]He speaks in a strange fashion that no one can understand.|他说话的方式很奇怪，没人能听懂。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]fashion sth out of sth|用某物制作某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duff fashioned a monster alarm out of goat bells and rope for the pasture.|达夫用山羊铃铛和绳子，为牧场做了一个怪兽警报器。[/EX][C]fashion a cape out of a blanket|用毛毯做斗篷[/C][C]fashion a mask out of paper|用纸做面具[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]the latest fashion|最新时尚；最新款式[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess always wears clothes in the latest fashion when she visits other castles.|女公爵拜访其他城堡时，总是穿着最新款式的衣服。[/EX][C]fashion show|时装秀[/C][C]fashion brand|时尚品牌[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in a ... fashion|以……的方式[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black fought the monster in a brave fashion that everyone admired.|黑衣公主以一种所有人都敬佩的勇敢方式对抗怪兽。[/EX][C]in a strange fashion|以奇怪的方式[/C][C]in a quick fashion|以快速的方式[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]He fashioned a stick into a crook to take care of the goats better.|他把一根棍子做成了牧羊杖，以便更好地照看山羊。[/EX][EX]Long dresses are in fashion in the castle this year and all the ladies wear them.|今年城堡里流行长裙，所有的女士都穿着。[/EX][EX]She fashioned a beautiful flower crown out of fresh flowers for the little princess.|她用鲜花为小公主做了一个漂亮的花冠。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]fashion作动词表示“用某物制作某物”时，固定搭配为fashion sth out of sth，不可漏掉out of，错误：fashion a mask goat blanket，正确：fashion a mask out of goat blanket。[/ERR][ERR]fashion表示“时尚”时是不可数名词，不可加不定冠词，错误：a new fashion（表具体款式可加，表潮流不可），正确：the new fashion in clothes。[/ERR][ERR]不要把fashion和fasion混淆，注意拼写有字母h，错误：fasion，正确：fashion。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To punish someone who has harmed you, your family, or someone you care about, in order to get justice (used in Chapter 13 of The Princess in Black, from the derivative word Goat Avenger, meaning to take justice for the goats)[/EN][CN]为……报仇；报……的仇；雪恨（惩罚伤害自己/亲友的人以寻求公正，出自《黑衣公主》第十三章，派生词Goat Avenger（山羊复仇者），指为山羊讨回公道）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/əˈvendʒ/（英美）[/PH][DU]The Goat Avenger wanted to avenge the goats in the pasture from the monsters.|(原文衍生例句) 山羊复仇者想要为牧场上的山羊向怪兽报仇。[/DU][DU]She vowed to avenge her friend who was hurt by the big blue monster.|她发誓要为被蓝色大怪兽伤害的朋友报仇。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/avenge.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To take revenge for a wrong that has been done to a group or country[/EN][CN]为（群体、国家）复仇；报复[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The knight swore to avenge the kingdom that was attacked by the monsters from Monster Land.|骑士发誓要为被怪兽之地的怪兽袭击的王国复仇。[/DU][DU]They fought to avenge their village that was destroyed by the evil beasts.|他们奋力战斗，为被凶兽摧毁的村庄报仇。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]avenge sb/sth (on sb)|向某人为某人/某物报仇[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The Goat Avenger decided to avenge the goats on the monsters that tried to eat them.|山羊复仇者决定向那些想吃山羊的怪兽，为山羊们报仇。[/EX][C]avenge a friend on the monster|向怪兽为朋友报仇[/C][C]avenge the pasture on the beast|向野兽为牧场报仇[/C][/COLL][H]avenge a wrong|雪恨；为所受的冤屈报仇[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black fought monsters to avenge the wrongs they did to the villagers.|黑衣公主对抗怪兽，为他们对村民所做的坏事雪恨。[/EX][C]avenge an injury|为所受的伤害报仇[/C][/COLL][H]swear to avenge|发誓要报仇[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duff swore to avenge the goats and became the Goat Avenger.|达夫发誓要为山羊报仇，成为了山羊复仇者。[/EX][C]vow to avenge|立誓报仇[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The princess in Black will avenge any goat that is hurt by the monsters in the pasture.|黑衣公主会为任何被牧场里的怪兽伤害的山羊报仇。[/EX][EX]He set out to avenge his brother who was caught by the evil monster.|他出发去为被邪恶怪兽抓走的哥哥报仇。[/EX][EX]The people of the kingdom wanted to avenge their king on the monster army.|王国的子民想要向怪兽大军，为他们的国王报仇。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆avenge和revenge，**avenge是动词**，侧重“为他人/正义报仇”；**revenge可作动词/名词**，侧重“为自己报仇”，错误：I will revenge my friend.，正确：I will avenge my friend.。[/ERR][ERR]avenge的过去式和过去分词为avenged，直接加ed，不要双写g，错误：avengged，正确：avenged。[/ERR][ERR]avenge作及物动词，后接报仇的对象，若要接“报仇的对象是谁”，需加介词on，错误：avenge the monster for the goat，正确：avenge the goat on the monster。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Being too bold or rude in a playful or annoying way; not showing enough respect for someone (used in Chapter 14 of The Princess in Black, describing the snail in the secret chute)[/EN][CN]厚脸皮的；放肆的；调皮的（略带玩笑或恼人的大胆、无礼，不够尊重他人，出自《黑衣公主》第十四章，形容秘密滑道里的蜗牛）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈtʃiːki/（英美）[/PH][DU]There was one very cheeky snail in the secret chute.|(原文例句) 秘密滑道里还有一只十分放肆的蜗牛。[/DU][DU]The cheeky little bird flew close to the monster and pecked its nose.|那只调皮的小鸟飞到怪兽身边，啄了它的鼻子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/cheeky.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Confident and informal in a way that is attractive and not rude (informal, British English)[/EN][CN]俏皮的；爽朗的；大方的（口语，英式英语，无冒犯性的自信随意）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The cheeky little boy waved at the Princess in Black and she smiled at him.|那个俏皮的小男孩朝黑衣公主挥手，公主对他笑了笑。[/DU][DU]She made a cheeky joke and everyone in the castle laughed.|她开了个爽朗的玩笑，城堡里的所有人都笑了。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]a cheeky snail|一只放肆的蜗牛[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The Princess in Black wasn't afraid of the cheeky snail in the secret chute of the castle.|黑衣公主一点也不怕城堡秘密滑道里那只放肆的蜗牛。[/EX][C]a cheeky little boy|一个调皮的小男孩[/C][C]a cheeky bird|一只胆大的小鸟[/C][/COLL][H]cheeky behaviour|放肆的行为[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The monster's cheeky behaviour of breaking into the pasture made the Princess in Black angry.|怪兽闯入牧场的放肆行为，让黑衣公主很生气。[/EX][C]cheeky words|放肆的话语[/C][C]cheeky look|调皮的表情[/C][/COLL][H]a cheeky joke|一个俏皮的玩笑[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The goat boy told a cheeky joke to the Princess in Black after the monster was defeated.|怪兽被打败后，牧羊男孩给黑衣公主讲了一个俏皮的笑话。[/EX][C]a cheeky smile|俏皮的笑容[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The cheeky cat stole a piece of cake from the princess's table and ran away.|那只厚脸皮的猫从公主的桌子上偷了一块蛋糕，然后跑掉了。[/EX][EX]She gave him a cheeky grin when he told her not to snoop around the castle.|他让她不要在城堡里四处窥探，她却对他调皮地咧嘴一笑。[/EX][EX]The cheeky monkey jumped on the knight's horse and wouldn't get off.|那只胆大的猴子跳到骑士的马上，死活不肯下来。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]cheeky的比较级是**cheekier**，最高级是**cheekiest**，要变y为i加er/est，错误：more cheeky，most cheeky（非正式可使用，但规范为cheekier/cheekiest）。[/ERR][ERR]cheeky是形容词，不可作副词用，错误：he spoke cheeky to the princess，正确：he spoke cheekily to the princess。[/ERR][ERR]不要把cheeky拼写为cheaky，注意有两个e，错误：cheaky，正确：cheeky。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make a short, high sound like a small bird; the short, high sound of a small bird (used in Chapter 15 of The Princess in Black, Princess Magnolia lied the birds were making the sound)[/EN][CN]v.（小鸟）啾啾叫；鸣叫；n.啾啾声；鸟鸣声（小鸟发出的短促高音，出自《黑衣公主》第十五章，玛格诺莉亚公主谎称小鸟在叫）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/twiːt/（英美）[/PH][DU]All the birds are well and properly tweeting.|(原文例句) 所有的小鸟都好好的，正啾啾地叫着呢。[/DU][DU]The little birds tweet loudly in the trees near the castle every morning.|每天早上，小鸟们在城堡附近的树上大声啾啾叫。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tweet.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To send a short message on the social media service Twitter; a short message sent on Twitter[/EN][CN]v.（在推特上）发推文；发微博；n.推文；推特消息[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][DU]She likes to tweet about her daily life in the castle to her friends.|她喜欢在推特上发推文，和朋友们分享她在城堡里的日常生活。[/DU][DU]He posted a tweet about the Princess in Black fighting the monster and many people liked it.|他发了一条关于黑衣公主对抗怪兽的推文，很多人点赞了。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]tweet loudly|大声地啾啾叫[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The birds in the forest tweet loudly when the sun rises every morning.|每天早上太阳升起时，森林里的小鸟都会大声啾啾叫。[/EX][C]tweet softly|轻声鸣叫[/C][C]the tweet of birds|小鸟的啾啾声[/C][/COLL][H]tweet sth about sb/sth|发关于某人/某物的推文[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The goat boy wanted to tweet something about the Princess in Black to tell everyone how brave she is.|牧羊男孩想发一条关于黑衣公主的推文，告诉所有人她有多勇敢。[/EX][C]tweet a photo|发推文配照片[/C][C]tweet a video|发推文配视频[/C][/COLL][H]a funny tweet|一条有趣的推文[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]She saw a funny tweet about the monster and laughed for a long time.|她看到一条关于怪兽的有趣推文，笑了很久。[/EX][C]a viral tweet|一条爆红的推文[/C][C]post a tweet|发推文[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The little bird flew to the window and began to tweet, waking the princess up.|小鸟飞到窗边，开始啾啾叫，把公主吵醒了。[/EX][EX]He tweets every day about the interesting things that happen in the goat pasture.|他每天都发推文，分享牧羊场里发生的有趣事。[/EX][EX]The tweet about the Princess in Black's victory over the monster was shared by many people.|那条关于黑衣公主战胜怪兽的推文被很多人转发了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]tweet的过去式和过去分词为tweeted，直接加ed，不要双写t，错误：tweett ed，正确：tweeted。[/ERR][ERR]tweet表示“鸟鸣声”时是可数名词，复数为tweets，不要用作不可数，错误：the tweet of the bird，正确：the tweets of the birds/a tweet from the bird。[/ERR][ERR]不要把tweet拼写为tweit，注意元音字母组合是ee，错误：tweit，正确：tweet。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To travel around a place to visit and see it (used in Chapter 15 of The Princess in Black, the duchess walked around Princess Magnolia's castle to find secrets)[/EN][CN]v.游览；参观；逛（周游某地进行参观，出自《黑衣公主》第十五章，女公爵逛玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡，想找出秘密）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/tʊə(r)/（英式）/tʊr/（美式）[/PH][DU]While you were gone, I toured your castle.|(原文例句) 你不在的时候，我逛了逛你的城堡。[/DU][DU]She toured the castle's garden and admired the beautiful flowers there.|她游览了城堡的花园，欣赏那里漂亮的花。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tour.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A journey for pleasure in which you visit several places; a short visit to a place to see it; to travel to different places to perform or give a show[/EN][CN]n.旅行；游览；观光；巡回演出；v.（去各地）巡回演出；巡回访问[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]We went on a tour of the castle and the guide told us many stories.|我们去城堡观光，导游给我们讲了很多故事。[/DU][DU]The singer will tour around the kingdoms and give concerts in every castle.|这位歌手将在各个王国巡回演出，在每座城堡举办音乐会。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]tour a place|游览/参观某地[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Duchess Wigtower toured Princess Magnolia's castle and tried to find her secret.|维格塔女公爵参观了玛格诺莉亚公主的城堡，试图找出她的秘密。[/EX][C]tour the palace|游览宫殿[/C][C]tour the forest|逛森林[/C][/COLL][H]go on a tour|去旅行；去观光[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The princess and her friends went on a tour of the nearby kingdoms in summer.|夏天，公主和她的朋友们去附近的王国旅行了。[/EX][C]a castle tour|城堡观光[/C][C]a guided tour|有导游的游览[/C][/COLL][H]tour around sp|在某地巡回/游览[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The knight toured around the kingdom to check for monsters from Monster Land.|骑士在王国各地巡回，检查是否有来自怪兽之地的怪兽。[/EX][C]tour around the world|周游世界[/C][C]tour around the country|在全国巡回演出[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]He toured the goat pasture and was surprised by how many lovely goats there were.|他逛了牧羊场，对那里有这么多可爱的山羊感到惊讶。[/EX][EX]We took a walking tour of the old castle and saw many ancient rooms.|我们徒步游览了这座古老的城堡，看到了很多古老的房间。[/EX][EX]The ballet group will tour in the northern kingdoms next month.|芭蕾舞团下个月将在北方的王国巡回演出。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]tour作动词表示“游览某地”时是及物动词，可直接接宾语，无需加介词in/at，错误：tour in the castle，正确：tour the castle。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆tour和travel，tour侧重“以参观为目的的短途游览/巡回”，travel侧重“长途的旅行（尤指去国外）”。[/ERR][ERR]tour的名词形式tourist表示“游客”，不要拼写为touristt，错误：touristt，正确：tourist。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Extremely dirty; covered with dirt (used in Chapter 15 of The Princess in Black, describing the white stockings that turned black because of dirt)[/EN][CN]肮脏的；污秽的；脏透的（极其脏乱，沾满泥土，出自《黑衣公主》第十五章，形容白色长袜因脏污变得漆黑）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈfɪlθi/（英美）[/PH][DU]These white stockings are so filthy, they’ve turned as black as coal!|(原文例句) 这双白色长袜脏透了，都变得像煤一样黑了！[/DU][DU]The floor of the secret chute was filthy with dust and spider webs.|秘密滑道的地板脏透了，满是灰尘和蜘蛛网。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/filthy.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Extremely unpleasant or bad; morally wrong or offensive; used to emphasize how bad something is (informal)[/EN][CN]极其恶劣的；淫秽的；可恶的；非常的（口语，表强调）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]It was a filthy day with heavy rain and strong wind in the forest.|森林里的这天气糟透了，下着大雨还刮着大风。[/DU][DU]He told a filthy joke and everyone was angry with him.|他讲了一个淫秽的笑话，所有人都对他很生气。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]filthy stockings|肮脏的长袜[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The duchess found a pair of filthy stockings in the broom closet of Princess Magnolia's castle.|女公爵在玛格诺莉亚公主城堡的扫帚间里，发现了一双肮脏的长袜。[/EX][C]filthy clothes|脏衣服[/C][C]filthy hands|脏手[/C][/COLL][H]so filthy that...|如此脏以至于……[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The cloth was so filthy that it couldn't be cleaned anymore.|这块布脏透了，再也洗不干净了。[/EX][C]filthy with dust|满是灰尘的[/C][C]filthy with mud|沾满泥巴的[/C][/COLL][H]a filthy day|糟糕的一天[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]It was a filthy day for fighting monsters because the rain made the ground slippery.|这是对抗怪兽的糟糕一天，因为下雨让地面变得很滑。[/EX][C]filthy weather|恶劣的天气[/C][C]filthy language|污秽的言语[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The monster's paws were filthy with mud from Monster Land when it came to the pasture.|怪兽来到牧场时，爪子上沾满了怪兽之地的泥巴，脏极了。[/EX][EX]She cleaned the filthy broom closet and found many interesting things there.|她打扫了脏乱的扫帚间，在那里发现了很多有趣的东西。[/EX][EX]He has a filthy temper and gets angry at everyone for no reason.|他的脾气糟透了，无缘无故就对所有人发脾气。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]filthy的比较级是**filthier**，最高级是**filthiest**，要变y为i加er/est，错误：more filthy，most filthy（非正式可使用，规范为filthier/filthiest）。[/ERR][ERR]filthy的副词形式是filthily，名词形式是filth，不要混淆词性，错误：he acted filthy，正确：he acted filthily。[/ERR][ERR]不要把filthy拼写为filthy y或filthie，注意结尾是y，无额外字母，错误：filthie，正确：filthy。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To keep energy or something in a place for later use (used in Battery Power! Level F, referring to batteries keeping electricity)[/EN][CN]储存；存放（将能量或某物保存在某处供后续使用，出自《Battery Power!》Level F，指电池储存电能）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/stɔː(r)/（英美）[/PH][DU]Batteries store and release energy called electricity.|(原文例句) 电池储存并释放一种名为电能的能量。[/DU][DU]We need to store water in the tank for the dry season.|我们需要在水箱里储存水，以备旱季使用。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/store.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A shop where things are sold; a large shop that sells many different things[/EN][CN]商店；店铺；百货商店[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]She bought a notebook from the stationery store downtown.|她从市中心的文具店买了一本笔记本。[/DU][DU]The big store on the street sells food, clothes and toys.|街上的那家大商店售卖食品、衣服和玩具。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]store energy|储存能量[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Solar panels store energy from the sun during the day.|太阳能电池板在白天储存来自太阳的能量。[/EX][C]store electricity|储存电能[/C][C]store heat|储存热量[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a grocery store|杂货店[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]My mom goes to the grocery store every weekend to buy fresh vegetables.|我妈妈每个周末都去杂货店买新鲜蔬菜。[/EX][C]a clothing store|服装店[/C][C]an online store|网上商店[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]store sth in/at sth|把某物储存在某处[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]We store our winter clothes in the attic when spring comes.|春天来临时，我们把冬装储存在阁楼里。[/EX][C]store books on the shelf|把书放在书架上[/C][C]store food in the fridge|把食物储存在冰箱里[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The company plans to store data in the new server.|该公司计划将数据储存在新服务器中。[/EX][EX]There is a big department store near our school, so we often go shopping there.|我们学校附近有一家大型百货商店，所以我们经常去那里购物。[/EX][EX]These boxes are used to store old documents in the office.|这些盒子用于在办公室储存旧文件。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]store作动词表示“储存”时，是及物动词，可直接接宾语，无需加介词up（错误：store up energy，虽口语中常用，但规范用法为store energy）。[/ERR][ERR]store作“商店”讲时，复数形式为stores，直接加s，不要写成storees。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆store和shop，store多指大型商店或百货店，shop多指小型店铺或专卖店，二者在日常语境中可通用，但特指小型店铺时用shop更准确。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To let energy or something out from where it is stored (used in Battery Power! Level F, referring to batteries letting out electricity)[/EN][CN]释放；放出（将储存的能量或某物释放出来，出自《Battery Power!》Level F，指电池释放电能）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/rɪˈliːs/（英美）[/PH][DU]Batteries store and release energy called electricity.|(原文例句) 电池储存并释放一种名为电能的能量。[/DU][DU]The machine releases heat when it works for a long time.|这台机器长时间工作会释放热量。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/release.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make a new product, film, book, etc. available to the public; to set someone free from a place or situation[/EN][CN]发布；发行；释放；解放（将新产品、电影、书籍等公之于众；将某人从某地或某种情况中释放）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][DU]The company will release a new phone model next month.|该公司下个月将发布一款新手机型号。[/DU][DU]The police released the innocent man after checking the evidence.|警方核对证据后释放了那个无辜的人。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]release energy|释放能量[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Batteries slowly release energy to power the toy car.|电池缓慢释放能量，为玩具车提供动力。[/EX][C]release heat|释放热量[/C][C]release gas|释放气体[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]release a movie|发行电影[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The film studio will release the adventure movie during the summer vacation.|电影制片厂将在暑假期间发行这部冒险电影。[/EX][C]release a book|出版书籍[/C][C]release a song|发行歌曲[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]release sb from sth|把某人从某物中释放[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The doctor released her from the hospital after she recovered.|她康复后，医生让她出院了。[/EX][C]release from prison|从监狱释放[/C][C]release from stress|从压力中解脱[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Press this button to release the lock of the door.|按下这个按钮可以解开门锁。[/EX][EX]The new game was released last week and became very popular soon.|这款新游戏上周发布，很快就变得非常受欢迎。[/EX][EX]The plant releases oxygen during the day and absorbs carbon dioxide.|这种植物在白天释放氧气，吸收二氧化碳。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]release作动词表示“释放”时，是及物动词，可直接接宾语，无需加介词out，错误：release out energy，正确：release energy。[/ERR][ERR]release的名词形式是release（不可数），表示“一次发布”时可加不定冠词，错误：a new release of the software，正确：the release of the new software/a new software release。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆release和relieve，release侧重“释放、发行”，relieve侧重“缓解、减轻”，错误：relieve the new book，正确：release the new book。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A long, thin piece of metal or wood inside a battery (used in Battery Power! Level F, referring to the center part of a battery)[/EN][CN]（电池的）中心杆；棒（电池内部的细长金属或木质部件，出自《Battery Power!》Level F，指电池的核心部件）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/rɒd/（英式）/rɑːd/（美式）[/PH][DU]Batteries have a center rod, metal case, and chemicals inside them.|(原文例句) 电池内部有一根中心杆、一个金属外壳和化学物质。[/DU][DU]The metal rod in the device helps conduct electricity.|这个装置里的金属杆有助于导电。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/rod.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A long, thin piece of wood or metal used for fishing, supporting things, etc.; a official staff or symbol of authority[/EN][CN]竿；杆；权杖（用于钓鱼、支撑物品等的细长木杆或金属杆；象征权威的权杖）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]He used a bamboo rod to fish by the river on weekends.|他周末用竹竿在河边钓鱼。[/DU][DU]The king held a golden rod during the ceremony.|国王在仪式上手持一根金权杖。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]a center rod|中心杆[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The center rod of the battery is made of special metal to store energy.|电池的中心杆由特殊金属制成，用于储存能量。[/EX][C]a metal rod|金属杆[/C][C]a wooden rod|木质杆[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a fishing rod|钓鱼竿[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]My grandpa gave me a small fishing rod as a birthday gift.|爷爷送了我一根小钓鱼竿作为生日礼物。[/EX][C]a curtain rod|窗帘杆[/C][C]a support rod|支撑杆[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a magic rod|魔杖[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The wizard waved his magic rod and made the monster disappear.|巫师挥动魔杖，让怪兽消失了。[/EX][C]a royal rod|皇家权杖[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The worker used a long rod to reach the book on the top shelf.|工人用一根长杆够到了顶层书架上的书。[/EX][EX]The structure is supported by several steel rods to keep it stable.|这个结构由几根钢杆支撑，以保持稳定。[/EX][EX]She hung the clothes on the rod to dry in the sun.|她把衣服挂在杆子上晒太阳晾干。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]rod是可数名词，复数形式为rods，直接加s，不要写成rodss或rodes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆rod和pole，rod多指较细的杆（如鱼竿、电池杆），pole多指较粗的杆（如旗杆、电线杆），二者不可随意替换。[/ERR][ERR]rod的发音需注意，英式/rɒd/与美式/rɑːd/的区别，不要读成/rəʊd/（road的发音）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Referring to the main colors that can be mixed to make other colors (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F, red, yellow, and blue are primary colors)[/EN][CN]（颜色）原色的（可混合成其他颜色的主要颜色，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F，红色、黄色和蓝色是原色）[/CN][POS]adj./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpraɪməri/（英美）[/PH][DU]Red, yellow, and blue are primary colors.|(原文例句) 红色、黄色和蓝色是原色。[/DU][DU]We can mix primary colors to get more beautiful shades.|我们可以混合原色，得到更漂亮的色调。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/primary.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Main or most important; relating to the first stage of something, especially education[/EN][CN]主要的；首要的；初级的（尤指教育阶段的初级）[/CN][POS]adj./n.[/POS][DU]The primary reason for his success is hard work.|他成功的主要原因是努力工作。[/DU][DU]She studied in a primary school near her home when she was a child.|她小时候在离家近的一所小学上学。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]primary colors|原色[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Art teachers often teach students to mix primary colors in class.|美术老师经常在课堂上教学生混合原色。[/EX][C]primary red|正红色[/C][C]primary yellow|正黄色[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]primary school|小学[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Many children make good friends in primary school.|很多孩子在小学交到好朋友。[/EX][C]primary education|初等教育[/C][C]primary student|小学生[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]primary reason|主要原因[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The primary problem we need to solve is lack of time.|我们需要解决的首要问题是时间不足。[/EX][C]primary goal|首要目标[/C][C]primary importance|至关重要[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Water is a primary need for all living things.|水是所有生物的基本需求。[/EX][EX]The primary function of this machine is to cut paper into small pieces.|这台机器的主要功能是把纸切成小块。[/EX][EX]He plays a primary role in the team's project.|他在团队项目中扮演着主要角色。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]primary作形容词表示“主要的”时，比较级是more primary，最高级是most primary，不要变y为i加er/est（错误：primarier）。[/ERR][ERR]primary school是固定搭配，中间不可加冠词，错误：a primary school（指某一所小学时可加），泛指小学教育时不加，正确：She teaches in primary school.。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆primary和principal，primary侧重“初级的、首要的”，principal侧重“最重要的、校长”，错误：principal colors，正确：primary colors。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Referring to colors made by mixing two primary colors (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F, orange, green, and purple are secondary colors)[/EN][CN]（颜色）次生色的；间色的（由两种原色混合而成，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F，橙色、绿色和紫色是次生色）[/CN][POS]adj./n.[/POS][PH]/ˈsekəndri/（英美）[/PH][DU]Orange, green, and purple are secondary colors.|(原文例句) 橙色、绿色和紫色是次生色。[/DU][DU]We can get secondary colors by mixing red and yellow, blue and red, or yellow and blue.|我们可以通过混合红色和黄色、蓝色和红色或黄色和蓝色得到次生色。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/secondary.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Less important than something else; relating to the second stage of something, especially education[/EN][CN]次要的；第二的；中级的（尤指教育阶段的中级）[/CN][POS]adj./n.[/POS][DU]Safety is secondary to nothing in this factory.|在这家工厂，安全高于一切（没有什么比安全更重要）。[/DU][DU]He went to a secondary school after graduating from primary school.|他小学毕业后进入了一所中学。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]secondary colors|次生色；间色[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The painter used many secondary colors to make the picture more vivid.|画家使用了许多次生色，让画面更生动。[/EX][C]secondary orange|橙黄色[/C][C]secondary green|草绿色[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]secondary school|中学[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Students learn more subjects in secondary school than in primary school.|中学生比小学生学习的科目更多。[/EX][C]secondary education|中等教育[/C][C]secondary student|中学生[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]secondary importance|次要地位[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]This matter is of secondary importance; we can deal with it later.|这件事处于次要地位，我们可以稍后处理。[/EX][C]secondary effect|次要影响[/C][C]secondary role|次要角色[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The secondary cause of the accident was poor weather conditions.|事故的次要原因是恶劣的天气状况。[/EX][EX]This tool has a primary function of cutting and a secondary function of opening bottles.|这个工具的主要功能是切割，次要功能是开瓶。[/EX][EX]Secondary colors are often used in children's paintings because they are bright.|次生色常被用于儿童绘画，因为它们很鲜艳。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]secondary的复数形式（作名词时）是secondaries，不要写成secondarys或secondariers。[/ERR][ERR]secondary作形容词表示“次要的”时，比较级是more secondary，最高级是most secondary，不可变y为i加er/est。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆secondary和second，secondary侧重“次要的、中级的”，second侧重“第二的、秒”，错误：second colors，正确：secondary colors。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Colors that make people feel warm, such as red, orange, and yellow (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F)[/EN][CN]暖色（让人感觉温暖的颜色，如红色、橙色和黄色，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/wɔːm ˈkʌlə(r)/（英式）/wɔːrm ˈkʌlər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Red, orange, and yellow are warm colors.|(原文例句) 红色、橙色和黄色是暖色。[/DU][DU]People often use warm colors to decorate rooms in winter to feel cozy.|人们冬天常常用暖色装饰房间，让人感觉舒适。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/warm-color.webp[/IMG]
