[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]warm color是可数名词短语，复数形式为warm colors，不可遗漏color后的s，错误：warm color are，正确：warm colors are。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆warm color和hot color，warm color指“让人感觉温暖的颜色”，hot color指“鲜艳、刺眼的颜色”，二者含义不同，不可通用。[/ERR][ERR]warm color的发音需注意，color在英式中读/ˈkʌlə(r)/，美式中读/ˈkʌlər/，不要读成/ˈkɒlə(r)/（英式color的错误发音）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Colors that make people feel cool or calm, such as blue, green, and purple (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F)[/EN][CN]冷色（让人感觉凉爽或平静的颜色，如蓝色、绿色和紫色，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/kuːl ˈkʌlə(r)/（英式）/kuːl ˈkʌlər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Blue, green, and purple are cool colors.|(原文例句) 蓝色、绿色和紫色是冷色。[/DU][DU]Cool colors are suitable for decorating bedrooms because they can help people relax.|冷色适合装饰卧室，因为它们能帮助人们放松。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/cool-color.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]calm cool colors|平静的冷色[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The designer used calm cool colors to decorate the office, making employees work more efficiently.|设计师用平静的冷色装饰办公室，让员工工作更高效。[/EX][C]fresh cool colors|清新的冷色[/C][C]dark cool colors|深色冷色[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]decorate with cool colors|用冷色装饰[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We decided to decorate the study with cool colors to create a quiet atmosphere.|我们决定用冷色装饰书房，营造安静的氛围。[/EX][C]paint with cool colors|用冷色绘画[/C][C]mix cool colors|混合冷色[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]cool colors of summer|夏天的冷色[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The cool colors of summer, like light blue and green, make people feel refreshed.|夏天的冷色，如浅蓝色和绿色，让人感觉清爽。[/EX][C]cool colors of the sea|大海的冷色[/C][C]cool colors of the sky|天空的冷色[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Cool colors can make a large room look more peaceful and comfortable.|冷色可以让大房间看起来更宁静、更舒适。[/EX][EX]The artist used cool colors to paint the winter landscape, showing the coldness of the season.|画家使用冷色描绘冬季风景，展现了这个季节的寒冷。[/EX][EX]Many hospitals use cool colors in corridors to make patients feel calm.|很多医院在走廊使用冷色，让病人感觉平静。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]cool color是可数名词短语，复数形式为cool colors，不可遗漏color后的s，错误：cool color is，正确：cool colors are。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆cool color和cold color，cool color指“让人感觉凉爽、平静的颜色”，cold color指“让人感觉寒冷、冷漠的颜色”，二者情感倾向不同。[/ERR][ERR]cool color的搭配中，介词用in/with，错误：cool color on the wall，正确：cool colors on the wall。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A darker form of a color made by adding black (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F)[/EN][CN]（颜色的）深色；阴影色（通过加黑色形成的更深颜色，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/ʃeɪd/（英美）[/PH][DU]Adding black makes shades of colors.|(原文例句) 加黑色会形成各种深色色调。[/DU][DU]She chose a dark shade of blue for her bedroom walls.|她为卧室墙壁选择了深蓝色调。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/shade.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A dark area where the sun does not shine, caused by something blocking it; to protect from the sun or light[/EN][CN]树荫；阴凉处；遮蔽（某物遮挡阳光形成的阴暗区域；遮挡阳光或光线）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]We sat in the shade of a big tree to avoid the hot sun.|我们坐在大树的树荫下躲避烈日。[/DU][DU]She used an umbrella to shade her baby from the sun.|她用雨伞为宝宝遮挡阳光。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]shades of a color|某种颜色的不同深色色调[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The dress comes in different shades of pink, from light to dark.|这条裙子有不同深浅的粉色，从浅到深。[/EX][C]a shade of red|红色调[/C][C]dark shades|深色阴影[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in the shade|在阴凉处[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Old people like to chat in the shade in summer afternoons.|老人们喜欢在夏天的下午在阴凉处聊天。[/EX][C]under the shade of a tree|在树荫下[/C][C]seek shade|寻找阴凉处[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]shade sb/sth from sth|为某人/某物遮挡某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The curtain shades the room from strong sunlight.|窗帘为房间遮挡强烈的阳光。[/EX][C]shade eyes from the sun|遮挡眼睛免受阳光照射[/C][C]shade plants from rain|为植物遮挡雨水[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The artist used different shades of gray to paint the city at night.|画家使用不同深浅的灰色描绘夜晚的城市。[/EX][EX]There are many trees in the park, so there are plenty of shades to rest.|公园里有很多树，所以有很多阴凉处可以休息。[/EX][EX]He shaded his face with his hand to look at the distant mountain.|他用手遮挡脸部，看向远方的山。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]shade作“色调”讲时，是可数名词，复数形式为shades，不要写成shadees。[/ERR][ERR]shade作动词表示“遮挡”时，是及物动词，后接宾语需加介词from，错误：shade the sun，正确：shade from the sun。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆shade和shadow，shade侧重“阴凉处、色调”，shadow侧重“影子、阴影”，错误：sit in the shadow of a tree，正确：sit in the shade of a tree（指树荫）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A lighter form of a color made by adding white (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F)[/EN][CN]（颜色的）浅色；淡色调（通过加白色形成的更浅颜色，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/tɪnt/（英美）[/PH][DU]Adding white makes tints of colors.|(原文例句) 加白色会形成各种浅色色调。[/DU][DU]She likes the light tint of pink on the walls of the baby's room.|她喜欢婴儿房墙壁上淡淡的粉色调。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tint.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A small amount of a color; to color something slightly[/EN][CN]少许颜色；染色；着色（给某物轻微染色）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]The fabric has a faint tint of blue that looks very elegant.|这块布料带有淡淡的蓝色，看起来很优雅。[/DU][DU]She tinted her hair a light brown for the summer.|她为夏天把头发染成了浅棕色。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]tints of a color|某种颜色的不同浅色调[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The painter used soft tints of purple to paint the lavender field.|画家使用柔和的紫色调描绘薰衣草田。[/EX][C]a tint of blue|浅蓝色调[/C][C]light tints|浅色色调[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]tint sth with sth|用某物给某物染色[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The artist tinted the paper with a light yellow to make it look old.|艺术家把纸染成淡黄色，让它看起来有年代感。[/EX][C]tint hair with brown|把头发染成棕色[/C][C]tint glass with green|把玻璃染成绿色[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a faint tint|淡淡的色调[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a faint tint of pink in the white clouds at sunrise.|日出时的白云中有淡淡的粉色调。[/EX][C]a slight tint|轻微的颜色[/C][C]a soft tint|柔和的色调[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The walls of the room have a warm tint of yellow that makes people feel relaxed.|房间的墙壁有温暖的黄色调，让人感觉放松。[/EX][EX]She tinted the photograph to make the colors more vivid.|她给照片染色，让颜色更鲜艳。[/EX][EX]The water in the lake has a tint of green because of the plants underneath.|因为水下的植物，湖水带有淡淡的绿色。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]tint作“色调”讲时，是可数名词，复数形式为tints，不要写成tintss。[/ERR][ERR]tint作动词表示“染色”时，是及物动词，后接宾语无需加介词，错误：tint on the hair，正确：tint the hair。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆tint和dye，tint侧重“轻微染色、着色”，dye侧重“深度染色”，错误：tint clothes black，正确：dye clothes black（指染成黑色，颜色较深）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Referring to colors that are across from each other on a color wheel and look good together (used in Color Wheel Colors Level F)[/EN][CN]（颜色）互补的（色轮上相对的颜色，搭配起来好看，出自《Color Wheel Colors》Level F）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˌkɒmplɪˈmentri/（英式）/ˌkɑːmplɪˈmentri/（美式）[/PH][DU]Colors across from each other are complementary.|(原文例句) 色轮上相对的颜色是互补色。[/DU][DU]Red and green are complementary colors that are often used in Christmas decorations.|红色和绿色是互补色，常被用于圣诞装饰。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/complementary.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Combining well with something else to form a whole; supplying what is missing from something else[/EN][CN]补充的；补足的（与某物很好地结合形成一个整体；补充某物所缺少的部分）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The two teams have complementary skills, so they work well together on the project.|这两个团队拥有互补的技能，所以在项目上合作得很好。[/DU][DU]The book provides complementary information to what we learned in class.|这本书提供了我们在课堂上学到的补充信息。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]complementary colors|互补色[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Art students need to learn which colors are complementary to create beautiful works.|美术学生需要学习哪些颜色是互补色，以创作美丽的作品。[/EX][C]complementary red and green|红色和绿色互补[/C][C]complementary blue and orange|蓝色和橙色互补[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]complementary skills|互补的技能[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]He is good at planning and she is good at executing, so their skills are complementary.|他擅长规划，她擅长执行，所以他们的技能是互补的。[/EX][C]complementary advantages|互补优势[/C][C]complementary knowledge|互补知识[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]complementary to sth|与某物互补[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]This software is complementary to the main program and improves its functions.|这款软件与主程序互补，提升了其功能。[/EX][C]complementary to each other|彼此互补[/C][C]complementary to the plan|对计划的补充[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The complementary colors of yellow and purple make the poster very eye-catching.|黄色和紫色这对互补色让海报非常引人注目。[/EX][C]complementary to each other|彼此互补[/C][C]complementary to the plan|对计划的补充[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The complementary colors of yellow and purple make the poster very eye-catching.|黄色和紫色这对互补色让海报非常引人注目。[/EX][EX]The two companies signed a cooperation agreement because their business scopes are complementary.|这两家公司签署了合作协议，因为它们的业务范围是互补的。[/EX][EX]The necklace is complementary to her dress and makes her look more elegant.|这条项链与她的裙子互补，让她看起来更优雅。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]complementary的拼写不要漏写中间的e，错误：complimentary（意为“免费的、赞美的”），二者发音相同但含义不同，切勿混淆。[/ERR][ERR]complementary是形容词，不可作名词用，错误：a complementary，正确：a complementary color。[/ERR][ERR]complementary后接介词to，错误：complementary with，正确：complementary to。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A planned time for children to meet and play together (used in Stella Storyteller Level F, referring to the cookie's imaginary meeting to play)[/EN][CN]（儿童的）玩伴约会；一起玩耍的约定时间（出自《Stella Storyteller》Level F，指饼干想象中的玩耍约会）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpleɪdeɪt/（英美）[/PH][DU]The second cookie went on a playdate.|(原文例句) 第二块饼干去赴玩伴约会了。[/DU][DU]My daughter has a playdate with her classmate at the park this Saturday.|我女儿这周六和同学在公园有个玩伴约会。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/playdate.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]have a playdate|有玩伴约会[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The little boy is very excited because he is going to have a playdate with his best friend.|这个小男孩非常兴奋，因为他要和最好的朋友进行玩伴约会。[/EX][C]arrange a playdate|安排玩伴约会[/C][C]go on a playdate|去赴玩伴约会[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a playdate at the park|在公园的玩伴约会[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]They prepared snacks and toys for the playdate at the park.|他们为在公园的玩伴约会准备了零食和玩具。[/EX][C]a playdate at home|在家的玩伴约会[/C][C]a playdate with classmates|和同学的玩伴约会[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]during the playdate|在玩伴约会期间[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]During the playdate, the children played games and shared stories.|在玩伴约会期间，孩子们一起玩游戏、分享故事。[/EX][C]after the playdate|玩伴约会之后[/C][C]before the playdate|玩伴约会之前[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]She called her friend's mom to arrange a playdate for their kids next weekend.|她给朋友的妈妈打电话，为孩子们安排下周末的玩伴约会。[/EX][EX]The playdate was canceled because of the bad weather, so the children felt a little sad.|因为天气不好，玩伴约会取消了，孩子们有点难过。[/EX][EX]During the playdate, they learned to share toys with each other and made more friends.|在玩伴约会期间，他们学会了彼此分享玩具，还交了更多朋友。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]playdate是可数名词，复数形式为playdates，直接加s，不要写成playdatees或play-dates（正确拼写为连写，无需连字符）。[/ERR][ERR]playdate的搭配中，常用have/arrange/go on等动词，错误：do a playdate，正确：have a playdate。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆playdate和date，playdate特指儿童之间的玩耍约会，date特指成年人的约会，二者适用对象不同。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To stumble and almost fall or fall (used in Are You Okay? Level F, referring to Dog stumbling while walking to school)[/EN][CN]绊倒；绊跌（走路时被某物绊倒，险些摔倒或摔倒，出自《Are You Okay?》Level F，指小狗上学路上绊倒）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/trɪp/（英美）[/PH][DU]Dog tripped and fell.|(原文例句) 小狗绊倒摔倒了。[/DU][DU]She tripped over a stone on the path and scraped her knee.|她在小路上被一块石头绊倒，膝盖擦伤了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/trip.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A journey to a place for a short time, especially for pleasure; to move with light, quick steps[/EN][CN]旅行；出行（短途的旅程，尤指为了娱乐；轻快地走）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]We went on a school trip to the zoo last Friday.|上周五我们学校组织了去动物园的旅行。[/DU][DU]The little girl tripped along the beach, chasing seagulls.|小女孩轻快地沿着沙滩跑，追逐海鸥。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]trip over sth|被某物绊倒[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Owl helped Dog up after he tripped over a root on the way to school.|小狗在上学路上被树根绊倒后，猫头鹰把他扶了起来。[/EX][C]trip on the stairs|在楼梯上绊倒[/C][C]trip over a wire|被电线绊倒[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]go on a trip|去旅行[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]My family will go on a trip to the mountains during the holiday.|我们家假期要去山里旅行。[/EX][C]a school trip|学校旅行[/C][C]a short trip|短途旅行[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]trip lightly|轻快地走[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The ballerina tripped lightly across the stage, dancing beautifully.|芭蕾舞女演员轻快地穿过舞台，舞姿优美。[/EX][C]trip along the path|沿着小路轻快地走[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Be careful not to trip over the rug when you walk into the room.|走进房间时小心别被小地毯绊倒。[/EX][EX]We had a wonderful trip to the seaside and collected many seashells.|我们去海边的旅行很愉快，收集了很多贝壳。[/EX][EX]The little boy tripped over his own feet and laughed loudly.|小男孩被自己的脚绊倒了，然后大声笑了起来。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]trip作动词表示“绊倒”时，过去式和过去分词为tripped，双写p加ed，不要写成triped。[/ERR][ERR]trip作“旅行”讲时，是可数名词，复数形式为trips，不要写成tripes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆trip和travel，trip侧重“短途旅行”，travel侧重“长途旅行（不可数）”，错误：a long trip（可）/a long travel（不可），正确：a long journey/travel to other countries。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Feeling sad, worried, or annoyed (used in Bake Sale Level F, referring to Billy being sad because his bike was broken)[/EN][CN]不高兴的；心烦的；苦恼的（感到悲伤、担忧或恼怒，出自《Bake Sale》Level F，指比利因为自行车坏了而心烦）[/CN][POS]adj./v./n.[/POS][PH]/ʌpˈset/（英美，形容词/动词）/ˈʌpset/（英美，名词）[/PH][DU]“You look upset,” Mac said to Billy.|(原文例句) “你看起来不高兴，”麦克对比利说。[/DU][DU]She felt upset when she found her favorite book was lost.|发现自己最喜欢的书丢了，她感到很心烦。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/upset.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make someone feel sad, worried, or annoyed; to knock something over by accident[/EN][CN]使心烦；使苦恼；打翻；弄翻（意外撞倒某物）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The bad news upset all the students in the class.|这个坏消息让班里所有学生都很心烦。[/DU][DU]He accidentally upset the cup of water and wet the paper.|他不小心打翻了水杯，弄湿了纸。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]A feeling of being sad, worried, or annoyed; a problem or disturbance[/EN][CN]心烦；苦恼；混乱；麻烦[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]She tried to hide her upset after failing the test.|考试不及格后，她努力掩饰自己的苦恼。[/DU][DU]The delay caused an upset in our travel plans.|延误打乱了我们的旅行计划。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]feel upset|感到心烦[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Billy felt upset because he couldn't afford to fix his broken bike.|比利因为没钱修坏了的自行车而感到心烦。[/EX][C]get upset|变得不高兴[/C][C]be upset about sth|为某事心烦[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]upset sb|使某人心烦[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Don't upset your mom by forgetting her birthday.|别因为忘记妈妈的生日让她心烦。[/EX][C]upset a friend|惹朋友不高兴[/C][C]upset the balance|打破平衡[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]upset sth|打翻某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The cat jumped onto the table and upset the bowl of soup.|猫跳到桌子上，打翻了汤碗。[/EX][C]upset a glass of milk|打翻一杯牛奶[/C][C]upset the apple cart|打乱计划[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]He was upset about missing the important game on TV.|他因为错过了电视上的重要比赛而心烦。[/EX][EX]The strong wind upset many umbrellas on the street.|大风刮翻了街上很多雨伞。[/EX][EX]There was a big upset in the football match— the weak team won.|足球比赛出现了大冷门——弱队赢了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]upset的过去式和过去分词为upset（不变形），不要写成upsetted或upsettd。[/ERR][ERR]upset作形容词时，主语是人，表“心烦的”，若主语是物，需用upsetting（令人心烦的），错误：The news is upset.，正确：The news is upsetting./I am upset about the news.。[/ERR][ERR]upset作“打翻”讲时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词over，错误：upset over the cup，正确：upset the cup。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A special food or thing that you enjoy (used in Bake Sale Level F, referring to the apple-based foods Tosh baked for the sale)[/EN][CN]美味的食物；乐趣；乐事（让人享受的特殊食物或事物，出自《Bake Sale》Level F，指托什为义卖烘焙的苹果类美食）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/triːt/（英美）[/PH][DU]Tosh baked many yummy apple treats.|(原文例句) 托什烤了很多美味的苹果点心。[/DU][DU]Ice cream is a favorite treat for many children in summer.|冰淇淋是很多孩子夏天最喜欢的美食。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/treat.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To behave towards someone in a particular way; to give medical care to someone who is ill or hurt; to deal with a problem or situation[/EN][CN]对待；看待；治疗；处理（以特定方式对待某人；为生病或受伤的人提供医疗护理；处理问题或情况）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]We should treat everyone with kindness and respect.|我们应该友善、尊重地对待每个人。[/DU][DU]The doctor treated his cold with some medicine.|医生用一些药治疗了他的感冒。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To pay for something for someone, especially food or drinks[/EN][CN]请客；款待（为某人支付某物的费用，尤指食物或饮料）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]My dad treated the whole family to dinner at a restaurant tonight.|爸爸今晚请全家人在餐厅吃了晚饭。[/DU][DU]She treated her friends to ice cream after the exam.|考试后她请朋友们吃了冰淇淋。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]apple treats|苹果点心[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]People bought many apple treats like pies and jams at the bake sale.|人们在义卖会上买了很多苹果点心，比如苹果派和苹果酱。[/EX][C]sweet treats|甜食[/C][C]a special treat|特别的乐事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]treat sb well|善待某人[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The teacher treats all her students well and cares about their growth.|老师善待所有学生，关心他们的成长。[/EX][C]treat sb badly|虐待某人[/C][C]treat sb with respect|尊重某人[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]treat a disease|治疗疾病[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Doctors are trying their best to treat the rare disease.|医生们正在尽力治疗这种罕见病。[/EX][C]treat an injury|处理伤口[/C][C]treat sb to sth|请某人吃某物[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Going to the park is a nice treat for us on weekends.|周末去公园对我们来说是件愉快的事。[/EX][EX]The company decided to treat its employees to a trip abroad.|公司决定请员工出国旅行。[/EX][EX]We need to treat this problem carefully before making a decision.|在做决定之前，我们需要谨慎处理这个问题。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]treat作“对待”讲时，常见搭配为treat sb as sth（把某人当作某物），不要混淆为treat sb like sth（口语中可通用，但规范搭配为as）。[/ERR][ERR]treat作“治疗”讲时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词for，错误：treat for the cold，正确：treat the cold。[/ERR][ERR]treat作“请客”讲时，固定搭配为treat sb to sth，不可漏掉to，错误：treat sb sth，正确：treat sb to dinner。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A food made by cooking apples with sugar and water, usually smooth (used in Bake Sale Level F, one of the apple treats people bought)[/EN][CN]苹果酱（将苹果加糖和水煮熟制成的食物，通常质地顺滑，出自《Bake Sale》Level F，是人们在义卖会上购买的苹果类点心之一）[/CN][POS]n.（不可数）[/POS][PH]/ˈæplsɔːs/（英式）/ˈæplsɔːrs/（美式）[/PH][DU]People bought applesauce at the bake sale.|(原文例句) 人们在义卖会上买了苹果酱。[/DU][DU]My mom makes delicious applesauce every autumn when apples are in season.|每年秋天苹果上市时，妈妈都会做美味的苹果酱。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/applesauce.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]homemade applesauce|自制苹果酱[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Tosh made homemade applesauce with fresh apples for the bake sale.|托什用新鲜苹果做了自制苹果酱，拿去参加义卖。[/EX][C]sweet applesauce|甜苹果酱[/C][C]unsweetened applesauce|无糖苹果酱[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]eat applesauce|吃苹果酱[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The little boy likes to eat applesauce with bread for breakfast.|这个小男孩喜欢早餐吃苹果酱配面包。[/EX][C]serve applesauce|供应苹果酱[/C][C]make applesauce|制作苹果酱[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]applesauce with cinnamon|肉桂苹果酱[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]She added some cinnamon to the applesauce and it tasted better.|她在苹果酱里加了点肉桂，味道更好了。[/EX][C]applesauce with yogurt|苹果酱配酸奶[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Applesauce is a popular side dish for pancakes in many countries.|在很多国家，苹果酱是薄煎饼的热门配菜。[/EX][EX]We can use applesauce as a healthy substitute for sugar in some recipes.|在一些食谱中，我们可以用苹果酱作为糖的健康替代品。[/EX][EX]The jar of applesauce in the fridge can be kept for a month.|冰箱里那罐苹果酱可以保存一个月。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]applesauce是不可数名词，不可直接加s变复数，错误：applesauces，若表示“多份苹果酱”，需用servings of applesauce。[/ERR][ERR]applesauce的拼写是apple+sauce连写，不要分开写（错误：apple sauce），也不要加连字符（错误：apple-sauce）。[/ERR][ERR]不要把applesauce发音为/ˈæpl saʊs/，注意apple和sauce连读，正确发音为/ˈæplsɔːs/（英式）/ˈæplsɔːrs/（美式）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small, sweet or savory pastry with a filling (used in Bake Sale Level F, one of the apple treats people bought)[/EN][CN]果馅饼；小馅饼（一种有馅料的小型甜点心或咸点心，出自《Bake Sale》Level F，是人们在义卖会上购买的苹果类点心之一）[/CN][POS]n./adj.[/POS][PH]/tɑːt/（英式）/tɑːrt/（美式）[/PH][DU]People bought apple tarts at the bake sale.|(原文例句) 人们在义卖会上买了苹果馅饼。[/DU][DU]She baked a batch of lemon tarts and shared them with her neighbors.|她烤了一批柠檬馅饼，分给了邻居们。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tart.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Having a sharp, sour taste; (of a person's words or manner) sharp and unkind[/EN][CN]酸的；尖刻的；刻薄的（味道尖锐、酸；人的言语或态度尖锐不友善）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The cherry is a bit tart, but I still like it.|这颗樱桃有点酸，但我还是喜欢。[/DU][DU]She made a tart comment about his mistake and hurt his feelings.|她对他的错误发表了尖刻的评论，伤害了他的感情。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]apple tart|苹果馅饼[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Mac and Tosh sold many apple tarts at their bake sale and earned much money.|麦克和托什在义卖会上卖了很多苹果馅饼，赚了不少钱。[/EX][C]fruit tart|水果馅饼[/C][C]chocolate tart|巧克力馅饼[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]tart taste|酸味[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The tart taste of the orange makes it refreshing.|橙子的酸味让它很清爽。[/EX][C]tart apples|酸苹果[/C][C]tart lemonade|酸柠檬水[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]tart words|尖刻的话[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]We should avoid using tart words when talking to friends.|和朋友说话时，我们应该避免使用尖刻的语言。[/EX][C]tart manner|刻薄的态度[/C][C]tart reply|尖锐的回答[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The bakery on the street sells delicious strawberry tarts every weekend.|街上的面包店每个周末都卖美味的草莓馅饼。[/EX][EX]This grape is too tart for my little sister— she likes sweet fruits.|这颗葡萄对我妹妹来说太酸了，她喜欢甜水果。[/EX][EX]His tart response made the conversation awkward.|他尖锐的回应让谈话变得很尴尬。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]tart作“果馅饼”讲时，复数形式为tarts，直接加s，不要写成tartes或tartts。[/ERR][ERR]tart作形容词表示“酸的”时，比较级是tarter，最高级是tartest，不要写成more tart/most tart（非正式可使用，规范形式为tarter/tartest）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆tart和pie，tart通常是小型、薄底的馅饼，pie是大型、厚底的派，二者大小和饼底厚度有区别，不可完全通用。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To get money by working (used in Jobs for James Level F, referring to James getting money by doing chores)[/EN][CN]赚得；挣得（通过工作获得金钱，出自《Jobs for James》Level F，指詹姆斯通过做家务赚钱）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ɜːn/（英美）[/PH][DU]James earned money by pulling weeds, cleaning the garage, and raking leaves.|(原文衍生例句) 詹姆斯通过拔草、打扫车库和耙树叶赚钱。[/DU][DU]She earns $10 an hour by helping her neighbor walk the dog.|她帮邻居遛狗，每小时赚10美元。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/earn.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To gain or deserve something because of your actions or qualities[/EN][CN]赢得；获得（因自身行为或品质而获得某物）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]He earned the respect of his classmates by being honest and helpful.|他因诚实乐于助人而赢得了同学们的尊重。[/DU][DU]The team earned a chance to compete in the final by winning all their games.|这支队伍赢了所有比赛，赢得了晋级决赛的机会。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]earn money|赚钱[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]James earned enough money to buy a new hamster cage by doing chores for his family and neighbors.|詹姆斯通过给家人和邻居做家务，赚够了买新仓鼠笼的钱。[/EX][C]earn a living|谋生[/C][C]earn wages|挣工资[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]earn respect|赢得尊重[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The teacher earns the students' respect by treating everyone fairly.|这位老师因公平对待每个人而赢得学生们的尊重。[/EX][C]earn praise|赢得赞扬[/C][C]earn trust|获得信任[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]earn sth by doing sth|通过做某事获得某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]She earned a scholarship by studying hard every day.|她通过每天努力学习获得了奖学金。[/EX][C]earn a reward by helping others|通过帮助他人获得奖励[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The restaurant earns a lot of money on weekends because many people come to eat.|这家餐厅周末赚了很多钱，因为有很多人来吃饭。[/EX][EX]His hard work earned him a promotion at work.|他的努力工作让他在工作中得到了晋升。[/EX][EX]You can earn points by shopping at this store, and exchange them for gifts.|你在这家店购物可以积分，然后用积分兑换礼物。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]earn的过去式和过去分词为earned，直接加ed，不要写成earnt（英式口语中可使用，规范写法为earned）。[/ERR][ERR]earn表示“赚钱”时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词for，错误：earn money for working，正确：earn money by working。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆earn和win，earn侧重“通过努力获得（金钱、尊重等）”，win侧重“赢得比赛、奖品等”，错误：earn the game，正确：win the game。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A part of a place or country (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to places where birds live in different seasons)[/EN][CN]区域；地区（地方或国家的一部分，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指鸟类不同季节栖息的区域）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈeəriə/（英式）/ˈeriə/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bluebirds have summer area, winter area, and year-round area.|(原文衍生例句) 蓝鸟有夏季栖息地、冬季栖息地和全年栖息地。[/DU][DU]We visited a rural area in the north of the country during the holiday.|我们假期去了这个国家北部的一个农村地区。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/area.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A particular subject or field of activity; the size of a surface[/EN][CN]领域；范围；面积（特定的主题或活动领域；表面的大小）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]She is an expert in the area of computer science.|她是计算机科学领域的专家。[/DU][DU]The area of this room is about 20 square meters.|这个房间的面积大约是20平方米。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]summer area|夏季区域[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Many birds fly to their summer area to breed when the weather gets warm.|天气变暖时，许多鸟类飞到它们的夏季栖息地繁殖。[/EX][C]winter area|冬季区域[/C][C]year-round area|全年区域[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]rural area|农村地区[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There are fewer shops in rural areas than in cities.|农村地区的商店比城市里少。[/EX][C]urban area|城市地区[/C][C]coastal area|沿海地区[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]area of study|研究领域[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]His area of study is environmental protection, and he has published many papers.|他的研究领域是环境保护，发表了很多论文。[/EX][C]area of interest|兴趣领域[/C][C]area of work|工作范围[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The park has a special area for children to play, with many toys and slides.|这个公园有一个专门供孩子们玩耍的区域，有很多玩具和滑梯。[/EX][EX]She is looking for a job in the area of education because she likes working with kids.|她正在教育领域找工作，因为她喜欢和孩子们一起工作。[/EX][EX]The math problem asks us to calculate the area of a circle with a radius of 5 centimeters.|这道数学题要求我们计算半径为5厘米的圆的面积。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]area是可数名词，复数形式为areas，直接加s，不要写成areaes。[/ERR][ERR]表示“在某个地区”时，常用介词in，错误：at this area，正确：in this area。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆area和region，area泛指“区域、面积”，region侧重“行政区域、地理区域”，错误：a region of a city，正确：an area of a city（指城市的一部分）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Happening or existing all year long (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to areas where birds live all year)[/EN][CN]全年的；终年的（全年发生或存在，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指鸟类全年栖息的区域）[/CN][POS]adj./adv.[/POS][PH]/ˌjɪə raʊnd/（英式）/ˌjɪr raʊnd/（美式）[/PH][DU]Eastern bluebirds have a year-round area where they live all year.|(原文衍生例句) 东部蓝鸟有一个全年栖息地，它们全年都住在那里。[/DU][DU]This town has year-round sunshine, so it's a popular tourist destination.|这个小镇全年阳光充足，是热门的旅游目的地。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/year-round.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]year-round area|全年区域[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Some birds don't migrate because they have a safe year-round area with enough food.|有些鸟类不迁徙，因为它们有安全的全年栖息地，食物充足。[/EX][C]year-round weather|全年稳定的天气[/C][C]year-round work|全年性工作[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]all year-round|全年；终年[POS]adv.[/POS][/H][EX]The lake is frozen all year-round, so people can skate on it in winter.|这个湖全年结冰，所以人们冬天可以在上面滑冰。[/EX][C]operate year-round|全年运营[/C][C]stay year-round|全年停留[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]year-round activities|全年活动[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The community center offers year-round activities for both children and adults.|社区中心为儿童和成人提供全年性的活动。[/EX][C]year-round access|全年可使用[/C][C]year-round supply|全年供应[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]This plant is a year-round bloomer, so you can see flowers on it every month.|这种植物是全年开花的，所以每个月都能看到它开花。[/EX][EX]The hotel is open year-round, welcoming tourists from all over the world.|这家酒店全年营业，接待来自世界各地的游客。[/EX][EX]We need a year-round plan to protect the environment, not just for one season.|我们需要一个全年的环保计划，而不仅仅是一个季节。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]year-round是合成词，中间需加连字符，不可分开写（错误：year round）或写成一个单词（错误：yearround），规范写法为year-round。[/ERR][ERR]year-round作形容词时，通常放在名词前作定语，不可作表语，错误：The area is year-round.，正确：The area is a year-round habitat.。[/ERR][ERR]发音时注意重音在第一个音节，不要读成/jɪə ˈraʊnd/，正确发音为/ˌjɪə raʊnd/（英式）/ˌjɪr raʊnd/（美式）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Relating to the east part of something (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to a type of bluebird)[/EN][CN]东部的；东方的（与某物的东部有关，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指一种蓝鸟）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈiːstən/（英美）[/PH][DU]The eastern bluebird has summer, winter, and year-round areas.|(原文衍生例句) 东部蓝鸟有夏季、冬季和全年栖息地。[/DU][DU]We visited an eastern city of China and learned about its history.|我们参观了中国的一个东部城市，了解了它的历史。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/eastern.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Relating to the East or its people, especially Eastern Europe, Asia, or the Middle East[/EN][CN]东方的；东部国家的（与东方或其人民有关，尤指东欧、亚洲或中东）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]Eastern culture has a long history and rich traditions.|东方文化有着悠久的历史和丰富的传统。[/DU][DU]She is interested in eastern cuisine and often cooks Chinese and Japanese food.|她对东方美食感兴趣，经常做中餐和日餐。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]eastern bluebird|东部蓝鸟[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The eastern bluebird is a small, colorful bird that lives in North America.|东部蓝鸟是一种小型彩色鸟类，生活在北美。[/EX][C]eastern part|东部地区[/C][C]eastern coast|东海岸[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]eastern country|东方国家[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Many eastern countries celebrate Spring Festival with family gatherings.|许多东方国家通过家庭聚会来庆祝春节。[/EX][C]eastern culture|东方文化[/C][C]eastern time|东部时间[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in the eastern part of|在……的东部[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a large forest in the eastern part of the country, where many animals live.|这个国家的东部有一片大森林，许多动物生活在那里。[/EX][C]eastern region|东部地区[/C][C]eastern hemisphere|东半球[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The eastern sky turns pink at sunrise, which is a beautiful sight.|日出时东方的天空变成粉红色，景色很美。[/EX][EX]Eastern languages, such as Chinese and Korean, use different writing systems from English.|中文和韩语等东方语言使用与英语不同的书写系统。[/EX][EX]The company has offices in both eastern and western parts of the United States.|这家公司在美国的东部和西部都有办事处。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]eastern的比较级是more eastern，最高级是most eastern，不可加er/est（错误：easterner）。[/ERR][ERR]表示“在东部”时，常用介词in，错误：on the eastern of the city，正确：in the eastern part of the city。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆eastern和east，eastern是形容词，修饰名词，east可作名词、形容词或副词，错误：east country，正确：eastern country。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Used to say why someone does something or why something happens (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to birds migrating to survive)[/EN][CN]为了；以便（用于说明某人做某事或某事发生的原因，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指鸟类为了生存而迁徙）[/CN][POS]phrase[/POS][DU]Many birds migrate before winter in order to survive.|(原文例句) 许多鸟类在冬天来临前迁徙以生存。[/DU][DU]She studies hard in order to get good grades in the exam.|她努力学习是为了在考试中取得好成绩。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/in order to.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]in order to do sth|为了做某事[POS]phrase[/POS][/H][EX]Birds fly thousands of miles in order to find warm places and enough food.|鸟类飞行数千英里，为了找到温暖的地方和足够的食物。[/EX][C]in order to achieve sth|为了实现某事[/C][C]in order to protect sth|为了保护某物[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in order to avoid sth|为了避免某事[POS]phrase[/POS][/H][EX]He left early in order to avoid the rush hour traffic.|他早点出发是为了避开高峰时段的交通。[/EX][C]in order to save time|为了节省时间[/C][C]in order to help others|为了帮助他人[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]used at the beginning of a sentence|用于句首[POS]phrase[/POS][/H][EX]In order to finish the project on time, the team works overtime every day.|为了按时完成项目，团队每天都加班。[/EX][C]In order to learn English well|为了学好英语[/C][C]In order to stay healthy|为了保持健康[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]We need to plant more trees in order to improve the environment.|我们需要种更多的树，以改善环境。[/EX][EX]He practices playing the piano every day in order to win the competition.|他每天练习弹钢琴，为了赢得比赛。[/EX][EX]In order to understand the story better, she read the book twice.|为了更好地理解这个故事，她把书读了两遍。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]in order to后接动词原形，不可接动名词，错误：in order to studying，正确：in order to study。[/ERR][ERR]in order to引导目的状语时，不可省略to，错误：in order do sth，正确：in order to do sth。[/ERR][ERR]不要与so that混淆，in order to后接动词原形，so that后接从句，错误：in order to he can pass the exam，正确：in order to pass the exam/so that he can pass the exam。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To continue to live or exist, especially after a difficult or dangerous situation (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to birds living through winter)[/EN][CN]生存；存活；继续存在（尤指在困难或危险的情况下继续生存，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指鸟类度过冬天）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/səˈvaɪv/（英美）[/PH][DU]Many birds migrate before winter in order to survive.|(原文例句) 许多鸟类在冬天来临前迁徙以生存。[/DU][DU]The small animal can survive in the cold winter by storing food in autumn.|这种小动物通过在秋天储存食物，能在寒冷的冬天存活下来。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/survive.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To continue to live after an accident, illness, or war; to manage to live with a difficult situation[/EN][CN]幸存；幸免于难；勉强维持生活（在事故、疾病或战争后继续生存；勉强应对困难局面）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]He was lucky to survive the car accident without serious injuries.|他很幸运在车祸中幸存下来，没有受重伤。[/DU][DU]The family survives on a small income, but they are very happy.|这个家庭靠微薄的收入勉强维持生活，但他们很幸福。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]survive the winter|过冬；度过冬天[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Birds either migrate or find warm places to survive the winter.|鸟类要么迁徙，要么找到温暖的地方过冬。[/EX][C]survive a storm|在暴风雨中幸存[/C][C]survive an illness|战胜疾病[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]survive on sth|靠某物生存[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Plants survive on sunlight, water, and soil.|植物靠阳光、水和土壤生存。[/EX][C]survive on little money|靠很少的钱维持生活[/C][C]survive on food and water|靠食物和水生存[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]struggle to survive|努力生存[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Animals in the desert struggle to survive because of the lack of water.|沙漠里的动物因为缺水而努力生存。[/EX][C]fight to survive|为生存而奋斗[/C][C]manage to survive|设法存活[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The old tree has survived for hundreds of years, witnessing many changes.|这棵古树已经存活了几百年，见证了许多变化。[/EX][EX]She survived the fire by hiding in a small room.|她躲在一个小房间里，从火灾中幸存下来。[/EX][EX]Many endangered animals need our help to survive.|许多濒危动物需要我们的帮助才能存活。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]survive是及物动词，后接宾语时无需加介词，错误：survive from the accident，正确：survive the accident。[/ERR][ERR]survive的名词形式是survival（生存）和survivor（幸存者），不要混淆，错误：a survive，正确：a survivor。[/ERR][ERR]survive的过去式和过去分词为survived，直接加ed，不要写成survivedd。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A group of birds of the same type flying or living together (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to birds migrating in groups)[/EN][CN]鸟群（一群同类的鸟一起飞行或生活，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指成群迁徙的鸟类）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/flɒk/（英式）/flɑːk/（美式）[/PH][DU]Snow geese migrate in a V-shaped flock.|(原文例句) 雪雁以V字形鸟群迁徙。[/DU][DU]A flock of sparrows flew into the garden and ate the seeds.|一群麻雀飞到花园里吃种子。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/flock.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A large group of animals of the same type; a large number of people gathered together[/EN][CN]兽群；人群（一大群同类的动物；聚集在一起的一大群人）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][DU]We saw a flock of sheep eating grass on the hillside.|我们看到一群羊在山坡上吃草。[/DU][DU]A flock of fans waited outside the theater to see the movie star.|一大群粉丝在剧院外等着看这位电影明星。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To gather or move together in a group[/EN][CN]聚集；成群而行[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]People flocked to the park to enjoy the beautiful flowers.|人们成群结队地来到公园欣赏美丽的花朵。[/DU][DU]Birds flocked to the lake to drink water in the morning.|早上，鸟类成群飞到湖边喝水。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]a flock of birds|一群鸟[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A flock of geese flew across the sky, making a loud sound.|一群大雁飞过天空，发出响亮的声音。[/EX][C]a flock of ducks|一群鸭子[/C][C]a flock of pigeons|一群鸽子[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in a flock|成群地[POS]adv.[/POS][/H][EX]Birds migrate in a flock to protect themselves from predators.|鸟类成群迁徙，以保护自己免受捕食者的伤害。[/EX][C]fly in a flock|成群飞行[/C][C]move in a flock|成群移动[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]flock to sth|涌向某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Tourists flocked to the beach during the summer vacation.|暑假期间，游客们涌向海滩。[/EX][C]flock to the city|涌向城市[/C][C]flock to the concert|涌向音乐会[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The farmer watched over his flock of sheep to make sure they didn't get lost.|农夫看管着他的羊群，确保它们不会迷路。[/EX][EX]A flock of butterflies danced in the garden, looking very beautiful.|一群蝴蝶在花园里飞舞，看起来非常美丽。[/EX][EX]People flocked to the new shopping mall on its opening day.|这家新购物中心开业当天，人们纷纷涌向那里。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]flock作“鸟群、兽群”讲时，是可数名词，复数形式为flocks，直接加s，不要写成flockes。[/ERR][ERR]表示“一群”时，不同动物搭配不同量词，flock用于鸟类和绵羊，错误：a flock of cows，正确：a herd of cows。[/ERR][ERR]flock作动词时，是不及物动词，后接宾语需加介词to，错误：flock the park，正确：flock to the park。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small bird with bright feathers that can hover in the air and make a humming sound (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to a migrating bird)[/EN][CN]蜂鸟（一种羽毛鲜艳的小鸟，能在空中悬停并发出嗡嗡声，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指一种迁徙鸟类）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈhʌmɪŋbɜːd/（英美）[/PH][DU]Hummingbirds migrate when the air grows too cold.|(原文例句) 当空气变得太冷时，蜂鸟会迁徙。[/DU][DU]We saw a colorful hummingbird drinking nectar from the flowers in the garden.|我们看到一只色彩鲜艳的蜂鸟在花园里的花上吸食花蜜。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/hummingbird.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]colorful hummingbird|色彩鲜艳的蜂鸟[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The colorful hummingbird is one of the most beautiful birds in the world.|色彩鲜艳的蜂鸟是世界上最美丽的鸟类之一。[/EX][C]small hummingbird|小型蜂鸟[/C][C]tiny hummingbird|微型蜂鸟[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]drink nectar|吸食花蜜[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Hummingbirds have long beaks to drink nectar from deep flowers.|蜂鸟有长长的喙，可以从深层花朵中吸食花蜜。[/EX][C]feed on nectar|以花蜜为食[/C][C]hover to drink nectar|悬停吸食花蜜[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]migrate south|南迁[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Hummingbirds migrate south every winter to find warm places and enough food.|蜂鸟每年冬天南迁，寻找温暖的地方和足够的食物。[/EX][C]migrate to warmer areas|迁徙到温暖的地区[/C][C]begin to migrate|开始迁徙[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The hummingbird can fly backward, which is a unique ability among birds.|蜂鸟能向后飞，这是鸟类中独特的能力。[/EX][EX]We put a hummingbird feeder in the yard, and many hummingbirds come to eat every day.|我们在院子里放了一个蜂鸟喂食器，每天都有很多蜂鸟来吃东西。[/EX][EX]Hummingbirds are very small, some of them are only a few centimeters long.|蜂鸟非常小，有些只有几厘米长。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]hummingbird是可数名词，复数形式为hummingbirds，直接加s，不要写成hummingbirdes。[/ERR][ERR]注意发音，不要把hummingbird读成/ˈhʌmɪŋ bɜːd/（分开读），正确发音为/ˈhʌmɪŋbɜːd/（连读）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆hummingbird和humming，hummingbird是名词“蜂鸟”，humming是动词“嗡嗡叫”或名词“嗡嗡声”，错误：a humming，正确：a hummingbird。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small bird with long wings and a forked tail that flies quickly (used in Some Birds Go Level F, referring to a migrating bird)[/EN][CN]燕子（一种翅膀长、尾巴分叉、飞行迅速的小鸟，出自《Some Birds Go》Level F，指一种迁徙鸟类）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈswɒləʊ/（英式，n.）/ˈswɑːloʊ/（美式，n.）[/PH][DU]Tree swallows migrate in a flock of thousands.|(原文例句) 树燕以数千只的鸟群迁徙。[/DU][DU]We often see swallows building nests under the eaves of houses in spring.|春天我们经常看到燕子在屋檐下筑巢。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/swallow.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make food or drink go down your throat into your stomach; to accept something without question[/EN][CN]吞咽；咽下；轻信；接受（不加质疑地接受某物）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈswɒləʊ/（英式）/ˈswɑːloʊ/（美式）[/PH][DU]She swallowed the medicine with a glass of water.|她用一杯水把药咽了下去。[/DU][DU]He swallowed her excuse without asking any questions.|他不加质疑地相信了她的借口。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]tree swallow|树燕[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Tree swallows are good at flying and catch insects while flying.|树燕擅长飞行，在飞行中捕捉昆虫。[/EX][C]barn swallow|家燕[/C][C]a flock of swallows|一群燕子[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]swallow food|吞咽食物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Chew your food well before you swallow it to help digestion.|吞咽前要把食物嚼碎，以帮助消化。[/EX][C]swallow water|喝水；咽下水分[/C][C]swallow a pill|吞服药片[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]swallow an excuse|轻信借口[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Don't swallow his words easily; you should check the facts first.|不要轻易相信他的话，你应该先核实事实。[/EX][C]swallow a lie|轻信谎言[/C][C]swallow pride|放下自尊[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Swallows fly back to the north every spring to breed.|燕子每年春天飞回北方繁殖。[/EX][EX]He accidentally swallowed a small piece of bone, but it didn't hurt him.|他不小心吞下了一小块骨头，但没有受伤。[/EX][EX]The little girl couldn't swallow the bitter medicine, so her mom mixed it with honey.|小女孩咽不下苦药，所以妈妈把它和蜂蜜混合在一起。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]swallow作“燕子”讲时，复数形式为swallows，直接加s，不要写成swallowes。[/ERR][ERR]swallow作动词表示“吞咽”时，是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词，错误：swallow down the food，正确：swallow the food（down可省略）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆swallow和swallow up，swallow up表示“吞没；耗尽”，错误：swallow the money，正确：swallow up the money（指耗尽金钱）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A round vegetable with white flesh and a purple or white skin (used in The Giant Turnip Level F, referring to the main vegetable in the story)[/EN][CN]芜菁；大头菜（一种圆形蔬菜，果肉白色，果皮紫色或白色，出自《The Giant Turnip》Level F，指故事中的主要蔬菜）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈtɜːnɪp/（英美）[/PH][DU]Grandpa planted a turnip seed, and it grew into a giant turnip.|(原文衍生例句) 爷爷种了一颗芜菁种子，它长成了一颗巨大的芜菁。[/DU][DU]We cooked turnip soup for dinner, and it tasted very delicious.|我们晚餐做了芜菁汤，味道非常美味。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/turnip.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]giant turnip|巨大的芜菁[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]It took Grandpa, Grandma, and their friends to pull out the giant turnip.|爷爷、奶奶和他们的朋友们一起才把那颗巨大的芜菁拔了出来。[/EX][C]fresh turnip|新鲜的芜菁[/C][C]raw turnip|生芜菁[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]turnip soup|芜菁汤[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]My mom makes turnip soup with carrots and potatoes, which is very nutritious.|我妈妈用芜菁、胡萝卜和土豆做汤，非常有营养。[/EX][C]mashed turnip| mashed turnip[/C][C]roasted turnip|烤芜菁[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]plant turnip seeds|种芜菁种子[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Farmers plant turnip seeds in spring and harvest them in autumn.|农民们春天种芜菁种子，秋天收获。[/EX][C]grow turnips|种芜菁[/C][C]harvest turnips|收芜菁[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The turnip is a healthy vegetable that is rich in vitamins and fiber.|芜菁是一种健康的蔬菜，富含维生素和纤维。[/EX][EX]She chopped the turnip into small pieces and fried it with meat.|她把芜菁切成小块，和肉一起炒。[/EX][EX]The giant turnip in the story is so big that no one can pull it out alone.|故事里的巨大芜菁太大了，没有人能独自把它拔出来。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]turnip是可数名词，复数形式为turnips，直接加s，不要写成turnipies。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆turnip和radish，turnip是“芜菁、大头菜”，体型较大，radish是“小萝卜”，体型较小，二者是不同的蔬菜。[/ERR][ERR]发音时注意重音在第一个音节，不要读成/tɜːˈnɪp/，正确发音为/ˈtɜːnɪp/。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To start to grow; to produce new growth (used in The Giant Turnip Level F, referring to turnip leaves growing)[/EN][CN]发芽；长出；抽芽（开始生长；长出新的枝叶，出自《The Giant Turnip》Level F，指芜菁长出叶子）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/spraʊt/（英美）[/PH][DU]In summer, turnip leaves sprouted, and the turnip grew and grew.|(原文例句) 夏天，芜菁长出了叶子，然后越长越大。[/DU][DU]The seeds sprouted after being watered for a few days.|这些种子浇水几天后就发芽了。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/sprout.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A new growth on a plant, such as a new leaf or stem; young vegetables that have just sprouted[/EN][CN]幼苗；新芽；嫩苗（植物上的新生长部分，如新叶或新茎；刚发芽的嫩蔬菜）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]We picked the bean sprouts and cooked them with eggs.|我们摘了豆芽，和鸡蛋一起炒了。[/DU][DU]The plant's sprouts are green and tender, and they grow very fast.|这株植物的嫩芽是绿色的，很嫩，长得非常快。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]sprout leaves|长叶子[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The turnip sprouted green leaves in summer, and it looked very lively.|这颗芜菁夏天长出了绿色的叶子，看起来很有生机。[/EX][C]sprout buds|发芽[/C][C]sprout roots|长根[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]bean sprouts|豆芽[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Bean sprouts are a common ingredient in Chinese cooking, often used in stir-fries and soups.|豆芽是中国烹饪中常见的食材，常用于炒菜和煮汤。[/EX][C]alfalfa sprouts|紫花苜蓿芽[/C][C]vegetable sprouts|蔬菜嫩苗[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]start to sprout|开始发芽[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The seeds started to sprout after being kept in a warm and wet place.|这些种子放在温暖潮湿的地方后开始发芽。[/EX][C]begin to sprout|开始抽芽[/C][C]soon sprout|很快发芽[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The tree sprouted new branches after being pruned last year.|这棵树去年修剪后长出了新的树枝。[/EX][EX]We planted some tomato seeds, and they sprouted in a week.|我们种了一些西红柿种子，一周后它们就发芽了。[/EX][EX]The sprouts of this plant are edible and taste very fresh.|这种植物的嫩苗可以食用，味道很新鲜。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]sprout的过去式和过去分词为sprouted，直接加ed，不要写成sproutted。[/ERR][ERR]sprout作动词表示“发芽”时，是不及物动词，后接宾语需加介词with，错误：sprout leaves，正确：sprout with leaves（或直接说sprout leaves，口语中可省略with，规范用法需加）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆sprout和grow，sprout侧重“发芽、抽芽”，grow侧重“生长、成长”，错误：the plant sprouted quickly，正确：the plant grew quickly（指植物整体生长快）/the seeds sprouted quickly（指种子发芽快）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A prize given to someone for their good work, skill, or achievement (used in Ramadan Is Here Level F, referring to what people win during Ramadan)[/EN][CN]奖；奖品；奖项（因工作出色、技能突出或取得成就而授予的奖品，出自《Ramadan Is Here》Level F，指人们在斋月期间赢得的荣誉）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/əˈwɔːd/（英美）[/PH][DU]Ramadan is here! We win awards during Ramadan.|(原文例句) 斋月到了！我们在斋月期间赢得奖项。[/DU][DU]She received an award for being the best student in the grade.|她因成为年级最佳学生而获得了奖项。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/award.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To give someone a prize for their good work, skill, or achievement[/EN][CN]授予；颁发；奖励[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The school awarded him a medal for his bravery.|学校因他的勇敢授予他一枚奖牌。[/DU][DU]The judge awarded the first prize to the little painter.|评委把一等奖颁发给了这位小画家。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]win an award|获奖[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Many children win awards for their crafts and poems during Ramadan.|许多孩子在斋月期间因他们的手工和诗歌获奖。[/EX][C]get an award|获得奖项[/C][C]receive an award|领取奖项[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]award a prize|颁发奖品[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The teacher awarded a book as a prize to the student who read the most poems.|老师把一本书作为奖品颁发给了读诗最多的学生。[/EX][C]award a medal|授予奖牌[/C][C]award a scholarship|颁发奖学金[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]music award|音乐奖项[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]He dreamed of winning a music award when he grew up.|他梦想长大后赢得音乐奖项。[/EX][C]art award|艺术奖项[/C][C]academic award|学术奖项[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The film won three awards at the movie festival.|这部电影在电影节上赢得了三项大奖。[/EX][EX]The city awarded her a certificate for her volunteer work.|这座城市因她的志愿工作授予她一份证书。[/EX][EX]His hard work helped him win the science award.|他的努力工作帮助他赢得了科学奖项。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]award作动词时，常用搭配为award sb sth或award sth to sb，不可说award sb with sth（错误），正确：award him a prize/award a prize to him。[/ERR][ERR]award是可数名词，复数形式为awards，直接加s，不要写成awardes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆award和reward，award侧重“因成就而授予的奖项”，reward侧重“因付出而获得的报酬或回报”，错误：a reward for his good grades，正确：an award for his good grades。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Something given or received in return for good behavior, hard work, or helping others (未在Level F书籍中明确出现，以下为日常高频义)[/EN][CN]报酬；回报；奖励（因良好行为、努力工作或帮助他人而获得的东西）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/rɪˈwɔːd/（英美）[/PH][DU]She got a small reward for helping the old man cross the street.|她因帮助老人过马路而得到了一份小奖励。[/DU][DU]Hard work always brings good rewards in the end.|努力工作最终总会带来好的回报。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/reward.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To give someone something in return for their good behavior, hard work, or help[/EN][CN]奖励；奖赏；给以报酬[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Mom rewarded me with a trip to the zoo for finishing my homework on time.|妈妈因我按时完成作业，奖励我去动物园玩。[/DU][DU]The company rewarded its best employees with a bonus.|公司给业绩最好的员工发放了奖金作为奖励。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]get a reward|得到奖励[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The boy got a reward for finding the lost dog.|这个男孩因找到丢失的狗而得到了奖励。[/EX][C]offer a reward|提供报酬[/C][C]deserve a reward|值得奖励[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]reward sb for sth|因某事奖励某人[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Dad rewarded me for cleaning my room by letting me play games.|爸爸因我打扫了房间，允许我玩游戏作为奖励。[/EX][C]reward sb with sth|用某物奖励某人[/C][C]reward hard work|奖励努力工作[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]financial reward|金钱奖励[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The store offers a financial reward for reporting shoplifters.|这家商店为举报入店行窃者提供金钱奖励。[/EX][C]small reward|小奖励[/C][C]great reward|丰厚的回报[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The greatest reward of volunteering is the happiness you bring to others.|志愿工作最大的回报是你带给他人的快乐。[/EX][EX]She rewarded her cat with a snack for catching the mouse.|她用零食奖励了抓老鼠的猫。[/EX][EX]There is no reward for being lazy—you have to work hard to get what you want.|懒惰没有回报，你必须努力才能得到想要的东西。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]reward作动词时，常用搭配为reward sb for sth，不可说reward sb sth（错误），正确：reward her for her kindness。[/ERR][ERR]reward是可数名词，复数形式为rewards，直接加s，不要写成rewardes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆reward和award，reward侧重“因付出（帮助、努力）而得的回报”，award侧重“因成就（成绩、技能）而授的奖项”，错误：an award for helping others，正确：a reward for helping others。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To get or be given something (used in Ramadan Is Here Level F, referring to getting gifts after Ramadan)[/EN][CN]收到；接到；得到（获得或被给予某物，出自《Ramadan Is Here》Level F，指斋月结束后收到礼物）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/rɪˈsiːv/（英美）[/PH][DU]When Ramadan is over, we give and receive gifts.|(原文例句) 斋月结束后，我们互赠礼物。[/DU][DU]I received a birthday card from my best friend yesterday.|我昨天收到了最好的朋友寄来的生日贺卡。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/receive.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To welcome or accept someone or something[/EN][CN]接待；接纳；接受[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The hotel receives hundreds of guests every weekend.|这家酒店每个周末接待数百名客人。[/DU][DU]She received the invitation to the party and decided to go.|她接受了派对邀请，决定参加。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]receive a gift|收到礼物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Children receive gifts from their family and friends during Ramadan.|孩子们在斋月期间收到家人和朋友送的礼物。[/EX][C]receive a letter|收到信件[/C][C]receive an email|收到邮件[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]receive guests|接待客人[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]My mom receives guests in the living room when they come to visit.|客人来访时，我妈妈在客厅接待他们。[/EX][C]receive visitors|接待访客[/C][C]receive a warm welcome|受到热烈欢迎[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]receive sth from sb|从某人那里收到某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He received a lot of support from his classmates when he was ill.|他生病时收到了同学们的很多支持。[/EX][C]receive help from others|得到他人的帮助[/C][C]receive advice from a teacher|得到老师的建议[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Did you receive the package I sent you last week?|你收到我上周寄给你的包裹了吗？[/EX][EX]The team received a trophy for winning the competition.|这支队伍因赢得比赛而获得了奖杯。[/EX][EX]She was happy to receive a compliment on her new dress.|她收到对她新裙子的赞美，非常开心。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]receive的拼写容易出错，注意中间是“ei”，不是“ie”，错误：recieve，正确：receive（口诀：i before e except after c，但receive是例外）。[/ERR][ERR]receive是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词for，错误：receive for the gift，正确：receive the gift。[/ERR][ERR]receive的过去式和过去分词为received，直接加ed，不要写成receeved。[/ERR]

Level F, listed as a Brazilian animal)[/EN][CN]龙虾（一种有硬壳、爪子和长身体的海洋动物，生活在巴西附近海域，出自《Are You From Brazil?》Level F，被列为巴西的动物之一）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈlɒbstə(r)/（英式）/ˈlɑːbstər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Lobster is a sea animal that lives in the ocean near Brazil.|龙虾是一种生活在巴西附近海域的海洋动物。[/DU][DU]We ate grilled lobster for dinner at the seaside restaurant.|我们在海滨餐厅吃了烤龙虾当晚餐。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/lobster.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A type of mollusk with a small, smooth, spotted shell (used in Seashells Level F, referring to a shell-bearing mollusk)[/EN][CN]宝贝螺；子安贝（一种有小巧、光滑且带斑点贝壳的软体动物，出自《Seashells》Level F，指带壳的软体动物之一）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkaʊri/（英美）[/PH][DU]The cowrie is a mollusk with a spotted shell.|宝贝螺是一种带有斑点贝壳的软体动物。[/DU][DU]People used to use cowrie shells as money in some ancient cultures.|在一些古代文化中，人们曾用宝贝螺的贝壳当钱。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/cowrie.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]cowrie的复数形式为cowries，变y为i加es，不要写成cowrys或cowriees。[/ERR][ERR]不要把cowrie发音为/ˈkaʊəri/，正确发音为/ˈkaʊri/，注意中间没有额外的元音。[/ERR][ERR]cowrie是“宝贝螺”，属于软体动物，不要误认为是“贝壳”本身，错误：a pretty cowrie，正确：a pretty cowrie shell（指贝壳）/a small cowrie（指动物）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A type of mollusk with two fan-shaped shells (used in Seashells Level F, one of the shell-bearing mollusks)[/EN][CN]扇贝（一种有两个扇形贝壳的软体动物，出自《Seashells》Level F，是带壳软体动物之一）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈskɒləp/（英式）/ˈskæləp/（美式）[/PH][DU]Scallops are mollusks that live in the ocean with fan-shaped shells.|扇贝是生活在海洋里、长有扇形贝壳的软体动物。[/DU][DU]The chef cooked scallops with butter and garlic, and they tasted delicious.|厨师用黄油和大蒜做了扇贝，味道非常美味。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/scallop.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To decorate the edge of something with curved cuts[/EN][CN]（用弧形切口）装饰……的边缘[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She scalloped the edge of the tablecloth to make it look nicer.|她把桌布的边缘剪成扇形，让它看起来更漂亮。[/DU][DU]The tailor scalloped the hem of the dress for a lovely design.|裁缝把裙子的下摆做成扇形，设计很可爱。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]scallop作名词“扇贝”时，复数形式为scallops，直接加s，不要写成scallopes。[/ERR][ERR]scallop作动词时，过去式和过去分词为scalloped，双写p加ed，不要写成scallopied。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆scallop和shell，scallop是“扇贝（动物）”，shell是“贝壳”，错误：I found a scallop on the beach，正确：I found a scallop shell on the beach（指贝壳）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A large sea snail with a spiral shell (used in Seashells Level F, a mollusk with a spiral shell)[/EN][CN]海螺；凤螺（一种有螺旋形贝壳的大型海蜗牛，出自《Seashells》Level F，是带螺旋形贝壳的软体动物）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/kɒntʃ/（英式）/kɑːntʃ/（美式）[/PH][DU]The conch is a large mollusk with a beautiful spiral shell.|海螺是一种带有漂亮螺旋形贝壳的大型软体动物。[/DU][DU]He blew the conch shell to call his friends to gather.|他吹海螺壳呼唤朋友们集合。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/conch.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A thin sheet or coating of something [/EN][CN]层；层次；薄层（某物的薄片或涂层）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈleɪə(r)/（英美）[/PH][DU]The cake has three layers of cream between the sponge.|这个蛋糕的海绵层之间有三层奶油。[/DU][DU]The ground was covered with a thin layer of snow in the morning.|早上地面覆盖着一层薄薄的雪。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/layer.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To cover or coat something with a thin sheet of a substance[/EN][CN]把…分层堆放；给…涂层[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She layered the salad with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.|她把生菜、西红柿和奶酪分层做成沙拉。[/DU][DU]The artist layered paint on the canvas to create depth.|艺术家在画布上分层涂漆以营造层次感。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]layer of sth|某物的一层[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a layer of dust on the old bookshelf.|旧书架上有一层灰尘。[/EX][C]thin layer|薄层[/C][C]thick layer|厚层[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]layer up|分层穿着（保暖）[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to layer up with sweaters and coats in winter.|冬天我们需要分层穿毛衣和外套保暖。[/EX][C]layer with|用…涂层[/C][C]layer together|分层组合[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]different layers|不同层次[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The earth has different layers, including the crust and mantle.|地球有不同的层次，包括地壳和地幔。[/EX][C]outer layer|外层[/C][C]inner layer|内层[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The fog formed a thick layer over the lake, making it hard to see.|雾在湖面上形成了一层厚层，让人难以看清。[/EX][EX]She layered the lasagna with pasta, sauce, and meat.|她把千层面用意大利面、酱汁和肉分层叠加。[/EX][EX]The scientist studied the layers of rock to learn about ancient times.|科学家研究岩层以了解古代的情况。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]layer是可数名词，复数形式为layers，直接加s，不要写成layeres。[/ERR][ERR]layer作动词时，是及物动词，可直接接宾语，错误：layer on the paint，正确：layer the paint on the wall（需明确宾语位置）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆layer和level，layer指“物理层面”，level指“等级、水平”，错误：a level of paint，正确：a layer of paint。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To find or discover something that was hidden or not known before (used in A Look at Fossils Level F, referring to finding fossilized bones)[/EN][CN]发掘；发现（隐藏或未知的事物，出自《A Look at Fossils》Level F，指发现化石骨骼）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ʌnˈkʌvə(r)/（英美）[/PH][DU]Bone fossils are uncovered after layers of rock are removed.|(原文衍生例句) 移除岩层后，骨骼化石被发掘出来。[/DU][DU]Scientists uncover new fossils to learn about ancient living things.|科学家发掘新的化石，以了解古代生物。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/uncover1.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To remove a cover from something; to make something visible[/EN][CN]揭开；揭露；使显露[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She uncovered the bowl and found a plate of fresh fruit.|她揭开碗盖，发现一盘新鲜水果。[/DU][DU]The journalist uncovered the truth about the secret project.|记者揭露了这个秘密项目的真相。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]uncover fossils|发掘化石[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Archaeologists travel to deserts to uncover fossils of dinosaurs.|考古学家前往沙漠发掘恐龙化石。[/EX][C]uncover secrets|揭露秘密[/C][C]uncover evidence|发现证据[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]uncover the truth|揭露真相[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The detective worked hard to uncover the truth behind the mystery.|侦探努力揭开谜团背后的真相。[/EX][C]uncover a lie|揭穿谎言[/C][C]uncover a plot|发现阴谋[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]uncover sth from|从…中发掘/揭露某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]They uncovered a old coin from the soil in the garden.|他们从花园的泥土中发掘出一枚古币。[/EX][C]uncover sth by|通过…揭露某物[/C][C]uncover sth accidentally|偶然发现某物[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The students uncovered the box to see what was inside their science project.|学生们揭开盒子，看看他们的科学项目里有什么。[/EX][EX]After years of research, the team uncovered the cause of the disease.|经过多年研究，该团队发现了这种疾病的病因。[/EX][EX]He uncovered the painting and was surprised by its beauty.|他揭开画作，被它的美丽惊呆了。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]uncover是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词，错误：uncover about the secret，正确：uncover the secret。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆uncover和discover，uncover侧重“揭开覆盖物或揭露隐藏的事物”，discover侧重“发现原本存在但未被人知晓的事物”，错误：discover the covered box，正确：uncover the covered box。[/ERR][ERR]uncover的过去式和过去分词为uncovered，双写c加ed，不要写成uncoverred。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A small or specific part of something (used in A Look at Fossils Level F, referring to small features shown by fossils)[/EN][CN]细节；详情；细微特征（某物的细小或特定部分，出自《A Look at Fossils》Level F，指化石所显示的细微特征）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/ˈdiːteɪl/（英美，名词）/dɪˈteɪl/（英美，动词）[/PH][DU]This fossil shows details of ancient plant leaves.|(原文衍生例句) 这块化石显示了古代植物叶子的细微特征。[/DU][DU]We need to look at every detail of the footprint fossil to learn about the animal.|我们需要观察足迹化石的每个细节，以了解这种动物。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/detail1.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To describe something completely, including all the small parts[/EN][CN]详细描述；详述[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She detailed her trip to the museum, telling us about every fossil she saw.|她详细描述了去博物馆的行程，告诉我们她看到的每一块化石。[/DU][DU]The teacher detailed the steps to complete the science project.|老师详细说明了完成科学项目的步骤。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]small details|小细节[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Don’t forget the small details when drawing the fossil.|画化石时不要忘记小细节。[/EX][C]important details|重要详情[/C][C]specific details|具体细节[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in detail|详细地[POS]adv.[/POS][/H][EX]The scientist explained how fossils form in detail.|科学家详细解释了化石是如何形成的。[/EX][C]go into detail|深入详述[/C][C]provide details|提供详情[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]detail sth to sb|向某人详细描述某物[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He detailed the features of the shell fossil to his classmates.|他向同学们详细描述了贝壳化石的特征。[/EX][C]detail the process|详述过程[/C][C]detail the plan|详细说明计划[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The book includes many details about different types of fossils.|这本书包含了许多关于不同类型化石的细节。[/EX][EX]Can you detail how you found the interesting rock in the park?|你能详细说说你是如何在公园里发现这块有趣的石头的吗？[/EX][EX]Paying attention to details helps you do better in your homework.|关注细节能帮助你在作业中表现得更好。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]detail作名词时，复数形式为details，直接加s，不要写成detailes。[/ERR][ERR]detail的名词发音/ˈdiːteɪl/与动词发音/dɪˈteɪl/重音位置不同，注意区分，不要混淆发音。[/ERR][ERR]表示“详细地”时，固定短语为in detail，错误：in details，正确：in detail。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Solid waste from animals or humans (used in A Look at Fossils Level F, referring to fossilized animal waste)[/EN][CN]粪便；排泄物（动物或人类的固体废弃物，出自《A Look at Fossils》Level F，指动物的化石粪便）[/CN][POS]n./v.[/POS][PH]/puːp/（英美）[/PH][DU]This fossil shows poop from an ancient animal.|(原文例句) 这块化石显示的是一种古代动物的粪便。[/DU][DU]Scientists study fossil poop to learn what ancient animals ate.|科学家研究化石粪便，以了解古代动物的食物。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/poop.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To pass solid waste from the body[/EN][CN]排便；拉屎[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The dog pooped on the grass in the park.|小狗在公园的草地上拉了屎。[/DU][DU]Cats usually poop in a litter box to keep clean.|猫通常在猫砂盆里排便，以保持干净。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]animal poop|动物粪便[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Farmers use animal poop as fertilizer for plants.|农民用动物粪便作为植物的肥料。[/EX][C]fossil poop|化石粪便[/C][C]dog poop|狗屎[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]poop on|在…上排便[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The bird pooped on the car window while we were eating.|我们吃饭的时候，一只鸟在车窗上拉了屎。[/EX][C]poop in|在…里排便[/C][C]poop outside|在外面排便[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]clean up poop|清理粪便[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Mom asked me to clean up the dog’s poop in the yard.|妈妈让我清理院子里小狗的粪便。[/EX][C]scoop poop|铲粪便[/C][C]avoid stepping on poop|避免踩到粪便[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The zookeeper cleans the animal cages and removes poop every morning.|动物园管理员每天早上清理动物笼子，清除粪便。[/EX][EX]Baby elephants poop a lot because they eat a lot of plants.|小象拉很多屎，因为它们吃很多植物。[/EX][EX]Fossil poop is called coprolite by scientists.|科学家把化石粪便称为粪化石。[/EX]
[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]poop是口语化词汇，正式场合常用feces（复数）或dung，避免在正式写作中过度使用poop。[/ERR][ERR]poop作名词时，复数形式为poops，直接加s，不要写成poopes。[/ERR][ERR]poop作动词时，过去式和过去分词为pooped，双写p加ed，不要写成pooped（正确），注意不要漏写p。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A person who travels, especially to different places (used in At the Airport Level F, referring to people who take planes)[/EN][CN]旅行者；旅客（旅行的人，尤指去不同地方的人，出自《At the Airport》Level F，指乘坐飞机的人）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈtrævələr/（美式）/ˈtrævələ(r)/（英式）[/PH][DU]Travelers park their cars in big parking lots at the airport.|(原文例句) 旅行者把车停在机场的大型停车场。[/DU][DU]Travelers wait to get on their planes at the airport gate.|旅行者在机场登机口等待登机。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/traveler.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A person who goes on a trip for pleasure or business[/EN][CN]旅行者；出行者（为休闲或公务出行的人）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]International travelers need to show their passports at the border.|国际旅行者需要在边境出示护照。[/DU][DU]Business travelers often stay in hotels near airports for convenience.|商务旅行者为了方便，经常住在机场附近的酒店。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]airport traveler|机场旅客[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Airport travelers should arrive early to go through security checks.|机场旅客应该早点到，以便通过安检。[/EX][C]international traveler|国际旅行者[/C][C]business traveler|商务旅行者[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]traveler's bag|旅行者的行李[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The traveler's bag was checked by the airline staff.|旅行者的行李被航空公司工作人员检查了。[/EX][C]traveler's passport|旅行者的护照[/C][C]traveler's guide|旅行指南[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]a group of travelers|一群旅行者[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A group of travelers took photos together at the airport.|一群旅行者在机场一起拍照。[/EX][C]solo traveler|独自旅行者[/C][C]family travelers|家庭旅行者[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The traveler asked the airport staff for directions to the boarding gate.|这位旅行者向机场工作人员询问登机口的方向。[/EX][EX]Travelers from different countries can learn about each other's cultures.|来自不同国家的旅行者可以了解彼此的文化。[/EX][EX]She is a frequent traveler who visits five countries every year.|她是一位频繁出行的旅行者，每年访问五个国家。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]traveler的拼写：美式为traveler（单l），英式为traveller（双l），两种形式均可，不要写成traveler（美式正确）或travler（漏写l）。[/ERR][ERR]traveler是可数名词，复数形式为travelers（美式）/travellers（英式），不要写成traveleres。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆traveler和tourist，traveler泛指“旅行者”，tourist特指“游客”（以观光为目的），错误：a tourist on a business trip，正确：a traveler on a business trip。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A company that provides regular flights to carry passengers or goods (used in At the Airport Level F, referring to companies that operate planes)[/EN][CN]航空公司（提供定期航班运送旅客或货物的公司，出自《At the Airport》Level F，指运营飞机的公司）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈeəlaɪn/（英式）/ˈerlaɪn/（美式）[/PH][DU]Travelers stand in line to check in with their airline at the airport.|(原文例句) 旅行者在机场排队向他们的航空公司办理登机手续。[/DU][DU]The airline announced that the flight was delayed due to bad weather.|航空公司宣布航班因天气恶劣而延误。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/airline.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]The planes and services provided by such a company[/EN][CN]（某航空公司的）飞机；航班服务[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]We enjoyed the comfortable seats and good food on the airline.|我们喜欢这家航空公司舒适的座位和美味的食物。[/DU][DU]The airline offers free snacks and drinks during the flight.|这家航空公司在飞行期间提供免费的零食和饮料。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]airline ticket|机票[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]I bought an airline ticket to visit my grandma during the holiday.|我买了一张机票，打算假期去看望奶奶。[/EX][C]airline staff|航空公司工作人员[/C][C]airline company|航空公司[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]international airline|国际航空公司[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]This international airline flies to over 50 countries around the world.|这家国际航空公司飞往全球50多个国家。[/EX][C]domestic airline|国内航空公司[/C][C]low-cost airline|廉价航空公司[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]check in with the airline|向航空公司办理登机手续[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]You need to show your ID when checking in with the airline.|向航空公司办理登机手续时，你需要出示身份证。[/EX][C]book with an airline|向航空公司预订[/C][C]complain to the airline|向航空公司投诉[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The airline changed our flight to an earlier time, so we had to hurry to the airport.|航空公司把我们的航班改成了更早的时间，所以我们不得不匆忙赶往机场。[/EX][EX]My dad works for a big airline as a pilot.|我爸爸在一家大型航空公司当飞行员。[/EX][EX]The airline provides special services for children traveling alone.|这家航空公司为独自旅行的儿童提供特殊服务。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]airline是可数名词，复数形式为airlines，直接加s，不要写成airlinees。[/ERR][ERR]表示“乘坐某航空公司的航班”，常用介词on，错误：by the airline，正确：on the airline 或 take the airline's flight。[/ERR][ERR]发音时注意英式/ˈeəlaɪn/与美式/ˈerlaɪn/的区别，不要读成/ˈeɪlaɪn/。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To give something to someone else, especially because they have the right to it or need it (used in At the Airport Level F, referring to travelers giving bags to airline staff)[/EN][CN]交出；移交；交给（把某物给别人，尤指因为对方有权拥有或需要它，出自《At the Airport》Level F，指旅行者把行李交给航空公司工作人员）[/CN][POS]v. 短语[/POS][PH]/hænd ˈəʊvə(r)/（英式）/hænd ˈoʊvər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Travelers hand over their large bags at the airport check-in counter.|(原文衍生例句) 旅行者在机场值机柜台交出他们的大件行李。[/DU][DU]You need to hand over your passport to the customs officer for inspection.|你需要把护照交给海关官员检查。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/handover.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To give control or responsibility of something to someone else[/EN][CN]移交（控制权或责任）[/CN][POS]v. 短语[/POS][DU]The manager handed over the project to her team before going on vacation.|经理度假前把项目移交给了她的团队。[/DU][DU]He handed over the keys to the new owner of the house.|他把钥匙交给了房子的新主人。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]hand over sth to sb|把某物交给某人[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]She handed over the lost wallet to the police officer.|她把捡到的钱包交给了警察。[/EX][C]hand over the bags|交出行李[/C][C]hand over the documents|交出文件[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]hand over control|移交控制权[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The company decided to hand over control of the branch to a local manager.|公司决定把分公司的控制权移交给当地经理。[/EX][C]hand over responsibility|移交责任[/C][C]hand over power|移交权力[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]refuse to hand over|拒绝交出[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The thief refused to hand over the stolen phone to the security guard.|小偷拒绝把偷来的手机交给保安。[/EX][C]agree to hand over|同意交出[/C][C]order to hand over|命令交出[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]Before leaving the classroom, students should hand over their homework to the teacher.|离开教室前，学生应该把作业交给老师。[/EX][EX]The old man handed over his savings to his son to help him buy a house.|老人把积蓄交给儿子，帮他买房。[/EX][EX]The witness was asked to hand over the video evidence to the court.|证人被要求把视频证据交给法庭。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]hand over是动词短语，宾语位置：代词宾语放中间（hand it over），名词宾语可放中间或后面（hand the bag over / hand over the bag），错误：hand over it，正确：hand it over。[/ERR][ERR]不要遗漏over，错误：hand the document to sb（仅“递给”，无“移交”含义），正确：hand over the document to sb（强调“正式移交”）。[/ERR][ERR]hand over的过去式和过去分词为handed over，双写d加ed，不要写成hand overed。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A flat, moving surface in airports or train stations that carries people from one place to another (used in At the Airport Level F, referring to a tool for travelers to move faster)[/EN][CN]自动人行道；移动步道（机场或火车站里的平坦移动表面，载运人们从一个地方到另一个地方，出自《At the Airport》Level F，指旅行者快速移动的工具）[/CN][POS]n. 短语（可数）[/POS][PH]/ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈsaɪdwɔːk/（英式）/ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈsaɪdwɔːrk/（美式）[/PH][DU]Travelers ride on moving sidewalks to get around faster at the airport.|(原文例句) 旅行者在机场乘坐自动人行道以更快地移动。[/DU][DU]The moving sidewalk helps elderly travelers walk from the parking lot to the terminal.|自动人行道帮助老年旅行者从停车场走到航站楼。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/movingsidewalk.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A motorized conveyor belt designed for transporting pedestrians, also called a travelator[/EN][CN]自动人行道；电动步道（专为运送行人设计的机动传送带，也称为travelator）[/CN][POS]n. 短语（可数）[/POS][DU]Many large shopping malls also have moving sidewalks to make shopping easier.|许多大型购物中心也有自动人行道，让购物更方便。[/DU][DU]You should stand on the right side of the moving sidewalk to let others walk past.|你应该站在自动人行道的右侧，让别人从旁边走过。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]ride on a moving sidewalk|乘坐自动人行道[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]My little sister likes to ride on the moving sidewalk back and forth at the airport.|我妹妹喜欢在机场的自动人行道上往返乘坐。[/EX][C]get on a moving sidewalk|上自动人行道[/C][C]get off a moving sidewalk|下自动人行道[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]airport moving sidewalk|机场自动人行道[POS]n. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The airport moving sidewalk connects the arrival area to the baggage claim.|机场自动人行道连接到达区和行李提取处。[/EX][C]mall moving sidewalk|商场自动人行道[/C][C]long moving sidewalk|长自动人行道[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]move faster on a moving sidewalk|在自动人行道上更快移动[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]We can move faster on the moving sidewalk and save time for boarding.|我们可以在自动人行道上更快移动，节省登机时间。[/EX][C]walk on a moving sidewalk|在自动人行道上行走[/C][C]stand still on a moving sidewalk|在自动人行道上站着不动[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The moving sidewalk in the train station is broken, so we have to walk to the platform.|火车站的自动人行道坏了，所以我们不得不走到站台。[/EX][EX]Parents should hold their children's hands when on the moving sidewalk to keep them safe.|家长在自动人行道上应该拉住孩子的手，确保他们的安全。[/EX][EX]The sign says “Do not run on the moving sidewalk” for safety reasons.|出于安全考虑，指示牌上写着“请勿在自动人行道上奔跑”。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]moving sidewalk是复合名词，复数形式为moving sidewalks，仅sidewalk变复数，不要写成movings sidewalks或moving sidewalkes。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆moving sidewalk和elevator/escalator，moving sidewalk是“水平移动的自动步道”，elevator是“电梯（垂直移动）”，escalator是“自动扶梯（倾斜移动）”，错误：take the elevator to the other terminal，正确：take the moving sidewalk to the other terminal。[/ERR][ERR]美式英语中sidewalk为“人行道”，英式英语中为pavement，但moving sidewalk为通用表达，不要写成moving pavement。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A journey made by plane (used in At the Airport Level F, referring to a trip on an airplane)[/EN][CN]航班；飞行旅程（乘飞机进行的旅行，出自《At the Airport》Level F，指乘飞机的行程）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/flaɪt/（英美）[/PH][DU]Travelers buy food and magazines before their flights at the airport.|(原文例句) 旅行者在机场航班起飞前购买食物和杂志。[/DU][DU]Our flight to New York will leave at 3 o'clock in the afternoon.|我们飞往纽约的航班将于下午3点起飞。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/flight.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]The act of flying, or a way of flying[/EN][CN]飞行；飞行方式[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The bird's flight over the ocean was long and tiring.|这只鸟飞越海洋的飞行漫长而疲惫。[/DU][DU]The pilot has many years of flight experience.|这位飞行员有多年的飞行经验。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]A sudden and hurried escape from a place[/EN][CN]逃跑；逃走[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The rabbit made a quick flight into its hole when it saw the dog.|兔子看到狗时，迅速逃进了洞里。[/DU][DU]The thief took flight when he heard the police siren.|小偷听到警笛声就逃跑了。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]take a flight|乘坐航班[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to take an early flight to arrive at the meeting on time.|我们需要乘坐早班机，以便准时参加会议。[/EX][C]catch a flight|赶航班[/C][C]miss a flight|错过航班[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]flight number|航班号[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Can you tell me the flight number so I can check if it's on time?|你能告诉我航班号吗？我可以查一下是否准点。[/EX][C]flight attendant|空乘人员[/C][C]flight delay|航班延误[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in flight|在飞行中[POS]adv.[/POS][/H][EX]Passengers should fasten their seatbelts during the flight.|乘客在飞行过程中应系好安全带。[/EX][C]during the flight|飞行期间[/C][C]after the flight|飞行后[/C][/COLL]
