[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The poem celebrates the beauty of liberty and the courage of those who defend it.|这首诗赞颂了自由的美好和捍卫自由者的勇气。[/EX][EX]Children should be given the liberty to express their own ideas freely.|应该给予孩子们自由表达自己想法的权利。[/EX][EX]Liberty is not absolute—we must respect the rights of others while enjoying our own.|自由不是绝对的，我们在享受自由的同时必须尊重他人的权利。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]liberty是不可数名词，通常不用于复数形式（特殊固定搭配除外），错误：liberties（表示“特权；自由权”时可复数，但日常“自由”义不可数），正确：enjoy liberty。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆liberty和freedom，liberty侧重“不受权威干涉的自由”，freedom侧重“广义的自由”，错误：freedom of the Statue，正确：liberty represented by the Statue of Liberty。[/ERR][ERR]固定搭配“Statue of Liberty”中，Liberty首字母必须大写，不可小写（错误：Statue of liberty）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A building, statue, or place built to remember a person or event (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to the Lincoln Memorial as a U.S. symbol)[/EN][CN]纪念碑；纪念堂；纪念馆（为纪念某人或某事而建造的建筑、雕像或场所，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指作为美国象征的林肯纪念堂）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/məˈmɔːriəl/（英美）[/PH][DU]The Lincoln Memorial is a famous memorial to President Abraham Lincoln.|(原文衍生例句) 林肯纪念堂是纪念亚伯拉罕·林肯总统的著名建筑。[/DU][DU]The bald eagle’s image can be seen on memorials and public buildings in the United States.|在美国的纪念馆和公共建筑上可以看到白头海雕的形象。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/memorial.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A service or ceremony held to remember someone who has died[/EN][CN]追悼会；纪念仪式（为缅怀逝者而举行的仪式）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]We attended a memorial for the brave firefighter who saved many lives.|我们参加了那位拯救了许多生命的勇敢消防员的追悼会。[/DU][DU]The school held a special memorial to honor the teacher who retired after 30 years.|学校举行了一场特别的纪念仪式，向任教30年退休的老师致敬。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]Lincoln Memorial|林肯纪念堂[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]My family visited the Lincoln Memorial during our trip to Washington D.C.|我们一家去华盛顿特区旅行时参观了林肯纪念堂。[/EX][C]war memorial|战争纪念碑[/C][C]memorial statue|纪念雕像[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]memorial to sb|纪念某人的建筑/仪式[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a small memorial to the soldiers who died in the village.|村里有一座纪念阵亡士兵的小纪念碑。[/EX][C]memorial for sb|为某人举行的纪念仪式[/C][C]memorial service|追悼会[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]build a memorial|建造纪念碑[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The town decided to build a memorial to remember the flood victims.|这个城镇决定建造一座纪念碑，缅怀洪灾遇难者。[/EX][C]visit a memorial|参观纪念馆[/C][C]hold a memorial|举行纪念仪式[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The memorial has an inscription that tells the story of the hero’s deeds.|这座纪念碑上有铭文，讲述了这位英雄的事迹。[/EX][EX]People lay flowers at the war memorial every year on Memorial Day.|每年阵亡将士纪念日，人们都会在战争纪念碑前献花。[/EX][EX]The museum has a special memorial exhibition about the history of the city.|这个博物馆有一个关于城市历史的特别纪念展览。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]memorial是可数名词，复数形式为memorials，直接加s，不要写成memoriales。[/ERR][ERR]表示“为纪念某人”时，常用介词to，错误：memorial of sb，正确：memorial to sb。[/ERR][ERR]发音时注意重音在第二个音节，不要读成/ˈmeməriəl/，正确发音为/məˈmɔːriəl/。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To represent or symbolize something (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to what the bald eagle symbolizes)[/EN][CN]代表；象征（表示某物的意义或象征，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指白头海雕所象征的意义）[/CN][POS]v. 短语[/POS][PH]/stænd fɔː(r)/（英美）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle stands for the strength and freedom of the United States.|(原文衍生例句) 白头海雕代表着美国的力量和自由。[/DU][DU]The color red in the flag stands for courage and loyalty.|旗帜中的红色代表勇气和忠诚。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/standfor.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To support or agree with a belief or idea[/EN][CN]支持；拥护（赞同某种信仰或观点）[/CN][POS]v. 短语[/POS][DU]My parents stand for honesty and kindness in daily life.|我的父母在日常生活中崇尚诚实和善良。[/DU][DU]We stand for equal rights for all people, regardless of their background.|我们支持所有人享有平等权利，无论其背景如何。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]To tolerate or endure something (informal)[/EN][CN]容忍；忍受（非正式用法）[/CN][POS]v. 短语[/POS][DU]I can’t stand for people who are rude to others.|我无法容忍对别人粗鲁的人。[/DU][DU]She won’t stand for laziness in her class.|她不允许班上出现懒惰的情况。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]stand for strength|代表力量[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The lion stands for strength and courage in many cultures.|在许多文化中，狮子代表力量和勇气。[/EX][C]stand for freedom|象征自由[/C][C]stand for justice|代表正义[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]stand for an idea|拥护一种理念[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]Many people stand for the idea of protecting the environment.|许多人拥护保护环境的理念。[/EX][C]stand for equal rights|支持平等权利[/C][C]stand for honesty|崇尚诚实[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]can’t stand for|无法容忍[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]Teachers can’t stand for cheating in exams.|老师无法容忍考试作弊的行为。[/EX][C]won’t stand for|不允许[/C][C]refuse to stand for|拒绝忍受[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]What does the star on the logo stand for? Is it hope or success?|标志上的星星代表什么？是希望还是成功？[/EX][EX]Our school motto stands for hard work and mutual respect.|我们的校训代表着勤奋和相互尊重。[/EX][EX]He said he would stand for his friends no matter what happened.|他说无论发生什么，他都会支持他的朋友。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]stand for是动词短语，不可拆分使用，宾语需放在for后面，错误：stand it for（正确：stand for it）。[/ERR][ERR]表示“代表”时，不要与represent混淆，stand for更侧重“象征意义”，represent更侧重“代表某人/团体”，错误：He stands for our class in the meeting，正确：He represents our class in the meeting。[/ERR][ERR]stand for的过去式和过去分词为stood for，不要写成standed for（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Having no feathers on the head (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to the national bird of the United States with a white-feathered head)[/EN][CN]白头的；无羽的（头部没有羽毛的，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指美国国鸟白头海雕，头部有白色羽毛）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/bɔːld/（英美）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle is called “bald” because of its white head feathers.|(原文衍生例句) 白头海雕被称为“白头”，是因为它头部的白色羽毛。[/DU][DU]The bald eagle is a large bird with a bald head and sharp claws.|白头海雕是一种大型鸟类，头部无深色羽毛，爪子锋利。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/bald.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Having little or no hair on the head[/EN][CN]秃顶的；光头的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]My grandpa became bald when he was 50 years old.|我爷爷50岁时开始秃顶。[/DU][DU]Some men choose to keep their heads bald instead of growing hair.|有些男人选择留光头，而不是留头发。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]Having no covering or decoration[/EN][CN]光秃秃的；无装饰的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The bald mountain top was covered with snow in winter.|光秃秃的山顶在冬天被雪覆盖。[/DU][DU]The wall looks bald without any pictures or posters.|这面墙没有任何图片或海报，看起来光秃秃的。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]bald eagle|白头海雕[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The bald eagle is one of the most famous birds in North America.|白头海雕是北美最著名的鸟类之一。[/EX][C]bald head|光头；白头[/C][C]bald man|秃顶的男人[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]bald mountain|光秃秃的山[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]We climbed the bald mountain and enjoyed the beautiful view from the top.|我们爬上了那座光秃秃的山，欣赏了山顶的美景。[/EX][C]bald tree|无叶的树[/C][C]bald wall|无装饰的墙[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]go bald|变秃顶[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Many people worry about going bald as they get older.|很多人担心随着年龄增长会变秃顶。[/EX][C]keep bald|留光头[/C][C]look bald|看起来光秃秃的[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The old tree has become bald after losing all its leaves in autumn.|这棵老树在秋天掉光了叶子，变得光秃秃的。[/EX][EX]The bald eagle builds its nest on tall trees near rivers.|白头海雕在河边的高大树木上筑巢。[/EX][EX]He laughed and said he didn’t mind being bald—It made him look cool.|他笑着说自己不介意秃顶，这让他看起来很酷。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]bald的比较级和最高级为baldest（单音节词，直接加est），不要写成more bald、most bald（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆bald和bare，bald侧重“头部无发或物体无覆盖物”，bare侧重“表面无遮挡物”，错误：a bare eagle，正确：a bald eagle。[/ERR][ERR]固定搭配“bald eagle”中，bald首字母小写（专有名词中修饰词小写），不要写成Bald Eagle（错误，除非句首）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]The state of being free to act or live as you want (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to what the bald eagle stands for)[/EN][CN]自由；自主（能够按照自己的意愿行动或生活的状态，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指白头海雕所象征的意义）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈfriːdəm/（英美）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle stands for the freedom of the United States and its people.|(原文衍生例句) 白头海雕象征着美国及其人民的自由。[/DU][DU]People all over the world love freedom and peace.|全世界的人们都热爱自由与和平。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/freedom.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]The right to do what you want without being restricted by authority[/EN][CN]自由权（不受权威限制做某事的权利）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]Citizens have the freedom to speak their minds in a democratic country.|在民主国家，公民有言论自由的权利。[/DU][DU]The Constitution protects the basic freedoms of all Americans.|宪法保护所有美国人的基本自由权。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]personal freedom|人身自由[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We should respect the personal freedom of every individual.|我们应该尊重每个人的人身自由。[/EX][C]freedom of speech|言论自由[/C][C]freedom of choice|选择自由[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]fight for freedom|为自由而战[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]Many heroes fought bravely for the freedom of their country.|许多英雄为了国家的自由而英勇战斗。[/EX][C]enjoy freedom|享受自由[/C][C]defend freedom|捍卫自由[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]freedom to do sth|做某事的自由[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]Children have the freedom to play and explore the world around them.|孩子们有玩耍和探索周围世界的自由。[/EX][C]freedom of movement|行动自由[/C][C]freedom of thought|思想自由[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The poem expresses the poet’s longing for freedom and a better life.|这首诗表达了诗人对自由和美好生活的向往。[/EX][EX]After years of hard work, they finally gained the freedom to live in peace.|经过多年的努力，他们终于获得了和平生活的自由。[/EX][EX]Freedom comes with responsibility—we must not hurt others while exercising our freedom.|自由伴随着责任，我们在行使自由时不能伤害他人。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]freedom是不可数名词，通常不用于复数形式，错误：freedoms（表示“多种自由权”时可复数，但日常“自由”义不可数），正确：value freedom。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆freedom和liberty，freedom侧重“广义的自由”，liberty侧重“不受权威干涉的自由”，错误：liberty of speech（正确：freedom of speech）。[/ERR][ERR]表示“做某事的自由”时，常用介词to，错误：freedom of doing sth，正确：freedom to do sth。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]To bring people or things together to form a single group or unit (未在Level F书籍中明确出现，以下为日常高频义)[/EN][CN]联合；团结；统一（使人们或事物聚集在一起形成一个整体）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/juˈnaɪt/（英美）[/PH][DU]People from different countries unite to protect the environment.|来自不同国家的人们联合起来保护环境。[/DU][DU]The two small teams decided to unite and work on the project together.|这两个小团队决定团结起来，一起完成这个项目。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/unite.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To join together to achieve a common goal[/EN][CN]联手；联合（为实现共同目标而合作）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Schools and families must unite to help children grow up healthily.|学校和家庭必须联手，帮助孩子健康成长。[/DU][DU]The three companies united to develop new technology for renewable energy.|这三家公司联合起来，研发可再生能源新技术。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]unite people|团结人们[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]A common dream can unite people from all walks of life.|共同的梦想能团结各行各业的人们。[/EX][C]unite countries|联合国家[/C][C]unite teams|团结团队[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]unite for a goal|为目标而联合[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]All members of the community united for the goal of building a park.|社区所有成员为了建造公园的目标而联合起来。[/EX][C]unite against|联合反对[/C][C]unite to do sth|联合做某事[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]unite as one|团结一致[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]When facing difficulties, we should unite as one and support each other.|遇到困难时，我们应该团结一致，互相支持。[/EX][C]unite together|联合起来[/C][C]successfully unite|成功联合[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The festival is a time for families to unite and celebrate together.|这个节日是家人团聚庆祝的时刻。[/EX][EX]Music has the power to unite people regardless of language and culture.|音乐有跨越语言和文化、团结人们的力量。[/EX][EX]The organization aims to unite young people to volunteer for public welfare.|这个组织旨在团结年轻人参与公益志愿活动。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]unite是及物动词，直接接宾语，无需加介词，错误：unite with people（可加with，但日常直接接宾语更自然），正确：unite people。[/ERR][ERR]unite的过去式和过去分词为united，直接加ed，不要写成united（正确）或uniteed（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆unite和join，unite侧重“多个个体形成整体”，join侧重“加入已有团体”，错误：unite the club，正确：join the club。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A region of a country with its own government (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to state flags in the United States)[/EN][CN]州（国家的一个区域，有自己的政府，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指美国的州旗）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/steɪt/（英美）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle’s image can be seen on many state flags in the United States.|(原文衍生例句) 在美国许多州的州旗上都能看到白头海雕的形象。[/DU][DU]California is a famous state on the west coast of the United States.|加利福尼亚州是美国西海岸的一个著名州。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/state.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A country or nation[/EN][CN]国家；邦[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The two states signed a peace agreement to promote trade and cooperation.|这两个国家签署了和平协议，促进贸易与合作。[/DU][DU]Each state has the right to make its own laws within certain limits.|每个国家都有权在一定范围内制定自己的法律。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]The condition or situation of someone or something[/EN][CN]状态；状况[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The doctor checked the patient’s state of health carefully.|医生仔细检查了病人的健康状况。[/DU][DU]The old building is in a poor state and needs to be repaired soon.|这座老建筑状况不佳，需要尽快修缮。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]state flag|州旗[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We learned about different state flags during our social studies class.|我们在社会课上学习了不同的州旗。[/EX][C]state government|州政府[/C][C]state capital|州首府[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]member state|成员国[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]China is an important member state of the United Nations.|中国是联合国的重要成员国。[/EX][C]independent state|独立国家[/C][C]city-state|城邦[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]in a good state|状态良好[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The car is still in a good state after being used for five years.|这辆车使用了五年后仍然状态良好。[/EX][C]in a bad state|状况糟糕[/C][C]state of mind|心态[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The state of New York is known for its big cities like New York City.|纽约州以其纽约市等大城市而闻名。[/EX][EX]She was in a calm state of mind before the important exam.|重要考试前，她心态平静。[/EX][EX]The government is working to improve the state of the environment in rural areas.|政府正在努力改善农村地区的环境状况。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]state作“州、国家”讲时是可数名词，复数形式为states，直接加s，不要写成statees。[/ERR][ERR]表示“处于某种状态”时，常用介词in，错误：on a bad state，正确：in a bad state。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆state和country，state在美式英语中常指“州”，country指“国家”，错误：the United States country，正确：the United States（美国，由多个州组成）。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]A building where a city’s government works (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to public buildings with the bald eagle’s image)[/EN][CN]市政厅（城市政府办公的建筑，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指印有白头海雕形象的公共建筑）[/CN][POS]n. 短语（可数）[/POS][PH]/ˈsɪti hɔːl/（英式）/ˈsɪti hɔːl/（美式）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle’s symbol can be seen on city halls and other public buildings.|(原文衍生例句) 在市政厅和其他公共建筑上可以看到白头海雕的标志。[/DU][DU]We visited the city hall to learn about how the city is managed.|我们参观了市政厅，了解城市是如何管理的。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/cityhall.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]The government of a city, or the officials who work there[/EN][CN]市政当局；市政府官员[/CN][POS]n. 短语（不可数）[/POS][DU]The city hall decided to build a new park in the neighborhood.|市政当局决定在这个社区建造一个新公园。[/DU][DU]We can go to the city hall to ask for help with community problems.|我们可以去市政厅咨询社区问题的解决方案。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]visit the city hall|参观市政厅[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]Our class took a field trip to visit the city hall and meet the mayor.|我们班组织了实地考察，参观了市政厅并见到了市长。[/EX][C]work at the city hall|在市政厅工作[/C][C]near the city hall|在市政厅附近[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]city hall building|市政厅建筑[POS]n. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]The city hall building is a beautiful historic structure with a big clock tower.|市政厅建筑是一座美丽的历史建筑，带有一个大钟塔。[/EX][C]city hall square|市政厅广场[/C][C]city hall meeting|市政厅会议[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]ask the city hall|向市政当局咨询[POS]v. 短语[/POS][/H][EX]Residents asked the city hall to fix the broken roads in the area.|居民们要求市政当局修复该地区破损的道路。[/EX][C]contact the city hall|联系市政厅[/C][C]city hall officials|市政厅官员[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The city hall holds a public meeting every month to listen to citizens’ opinions.|市政厅每月举行一次公开会议，听取市民的意见。[/EX][EX]There is a big celebration in front of the city hall on National Day.|国庆节那天，市政厅前会举行盛大的庆祝活动。[/EX][EX]My dad went to the city hall to apply for a building permit.|我爸爸去市政厅申请建筑许可证。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]city hall是复合名词，复数形式为city halls（指多座市政厅建筑），仅hall变复数，不要写成cities halls或city halles。[/ERR][ERR]表示“在市政厅”时，常用介词at或in，错误：on the city hall，正确：at the city hall（强调地点）/in the city hall（强调在建筑内部）。[/ERR][ERR]city hall作“市政当局”讲时为不可数名词，不可加s，错误：the city halls decided，正确：the city hall decided。[/ERR]

[TITLE] 解释 [/TITLE][DEF][EN]Relating to a whole country or nation (used in The Bald Eagle Level F, referring to the national bird of the United States)[/EN][CN]国家的；全国性的；民族的（与整个国家或民族相关的，出自《The Bald Eagle》Level F，指美国的国鸟）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈnæʃnəl/（英美）[/PH][DU]The bald eagle is the national bird of the United States.|(原文例句) 白头海雕是美国的国鸟。[/DU][DU]We sang the national anthem at the beginning of the school assembly.|我们在学校集会开始时唱了国歌。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/national.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Belonging to or typical of a particular nation’s people[/EN][CN]民族的；国民的[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The museum displays national art and cultural relics from all over the country.|这个博物馆展示来自全国各地的民族艺术和文物。[/DU][DU]National pride is strong among the people of this country.|这个国家的人民有着强烈的民族自豪感。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE] 常见用法 [/TITLE][COLL][H]national bird|国鸟[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]Many countries have a national bird that represents their culture.|许多国家都有象征本国文化的国鸟。[/EX][C]national anthem|国歌[/C][C]national flag|国旗[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]national day|国庆节[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]People celebrate national day with parades and fireworks.|人们通过游行和烟花庆祝国庆节。[/EX][C]national park|国家公园[/C][C]national team|国家队[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]national culture|民族文化[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]We should learn and protect our national culture and traditions.|我们应该学习和保护我们的民族文化和传统。[/EX][C]national economy|国民经济[/C][C]national security|国家安全[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE] 额外例句 [/TITLE][EX]The national park is home to many rare animals and plants.|这个国家公园是许多珍稀动植物的家园。[/EX][EX]She won a gold medal as part of the national swimming team.|她作为国家游泳队的一员赢得了金牌。[/EX][EX]The national newspaper reports news from all parts of the country.|这份全国性报纸报道来自全国各地的新闻。[/EX]

[TITLE] 常见错误 [/TITLE][ERR]national是形容词，不可用作名词表示“国民”（错误：a national），正确：a citizen（公民）/a national citizen（国民）。[/ERR][ERR]固定搭配中首字母大写：National Day（国庆节）、National Anthem（国歌），错误：national day（小写）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆national和international，national指“国家的、全国的”，international指“国际的”，错误：an international bird，正确：a national bird。[/ERR]
